rh khsnykhh br ann n`mt ddy; nh khshm grftgn br anh; w nh gmrhn [mrd z 'an`amta `alayhim: nby, Sdyqyn, shhd w SlHyn hstnd, chnnkhh dr swrhy ns ayh 69 amdh st. w mrd z 'lmaGDuwbi `alayhim yhwd nd. mrd z gmrhn, nSry mybshd].
lf. lm. mym [ lf. lm. mym, Hrwf mqT`h hstnd khh dr wyl brkhy z swrhhy qran amdh st, khh m`ny anh r tnh llh mt`l mydnd. (tfsyr bn khthyr)].
yn khtby st khh hych shkhy dr an nyst w myh hdyt prhyzgrn st. [mrd z prhyzgrn khsnynd khh fqT z llh mt`l mytrsnd w Hkhm w r bhjy myawrnd w z chyzhy mn`shdh dwry myjwynd].

an khsnykhh bh Gyb ymn myawrnd w nmz r br p mydrnd w z anchh rwzyshn ddhym nfq mykhnnd. [mrd z Gyb, tmm an chyzhyy st khh `ql w Hws ntwnd an r dr dny drkh khnd mnnd: wjwd llh mt`l, frshtgn, Hyt b`d z mrg w Gyrh, w dr ynj mrd z ymn bh Gyb, yqyndshtn bh tmm an msyl mwry `ql w Hws khh llh w rswl m r z an khbr ddhnd mybshd mnnd: ymn bh llh mt`l, `tqd dshtn bh frshtgn, khtbhy asmny, pymbrn, rwz rstkhyz w qD w qdr.]
w ann khh bh anchh br tw nzl shdh w anchh (br pymbrn) pysh z tw nzl shdh, ymn myawrnd, w bh rwz rstkhyz yqyn drnd.
ann br hdyt z jnb prwrdgrshnnd w ann rstgrnnd.
khsnykhh khfr shdnd, bryshn ykhsn st khh ann r btrsny y ntrsny, ymn nmyawrnd.
llh br dlh w gwshhyshn mhr zdh st w br chshmhyshn prdhy st, w bry anh `dhb bzrgy st.
grwhy z mrdm hstnd khh mygwynd: bh llh w rwz rstkhyz ymn awrdhym, dr Hlykhh ymn ndrnd.
ann (bh nZrshn) llh w mw'mnn r fryb mydhnd, dr Hlykhh jz khwdshn r fryb nmydhnd wly nmyfhmnd.
dr dlhy ann bymry st w llh br bymry ann fzwdh, w bkhTr drwGhyy khh mygftnd, bryshn `dhb drdnkhy st.
w hngmykhh bh anh gfth shwd: <<dr zmyn fsd nkhnyd>> mygwynd: <<m fqT SlHkhnndhym>>.
agh bshyd! anh hmn mfsdnnd; wly nmyfhmnd.
w hngmykhh bh ann gfth shwd: <<ymn bywryd; chnnkhh mrdm ymn awrdhnd>> mygwynd: <<ay ymn bywrym chnnkhh bykhrdn ymn awrdnd?>> agh bshyd, anh hmn nbkhrdnnd; wly nmydnnd.
w hngmykhh frd b ymn r mlqt mykhnnd, mygwynd: <<m ymn awrdhym>>, w hngmykhh b shyTnhy khwd khlwt mykhnnd, mygwynd: <<m b shmyym, m fqT (anh r) mskhrh mykhnym>>.
llh ann r mskhrh mykhnd, w anh r dr TGynshn ngh mydrd t srgrdn shwnd.
ann khsny hstnd khh gmrhy r bh hdyt khrydnd, ps tjrt anh swdy ndd, w hdyt nyftnd.
dstn ynn hmnnd dstn khsy st khh atshy frwkhth ps chwn atsh Trf w r rwshn skht, llh nwrshn r bgrft w dr trykhyhyy khh nmybynnd rhyshn khrd.
khrnnd, gngnnd, khwrnnd, ps bz nmygrdnd.
y hmchwn brny st khh z asmn (frw ryzd) w dr an trykhyh w r`d w brq bshd, w anh z trs mrg, ngshtn khwd r dr gwshhyshn frw mybrnd t Sdy S`qh r nshnwnd, w llh bh khfrn HTh drd.

nzdykh st khh brq chshmnshn r brbyd, hr gh khh bry anh rwshn shwd dr (rwshny'y) an rh myrwnd w chwn trykh shwd (dr jy khwd) bystnd. w gr llh bkhwhd gwsh w chshmnshn r z byn mybrd, chr khh llh br hr chyz twn st.
y mrdm, prwrdgr khwd r prstsh khnyd, an khsykhh shm w khsny r khh pysh z shm bwdnd afryd, t prhyzgr shwyd.
an khskhh zmyn r bry shm bgstrd w asmn r hmchwn sqfy bly sr shm qrr dd. w z asmn aby frw frstd w bwsylhy an nw` mywhh r bwjwd awrd t rwzy shm bshd. bnbryn bry llh hmtyny qrr ndhyd, dr Hlykhh mydnyd.
w gr drbrhy anchh br bndh khwd (mHmd Sly llh `lyh w slm) nzl khrdhym; dr shkh w trdyd hstyd, swrhy hmnnd an bywryd w gwhn khwd r - Gyr z llh- fr khwnyd; gr rst mygwyyd.
ps gr chnyn nkhrdyd - w hrgz ntwnyd khrd- z atshy btrsyd khh hyzm an mrdm w sngh st, w bry khfrn amdh shdh st.

bh khsnykhh ymn awrdh, w khrhy shysth njm ddhnd mjdh dh khh bGhyy z bhsht bry anhst khh nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st. hr zmn khh mywhy z an bh ann ddh shwd gwynd: <<yn hmn st khh qblan bh m rwzy ddh shdh bwd>> w mywhhyy hmnnd awrdh shwd, w bry ann hmsrny pkhyzh st w jwdnh dr an khwhnd bwd.

bhrsty llh z ynkhh bh pshhy y bltr z an mthl bznd shrm nmykhnd. ann khh ymn awrdhnd mydnnd khh an (mthl) Hq st z Trf prwrdgrshn w m anhyy khh khfrnd mygwynd: llh z yn mthl chh khwsth st? llh bsyry r b an gmrh, w grwh bsyry r hdyt mykhnd, w tnh fsqn r b an gmrh myszd.
khsnykhh pymn llh r, ps z mHkhm skhtn an myshkhnnd, w anchh r khh llh dstwr ddh br qrr sznd, qT` nmwdh, w dr rwy zmyn fsd mykhnnd, ynh zynkhrnnd.
chgwnh bh llh khfr myshwyd? dr Hlykhh shm mrdgn bwdyd, w w shm r zndh khrd, sps shm r mymyrnd, sps shm r zndh mykhnd, angh bhswy w bz grdndh myshwyd.
w (llh) st khh hmh anchh r khh dr zmyn st bry shm afryd, angh ahng asmn khrd w anh r bhSwrt hft asmn mrtb nmwd, w w bh hr chyz agh st.

w (byd bywr) hngmy r khh prwrdgrt bh frshtgn gft: <<mn dr zmyn jnshyny qrr khwhm dd>>. gftnd: <<ay khsy r dr an qrr mydhy khh dr an fsd w khwnryzy khnd? m tsbyH w Hmd tw r bh j myawrym w tw r tqdys mykhnym>>. prwrdgr frmwd: <<yqynan mn mydnm anchh r khh shm nmydnyd>>.
w nmh r hmgy bh adm amwkht. sps anh r bh frshtgn `rDh dsht, w frmwd: <<gr rstgwyyd, nmhy ynh r bh mn khbr dhyd>>.
(frshtgn) gftnd: <<mnzhy tw!. m chyzy jz anchh bh m amwkhthy nmydnym, tw dny Hkhymy>>.
frmwd: <<y adm! ann r z nmhyshn agh khn>> hngmykhh ann r agh khrd (llh) frmwd: <<ay bh shm ngftm khh mn Gyb asmnh w zmyn r mydnm?! w nyz mydnm anchh r khh ashkhr mykhnyd, w anchh r pnhn mydshtyd>>.
(yd bywr) hngmy r khh bh frshtgn gftym: <<bry adm sjdh khnyd>> ps (hmgy) sjdh khrdnd, jz blys khh srbz zd, w tkhbr wrzyd, w z khfrn shd.
w gftym: <<y adm! tw b hmsrt dr bhsht skhwnt khn, w z (mywhhy) an hr j mykhwhyd, gwr bkhwryd, w lykhn bh yn drkht nzdykh nshwyd, khh z stmgrn khwhyd shd>>.

ps shyTn mwjb lGzsh an dw shd, sps ann r z anchh dr an bwdnd (= bhsht) byrwn khrd. w gftym: <<hmgy (bh zmyn) frwd ayyd dr Hlykhh b`Dy dshmn b`Dy khwhyd bwd. w bry shm dr zmyn t mdt m`yny qrrgh w wsylhy bhrh brdry khwhd bwd>>.

angh adm z prwrdgrsh khlmty fr grft w llh twbh w r pdhyrft, chr khh llh twbhpdhyr mhrbn st. [mrd z <<khlmt>> skhnny st khh HDrt adm `lyh lslm b an d` w stGfr nmwd w dr swrhy `rf ayh 23 byn shdh st. (tfsyr bn khthyr)]
gftym: <<hmgy z an frwd ayyd! ps hr gh hdyty z Trf mn bry shm amd, khsnykhh z an pyrwy khnnd, nh trsy br ann khwhd bwd w nh Gmgyn khwhnd shd>>.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd w nshnhhy m r drwG pndshtnd ann hl dwzkhnd, w hmyshh dr an khwhnd bwd.
y frzndn sry'yl (= y`qwb)! n`mt mr khh bh shm rzny dshtm bh yd awryd, w bh pymny khh b mn bsthyd wf khnyd, t mn nyz bh pymn shm wf khnm w tnh z mn btrsyd.
w bh anchh nzl khrdhm (= qran) ymn bywryd khh tSdyqkhnndh chyzy st khh b shm st, w nkhstyn khfr bh an nbshyd, w ayt mr bh bhy nchyz nfrwshyd, w tnh z mn btrsyd.
w Hq r b bTl nymyzyd, w Hq r pnhn nkhnyd, dr Hlykhh mydnyd.
w nmz r br p dryd w zkht r bprdzyd, w b nmzgzrn nmz bkhwnyd.
ay mrdm r bh nykhy frmn mydhyd, w khwdtn r frmwsh mykhnyd, dr Hlykhh shm khtb (asmny) r mykhwnyd?! ay nmyndyshyd?!
w z shkhybyy w nmz yry jwyyd, w nmz; jz br frwtnn, dshwr w grn st.
an khsnykhh yqynan mydnnd dydr khnndhy prwrdgr khwyshnd w bhswy w bz mygrdnd.
y frzndn sry'yl (= y`qwb)! n`mt mr khh bh shm rzny dshtm bh yd awryd, w (nyz) ynkhh mn shm r br jhnyn brtry ddm.
w z rwzy btrsyd khh khsy z khsy khfyty nkhnd, w z w shf`t pdhyrfth nmyshwd, w nh z w twn w fdyh grfth myshwd, w nh yry myshwnd.

w (nyz bh yd awryd) hngmykhh shm r z chngl fr`wnyn njt ddym, (ann) shm r bh bdtryn Swrt azr w shkhnjh myddnd, psrn shm r sr mybrydnd, w znn shm r zndh ngh mydshtnd, w dr ynh azmysh bzrgy z jnb prwrdgrtn bry shm bwd.
w (bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh dry r bry shm shkhftym, w shm r njt ddym, w fr`wnyn r Grq skhtym, dr Hlykhh shm myngrystyd.
w (bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh b mwsy chhl shb w`dh gdhrdym, angh shm b`d z w gwslh r (bh prstsh) grftyd, dr Hlykhh stmkhr bwdyd.
sps shm r b`d z an bkhshydym, shyd spsgzry khnyd.
w (nyz bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh bh mwsy khtb (twrt) w frqn (m`jzhhy jdkhnndh myn Hq w bTl) r `T khrdym, t ynkhh hdyt shwyd.

w (bh yd awryd) zmny r khh mwsy bh qwm khwd gft: <<y qwm mn! shm b (bh prstsh) grftn gwslh bh khwd stm khrdhyd, ps bhswy afrydgr khwd bz grdyd w twbh khnyd, w khwd r (hmdygr r) bkhshyd, yn khr bry shm dr pyshgh prwrdgrtn bhtr st>>. angh llh twbh shm r pdhyrft, zyr khh w twbhpdhyr mhrbn st.
w (bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh gftyd: <<y mwsy! m hrgz bh tw ymn nmyawrym, mgr ynkhh llh r ashkhr bbynym>>. ps S`qh shm r grft, dr Hlykhh myngrystyd.
sps shm r ps z mrdntn br ngykhtym, shyd spsgzry khnyd.

w br r br shm sybn qrr ddym, w <<mn>> (trnjbyn) w <<slwy>> (bldrchyn) r br shm frw frstdym, (w gftym): <<z pkhyzhhyy khh bh shm rwzy ddhym; bkhwryd>> (wly shm khfr wrzydyd). anh bh m stm nkhrdnd; blkhh bh khwd stm mynmwdnd.

w (bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh gftym: <<bh yn shhr (= bytlmqds) wrd shwyd, w z n`mthy an z hr j khh mykhwhyd bh frwny bkhwryd, w b khshw` w frwtny bh drwzh dr ayyd w bgwyyd: <<khwsth m amrzsh gnhn st>> t gnhn shm r bbkhshym, w bh nykhw khrn fzwntr mybkhshym>>.

angh stmgrn yn skhn r khh bh anh gfth shdh bwd, tGyyr ddnd (w bh jy an khlmhy mskhrhamyzy gftnd) ldh br stmgrn dr brbr yn nfrmnyshn, `dhby z asmn nzl khrdym. [rswl llh Sly llh `lyh w slm frmwdnd: <<bh bny sry'yl gfth shd: angh ann b nshymnghhyshn khzydnd w `qb `qb wrd shdnd, w bh jy (HiTWa@un) (gnhn m r bbkhsh) gftnd: (HinWTa@un) HabWa@un fay sha`ra@in, dnhy dr jw>>. (SHyH bkhry: 4479)]

w (bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh mwsy bry qwm khwysh, ab khwst, ps gftym: <<`Sy khwd r br sng bzn>> angh dwzdh chshmhy ab z an jwshyd, w hr grwhy abshkhwr khwd r dnst, (w gftym): <<z rwzy llh bkhwryd w byshmyd, w dr zmyn bh tbhy mkhwshyd>>.

w (bh yd awryd) zmny r khh gftyd: <<y mwsy! m hrgz br ykh nw` Gdh shkhybyy ndrym, ps prwrdgr khwysh r bkhwn, t z anchh zmyn myrwynd, z sbzy w khyr w syr w `ds w pyzsh bry m byrwn awrd>>. (mwsy) gft: <<ay chyzy r khh psttr st bh jy chyz bhtr jygzyn mykhnyd? bh shhry frwd ayyd, zyr anchh r khwstyd dr anj bry shm hst>> w (mhr) dhlt w bynwyy br ann zdh shd, w szwr khshm llh grdydnd, chr khh ann bh ayt llh khfr mywrzydnd, w pymbrn r bh nHq mykhshtnd. ynh bh khTr an bwd khh gnhkhr w mtjwz bwdnd.

bhdrsty khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd, w khsnykhh yhwdy shdnd w nSry w Sby'n (= strh prstn) ann khh bh llh w rwz qymt ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm dhnd, pdshshn nzd prwrdgrshn st, w nh trsy br ann khwhd bwd w nh Gmgyn khwhnd shd.
w (bh yd awryd) zmny r khh z shm pymn grftym, w (khwh) Twr r bly sr shm br frshtym, (w bh shm gftym): <<anchh r bh shm ddhym, b qdrt bgyryd, w anchh r dr an st yd khnyd, shyd prhyzgr shwyd>>.
sps shm b`d z yn rwy grdndyd, ps gr fDl w rHmt llh br shm nbwd, z zynkhrn bwdyd.
bygmn shm z Hl khsny z shm khh dr rwz shnbh nfrmny w tjwz khrdnd, agh shdhyd, ps m bh anh gftym: <<bwzynhhy khwr w rndh shdh bshyd>>.
ps m yn (khyfr) r `brty bry mrdm an zmn w nslhy b`d z ann, w pnd w ndrzy bry prhyzgrn qrr ddym.
w (bh yd awryd) zmny r khh mwsy bh qwm khwd gft: <<llh bh shm dstwr mydhd khh gwy r dhbH khnyd>> gftnd: <<ay m r mskhrh mykhny?>> (mwsy) gft: <<bh llh pnh mybrm z ynkhh z ndnn bshm>>.

gftnd: <<z llh khwd bkhwh khh bry m rwshn khnd khh an chgwnh (gwy) st?>> (mwsy) gft: (llh) myfrmyd: <<an gwy st khh nh pyr w nh jwn, blkhh myn sly byn yn dw bshd, ps anchh bh shm dstwr ddh shdh st; njm dhyd>>.
gftnd: <<z prwrdgrt bkhwh t bry m rwshn szd, rng an chgwnh st?>> (mwsy) gft: (llh) myfrmyd: <<an gw zrd pr rngy st khh bynndgn r shd mykhnd>>.
gftnd: <<z prwrdgrt bkhwh t bry m rwshn szd khh an chgwnh (gwy) st? brsty yn gw br m mshtbh shdh, w gr llh bkhwhd m hdyt khwhym shd>>.

(mwsy) gft: (llh) myfrmyd: <<an gwy st khh nh bry shkhm zdn rm shdh, w nh bry zr`t abkhshy khnd, by `yb st w ykh rng w dr an khly nyst>> gftnd: <<ynkh skhn drst awrdy>> ps gw r sr brydnd, w nzdykh bwd khh yn khr nkhnnd.
w (bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh frdy r khshtyd, angh drbrhy w bh nz` prdkhtyd, w llh ashkhr khnndh an chyzy st khh pnhn mykhrdyd.
ps gftym: <<prhy z gw r bh mqtwl bznyd, llh yn gwnh mrdgn r zndh mykhnd, w nshnhhy khwd r bh shm mynmynd, shyd ndyshh khnyd>>.
sps b`d z yn dlhy shm skht shd, hmchwn sng, y skhttr! zyr khh prhy z sngh myshkhfd, w z anh nhrh jry myshwd, w prhy z trs llh frw myftd, w llh z anchh mykhnyd; Gfl nyst.
ay myd dryd khh (yhwdyn) bh (ayyn) shm ymn bywrnd, b ynkhh grwhy z ann skhnn llh (twrt) r myshnydnd w ps z fhmydnsh an r tHryf mykhrdnd, w Hl ankhh `lm w Tl` dshtnd?!

w chwn b mw'mnn mlqt khnnd; gwynd: <<ymn awrdhym>> wly hngmykhh b ykhdygr khlwt mykhnnd, mygwynd: <<chr mTlby r khh llh bry shm byn khrdh, bry mslmnn bzgw mykhnyd t (rwz qymt) dr pyshgh prwrdgrtn br Dd shm bh an stdll khnnd? ay nmyfhmyd?>>
ay nmydnnd khh anchh r pnhn mydrnd, w anchh r ashkhr mykhnnd; llh mydnd?!
w brkhy z ann byswdny hstnd khh khtb llh (twrt) r jz ykh msht khylt w arzwh nmydnnd, w tnh bh pndrhyshn dl bsthnd.
ps w y br khsnykhh b dst khwd mynwysnd, sps mygwynd: <<yn z jnb llh st >> t an r bh bhy ndkh bfrwshnd, ps w y br anh z anchh dsthyshn nwshth, w wy br ann z anchh z yn rh bh dst myawrnd!
w gftnd: <<atsh dwzkh; jz chnd rwz mHdwdy, hrgz bh m nkhwhd rsyd. bgw: <<ay z nzd llh pymny grfth yd?! khh llh hrgz khlf pymnsh nkhnd? y chyzy r khh nmydnyd bh llh nsbt mydhyd?!>>
ary hr khs khh mrtkhb gnh shwd, w gnhnsh w r HTh khnnd, anh hl atshnd, w jwdnh dr an khwhnd bwd.
w khsnykhh ymn awrdh w khrhy shysth njm ddhnd, ann hl bhshtnd, w jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd.

w (bh yd awryd) zmny r khh z bny sry'yl pymn grftym khh jz llh ygnh r prstsh nkhnyd, w bh pdr w mdr w nzdykhn w ytymn w bynwyn nykhy khnyd, w bh mrdm (skhn) nykh bgwyyd, w nmz r br p dryd w zkht r bprdzyd, sps hmhy shm; jz `dhy khmy psht khrdyd w rwygrdn shdyd.
w (bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh z shm pymn grftym khh khwn hy hmdygr r nryzyd w ykhdygr r z srzmyn khwd, byrwn nkhnyd. sps shm qrr khrdyd, w shm (br an pymn) gwhy mydhyd.

ps z an yn shm hstyd khh ykhdygr r mykhshyd w grwhy z khwdtn r z srzmyn shn byrwn mykhnyd w `lyh anh bh gnh w stm ykhdygr r khmkh mykhnyd. w gr (b`Dy z ann bh Swrt) syrn nzd shm aynd, fdyh mydhyd (w ann r azd mykhnyd) w Hl ynkhh byrwn khrdn ann br shm Hrm bwd. ay bh bkhshy z (dstwrt) khtb (asmny) ymn myawryd, w bh bkhshy khfr myshwyd?! ps jzy khsy z shm khh chnyn khnd chyst, jz rswyy w khwry dr yn jhn, w dr rwz qymt bh shdydtryn `dhb br grdnydh myshwnd, w llh z anchh njm mydhyd Gfl nyst.
ynn khsny hstnd khh zndgny dny r bh bhy akhrt khrydnd, ps `dhb anh tkhfyf ddh nmyshwd, w khsy anh r yry nkhwhd khrd.

bdrsty khh bh mwsy khtb (twrt) ddym, w b`d z w, pymbrny psht sr hm frstdym, w bh `ysy psr mrym m`jzhh w dlyl rwshn ddym, w w r bh wsylh rwH lqds (= jbryl) t'yyd khrdym, ay hr zmn; pymbry chyzy br khlf hwy nfs shm awrd, dr brbr w tkhbWr khrdyd, ps grwhy r tkhdhyb khrdh w grwhy r khshtyd.
w gftnd: <<dlhy m dr prdh st>>, blkhh llh ann r bh khTr khfr shn nfryn khrdh st, ps ndkhy ymn myawrnd.

w hngmykhh z Trf llh khtby (= qran) bry anh amd khh tSdyqkhnndh chyzhy'y bwd khh b khwd dshtnd, w pysh z yn br khfrn khwstr pyrwzy bwdnd, ps chwn an chh r khh (z qbl) shnkhth bwdnd, nzd anh amd, bh w khfr shdnd, ps l`nt llh br khfrn bd.

chh bd st chyzy khh khwd r bh bhy an frwkhtnd. w z rwy Hsd bh an chh llh frstdh bwd khfr shwnd, khh chr llh z fDl khwysh br hr khs z bndgnsh khh bkhwhd nzl mykhnd?! ps szwr khshmy br khshmy dygr shdnd, w bry khfrn `dhb khwr khnndh st.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! dr (mwrd) khshtgn (Hkhm) qSS br shm nwshth shdh st, azd bh azd, w brdh bh brdh, w zn bh zn (khshth myshwnd). ps gr khsy z swy brdr (dyny)sh (y`ny wly mqtwl) chyzy bh w bkhshydh shd, (w Hkhm qSS tbdyl bh khwn bh grdyd) byd (wly mqtwl) z rh psndydh pyrwy khnd w (qtl nyz) bh nykhy (dyh) bh w bprdzd, yn (Hkhm) tkhfyf w rHmty st z swy prwrdgrtn ps gr khsy b`d z an (gdhsht w `fw) tjwz khnd; w r `dhb drdnkhy st.
w y SHbn khrd! bry shm dr qSS Hyt w zndgy st, bshd khh shm tqw pyshh khnyd.
br shm nwshth shdh hngmykhh ykhy shm r mrg fr rsd, gr mly z khwd bh jy gdhrdh, bry pdr w mdr w khwyshwndn bh nykhy wSyt khnd. yn Hqy st br prhyzgrn.
ps hr khs khh b`d z shnydnsh an r tGyyr dhd, bdrsty khh gnhsh br khsny st khh an (wSyt) r tGyyr mydhnd, hmn llh shnwy dnst.
ps khsykhh z by `dlty (w myl by jy) wSytkhnndh (nsbt bh wrthh) y z gnh w (dr wSyt bh khr khlf) btrsd, angh myn anh r SlH nmwd, ps gnhy br w nyst bdrsty khh llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! rwzh br shm frD shdh st hmn gwnh khh br khsykhh pysh z shm bwdnd; frD shdh bwd, t prhyzgr shwyd.

(rwzh) dr rwzhyy m`dwd w ndkhy st, ps hr khs z shm khh bymr y msfr bshd, (bhndzh an rwzhy khh fTr khrdh) t`ddy z rwzhy dygr (rwzh bgyryd). w br khsnykhh twny'y an r ndrnd; lzm st khfrh bdhnd, (w an) khwrkh ddn bh mskhyny st, w hr khs khh rGbt khwd (byshtr) nykhy njm dhd ps an bry w bhtr st, w gr bdnyd rwzh grftn bry shm bhtr st.

(an chnd rwz mHdwd w ndkh) mh rmDn st (mhy) khh qran dr an nzl shdh st, (khtby) khh rhnmy mrdm st, w (dr brdrndh) nshnhh w dlyl ashkhr w rwshn z hdyt w jd khnndh Hq z bTl st. ps hr khs z shm yn mh r (dr HDr) drybd, byd khh an r rwzh bdrd, w hr khs khh bymr y dr sfr bwd, ps (byd bh t`dd rwzhy khh fTr khrdh) rwzhy dygr r (rwzh bgyryd). llh bry shm asny mykhwhd, w bry shm dshwry nmykhwhd, w t shmr (rwzhy rmDn) r khml khnyd, w llh r br ynkhh shm r hdyt khrdh, bzrg bdryd, w bshd khh shkhr gzry khnyd.
w chwn bndgnm, z tw drbrh mn bprsnd, bgw: bh rsty khh mn nzdykhm, d`y d`khnndh r hngmykhh mr bkhwnd; jbt mykhnm. ps (ann) byd d`wt mr bpdhyrnd, w bh mn ymn bywrnd, bshd khh rhybnd.

amyzsh w nzdykhy b hmsrntn dr shbi rwz br shm Hll grdydh st, ann lbs shm hstnd w shm lbs anh, llh mydnst khh shm bh khwdtn khynt mykhrdyd, ps twbhy shm r pdhyrft w shm r bkhshyd, ps khnwn (dr shbhy rmDn mytwnyd) b ann amyzsh khnyd, w anchh r llh bry shm mqrr dshth Tlb khnyd. w bkhwryd w byshmyd, t rshthy spyd SbH z rshthy syh (shb) bry shm ashkhr shwd, sps rwzh r t shb bh pyn rsnyd, w dr Hlykhh dr msjd m`tkhf hstyd b znn amyzsh nkhnyd, yn mrzhy lhy st ps bh an nzdykh nshwyd. llh yn chnyn ayt khwd r bry mrdm rwshn myszd; bshd khh prhyzgr shwnd.
w mwltn r dr byn khwd bh bTl (w nHq) nkhwryd, w (bh `nwn rshwh qsmty z) an r bh Hkhmn (w qDt) ndhyd; t bkhshy z mwl mrdm r bh gnh bkhwryd, dr Hlykhh shm mydnyd (yn khr gnh st.)

drbrh hllhy (mh) z tw sw'l mykhnnd, bgw anh byn wqt bry mrdm w (t`yyn wqt) Hj st. w nykhwkhry an nyst khh (dr Hl Hrm) z psht khnhh wrd shwyd, blkhh nykhwkhr khsy st khh tqw pyshh khnd, w bh khnhh z drhyshn wrd shwyd, w z llh btrsyd t rstgr shwyd.
w dr rh llh b khsnykhh b shm myjngnd, jng khnyd, w z Hd tjwz nkhnyd, khh llh tjwzgrn r dwst nmydrd.

w anh r hr khj yftyd, bkhshyd, w z anj (mkhh) khh shm r byrwn khrdhnd; anh r byrwn khnyd, w ftnh (shrkh) z khshtn bdtr st. w b anh dr nzd msjd lHrm jng nkhnyd, t ynkhh b shm dr anj bjngnd, ps gr (dr anj) b shm jngydnd, yshn r bkhshyd, szy khfrn chnyn st.
ps gr dst brdshtnd, bygmn llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
w b anh jng khnyd; t ftnh (shrkh) bqy nmnd, w dyn (khlSnh) z an llh grdd. ps gr dst brdshtnd; tjwz jz br stmkhrn rw nyst.
mh Hrm dr brbr mh Hrm st, w Hrmt (shkhnyh) dry qSS st, ps hr khs t`dy w tjwz khrd, hmn gwnh khh br shm t`dy khrdh; br w t`dy khnyd, w z llh btrsyd w bdnyd khh llh b prhyzgrn st.
w dr rh llh nfq khnyd w (b trkh nfq) khwd r b dst khwysh bh hlkht nyfkhnyd, w nykhy khnyd khh llh nykhwkhrn r dwst mydrd.

w Hj w `mrh r bry llh bh tmm brsnyd, w gr bz dshth shdyd (bwsylh dshmn y bymry w Gyrh) ps anchh z qrbny frhm shwd (dhbH khnyd, w angh z Hrm byrwn shwyd) w srhy khwd r ntrshyd t qrbny bh jyghsh brsd, w gr khsy z shm bymr bwd, w y nrHty dr sr dsht, (w nchr shwd dr Hl Hrm sr khwd r btrshd) ps fdyh dhd z (qbyl: sh rwz) rwzh y Sdqh (khwrkh ddn bh shsh mskhyn) y qrbny khrdn gwsfndy (khh myn fqr tqsym shwd) ps hngmykhh dr mn bwdyd, hr khs z `mrh bhrhmnd grdd; sps (`ml) Hj r aGz khnd, anchh z qrbny (bry w) mysr shd (dhbH mykhnd) w hr khs nyft sh rwz dr (ym) Hj w hft rwz hngmykhh bz gshtyd rwzh bgyryd. yn dh (rwz) khml st, yn (Hkhm) bry khsy st khh khnwdh w skhn msjd lHrm (= mkhh w Trf an) nbshd, w z llh btrsyd w bdnyd khh llh skhtkhyfr st.

Hj dr mhhy m`lwm w m`yny st, ps khsykhh dr yn mhh Hj r (br khwd) frD grdnd. (byd bdnd khh) dr Hj amyzsh jnsy w gnh w jdl (rw) nyst, w anchh z khrhy nykh njm dhyd; llh an r mydnd, w twshh br gyryd; khh bhtryn twshh prhyzgry st, w y khrdmndn, z mn bprhyzyd (btrsyd).

gnhy br shm nyst khh (dr ym Hj b khryd w frwsh) z fDl prwrdgrtn (rwzy) Tlb khnyd, w hngmykhh z `rft khwch khrdyd; llh r nzd msh`r lHrm yd khnyd, w w r yd khnyd hmchnn khh shm r hdyt khrd, w gr chh pysh z an z gmrhn bwdyd.
ps z anj khh mrdm khwch mykhnnd; khwch khnyd, w z llh amrzsh bkhwhyd hmn llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
ps chwn mnskh (Hj) khwd r bh jy awryd, llh r yd khnyd hmnnd yd khrdn pdrntn blkhh byshtr z an, z mrdm khsny hstnd khh mygwynd <<prwrdgr! bh m dr dny `T khn>> w w r dr akhrt bhrhy nyst.
w z ann khsny hstnd khh mygwynd: <<prwrdgr! bh m dr dny nykhy `T khn, w dr akhrt (nyz) nykhy (`T frm) w m r z `dhb atsh ngh dr>>
ynnnd khh z anchh bdst awrdhnd, bhrhy drnd. w llh sry` lHsb (zwd shmr) st.

w llh r dr rwzhy m`yn w shmrdh (khh sh rwz ym tshryq: 11w12w13 mh dhyHjh st) yd khnyd. ps khsykhh shtb khnd; w dr dw rwz (`ml r njm dhd) gnhy br w nyst. w khsykhh t'khyr khnd (w `ml r dr sh rwz njm dhd) gnhy br w nyst (yn rkhSt) bry khsykhh tqw pyshh khnd, w z llh btrsyd, w bdnyd khh shm bh swy w mHshwr khwhyd shd.
w z mrdm khsy hst khh gftrsh dr (brh) zndgy dny tw r bh shgft myndzd w llh r br anchh dr dl khwd drd; gwh mygyrd, w Hl ankhh w srskht tryn dshmnn st.
w hngmykhh rwy br mygrdnd w myrwd (w y bh rysty myrsd) dr rh fsd dr zmyn khwshsh mykhnd w khsht w nsl r nbwd myszd, w llh fsd w (tbhkhry) r dwst nmydrd.
w chwn bh w gfth shwd: <<z llh btrs>> khwd bzrgbyny w (tkhbr) w r bh gnh mykhshnd. ps (atsh) jhnm w r khfy st w chh bd armghy st.
w z mrdmn khsy hst khh jn khwd r bry bh dst awrdn khshnwdy llh myfrwshd, w llh nsbt bh bndgn mhrbn st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! hmgy bh slm (w T`t khd) dr ayyd w gmhy shyTn r pyrwy nkhnyd, bdrsty khh w bry shm dshmn ashkhr st.
ps gr b`d z ankhh nshnhhy rwshn w ashkhr bry shm amd; lGzsh khrdyd w (mnHrf shdyd), bdnyd khh llh twnmnd Hkhym st.

ay (khsnykhh rh slm nmypwynd w dr zmyn fsd mykhnnd) jz yn ntZr ndrnd, khh llh (bry dwry w qDwt myn bndgn) dr syhhyy z brh bh swy ann byyd. w (nyz) frshtgn (bry jr frmn lhy byynd) w khr ykhsrh shwd?! w khrh bh swy llh brgrdndh myshwd.

z bny sry'yl bprs: <<chh ndzh nshnhhy rwshn w ashkhr bh anh ddhym?>> (wly anh n`mth r ndydh grfth w nsps shdnd) w khsykhh n`mt llh r ps z ankhh brysh amd dgrgwn khnd (`dhb skhty khwhd dsht) hmn llh skhtkhyfr st.
zndgy dny bry khfrn arsth shdh st, w mw'mnn r mskhrh mykhnnd, w (Hl ankhh) prhyzgrn dr rwz qymt bltr z ann hstnd, w llh hr khs r bkhwhd by shmr rwzy mydhd.

(dr aGz) mrdm ykh mt bwdnd, angh llh pymbrn r mjdhawr w bymdhndh br ngykht w b ann khtb (asmny) r bHq nzl khrd, t dr myn mrdm, dr anchh khtlf dshtnd, dwry khnnd, w tnh khsnykhh (khtb) bh ann ddh shdh bwd, ps z ankhh nshnhhy rwshn bh anh rsydh bwd, bkhTr stm w Hsdty khh dr mynshn bwd, dr an khtlf khrdnd, ps llh bh frmn khwysh khsny r khh ymn awrdh bwdnd; bh an Hq w (Hqyqty) khh dr an khtlf dshtnd, hdyt khrd. w llh hr khs r bkhwhd bh rh rst hdyt mykhnd.

ay gmn khrdhyd khh dkhl bhsht myshwyd w Hl ankhh hnwz br (sr) shm nymdh st, mnnd anchh khh br (sr) pyshynyn shm amd? skhty w zyn bh anh rsyd, w (anchnn) tkhn khwrdnd t khh pymbr w khsnykhh b w ymn awrdh bwdnd, gftnd: <<yry llh khy khwhd bwd?>> agh bshyd khh yry llh nzdykh st.
z tw myprsnd chh chyzy nfq khnnd? bgw: <<hr mly khh nfq khrdyd, ps bry pdr w mdr w nzdykhn w ytymn w mstmndn w dr rh mndgn st. w hr khr nykhy khh njm dhyd, bdrsty khh llh bh an agh st.>>

jhd (dr rh khd) br shm wjb shdh st, dr Hlykhh bry shm ngwr st, chh bs chyzy r khwsh ndshth bshyd, Hl ankhh an bry shm bhtr bshd, w chh bs chyzy r dwst dshth bshyd, Hl ankhh an bry shm bd bshd, w llh mydnd, w shm nmydnyd.

z tw drbrh jng khrdn dr mh Hrm, myprsnd. bgw: <<jng dr an (gnhy) bzrg; st, w bzdshtn z rh llh w khfr wrzydn bh w w (bz dshtn z) msjd lHrm w byrwn rndn hlsh z an; nzd llh (gnhy) bzrgtr, w ftnh (= shrkh w shkhnjh mw'mnn) z khshtr bzrgtr st.>> w pywsth b shm myjngnd, t ankhh gr btwnnd shm r z dyntn brgrdnnd, w hr khs z shm khh z dynsh br grdd w dr Hl khfr bmyrd, ps ann `mlshn dr dny w akhrt tbh shdh st, w ann hl atsh (dwzkh) nd, w hmyshh dr an khwhnd bwd.
bdrsty khsnykhh ymn awrdnd w khsnykhh hjrt khrdnd w dr rh llh jhd nmwdnd, ann bh rHmt llh mydwrnd, w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

z tw drbrh shrb w qmr myprsnd bgw: <<dr an dw, gnhy bzrg st w swdhyy bry mrdm dr br drd, w gnh hr dw z swdshn bzrgtr st>>. w z tw myprsnd <<chh chyzy nfq khnnd?>> bgw: mzd (nyzmndy khwd) ynchnyn llh ayt r bry shm rwshn myszd, bshd khh ndyshh khnyd.

dr dny w akhrt, w z tw drbrh ytymn myprsnd, bgw: <<SlH khrdn (khr) ann bhtrst, w gr b ann hmzysty khnyd; anh brdrn (dyny) shm hstnd>>. w llh tbhkhr r z drstkhr myshnsd, w gr llh mykhwst shm r bh zHmt myndkht, bh rsty khh llh twnmnd Hkhym st.

w b znn mshrkh t ymn nywrdhnd; zdwj nkhnyd, w bygmn khnyz b ymn z zn (azd) mshrkh bhtr st, gr chh (zybyy y dryy w) shm r bh shgft awrd. w (znn b ymn r) bh zdwj mrdn mshrkh dr nywryd; t ymn bywrnd. w qT`an brdhy b ymn z mrd (azd) mshrkh; bhtr st, gr chh (zyby'y y dryy w mwq`yt w) shm r bh shgft awrd. ann bh swy atsh (dwzkh) d`wt mykhnnd w llh bh frmn w (twfyq) khwysh bh swy bhsht w amrzsh d`wt mykhnd, w ayt w (Hkhm) khwd r bry mrdm rwshn myszd, bshd khh mtdhkhWr (w ydawr) shwnd.

w z tw drbrhy HyD (`dt mhnh znn) myprsnd, bgw <<an plyd w zynbr st, ps dr Hlt q`dgy z znn khnrh gyry khnyd, w b anh nzdykhy nkhnyd; t pkh shwnd, ps hngmykhh pkh shdnd w Gsl khrdnd. z hmn j khh llh bh shm frmn ddh, b anh amyzsh khnyd, bh rsty khh llh twbh khnndgn r dwst mydrd w (nyz) pkhn r dwst mydrd>>.
znn shm khshtzr shm hstnd, ps hr gwnh khh bkhwhyd bh khshtzr khwd drayyd, w (twshhy) bry khwd z pysh bfrstyd, w z llh btrsyd, w bdnyd khh shm w r mlqt khwhyd khrd, w bh mw'mnn bshrt dh.
w llh r dstwyz swgndhy khwd qrr ndhyd, bry ynkhh nykhy khnyd w tqw pyshh szyd, w dr myn mrdm ashty dhyd (qsm yd nkhnyd) w llh shnwy dnst.
llh shm r bkhTr swgnd hyy khh byhwdh w bdwn qSd yd mykhnyd, mw'khdhh nmykhnd, wly shm r bh anchh dlhy tn khsb khrdh (z rwy khtyr w qSd bwdh) mw'khdhh mykhnd w llh amrzndhy brdbr st.
bry khsnykhh swgnd mykhwrnd b znn khwd amyzsh nkhnnd (yl) chhr mh ntZr w (mhlt) st. ps gr (swgnd khwd r ndydh grftnd) w bzgshtnd, hmn llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
w gr tSmym Tlq grftnd, bh rsty khh llh shnwy dnst.

w znn mTlqh byd mdt sh pkhy (y dydn sh br `dt mhnh) ntZr bkhshnd, w gr bh llh w rwz qymt ymn drnd; bry anh rw nyst khh anchh r llh dr rHmhyshn afrydh, khtmn khnnd. w shwhrnshn gr khwhn ashty hstnd, bry bzgrdndn anh (bh zndgy znshwy'y) dr yn (mdt z dygrn) szwrtrnd. w bry znn Hqwq shysthy st hmnnd (Hqwq w wZyfy) khh br `hdh anhst, w mrdn br ann brtry drnd, w llh twnmnd Hkhym st.

Tlq (rj`y) dwbr st ps (z an y byd hmsr r) bTwr shysth ngh dshtn, y b nykhy rh khrdn. w bry shm rw nyst khh z anchh bh ann ddhyd, chyzy ps bgyryd, mgr ankhh (zn w shwhr) btrsnd khh ntwnnd Hdwd lhy r br p drnd, ps (y mw'mnn) gr trsydyd khh Hdwd lhy r br p ndrnd, gnhy br an dw nyst, khh zn fdyh w `wDy bprdzd (w Tlq bgyrd) ynh Hdwd lhy st, ps z anh tjwz nkhnyd w hr khs z Hdwd llh tjwz khnd, ps ynnnd khh stmgrnd.

ps gr (shwhr bry br swm) w r Tlq dd, ps z an (zn) bry w Hll nyst t ynkhh shwhry Gyr z w zdwj khnd (w b w amyzsh jnsy nmyd) ps gr (shwhr b`dy) w r Tlq dd, gnhy bran dw nyst khh (b zdwj mjdd) bh ykhdygr bzgrdnd, gran dw pndrnd khh Hdwd llh r br p mydrnd, ynh Hdwd llh st khh anh r bry mrdmy khh mydnnd byn mynmyd.

w hngmykhh znn r Tlq (rj`y) ddyd, angh bh pyn (rwzhy) `dh khwysh rsydnd. ps bh shystgy anh r ngh dryd w y bh nykhy w khwby anh r rh szyd, w ann r bkhTr zyn rsndn ngh ndryd t (bh Hqwq shn) t`dy w tjwz khnyd, w khsykhh chnyn khnd qT`an bh khwd stm khrdh st, w ayt llh r bh mskhrh ngyryd. w n`mt llh r br khwd w a nchh r khh z khtb (qran) w Hkhmt (snt w srr shry`t) br shm nzl khrdh w shm r b an pnd mydhd, bh yd bywryd w z llh btrsyd w bdnyd khh llh bh hmh chyz dnst.

w hngmykhh znn r Tlq ddyd, angh (mdt) `dh khwd r bh pyn rsndnd, ann r z zdwj b shwhrn (sbq) khwd bz ndryd, wqty khh bh Trz psndydhy dr byn khwysh trDy khnnd. yn (dstwry st) khh hr khs z shm khh bh llh w rwz qymt ymn drd; bh an pnd ddh myshwd, w yn (dstwr) bry shm pr brkhttr w pkhyzhtr st, w llh mydnd w shm nmydnyd.

w mdrn (byd) frzndn khwd r dw sl tmm shyr dhnd. (yn dstwr) bry khsy st khh bkhwhd dwrn shyr khwrgy r tkhmyl khnd. w br an khs khh frznd bry w mtwld shdh (pdr) lzm st khwrkh w pwshkh ann (= mdrn) r bTwr shysth (dr mdt shyr ddn bprdzd) hych khs jz bhndzh twnyysh mkhlf nmyshwd. nh mdr bh khTr frzndsh w nh pdr bh sbb frzndsh byd zyn bbynd. w mnnd hmyn (Hkhm) br wrth (nyz) lzm st, ps gr an dw b rDyt w mshwrt ykhdygr bkhwhnd. (khwdkh r zwdtr) z shyr bzgyrnd, gnhy br anh nyst, w gr khwstyd khh bry frzndn khwd dyhy bgyryd, gnhy br shm nyst; bh shrT ynkhh anchh r khh mqrr khrdhyd, bTwr shysth bprdzyd. w z llh btrsyd, w bdnyd khh llh bh anchh njm mydhyd; bynst.

w khsny z shm khh mymyrnd w hmsrny bqy mygdhrnd; byd chhr mh w dh rwz ntZr bkhshnd (w`dh ngh drnd) ps hngmykhh mdt `dhy khwd r bh pyn rsndnd, dr anchh ann bh Twr shysth drbrh khwd njm dhnd; gnhy br shm nyst, w llh bh anchh mykhnyd agh st.

w gnhy br shm nyst dr anchh khh bTwr khnyh z khwstgry znny (khh dr `dhnd) br zbn awryd, y dr dlhy khwd pnhn dryd. llh dnst khh shm bh zwdy bh yd ann khwhyd ftd, wly pnhny b anh w`dh (znshwy'y) ndhyd, mgr ynkhh skhny psndydh (bTwr khnyh) bgwyyd, w tSmym bh `qd zdwj ngyryd t mdt mqrr (`dh) bh srayd, w bdnyd khh llh anchh r khh dr dlhy shmst mydnd, ps z (mkhlft) w btrsyd, w bdnyd khh llh amrzndhy brdbr st.

gr znn r mdmy khh b ann amyzsh jnsy nkhrdhyd w mhry bryshn m`yn nkhrdhyd Tlq ddyd; gnhy br shm nyst, w (dr yn Hlt) anh r (b hdyhy mnsb) bhrhmnd szyd, br twngr bhndzh twnsh, w br tngdst bhndzh twnsh hdyhy shysth st (w yn Hkhm) br nykhwkhrn lzmy st.

gr znn r pysh z ankhh b ann nzdykhy khnyd, Tlq ddyd dr Hlykhh bry anh mhry t`yyn khrdhyd; ps nSf anchh r t`yyn khrdhyd (bh anh bdhyd) mgr ynkhh ann (Hq khwd r) bbkhshnd. y khsykhh pywnd nkhH bh dst wst (shwhr) bbkhshd (w tmm mhr r bdhd) w ankhh bbkhshyd bh prhyzgry nzdykhtr st. w bzrgwry w nykhy r dr myn khwd frmwsh nkhnyd, bh rsty llh bh anchh mykhnyd; bynst.

ps gr (z dshmn w Gyrh) trsydyd, dr Hl pydh y swrh (nmz r bjy awryd) ps hngmykhh ymn shdyd, llh r yd khnyd. (w nmzh r bh tmm w khml bjy awryd) hmngwnh khh chyzhy r khh nmydnstyd bh shm yd dd.

w khsny z shm khh mymyrnd w hmsrny bh j mygdhrnd, byd bry hmsrn khwd wSyt khnnd khh t ykh sl anh r (b prdkhtn hzynh zndgy) bhrhmnd sznd bdwn ankhh (z khnh shwhr) byrwn khnnd. ps gr byrwn rwnd, drbrh anchh khh ann nsbt bkhwd bTwr shysth njm mydhnd (z qbyl zynt ddn khwd w zdwj mjdd) gnhy br shm nyst, w llh twnmnd Hkhym st.

khyst khh bh llh qrD dhd qrD nykhw t an r bry w chndyn brbr khnd? w llh st khh (rwzy bndgn r) tng w gshdh myszd, w bh swy w bz grdndh myshwyd.

ay ndydy jm`y z bny sry'yl r b`d z mwsy hngmykhh bh pymbr khwd gftnd: pdshhy bry m ntkhb khn; t dr rh llh jng khnym (pymbr anh) gft: shyd gr jhd br shm mqrr shwd (sr pychy khnyd w) dr rh llh jhd nkhnyd. gftnd: chr dr rh llh jhd nkhnym dr Hlykhh z khnhh w frzndnmn byrwn rndh shdhym. ps hngmykhh jng br ann mqrr shd, jz `dh khmy z ann hmh (sr pychy) w rwy grdny khrdnd, w llh bh stmkhrn agh st.

w pymbrshn bh anh gft: hmn llh <<Tlwt>> r (bh `nwn) pdshh bry shm mb`wth (w ntkhb) khrdh st, gftnd: chgwnh w br m pdshhy khnd b ynkhh m bh pdshhy z w szwrtrym, w z ml (dny) bhrh chndny ddh nshdh st? gft: bh rsty llh w r br shm brgzydh st, w w r dr `lm w (nyrwy) bdn ws`t w brtry bkhshydh st. w llh pdshhy khwd r bh hr khs khh bkhwhd mydhd, w llh gshyshgr dnst.

ps hngmykhh Tlwt b lshkhryn rhspr shd, bh anh gft: hmn llh shm r bwsylh ykh jwy (ab) azmysh mykhnd. ps hr khs z an bnwshd z (yrn) mn nyst. w hr khs z an nkhwrd, qT`an w z (yrn) mn st, mgr khsykhh b dst khwysh khfy (z ab) brgyrd. ps jz `dhy khmy; hmgy z an (ab) nwshydnd. w hngmykhh w w khsnykhh b w ymn awrdh bwdnd, z an (nhr) gdhshtnd. (z khmy frd khwd nrHt shdnd w `dhy) gftnd: <<mrwz m twnyy (mqblh) b jlwt w sphynsh r ndrym>>. (m) anny khh bh dydr llh yqyn dshtnd, gftnd: <<chh bs grwh khwchkhy khh bh frmn llh br grwhy bsyr pyrwz shdnd w llh b brdbrn st>>.
w hngmykhh bry (mbrzh) b jlwt w sphynsh bh mydn amdnd, gftnd: <<prwdgr! br (dlhy) m Sbr w shkhybyy frw ryz w gmhy m r stwr w thbt bdr, w m r br grwh khfrn pyrwz bgrdn>>.

ps bh frmn khd, anh r shkhst ddnd, w dwwd (jwn nyrwmnd w shj`y khh dr lshkhr Tlwt bwd) jlwt r khsht, w llh pdshhy w nbwt r bh w bkhshyd w z anchh mykhwst bh w amwkht, w gr llh brkhy z mrdm r bh wsylh brkhy dygr df` nmykhrd, qT`an zmyn tbh mygrdyd. wly llh br jhnyn fDl w bkhshsh drd.
ynh, ayt llh st khh m an r bHq br tw mykhwnym w bh rsty tw z pymbrn hsty.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! z anchh bh shm rwzy ddhym; nfq khnyd pysh z ankhh rwzy fr rsd khh dr an nh khryd w frwsh st w nh dwsty w nh shf`ty, w khfrn khwd stmkhrnnd.

llh (m`bwd br Hq st) hych m`bwdy bHq jz w nyst, zndh (w jhn hsty r) ngh dr w mdbr st, nh chrt w r fr gyrd w nh khwb, anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn st z an wst khyst khh dr nzd w jz bh frmn w shf`t khnd? anchh dr pysh rwy ann w anchh dr psht srshn st mydnd. w bh chyzy z `lm w, jz bh anchh bkhwhd HTh nmyybd, khrsy w asmnh w zmyn r dr br grfth, w nghdry an dw (zmyn w asmn) br w grn w dshwr nyyd, w w blnd mrtbh w bzrg st.

dr (qbwl) dyn hych jbry nyst, bh rsty khh rh rst (w hdyt) z rh nHrf (w gmrhy) rwshn shdh st. ps hr khs bh TGwt (shyTn w bt w nsnhy gmrh w TGyngr) khfr wrzd w bh llh ymn awrd, ps bh rsty khh bh dstgyrh mHkhmy chng zdh st, khh an r gsstn nyst, w llh shnwy dnst.

llh ywr w (sr prst) khsny st khh ymn awrdhnd, anh r z trykhyh bh swy nwr byrwn mybrd. w khsnykhh khfr shdnd ywr w sr prst anh TGwt st khh ann r z nwr, bh swy trykhyh byrwn mybrd, anh hl atshnd w jwdn dr an khwhnd mnd.

ay ndydy w (a ghy ndry z) khsy (= nmrwd pdshh bbl) khh b brhym drbrhy prwrdgrsh bh mjdlh w gftgw prdkht? bdn khTr khh llh bh w pdshhy ddh bwd. w (z khbr w Grwr srmst shdh bwd,) hngmykhh brhym gft: <<prwrdgr mn khsy st khh zndh mykhnd w mymyrnd>> (nmrwd) gft: <<mn (nyz) zndh mykhnm w mymyrnm>>. brhym gft: <<hmn llh, khwrshyd r z mshrq myawrd, ps tw an r z mGrb bywr!>> (dr ynj) an khsykhh khfr wrzydh bwd mbhwt shd. w llh qwm stmgr r hdyt nmykhnd.

y hmnnd an khsykhh br dhy gdhsht, dr Hlykhh dywrhy an bh rwy sqfh frw rykhth bwd. (w b khwd) gft: chgwnh llh (hl) yn (dh) r ps z mrgshn zndh mykhnd?! ps llh w r (bh mdt) Sd sl myrnd, ps zndhsh khrd (w bh w) frmwd: <<chh qdr drng khrdy?>> gft: <<ykh rwz, y bkhshy z ykh rwz r drng khrdm>>. frmwd: <<(nh) blkhh Sd sl drng khrdy, ps bh Gdh w nwshydny khwd ngh khn (khh T`m w rng an) tGyyr nkhrdh st, w bh lG khwd ngh khn (khh chgwnh mtlshy shdh st m chnyn khrdym t bh tw pskh gwyym) w (hm) tw r nshnhy bry mrdm (dr mwrd m`d) qrr dhym w (khnwn) bh stkhwnhy (lG khwd) ngh khn (khh) chgwnh anh r brdshth bh hm pywnd mydhym, sps gwsht br an mypwshnym>> ps hngmykhh (qdrt lhy br zndh khrdn mrdgn) brysh ashkhr shd, gft: <<mydnm khh llh br hr chyzy twnst>>.

w (bh yd bywr) hngmy r khh brhym gft: <<prwrdgr! bh mn nshn bdh chgwnh mrdgn r zndh mykhny?>> frmwd: <<mgr ymn nywrdhy?!>> gft: <<chr, wly (mykhwhm) khh qlbm arm bgyrd>> frmwd: <<ps chhr prndh r brgyr, angh anh r pysh khwd qT`h qT`h khn (w dr hm bymyz) sps br hr khwhy qsmty z an r bgdhr, angh anh r bkhwn; shtbn bh swy tw myaynd, w bdn khh llh twnmnd Hkhym st.
mthl khsnykhh mwl khwd r dr rh llh nfq mykhnnd, hmnnd dnhy st khh hft khwshh brwynd khh dr hr khwshh ykhSd dnh bshd, w llh bry hr khs khh bkhwhd chnd brbr mykhnd w llh gshyshgr dnst.
khsnykhh mwl khwd r dr rh llh nfq mykhnnd sps dr py anchh tfq khrdhnd, mnt nmygdhrnd w azry nmyrsnnd, pdsh anh bryshn nzd prwrdgrshn (mHfwZ) st. w trsy br ann nyst w nh yshn ndwhgyn shwnd.
skhn psndydh w gdhsht bhtr z Sdqhy st khh azry bh dnbl an bshd, w llh bynyz (w) brdbr st.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! Sdqhhy khwd r b mnt w azr, bTl mkhnyd, mnnd khsykhh mlsh r bry nshn ddn bh mrdm, nfq mykhnd, w bh llh w rwz qymt ymn ndrd, ps mthl w hmchwn mthl sng Sfy st khh brrwy an (ndkhy) khkh bshd. angh brn tndy bh an brsd, w an r Sf w skht br jy gdhrd. ann (ry khrn) z anchh khh njm ddhnd chyzy bh dst nmyawrnd, w llh grwh khfrn r hdyt nmykhnd.

w mthl khsnykhh mwl khwd r bry Tlb khshnwdy khd, w bkhTr yqyn w bwry khh dr dlhy shn (bh pdsh khd) drnd, nfq mykhnnd; hmchwn mthl bGy st khh br pshthy qrr drd, w brn (zyd w) tndy bh an brsd. ps mywhhy khwd r dw chndn dhd. w gr brn tnd bh an nrsd, brn khfyf w ndkhy (bry an khfy st). w llh bh anchh mykhnyd; bynst.

ay khsy z shm dwst drd khh bGy z drkhtn khrm w ngwr dshth bshd khh z zyr anh nhrh rwn st. w bry w dr an bG z hr gwnh mywhy (frhm) bshd. w dr Hlykhh bh sn pyry rsydh w frzndny (khrd sl) w ntwn drd. angh grdbdy khh dr an atsh (swzny) st, bh an br khwrd khnd w (ykhsrh) bswzd?! (hmyn Twr st, Hl khsnykhh Sdqhhy khwd r b mnt w azr w ry bTl mykhnnd). yn chnyn llh ayt (khwd) r bry shm rwshn myszd, shyd khh shm byndyshyd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! z chyzhy pkhyzhy khh bh dst awrdhyd, w z anchh z zmyn bry shm byrwn awrdhym, nfq khnyd, w bry nfq khrdn qSd n pkh an r nkhnyd, dr Hlykhh khwd shm HDr nystyd anh r bpdhyryd, mgr ankhh dr an chshm pwshy khnyd. w bdnyd khh llh bynyz stwdh st.
shyTn shm r (bh hngm nfq mytrsnd w) w`dh thy dsty mydhd, w shm r bh zshtyh mr mykhnd. w dr Hlykhh llh z jnb khwd bh shm w`dh amrzsh w fzwny (n`mt) mydhd, w llh gshyshgr dnst.
(llh) bh hr khs khh bkhwhd Hkhmt w (dnsh) mydhd, w bh hr khs Hkhmt ddh shwd, byshkh khyr frwny ddh shdh st, w jz khrdmndn pnd nmygyrd.
w hr chyzy r khh nfq khnyd y hr ndhry khh bbndyd, qT`an llh an r mydnd, w bry stmgrn hych ywry nyst.
gr Sdqhh r ashkhr khnyd chh nykhwst, w gr anh r pnhn dryd w bh thy dstn bdhyd, ps yn bry shm bhtr st, w brkhy z gnhn shm r myzdyd, w llh bh anchh mykhnyd, agh st.

hdyt ann br `hdhy tw nyst, w lykhn llh hr khh r bkhwhd hdyt mykhnd. w anchh z ml nfq mykhnyd, bry khwdtn st, w jz bry Tlb khshnwdy llh nfq nkhnyd, w anchh z ml nfq mykhnyd, (pdsh an) bTwr khml w tmm bh shm ddh myshwd, w bh shm stm nkhwhd shd.

(Sdqt shm) bry thy dstny st khh dr rh llh mHSwr w bzdshth shdhnd, w nmytwnnd (bry t'myn hzynh zndgy) dr zmyn sfr khnnd. z shdWt khwyshtn dry, frd ngh anh r bynyz mypndrd, anh r z chhrhhyshn myshnsy, b Srr (chyzy) z mrdm nmykhwhnd w anchh z ml nfq mykhnyd, qT`an llh bh an agh st.
khsnykhh mwl khwd r, dr shb w rwz pnhn w ashkhr nfq mykhnnd, mzd anh nzd prwrdgrshn bryshn (mHfwZ) st; w nh trsy br anhst, w nh yshn ndwhgyn myshwnd.

khsnykhh rb mykhwrnd (rwz qymt z gwr) br nmykhyznd; mgr mnnd brkhstn khsykhh br thr tms shyTn dywnh shdh w (nmytwnd t`dl khwd r HfZ khnd) yn bdn sbb st khh ann gftnd: <<hmn dd w std hm mthl rb st>> w dr Hlykhh llh dd w std r Hll khrdh w rb r Hrm nmwdh st. ps hmn hr khs khh z (jnb) prwrdgrsh pndy bh w brsd, angh (z rb khwry) bz ystd, anchh gdhshth w (qbl z nzwl Hkhm dryft khrdh st) z an wst. w khrsh bh llh wgdhr myshwd, w khsykhh (bh rb khwry) bz grdd, ann hl atshnd w dr an jwydn khwhnd bwd.
llh rb r nbwd mykhnd w Sdqt r fzysh w (brkht) mydhd. w llh hych (nsn) nsps gnhkhry r dwst nmydrd.
bh rsty khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd w `ml shysth njm ddhnd, w nmz r br p dshthnd w zkht r prdkhthnd; pdsh ann nzd prwrdgrshn bryshn (mHfwZ) st, w nh trsy br anhst w nh yshn ndwhgyn myshwnd.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! z llh btrsyd w anchh z (mTlbt) rb bqy mndh st rh khnyd; gr mw'mn hstyd.
ps gr (chnyn) nkhrdyd, yqyn dshth bshyd khh llh w rswlsh b shm jng khwhnd khrd. w gr twbh khrdyd Sl srmyhhytn z an shmst, nh stm mykhnyd w nh br shm stm wrd myshwd.
w gr (bdhkhr) tngdst bwd, ps t (hngm) gshysh (w twnyy) mhlt dhyd, w (gr twnyy prdkht ndrd) bkhshydn an bry shm bhtr st; gr bdnyd.
w z rwzy btrsyd khh dr an (rwz) bh swy llh bz grdndh myshwyd, sps bh hr khs (pdsh) anchh njm ddh; tmm w khml ddh myshwd, w bh ann stm nkhwhd shd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! hr gh bh hmdygr t mdt m`yny w my ddyd (y m`mlhy nsyhy njm ddyd). an r bnwysyd, w byd nwysndhy (an r) ddgrnh byn shm bnwysd, w hych nwysndhy nbyd z nwshtn hmngwnh khh llh bh w amwzsh ddh, khwd dry khnd. ps byd bnwysd w (an) khsykhh Hq br dhmhy wst (= bdhkhr) byd ml khnd, w byd z llh khh prwrdgr wst bprhyzd, w z an chyzy nkhhd, ps gr khsykhh Hq br dhmhy wst sfyh y ntwn bshd, y khwd nmytwnd ml khnd, ps byd wly w b (r`yt) `dlt; ml khnd, w dw shhd z mrdn tn r gwh bgyryd, ps gr dw mrd nbwdnd, ykh mrd w dw zn z myn gwhny khh (bh `dlt ann) rDyt dryd (gwh bgyryd). t gr ykhy z an dw (zn) frmwsh khrd, dygry bh w yd awry khnd. w gwhn nbyd bh hngmykhh anh r (bry gwhy) d`wt mykhnnd; khwd dry khnnd. w z nwshtn (bdhy) t sr rsydsh chh khwchkh bshd y bzrg mlwl nshwyd. yn (nwshtn shm) dr nzd llh bh `dlt nzdykhtr, w bry gwhy ddn stwrtr, w bry ankhh dchr shkh w trdyd nshwyd; bhtr mybshd. mgr ynkhh dd w stdy nqdy bshd khh byn khwd dst bh dst mykhnyd. ps dr yn Swrt gnhy br shm nyst khh an r nnwysyd. w hngmykhh dd w std (nqdy) khrdyd; gwh bgyryd. w nbyd bh nwysndh w shhd zyny brsd w gr (chnyn) khnyd; byshkh (byngr) nfrmny shm khwhd bwd. w z llh btrsyd. w (anchh khh bry shm mfyd st) llh bh shm amwzsh mydhd, w llh bh hmh chyz dnst.

w gr dr sfr bwdyd w nwysndhy nyftyd, ps (chyzy) grwgn bgyryd (grwy khh dr dst Tlbkhr qrr gyrd). w gr brkhy z shm brkhy dygr r myn dnst, ps an khs khh myn shmrdh shdh, byd mnt (bdhy) khwd r bz ps dhd w byd z llh khh prwrdgr wst btrsd, w shhdt r khtmn nkhnyd, w hr khs an r khtmn khnd, byshkh qlbsh gnhkhr st. w llh bh anchh mykhnyd, dnst.

anchh dr asmnh w zmyn st, z an llh st. w gr anchh r dr dl khwd dryd, ashkhr khnyd y an r pnhn nmyyd, llh shm r bh an mHsbh mykhnd. ps hr khs r bkhwhd mybkhshd, w hr khs r bkhwhd; `dhb mykhnd, w llh br hr chyzy twnst.

pymbr bh anchh z (swy) prwrdgrsh br w nzl shdh, ymn awrdh st, w mw'mnn (nyz) hmh bh llh w frshtgn w w khtbhysh w pymbrnsh ymn awrdhnd. (w gftnd): <<myn hych ykh z pymbrnsh frq nmygdhrym>> w gftnd: <<shnydym w T`t khrdym. prwrdgr! amrzsh tw r (khwhnym) w bzgsht bh swy twst>>.

llh hych khs r jz bhndzh twnsh tkhlyf nmykhnd. anchh (z khwby) bdst awrdh bh swd w, w anchh (z bdy) bh dst awrdh bh zyn wst. prwrdgr! gr frmwsh y khT khrdym, m r mw'khdhh nkhn, prwrdgr! br grn (w tkhlyf sngyn) r br (dwsh) m mgdhr, chnnkhh an r br (dwsh) khsnykhh pysh z m bwdnd; gdhshty, prwrdgr! anchh r khh Tqt tHml an r ndrym br (dwsh) m mgdhr, w m r bymrz w bh m rHm frmy. tw mwl w srwr myy ps m r br grwh khfrn pyrwz grdn.

mygwynd: prwrdgr! dlhy m r, b`d z ankhh m r hdyt khrdy (z rh Hq) mnHrf mgrdn, w z swy khwd, rHmty br m bbkhsh brsty khh tw bkhshndhy.

ps chgwnh khwhd bwd (Hlshn) hngmykhh anh bry rwzykhh shkhy dr an nyst, grd awrym w bh hr khs (pdsh) anchh frhm khrdh bh tmm w khml ddh shwd? w bh anh stm nkhwhd shd.

mw'mnn nbyd khfrn r bh jy mw'mnn dwst w wly khwd bgyrnd, w hr khs chnyn khnd, b llh hych rbThy ndrd w (`hd w pymn w b llh gssth shdh st). mgr ynkhh (z azr w dhyt) anh btrsyd (dr Zhr b ann dwsty khnyd). w llh shm r z (khyfr) khwdsh brHdhr mydrd, w bzgsht bh swy llh st.

rwzykhh hr khs anchh r z khyr w nykhy njm ddh, w anchh z bdy mrtkhb shdh, HDr shdh myybd. w arzw mykhnd, y khsh myn w w an (khrhy bd) fSlhy dwr bwd, w llh shm r z (khyfr) khwdsh br Hdhr mydrd, w (dr `yn Hl) llh bh bndgn mhrbn st.

bgw: <<khd w pymbr (w) r T`t khnyd>>. ps gr psht khrdnd w (sr pychy nmwdnd), qT`an llh khfrn r dwst nmydrd.
bh rsty llh adm w nwH w al brhym w al `mrn r br jhnyn brgzyd.
frzndny khh b`Dy z ann z (nsl) b`Dy dygrnd, w llh shnwy dnst.
hngmykhh hmsr `mrn gft: <<prwrdgr! mn anchh r dr shkhm drm bry tw ndhr khrdm khh azd, (bry khdmt bytlmqds w prstshgr tw) bshd. ps z mn bpdhyr khh tw khwd shnwy dnyy>>.

ps hngmykhh w r bzd, gft: <<prwrdgr! mn w r dkhtr zdh m - w llh bh anchh w zyyd dntr bwd- w psr hmnnd dkhtr nyst, w mn w r mrym nm gdhrdm, w mn w r w frzndnsh r z (shr) shyTn rndh shdh, bh tw pnh mydhm>>.

angh prwrdgrsh w (= mrym) r bh Trz nykhwyy pdhyrft, w bh Trz shysthy w r rwynyd (w prwrsh dd) w khflt w r bh zkhry sprd, hrgh zkhry wrd mHrb (w `bdtgh) w myshd, nzd w Gdh w rzqy myyft, (zkhry) mygft: <<y mrym yn z khj bry tw amdh st?>> (mrym) mygft: <<yn z jnb llh st, khh llh bh hr khs bkhwhd by shmr rwzy mydhd>>.
anj (bwd khh) zkhry prwrdgrsh r khwnd, (w) gft: <<prwrdgr! z Trf khwd frznd pkhyzhy bh mn `T khn, bh drsty tw shnwndh d`yy>>.
ps dr Hlykhh w ystdh dr mHrb nmz mykhwnd, frshtgn w r nd khrdnd khh: <<llh tw r bh yHyy bshrt mydhd, (w w) tSdyqkhnndhy khlmh llh (`ysy) st, w srwr w khwyshtndr (z rGbt bh znn) w pymbry z SlHn st>>.
(zkhry) gft: <<prwrdgr! chgwnh mr frzndy khwhd bwd? dr Hlykhh pyry bh srG mn amdh, w hmsrm nz st>>. (frshth) gft: <<bdyngwnh llh hr chh bkhwhd njm mydhd>>.
(zkhry) gft: <<prwrdgr! bry mn nshnhy qrr dh>>. frmwd: <<nshnht yn st khh sh rwz b mrdm, jz b shrh skhn ngwyy, w prwrdgrt r bsyr yd khn, w shmghn w SbHghn (w r) tsbyH bgw>>.
w (bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh frshtgn gftnd: <<y mrym! llh tw r brgzydh w pkh skhth w tw r br znn jhn brtry ddh st.
y mrym! frmnbr prwrdgr khwd bsh w sjdh khn w b rkhw`khnndgn rkhw` khn>>.

(y pymbr!) yn z khbrhy Gyby st khh bh tw wHy mykhnym, w tw dr an hngm khh qlmhy khwd r (bry qr`hkhshy bh ab) myfkhndnd t khdm ykh srprsty mrym r bh `hdh gyrd, nzd ann nbwdy, w (nyz) wqty khh b ykhdygr khshmkhsh mykhrdnd, nzdshn nbwdy.
w (bh yd awryd) hngmykhh frshtgn gftnd: <<y mrym! llh tw r bh khlmhy z jnb khwd, khh nmsh msyH, `ysy bn mrym st; bshrt mydhd, dr Hlykhh (w) dr dny w akhrt abrwmnd w z mqrbn (dr gh lhy) st.
w dr ghwrh w dr Hlt khhwlt (w mynsly) b mrdm skhn mygwyd w z shystgn st>>

(mrym) gft: <<prwrdgr! chgwnh mr frzndy khwhd bwd, dr Hly bshry bh mn dst nzdh st?>> (frshth) gft: <<llh bdynsn hr chh r bkhwhd myafrynd, (w) hr gh khh rdh chyzy khnd, fqT bh an mygwyd: <<mwjwd bsh>> ps (an by drng) mwjwd myshwd.
w bh w khtb w Hkhmt w twrt w njyl myamwzd.

w (w r bh `nwn) pymbry bh swy bny sry'yl (myfrstd khh w bh ann mygwyd:) <<mn z swy prwrdgrtn brytn nshnhy awrdhm, mn z gil bry shm (chyzy) bh shkhl prndh myszm, angh dr an mydmm, ps bh frmn llh prndhy myshwd. w bh frmn llh khwr mdr zd w mbtlyn bh brS (pysy) r bhbwdy mybkhshm, w mrdgn r zndh mykhnm, w z anchh mykhwryd w dr khnhhytn dhkhyrh mykhnyd; bh shm khbr mydhm, mslman dr ynh, nshnhy bry shmst gr ymn dshth bshyd.
w anchh r pysh z mn z twrt bwdh, tSdyq mykhnm, w (frstdh shdhm) t b`Dy z chyzhyy r khh br shm Hrm shdh bwd, Hll khnm, w nshnhy z Trf prwrdgrtn bry shm awrdhm, ps z llh btrsyd, w mr T`t khnyd.
bh rsty khh llh, prwrdgr mn w prwrdgr shmst, ps w r bprstyd, yn st rh rst>>.
ps hngmykhh `ysy z ann Hss khfr khrd, gft: <<ywrn mn (dr rh d`wt) bh swy llh chh khsny hstnd?>> Hwryn gftnd: <<m ywrn (dyn) llh hstym, bh llh ymn awrdhym, w (tw nyz) gwh bsh khh m tslym (w) hstym.
prwrdgr! bh anchh nzl khrdhy, ymn awrdym w z frstdh (tw) pyrwy nmwdym; ps m r z zmrh gwhn bnwys>>.
w (yhwd w dygr dshmnn msyH bry khshtn w) nqshh khshydnd, w llh chrhjwy'y khrd (w mkhr w nqshh ann r nbwd nmwd). w llh bhtryn chrh jwyn st.

(bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh llh (bh `ysy) frmwd: << y `ysy, bygmn mn tw r brgrfth w bh swy khwysh bl mybrm, w tw r z (alysh w thmt) khsnykhh khfr shdnd; pkh mygrdnm, w khsny r khh z tw pyrwy khrdnd, t rwz qymt brtr z khsny r khh khfr shdnd qrr mydhm, sps bzgsht shm bh swy mn st, angh dr anchh dr an khtlf mykhrdyd dr myn shm dwry mykhnm.

bgw: <<khd rst gft, ps z ayyn brhym khh ykht prst w Hq gr bwd, w z mshrkhn nbwd, pyrwy khnyd>>.

w byd z myn shm, grwhy bshnd khh (mrdm r) bh nykhy d`wt khnnd, w bh khr shysth w drnd w z zshty bz drnd, w annnd khh rstgrnd.
w mnnd khsny nbshyd khh prkhndh shdnd w khtlf khrdnd ps z ankhh dlyl rwshn bryshn amd, w ynn bryshn `dhb bzrgy st.
rwzykhh chhrhhyy sfyd w chhrhhyy syh mygrdd, m anh khh chhrhhyshn syh shdh (bh ann gfth myshwd) <<ay b`d z ymn tn khfr shdyd?!ps bh sbb anchh khfr mywrzydyd; `dhb r bchshyd>>.
w m anh khh chhrhhyshn sfydh shdh st, dr rHmt llh (= bhsht) khwhnd bwd, ann dr an jwydnnd.
ynh ayt llh st, khh an r bh Hq br tw mykhwnym, w llh (hych gh) stmy bry jhnyn nmykhwhd.
w anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn st z an llh st, w (hmh) khrh, bh swy llh bz grdndh myshwd.

shm bhtryn mty hstyd khh bry mrdm pdydr shdhyd: mr bh m`rwf mykhnyd w nhy z mnkhr mynmy'yd, w bh llh ymn dryd. w gr hl khtb ymn myawrdnd; qT`an bryshn bhtr bwd, brkhy z ann mw'mnnd w byshtr ann fsq w nfrmnnd.
(hl khtb) hrgz bh shm zyny nkhwhnd rsnyd; jz azry ndkh, w gr b shm bjngnd, bh shm psht khwhnd khrd, sps yry nmyshwnd.

hr khj yfth shwnd, (mhr) dhlt w khwry br ann zdh shdh st. mgr ankhh dr pnh mn khd, w mn mrdm bshnd. w bh khshmy z llh grftr shdhnd, w (mhr) bychrgy br anh zdh shdh, yn bdn sbb bwd khh bh ayt llh khfr mywrzydnd w pymbrn r bh nHq mykhshtnd, (w nyz) yn (sz) bkhTr an bwd khh nfrmny khrdnd w z Hdwd (lhy) tjwz mynmwdnd.
(wly hmhy ann) ykhsn nystnd, z hl khtb grwhy hstnd khh drstkhrdrnd, dr dl shb dr Hlykhh bh nmz ystdhnd, ayt llh r mykhwnnd.

bh llh w rwz qymt ymn drnd w mr bh m`rwf mykhnnd w z khr zsht w mnkhr bz mydrnd, w dr (njm) khrhy nykh, myshtbnd, w ann z shystgnnd. [y`ny tmm hl khtb chnnkhh dr ayt qbly mwrd nkhwhsh w mdhmt qrr grfthnd ykhsn nystnd, blkhh z myn anh khsny hstnd khh bh dyn slm grwydnd mnnd: `bdllh bn slm, sd bn `byd, th`lbh bn s`yh w syd bn s`yh w Gyrh, w hmchnyn dr myn anh hl tqw w nykhwkhr nyz wjwd drd.]
w hr khr nykhy njm dhnd, hrgz khfrn nkhwhd shd, w llh bh (Hl) prhyzgrn agh st.
bygmn khsnykhh khfr shdnd, hrgz mwlshn w frzndnshn chyzy z (`dhb) llh r z ann df` nkhwhd khrd. w ann hl atshnd, anh dr an jwdnh khwhnd bwd.

mthl anchh (khfrn) dr yn zndgy dny nfq mykhnnd; hmnnd bdy st khh dr an srmy skht w swzny st khh bh khshtzr qwmy khh br khwd stm khrdhnd; brsd, w an r nbwd szd. llh bh anh stm nkhrdh, blkhh anh khwd br khwyshtn stm khrdhnd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd, z Gyr khwdtn (khfrn) (dwst w) mHrm srr ngyryd, anh z hych nbkhry dr Hq shm khwthy nmykhnnd. anh dwst drnd khh shm dr rnj w zHmt bshyd. bh rsty dshmny z dhn (w zbn) shn ashkhr shdhst, w anchh synhhyshn pnhn mydrd; bzrgtr st, byshkh m ayt w nshnhh (y dshmny ann) r bry shm byn khrdym, gr ndyshh khnyd.

hn! shm khsny hstyd khh anh r dwst mydryd, dr Hlykhh anh shm r dwst ndrnd, w shm bh hmh khtb (hy asmny) ymn dryd, (w anh bh khtb shm ymn ndrnd). w chwn b shm mlqt mykhnnd mygwynd: <<ymn awrdhym>>. w hngmykhh tnh myshwnd, z shdt khshm br shm, sr ngshtn khwd r bh dndn mygznd. bgw: <<bh khshm khwd bmyryd>>. bygmn llh bh (rz) drwn synhh agh st.

gr bh shm nykhy (w khwshy) brsd; anh r nrHt mykhnd, w gr bh shm bdy (w gzndy) brsd; bdn khwshHl myshwnd. w gr shm Sbr khnyd w prhyzgry nmyyd, mkhr w nyrng shn hych zyny bh shm nmyrsd, byshkh llh bh anchh mykhnnd; HTh drd.
w (bh yd awr) zmny r khh (dr jng Hd) bmddn z myn khnwdh khwd byrwn amdy (w) mw'mnn r bry jngydn dr mwD`y mygmrdy, w llh shnwy dnst.
w (nyz bh yd awr) hngmykhh dw grwh z shm (= bnwslmh w bnwHrthh) khwstnd khh ssty wrznd, w llh ywr (w nghdr) anh bwd, w mw'mnn byd tnh br llh twkhl khnnd.
w bygmn llh shm r dr (jng) bdr yry khrd dr Hlykhh shm ntwn bwdyd, ps z llh btrsyd, bshd khh spsgzry nmyyd.
angh khh bh mw'mnn mygfty: <<ay shm r khfy nyst, khh prwrdgrtn shm r b sh hzr frshth khh (z asmn) frwd myaynd, yry khnd?>>
ary, gr Sbr khnyd w prhyzgry nmyyd, w (dshmn) b hmyn jwsh (w khrwsh) srG shm byyd. prwrdgrtn shm r bh pnj hzr frshth nshndr yry khwhd khrd.
w llh an (yry b frshtgn) r jz mjdhy bry (pyrwzy) shm qrr ndd, t (bdyn wsylh) dlhy shm bdn armsh gyrd, w grnh nSr w pyrwzy jz z jnb llh twnmnd Hkhym nyst.
t grwhy z khsnykhh khfr shdhnd; hlkh w nbwd khnd, y ann r khwr w mGlwb nmyd, angh m'yws w nmydnh bzgrdnd.
hych chyz z khr (bndgn) dr dst tw nyst, y (llh) twbh ann r mypdhyrd (w ann r mybkhshyd) y `dhbshn mykhnd, zyr ann stmkhrnd.
w anchh dr asmnh, w anchh dr zmyn st, z an llh st, hr khs r khh bkhwhd myamrzd, w hr khs r bkhwhd `dhb mykhnd, w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! rb r chnd brbr nkhwryd, w z llh btrsyd t rstgr shwyd.
w z atshy khh bry khfrn amdh shdhst btrsyd.
w llh w pymbr r T`t khnyd, t mwrd rHmt (khd) qrr gyryd.
w bh swy amrzsh prwrdgrtn, w bhshty khh phny an (bh qdr) asmnh w zmyn st, (w) bry prhyzgrn amdh shdhst, bshtbyd.
an khsnykhh dr twngry w tngdsty nfq mykhnnd, w khshm khwd r frw mybrnd, w z mrdm dr mygdhrnd, w llh nykhwkhrn r dwst mydrd.

w khsnykhh chwn mrtkhb khr zshty shwnd y br khwd stm khnnd, llh r bh yd myawrnd, ps bry gnhnshn amrzsh mykhwhnd, w chh khsy jz llh gnhn r myamrzd? w bh anchh khrdhnd, dr Hlykhh mydnnd (khh gnh st) p fshry w Srr nmykhnnd.
anh pdshshn amrzshy z (jnb) prwrdgrshn w bGhyy st khh z zyr (drkhtn) an jwyh jry st, jwdnh dr an mymnnd, w pdsh (nykhw khrn w) hl `ml chh khwb st.
byshkh pysh z shm (mlthyy w) snthyy gdhshth st, ps dr zmyn grdsh khnyd w bbynyd; srnjm tkhdhyb khnndgn chgwnh st?
yn (qran) byny st bry mrdm w hdyt w ndrzy bry prhyzgrn st.
w sst nshwyd w ndwhgyn ngrdyd, w shm brtr hstyd; gr mw'mn bshyd.

gr (dr rwz Hd) bh shm zkhm w asyby rsyd; bh rsty bh an grwh (khfr nyz dr rwz bdr) zkhm w asyby hmnnd an rsyd. w m yn rwzh (y shkhst w pyrwzy) r dr myn mrdm mygrdnym. w t llh frdy r khh (wq`an) ymn awrdhnd; m`lwm bdrd, w z myn shm shhdny bgyrd, w llh stmkhrn r dwst nmydrd.
w t llh khsny r khh ymn awrdhnd; pkh w khlS grdnd, w khfrn r nbwd szd.
ay pndshtyd khh (tnh b d`y ymn) bh bhsht dkhl myshwyd; dr Hlykhh llh hnwz mjhdn z shm m`lwm ndshth, w Sbrn r mshkhS w jd nskhth st?!
w bh rsty shm mrg (w shhdt) r pysh z ankhh b an rwbrw shwyd, arzw mykhrdyd, ps an r dydyd, dr Hlykhh bh an ngh mykhrdyd.

w mHmd jz frstdhy nyst, khh bh rsty pysh z w (nyz) frstdgny (bwdhnd w) gdhshtnd. ay gr bmyrd y khshth shwd, shm bh `qb mygrdyd (w `qydh w dyn khwd r rh mykhnyd?) w hr khs bh `qb bzgrdd (w `qydh w dyn rstyn r rh khnd) hrgz bh llh zyny nmyrsnd, w bh zwdy llh spsgzrn r pdsh mydhd.

w hych khsy jz bh frmn llh nmymyrd, sr nwshty st m`yn w mshkhS shdh, w hr khs khh pdsh yn dny r bkhwhd z an bh w mydhym, w hr khs khh pdsh akhrt r bkhwhd, z an bh w mydhym, w bzwdy spsgzrn r pdsh khwhym dd.

w chh bsyr pymbrny khh hmrh w twdhhy nbwh, mrdn khdyy nbrd khrdnd, anh hych gh dr brbr anchh dr rh llh bdyshn rsyd, ssty nwrzydnd w ntwn nshdnd, w zbwny nshn nddnd (w tslym dshmn nshdnd) w llh shkhybyn r dwst drd.
w skhn ann jz yn nbwd khh gftnd: <<prwrdgr! gnhn m r bymrz, w z zydh rwy m, dr khrmn (br m bymrz) w gmhy m r stwr bdr w m r br grwh khfrn, pyrwz grdn>>.
ps llh pdsh yn dny w pdsh nykh akhrt r bh anh `T khrd, w llh nykhwkhrn r dwst drd.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! gr z khsnykhh khfr shdhnd; T`t khnyd, shm r (bh khfr) br mygrdnnd, angh zyn dydh br mygrdyd.
(br khfrn tkhyh nkhnyd) blkhh, llh ywr w mwly shm st, w w bhtryn yry dhndgn st.
bh zwdy dr dlhy khsnykhh khfr shdnd, bym w trs khwhym fkhnd; bkhTr ynkhh chyzy r shrykh llh qrr ddhnd khh hychgwnh dlyly br (Hqnyt) an nzl nkhrdhst. w jygh anh atsh st, w jygh stmkhrn chh bd st.

w bh rsty llh, w`dh khwd r b shm (dr jng Hd) tHqq bkhshyd, angh khh dr (draGz jng) bh frmn w, ann r mykhshtyd. t ynkhh sst shdyd w dr khr (jng w jm`awry Gnymt) b ykhdygr bh nz` prdkhtyd, w b`d z ankhh anchh r dwst mydshtyd (z pyrwzy br dshmn) bh shm nshn dd, nfrmny khrdyd, b`Dy z shm khwhn dny bwd, w b`Dy khwhn akhrt. sps bry ankhh shm r azmysh khnd z (t`qyb) ann mnSrftn khrd, (w pyrwzy shm bh shkhst njmyd). w z (m`Syt w tqSyr) shm (khh nfrmny z dstwr pymbr bwd) dr gdhsht. w llh nsbt bh mw'mnn fDl w bkhshsh drd.

w (byd awryd) hngmy r khh (dr Hl gryz z khwh) bl myrftyd, w bh hych khs twjh nmykhrdyd. w pymbr z psht srtn shm r Sd myzd, ps (llh) b Gm w ndwhy dr py Gm w ndwhy (dygr) bh shm sz dd. yn bdyn khTr bwd khh br anchh z dst ddhyd w br anchh bh shm rsydhst; ndwhgyn nshwyd. w llh z anchh mykhnyd; agh st.

sps b`d z an Gm w ndwh, armshy (bh Swrt) khwb sbkhy br shm frw frstdh, khh grwhy z shm r fr grft. w grwhy dygr (= mnfqyn) dr fkhr jn khwd bwdnd, w drbrhy khd, gmnhy nrw w bTl, hmchwn gmnhy zmn jhlyt dshtnd. mygftnd: <<ay chyzy z nSrt w pyrwzy nSyb m myshwd?>> bgw: <<hmh khrh (shkhst w pyrwzy) bh dst llh st>>. anh chyzy r dr dlhy shn pnhn mydrnd khh bry tw ashkhr nmysznd, mygwynd: <<gr m r dr yn khr khtyry bwd (w bhrhy z pyrwzy dshtym) dr ynj khshth nmyshdym>>. bgw: <<gr shm dr khnhhy khwd hm bwdyd, khsnykhh khshth shdn br ann nwshth shdh bwd; qT`an bh qtlghhy khwd, byrwn myamdnd>>. w (ynh) bry yn st khh llh, anchh r dr synhhytn (pnhn) dryd, byzmyd, w anchh r dr dlhy tn st; khlS w pkh grdnd. w llh bh (rz) drwn synhh agh st.

bh rsty khsny z shm khh dr rwz br khwrd dw grwh (mslmnn w khfrn dr jng Hd) frr khrdnd, dr Hqyqt shyTn ann r bh sbb b`Dy z khrdr (w gnhny) khh mrtkhb shdh bwdnd, blGznyd, w qT`an llh z ann dr gdhsht, bygmn llh amrzndhy brdbr st.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! mnnd khsny nbshyd khh khfr wrzydnd, w drbrh brdrnshn chwn bh sfr rftnd (w mrdnd) y dr jng shrkht khrdnd (w khshth shdnd) gftnd: <<gr anh nzd m bwdnd, nmymrdnd w khshth nmyshdnd>> t llh yn (gftr) r Hsrty dr dlhy shn qrr dhd, w llh, zndh mykhnd w mymyrnd (zndgy w mrg hmh bh dst llh st) w llh bh `ml shm bynst.
w gr dr rh llh khshth shwyd y bmyryd, bygmn amrzsh w rHmt z (jnb) llh, z anchh anh jm` mykhnnd, bhtr st.
w gr bmyryd y khshth shwyd; qT`an bh swy llh mHshwr myshwyd.

ps bh (sbb) rHmt lhy st khh tw b ann nrm khw (w mhrbn) shdy, w gr tnd khw w skht dl bwdy, qT` z Trf tw prkhndh myshdnd, ps z ann dr gdhr w bryshn amrzsh bkhwh, w dr khrh, b ann mshwrt khn, w angh khh tSmym grfty br llh twkhl khn, zyr khh llh twkhl khnndgn r dwst mydrd.
gr llh shm r yry khnd, hych khs br shm pyrwz nkhwhd shd, w gr shm r bh khwd wgdhrd (w yrytn nkhnd) ps chh khsy b`d z w shm r yry khwhd khrd? w mw'mnn byd tnh br llh twkhWl khnnd.

w hych pymbry r nszd khh khynt khnd, w hr khs khynt khnd, rwz qymt, b anchh (dr an) khynt khrdh byyd. sps bh hr khs anchh r khsb khrdhst (z nykhy y bdy) bTwr khml (pdsh y sz) ddh myshwd, w bh ann stm nkhwhd shd.
ay khsykhh khshnwdy llh r pyrwy mykhnd, hmnnd khsy st khh bh khshm llh dchr grdd w jygh w jhnm st, w (an) chh bd jy'y st.
(hr ykh z) yshn, drjty dr nzd llh drnd, w llh bh anchh mykhnnd; bynst.

bh rsty khh llh br mw'mnn mnWt nhd, hngmykhh dr myn ann pymbry z khwdshn br ngykht, khh ayt w (= qran) r br anh mykhwnd w pkhyzh shn mydrd w bh ann khtb (= qran) w Hkhmt (= snt) myamwzd, w gr chh pysh z an dr gmrhy ashkhry bwdnd.

ay hngmykhh mSybty (dr jng Hd) bh shm rsyd, dr Hlykhh dw brbr an r (dr jng bdr bh khfrn) rsndh bwdyd, gftyd: <<yn (mSybt) z khj st?>> bgw: <<an z jnb khwd tn st>> (w ntyjh n frmny dstwr pymbr st) bygmn llh br hr chyz twnst.
w anchh (dr rwz Hd) rwzykhh dw grwh (mw'mnn w khfrn) b hm brkhwrd khrdnd, bh shm rsyd, bh frmn llh bwd, w bry yn bwd khh mw'mnn r m`lwm bdrd.

w (nyz) khsnykhh nfq wrzydnd m`lwm bdrd. w bh yshn gfth shd: <<byyyd dr rh llh bjngyd y (Hdql z khwd w shhrtn) df` khnyd>>. gftnd: <<gr mydnstym jngy rwy khwhd dd, mslman z shm pyrwy mykhrdym>>. ann dr an hngm, bh khfr nzdykhtr bwdnd t bh ymn, bh zbn khwysh chyzy mygwynd khh dr dlhy shn nyst, w llh bh anchh khtmn mykhnnd; aghtr st.
khsnykhh (khwd dr khnh) nshstnd w drbrhy brdrn khwd gftnd: <<gr anh z m pyrwy mykhrdnd, khshth nmyshdnd>> bgw: <<gr rst mygwyyd; ps mrg r z khwdtn dwr szyd>>.
w hrgz khsny r khh dr rh llh khshth shdhnd; mrdh mpndr, blkhh zndhnd, nzd prwrdgrshn rwzy ddh myshwnd.
bh anchh llh z fDl w khrm khwd bh yshn ddhst, shdmnnd, w bh khsnykhh hnwz bh anh npywsthnd, khwsh wqtnd, khh nh bymy br anhst w nh ndwhgyn myshwnd.
bh n`mt w fDl llh shdmnnd, w ynkhh (my bynnd) llh pdsh mw'mnn r Dy` nmykhnd.
khsnykhh d`wt llh w pymbr r ps z ankhh (dr mydn Hd) bh ann zkhm w jrHt rsyd jbt khrdnd. (w bry t`qyb mshrkhn bh swy <<Hmr l'sd>> rftnd) bry khsny z anh khh nykhy w prhyzgry khrdnd, pdsh bzrgy st.
khsnykhh mrdm bh ann gftnd: <<mrdm (= mshrkhn mkhh) bry (jng b) shm grd amdhnd, ps z anh btrsyd>>. (yn skhn) br ymnshn fzwdh w gftnd: <<llh m r bs st, w bhtryn Hmy st>>.
ps bh n`mt w fDl llh (z mydn jng) bzgshtnd, hych asyby bh ann nrsyd, w khshnwdy llh r pyrwy khrdnd, w llh dry fDl w bkhshsh bzrgy st.
(dr Hqyqt) yn shyTn st khh dwstnsh r mytrsnd, ps gr ymn dryd z anh ntrsyd, w z mn btrsyd.
w khsnykhh dr (yry) khfr shtb mykhnnd, tw r ndwhgyn nszd! yqynan anh hrgz zyny bh llh nmyrsnnd, llh mykhwhd khh bhrhy bry ann dr akhrt qrr ndhd w bry anh, `dhb bzrgy st.
bh rsty khsnykhh khfr r bh (bhy) ymn khrydnd, hrgz bh llh zyny nmyrsnnd, w bry anh, `dhb drdnkhy st.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd, mpndryd khh bh ann mhlt mydhym, bryshn bhtr st, m fqT bh anh mhlt mydhym; t br gnh (khwd) byfzynd, w bry anh `dhb khwr khnndhy st.

chnyn nbwd khh llh, mw'mnn r bh yn (Hly) khh shm br an hstyd, w gdhrd, t ankhh plyd r z pkh jd szd, w chnyn nbwd khh llh shm r z Gyb agh khnd, wly llh z myn frstdgnsh, hr khs r bkhwhd br mygzynd, ps bh llh w frstdgnsh ymn bywryd, w gr ymn bywryd w tqw pyshh khnyd, pdsh bzrgy bry shmst.

w khsnykhh bh anchh llh z fDl khwysh bh ann ddh, bkhl mywrznd, gmn nkhnnd khh an (bkhl) bry ann khyr st. blkhh bry anh shWr st, bh zwdy anchh r khh nsbt bh an bkhl wrzydn, rwz qymt Twq grdnshn myshwd, w myrth asmnh w zmyn z an llh st, w llh bh anchh mykhnyd;agh st.
bh rsty khh llh, skhn khsny r khh gftnd: <<khd fqyr st, w m by nyzym!>> shnyd, bh zwdy anchh r gftnd, w bh nHq khshtn pymbrn r khwhym nwsht, w mygwyym: <<bchshyd `dhb swzn r>>.
yn (`qwbt) bkhTr chyzy st khh dst hy shm z pysh frstdhst, w (grnh) llh hrgz bh bndgn (khwd) stmgr nyst.

khsnykhh gftnd: <<llh b m `hd w pymn bsth, khh bh hych pymbry ymn nywrym, t bry m qrbnyy bywrd khh atsh (= S`qh asmny) an r bkhwrd>> bgw: <<qT`an pymbrny pysh z mn, bry shm amdnd b m`jzhh w dlyl rwshn, w anchh r gftyd, (bry shm awrdnd) ps gr rst mygwyyd chr anh r khshtyd?!>>
ps gr tw r tkhdhyb khrdnd, (Gmgyn mbsh) pymbrny (hm) khh pysh z tw, dlyl rwshn, w nwshthh w khtb rwshn awrdh bwdnd, tkhdhyb shdnd.

hr khs chshndh (T`m) mrg st, w hmn rwz qymt pdshhytn r bTwr khml bh shm ddh myshwd, ps hr khh z atsh (dwzkh) dwr dshth shd, w bh bhsht dr awrdh shd, qT`an rstgr shdhst. w zndgy dny chyzy jz myh fryb nyst.

qT`an dr mwltn w jnhytn, azmysh myshwyd, w z khsnykhh pysh z shm bh anh khtb (asmny) ddh shdhst (= yhwd w nSry) w (nyz) z khsnykhh shrkh wrzydnd, skhnn azr dhndhy bsyry khwhyd shnyd, w gr Sbr khnyd, w tqw pyshh szyd, (bdnyd khh) yn z khrhy mhm w strg st.

w (bh yd bywryd) hngmy r khh llh, z khsnykhh khtb (asmny) bh anh ddh shdh, pymn grft, khh Htman an r bry mrdm byn khnyd, w an r khtmn nkhnyd, ps an (`hd) r psht sr khwd ndkhtnd, w bh bhy khmy frwkhtnd, chh bd st anchh mykhrnd?!
gmn mbr khsnykhh bh anchh khrdhnd khwshHl myshwnd, w dwst drnd bh anchh nkhrdhnd stwdh shwnd, qT`an gmn mbr z `dhb (lhy) njt w rhyy ybnd, (blkhh) bry anh, `dhb drdnkhy st.
w frmnrwyy asmnh w zmyn z an llh st, w llh br hr chyzy twnst.
bh rsty dr afrynsh asmnh w zmyn, w amd w rft shb w rwz, nshnhhy (ashkhry) bry khrdmndn st.

khsnykhh llh r dr Hl ystdh w nshsth, w br phlwy khwysh (armydh) yd mykhnnd, w dr afrynsh asmnh w zmyn myndyshnd, (w mygwynd:) prwrdgr ynh r byhwdh nyfrydhy, mnzhWy tw! ps m r z `dhb atsh (dwzkh) ngh dr.
prwrdgr! khsy r khh tw bh atsh (dwzkh) drawry, yqynan w r khwr w rsw khrdhy, w bry stmkhrn ywrny nyst.
prwrdgr! m shnydym khh nd dhndhy bh ymn fr mykhwnd, khh: <<bh prwrdgr khwd ymn bywryd>> ps ymn awrdym, prwrdgr! ps gnhn m r bbkhsh, w bdyhy m r bpwshn, w m r b nykhn bmyrn.
prwrdgr! anchh r khh br (zbn) frstdgnt bh m w`dh ddhy bh m `T khn, w m r dr rwz qymt rsw mgrdn, bdrsty khh tw khlf w`dh nmykhny.

ps prwrdgrshn d`y ann r jbt khrd. (w frmwd:) mn `ml hych `ml khnndhy z shm r, zn bshd y mrd; tbh w Dy` nmykhnm, brkhy z brkhy dygryd (w hmnw`yd). ps, khsnykhh hjrt khrdnd w z khnhhy khwd rndh shdnd, w dr rh mn azr dydnd w jngydnd w khshth shdnd, qT`an gnhnshn r mybkhshm w ann r bh bGhy (bhshty) khh z zyr (drkhtn) an nhrh jry st, dr myawrm. (yn) pdshy st z jnb khd, w pdsh nykhw tnh nzd llh st.
rft w amd khfrn dr shhrh, tw r nfrybd!
(yn) mt` nchyzy st, ps jyghshn dwzkh st, w chh bd jyghy st.
wly khsnykhh z prwrdgrshn trsydnd, bry anh bGhyy st khh z zyr (drkhtn) an nhrh jry st, jwdnh dr an mymnnd, (yn) pdhyry'y z jnb llh st, w anchh dr nzd llh st; bry nykhwkhrn bhtr st.

w z hl khtb khsny hstnd khh bh khd, w anchh br shm nzl shdh w anchh br khwdshn nzl shdh; ymn drnd, dr brbr (frmn) llh khsh` w frwtnnd, w ayt llh r bh bhy nchyzy nmyfrwshnd, ynnnd khh pdshshn r dr nzd prwrdgrshn khwhnd dsht, bygmn llh sry`lHsb (zwd shmr) st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! Sbr khnyd, w dygrn r bh Sbr w shkhybyy fr khwnyd (w pydry khnyd) w mrzh r nghbny khnyd, w z llh btrsyd, shyd rstgr shwyd.

y mrdm z prwrdgrtn btrsyd, an dhty khh shm r z ykh tn afryd, w hmsrsh r (nyz) z w afryd, w z an dw, mrdn w znn bsyry prkhndh khrd, w z prwrdgry khh bh (nm) w z hmdygr drkhwst mykhnyd, w (hmchnyn) z (gsstn) pywnd khwyshwndy bprhyzyd. bygmn llh hmwrh br shm mrqb (w nghbn) st.
w bh ytymn mwlshn r bdhyd, w (mwl) npkh (khwd) r b (mwl) pkh (ytymn) `wD nkhnyd, w mwl ann r hmrh mwl khwdtn (b mkhlwT khrdn) nkhwryd, bh rsty khh yn gnh bzrgy st.

w gr trsydyd khh dr Hq dkhtrn ytym ntwnyd `dlt r r`yt khnyd, (z zdwj b anh Srf nZr khnyd w) b znny (dygr) khh mwrd psnd shmst dw dw, w sh sh, chhr chhr, zdwj khnyd. ps gr bym dryd khh ntwnyd `dlt khnyd, bh ykh (zn) y bh anchh (z khnyzn) khh mlkh anhyyd (khtf nmyyd) yn (khr) nzdykhtr st bh ynkhh stm nkhnyd.
w mhryh znn r bh `nwn hdyh (w fryDhy lhy) b Tyb khTr bh ann bdhyd, ps gr ann chyzy z an r b rDyt khTr bh shm bkhshydnd, an r Hll w gwr bkhwryd.
w mwl khwd r khh llh an r wsylh qwm (zndgy) shm qrr ddhst, bh sfyhn (w khm khrdn) ndhyd, w z an, bh anh rwzy dhyd, w ann r lbs bpwshnyd, w b ann skhn shysth bgwyyd.

w ytymn r byzmyyd t wqty khh bh (sn) zdwj (w blwGt) rsnd, ps gr dr yshn rshd (khfy) yftyd, mwlshn r bh ann bdhyd, w an r (z bym) ankhh bzrg shwnd, bh srf w shtb mkhwryd, w hr khs khh bynyz st; byd (z grftn Hq lzHmh) khwd dry khnd, w hr khs khh nyzmnd st; byd bh Trz shysth (w bhndzh HqlzHmh w nyz khwd z an) bkhwrd, ps hr gh mwlshn r bh anh bz grdndyd; br yshn gwh bgyryd, w llh bry mHsbh khfy st.

bry mrdn, z anchh pdr w mdr w khwyshwndn (z khwd) br jy gdhshthnd; shmy st, w bry znn (nyz) z anchh pdr w mdr w khwyshwndn br jy gdhshthnd, shmy st, khwh an (ml)khm bshd y zyd, yn bhrh w shmy frD w t`yn shdhst.
w hr gh, khwyshwndn w ytymn w mstmndn br tqsym (myrth) HDr shdnd, (chyzy) z an (mwl) bh ann bdhyd, w b ann bTwr shysth w nykh skhn bgwyyd.
w khsnykhh gr frzndn ntwny ps z khwd br jy bgdhrnd, br (ayndh) ann mytrsnd; byd (z stm drbrhy ytymn mrdm nyz) btrsnd, ps byd khh z llh btrsnd w skhny snjydh w drst bgwynd.
bygmn khsnykhh mwl ytymn r bh stm mykhwrnd, jz yn nyst khh atsh r dr shkhm khwd (frw mybrnd w) mykhwrnd, w bh zwdy bh atshy brfrwkhth draynd.

llh drbrhy frzndntn bh shm sfrsh mykhnd, shm psr, chwn shm dw dkhtr st. ps gr (frzndn myt hmh) dkhtr (dw dkhtr y) bysh z dw dkhtr bshnd, dw swm trkhh bhrh yshn st, w gr ykh dkhtr bshd, nymy z trkhh z an wst. w bry hr ykh z pdr w mdr wy (= myt) ykh shshm z trkhh mybshd, dr Swrty khh (myt) frzndy dshth bshd, ps gr frzndy ndshth bshd w (tnh) pdr w mdrsh z w rth brnd, bry mdrsh ykh swm st (w bqy z an pdr khwhd bwd) w gr w (= myt) brdrny dshth bshd, shm mdrsh ykh shshm st, (hmh ynh) ps z njm wSyty st khh w (= myt) bh an sfrsh khrdh w b`d z dy dyn st, shm nmydnyd pdrntn w frzndntn khdm ykh bry shm swdmndtrnd. (yn Hkhm) fryDhy (m`yn w mqrr shdh) z jnb llh st w bygmn llh dny Hkhym st.

w bry shm nSf trkhh hmsrn tn st, gr anh frzndy ndshth bshnd, w gr frzndy dshth bshnd ykh chhrm trkhh z an shmst [dr hngm nbwdn frznd, nwhh Hkhm frznd r drnd. dr yn mwrd jm` `lm hst.]. ps z njm wSyty khh bh an sfrsh khrdhnd, w b`d z dy dyn (anh) st. w bry znn shm ykh chhrm trkhh shmst, gr shm frzndy ndshth bshyd, ps gr frzndy dshth bshyd ykh hshtm z trkhh shm z an anhst, b`d z njm wSyty khh bh an sfrsh khrdhyd w b`d z dy dyn. w gr mrd y zny khh z w rth mybrnd khllh (= by frznd w by pdr) bshd, w bry w brdr y khwhr (mdry) bshd; ps bry hr ykh z an dw ykh shshm st, w gr anh bysh z yn bshnd; dr ykh swm shrykhnd, ps z njm wSyty khh bh an sfrsh shdh w b`d z dy dayn, (bh shrT ankhh) zyny (bh wrthh) nrsnd, yn (Hkhm w) sfrsh llh st, w llh dny brdbr st.
ynh (Hkhm w) Hdwd lhy st, w hr khs z llh w pymbrsh T`t khnd, w y r bh bGhyy dr awrd khh z zyr (drkhtn) an nhrh jry st, dr an jwdnhnd, w yn pyrwzy bzrgy st.
w hr khs z llh w pymbrsh nfrmny khnd w z Hdwd w tjwz khnd, wy r dr atshy wrd mykhnd khh jwdnh dr an khwhd mnd, w bry w `dhb khwr khnndhy st.

w khsny z znn shm khh mrtkhb zn myshwd, chhr nfr z khwdtn br ann gwh gyryd, ps gr gwhy ddnd, ann (= znn) r dr khnhh ngh dryd, t mrgshn fr rsd, y llh rhy bry ann qrr dhd [ Hkhm yn ayh b ayh 3 swrhy nwr mnswkh grdydh st. (bh tfsyr bn khthyr rjw` khnyd)].
w z myn shm, an mrd w zny khh mrtkhb an (`ml zsht) myshwnd; anh r azr dhyd, ps gr twbh khrdnd w drstkhr shdnd, z anh Srf nZr khnyd, zyr llh twbhpdhyr mhrbn st.
jz yn nyst, khh (pdhyrsh) twbh z swy khd, bry khsny st khh z rwy jhlt w ndny khr bdy njm mydhnd. sps bh zwdy twbh mykhnnd, ynnnd khh llh twbh shn r mypdhyrd, w llh dny Hkhym st.

w bry khsnykhh khrhy bd mrtkhb myshwnd, t wqty khh mrg ykhy z yshn fr rsd; mygwyd: <<khnwn twbh khrdm>> twbh nyst, w nh bry khsnykhh dr Hl khfr mymyrnd, ynh khsny hstnd khh bryshn `dhb drdnkhy amdh khrdym.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! bry shm Hll nyst khh z znn bh khrh rth bryd, w ann r zyr fshr qrr ndhyd, t brkhy z anchh r khh bh ann [z mahr] ddhyd; ps bgyryd, mgr ynkhh anh mrtkhb `ml zsht ashkhry shwnd, w b anh bTwr shysth rftr khnyd, w gr z ann (khwshtn nymd w) khrht dshtyd, ps chh bs chyzy r khwsh nmydryd, w llh dr an khyr bsyr qrr mydhd.
w gr khwstyd hmsry (dygr) bh jy hmsr (pyshyn khwd) brgzynyd, w bh ykhy z ann ml frwny (b`nwn mhryh) prdkhth yd, chyzy zan r ps ngyryd, ay an (ml) rbh bhtn w gnh ashkhr bzps mygyryd?
w chgwnh an r bzps mygyryd dr Hlykhh shm b ykhdygramyzsh nmwdhyd, w ann (hngm `qd zdwj) z shm pymny mHkhm w stwr grfthnd?!
w b znny khh pdrntn (banh) zdwj khrdhnd, zdwj nkhnyd, mgr anchh (zmn jhlyt bwdh w) gdhshth st, chr khh yn khr, `mly zsht w mnfwr w rh w rwsh bsyr bdy st.

Hrm shdhst br shm: mdrntn, w dkhtrntn, w khwhrntn, w `mhhytn, w khlhhytn, w dkhtrn brdr, w dkhtrn khwhr, w mdrntn khh bh shm shyr ddhnd, w khwhrn rD`y shm, w mdrn znntn, w dkhtrn hmsrntn khh dr dmn shm prwrsh yfthnd z hmsrny khh b anh hmbstry khrdhyd, ps gr b anh hmbstry nkhrdhyd; br shm gnhy nyst (khh b dkhtrnshn zdwj khnyd) w (hmchnyn) znn psrntn khh z psht w Slb khwdtn hstnd, w (nyz) jm` myn dw khwhr (br shm Hrm st) mgr anchh khh dr gdhshth rkh ddh bshd khh llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

w znn shwhrdr (br shm Hrm st) mgr znny khh mlkh ann shdhyd. (yn) fryDhy lhy st khh br shm mqrr dshth st. w Gyr z ynh (khh gfth shd) bry shm Hll st b mwl khwd (znn dygr r) Tlb khnyd dr Hlykhh pkhdmn bshyd w znkhr nbshd ps an znny r khh (bh zdwj dr awrdyd w) z ann khm grftyd, byd mhrshn r bh `nwn fryDhy bh ann bdhyd, w gnhy br shm nyst dr anchh b`d z t`yyn mhryh b ykhdygr twfq khnyd, bygmn llh dny Hkhym st.

w hr khs z shm z lHZ mly twnyy zdwj b znn azdh mw'mn; ndshth bshd, ps b khnyzn b ymny khh mlkh ymyn shm hstnd (zdwj khnd) w llh bh ymn shm dntr st. brkhy z brkhy hstnd, ps ann r b jzh SHbnshn bh zdwj khwd dr awryd, w mhrshn bh Twr psndydh bh ann bdhyd. (bh shrT ankhh) pkhdmn bshnd, nh znkhr, w nh ann khh dr pnhny dwst gyrnd. ps chwn zdwj khrdnd, gr mrtkhb zn shdnd, ps mjztshn; nSf mjzt znn azd (pnjh tzynh) st [ Glm y khnyz chh mt'hl bshd y Gyr mt'hl gr mrtkhb zn grdd pnjh Drbhy shlq zdh myshwd w br w Hkhm rjm (sngsry) jry nkhwhd grdyd.]. yn (jzh zdwj b khnyzn) bry khsny z shmst khh z alysh gnh btrsd, w Sbr (w pkhdmny) pyshh khrdn; brytn bhtr st. w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
llh mykhwhd khh (Hkhm khwysh r) bry shm rwshn szd, w shm r bh rh w rwsh khsnykhh pysh z shm bwdnd; rhnmyy khnd, w llh dny Hkhym st.
w llh mykhwhd twbh shm r bpdhyrd (w z alwdgy pkh nmyd) w khsnykhh z khwsthhy nfsny pyrwy mykhnnd; mykhwhnd shm dstkhwsh nHrf bzrgy shwyd.
llh mykhwhd khr r br shm sbkh w asn khnd, w nsn, D`yf w ntwn afrydh shdhst.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! mwl ykhdygr r bh bTl (w z rhhy nmshrw`) nkhwryd, mgr ynkhh tjrty b rDyt shm (njm grfth) bshd. w khwdtn r nkhshyd [ y`ny khwdkhshy nkhnyd], zyr llh (nsbt) bh shm mhrbn st.
w hr khs khh rwy tjwz w stm chnyn khnd, ps bzwdy w r dr atshy (swzn) dr awrym, w yn br llh asn st.
gr z gnhn bzrgy khh z an nhy shdhyd; dwry khnyd, gnhn (SGyrh) shm r z shm myzdyym, w shm r dr jygh khwby (= bhsht) wrd mykhnym.

anchh r khh llh bdn b`Dy z shm r br b`Dy dygr brtry bkhshydhst, arzw mkhnyd, mrdn r z anchh bh dst awrdhnd; bhrhy st, w znn r (nyz) z anchh bh dst awrdhnd; bhrhy st, w z llh z fDl w bkhshsh w bkhwhyd, bygmn llh bh hr chyzy dnst.
w m bry hr khs, wrthny qrr ddhym, khh z anchh pdr w mdr w khwyshwndn, br jy gdhshthnd; rth bbrnd, w (nyz) khsnykhh shm (b ann) pymn bsthyd; nSybshn r bdhyd. bygmn llh br hr chyzy gwh st.

mrdn br znn sr prst w nghbnnd, bkhTr ankhh llh brkhy z yshn r br brkhy brtry ddh, w (nyz) bkhTr ankhh z mwlshn khrj mykhnnd. ps znn SlH, frmnbrdrnd, (w) bh ps anchh llh (bry ann) HfZ khrdh, (srr w Hqwq shwhrn khwd) r dr Gybt (ann) HfZ mykhnnd. w znny r khh nfrmny anh bym dryd, pnd w ndrz shn dhyd, (gr frmnbrdr nshd) dr bstr z yshn dwry khnyd, (w gr t'thyr nkhrd) ann r bznyd, ps gr z shm T`t khrdnd, hych rhy bry (srznsh w) t`dWy br anh mjwyyd, (bdnyd) khh llh, blnd mrtbhy bzrg st.

w gr z khtlf w jdy'y myn an dw (zn w shwhr) bym dshtyd, ps dwry z khnwdh shwhr w dwry z khnwdh zn (t`yyn khnyd w) bfrstyd, gr yn dw (dwr) qSd SlH dshth bshnd, llh myn an dw (zn w shwhr) szgry khwhd dd. bygmn llh dny agh st.

w llh r bprstyd, w chyzy r b w shrykh mgrdnyd. w bh pdr w mdr nykhy khnyd, w (nyz) bh khwyshwndn w ytymn w bynwyn w hmsyh khwyshwnd w hmsyh bygnh w hmnshyn w dr rhmndgn w brdgny khh mlkh anh hstyd, (nykhy khnyd) bygmn llh khsy r khh mtkhbWr w fkhr frwsh st; dwst nmydrd.
khsnykhh bkhl mywrznd, w mrdm r bh bkhl w mydrnd, w anchh r khh llh z fDl khwysh bh anh ddh, khtmn mynmynd, w bry khfrn (w nspsn) `dhby khwr khnndh amdh khrdhym.
w (nyz bry) khsnykhh mwlshn r bry nshn ddn bh mrdm nfq mykhnnd, w bh llh w rwz akhrt ymn ndrnd, w khsykhh shyTn hmdm w bshd, chh bd hmdmy st.
w gr anh bh llh w rwz akhrt ymn myawrdnd, w z anchh llh bh ann rwzy ddh, nfq mykhrdnd; chh zyny bry ann dsht?! w llh bh (Hl w `ml) anh dnst.
bygmn llh bhndzhy dhrhy stm nmykhnd, w gr khr nykhy b shd, an r dw chndn mykhnd, w z nzd khwd, pdsh bzrgy `T mykhnd.
ps chgwnh st (Hlshn)angh khh z hr mty gwhy awrym, w tw r br ynn gwh awrym?!
an rwz, khsnykhh khfr shdnd, w z pymbr nfrmny khrdnd, arzw mykhnnd khh y khsh b khkh ykhsn myshdnd, w hych skhny r nmytwnnd z llh pnhn khnnd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! dr Hl msty bh nmz nzdykh nshwyd, t bdnyd chh mygwyyd, w (nyz) dr Hl jnbt, t Gsl khnyd, mgr ynkhh rhgdhr bshyd. w gr bymr, y msfr bwdyd, w y ykhy z shm z mkhn qDy Hjt amd, y b znn amyzsh khrdhyd, w ab nyftyd, ps b khkh pkh tymWm khnyd, (bh yn rwsh khh) chhrh w dsthytn r (b an) msH khnyd, bygmn llh bkhshndhy amrzndh st.
ay ndydy khsny r khh bhrhy z khtb bh anh ddh shdhst, gmrhy r mykhrnd, w mykhwhnd shm (nyz) gmrh shwyd?
w llh bh dshmnn shm dntr st, w khfy st khh llh sr prst (shm) bshd, w khfy st khh llh ywr (shm) bshd.

brkhy z yhwd, khlmt (khd) r z jy khwd tHryf mykhnnd, my gwynd: <<shnydym w nfrmny khrdym>> w (nyz mygwynd:) <<bshnw, khh hrgz nshnwy>>. w (z rwy tmskhr mygwynd: <<r`n (= m r tHmyq khn)>> t b pychnydn zbn khwd bh dyn (slm) T`nh bznnd, wly gr anh mygftnd: <<shnydym w T`t khrdym, w (skhnn m r) bshnw w bh m mhlt bdh>>. qT`an bry ann bhtr w drst tr bwd, wly llh anh r bkhTr khfr shn l`nt khrdhst, ldh jz (grwhy) ndkh ymn nmyawrnd.

y khsnykhh khtb (asmny) bh shm ddh shdhst! bh anchh (br pymbr khwd) nzl khrdym, w tSdyqkhnndhy hmn chyzy st khh b shmst, ymn bywryd, pysh z ankhh Swrthyy r mHw khnym, angh anh r bh psht sr bz grdnym, y anh r l`nt khnym, hmngwnh khh SHb shnbh (grwhy z yhwd khh nfrmny khrdnd w dr rwz shnbh mhy grftnd) r l`nt khrdym. w frmn llh njm shdny st.
bygmn llh yn r khh bh w shrkh awrdh shwd, nmybkhshd, w Gyr z an r bry hr khs bkhwhd mybkhshd, w hr khs khh bh llh shrkh wrzd, yqynan gnhy bzrg br bfth st.
ay ndydy khsny r khh khwyshtn r pkh myshmrnd, (w khwdsty'y mykhnnd) blkhh llh hr khs r bkhwhd pkh mygrdnd, w bh anh ndzhy nkh rwy hsth khrmyy stm nmyshwnd.
bbyn chgwnh br llh drwG mybndnd, w hmyn khfy st khh yn, gnh ashkhry bshd.

ay ndydy khsny r khh bhrhy z khtb (asmny) bh ann ddh shdnd, bh jbt (= bt w sHr) w TGwt (= m`bwdn bTl) ymn myawrnd, w drbrh khsnykhh khfr wrzydhnd mygwynd: <<ynn z khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd, hdyt yfthtrnd>>?!
anh khsny hstnd khh llh l`nt shn khrdh, w hr khh r llh l`nt khnd, hrgz bry w ywry nkhwhy yft.
ay anh bhrhy z frmnrwyy w Hkhwmt drnd? ps dr yn Swrt bhndzh pwst hsth khrmyy (chyzy) bh mrdm nmyddnd.
ay bh mrdm (= pymbr w yrnsh) br anchh llh z fDl khwysh bh ann `T khrdh Hsd mywrznd? dr Hqyqt m bh khndn brhym khtb w Hkhmt ddym, w bh ann frmnrwyy bzrg bkhshydym.
ps brkhy z ann bh wy (= mHmd Sly llh `lyh wslm) ymn awrdnd w brkhy z ann z w rwy grdndnd, w (bry anh) atsh frwkhthy jhnm khfy st.
bygmn khsnykhh bh ayt m khfr wrzydnd, bzwdy anh r dr atshy (swzn) wrd mykhnym khh hr chh pwstshn bryn grdd, pwsthy dygry bh jysh qrrdhym, t (T`m) `dhb r bchshnd, Hq khh llh twnmnd Hkhym st.

w khsnykhh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd, bzwdy anh r bh bGhyy (z bhsht) wrd mykhnym, khh z zyr (drkhtn) an nhrh jry st, hmyshh dr an khwhnd mnd, w dr anj hmsrn pkhyzh drnd, w ann r bh syhhy gstrdh (w arm bkhsh) dr awrym.
bygmn llh bh shm frmn mydhd khh mnth r bh SHbn anh bz grdnyd. w hngmykhh myn mrdm dwry mykhnyd, bh `dlt dwry khnyd, dr Hqyqt, nykhw chyzy st khh llh shm r bh an ndrz mydhd, bygmn llh shnwy bynst.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! T`t khnyd llh r, w T`t khnyd pymbr, w SHbn mr tn r, w gr dr chyzy khtlf khrdyd, an r bh llh w pymbr bz grdnyd; gr bh llh w rwz qymt ymn dryd, yn bhtr w khwsh frjmtr st.

ay ndydhy khsny r khh gmn mykhnnd bh anchh br tw nzl shdh w bh anchh pysh z tw nzl shdhst; ymn awrdhnd, (wly) mykhwhnd bry dwry nzd TGwt (w Hkhm srkhsh) brwnd b an khh bh anh dstwr ddh shdh khh bh w khfr wrznd, w shyTn mykhwhd gmrh shn khnd, (w bh) gmrhy dwry (byfkhnd).
w chwn bh anh gfth shwd: <<bh swy anchh llh nzl khrdh, w bh swy pymbr byyyd>> mnfqn r mybyny khh z tw skht rwy mygrdnnd.
ps chgwnh wqty khh bh khTr `ml bdshn, mSybty bh ann brsd, angh nzd tw myaynd, swgnd bh llh yd mykhnnd khh mnZwr m (z rftn bry dwry nzd dygrn) jz nykhy w twfq (myn Trfyn) nbwdhst.
ann khsny hstnd khh llh anchh r dr dl drnd, my dnd. ps z ann rwy brgrdn, w ndrzshn bdh, w b byny rs (ntyj)khrdr shn r bh anh gwsh zd khn.
m hych pymbry r nfrstdym; mgr bry ynkhh bh frmn llh (z wy) T`t shwd. w gr anh hngmykhh br khwyshtn stm mykhrdnd, nzd tw myamdnd, w z llh Tlb amrzsh mykhrdnd, bygmn llh r twbhpdhyr mhrbn myyftnd.
nh, swgnd bh prwrdgrt khh anh ymn nmyawrnd, mgr ynkhh dr khtlft khwysh tw r dwr qrr dhnd, w sps z dwry tw, dr dl khwd Hss nrHty nkhnnd w khmlan tslym bshnd.

w gr (mnnd bny sry'yl) br ann mqrr mykhrdym khh khwd r bkhshyd, y z khnh w shhrtn byrwn rwyd, jz ndkhy z anh `ml nmykhrdnd, w gr ndrz hy khh bh ann ddh myshwd njm myddnd, bry anh bhtr bwd w (bry ymnshn) stwr tr bwd.
w dr yn Swrt z jnb khwd pdsh bzrgy bh anh myddym.
w bh rh rst, hdytshn mykhrdym.
w khsykhh llh w pymbr r T`t khnd (rwz qymt) hmnshyn khsny khwhd bwd khh llh br ann n`m nmwdhst, z pymbrn, w Sdyqn w shhd w SlHn, w ynn chh nykhw rfyqny hstnd.
