y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! slH khwd r br gyryd, angh grwh grwh byrwn rwyd y ykhprchh (bh swy dshmn) byrwn shwyd.
w bh rsty z (myn) shm khsy st khh (z shrkht dr jhd) ssty mykhnd, ps gr mSybty bh shm brsd, mygwyd: llh br mn n`m khrd khh b ann HDr nbwdm.
w gr fDl w Gnymty z jnb llh bh shm brsd, chnn khh gwy hrgz myn shm w ann dwsty w mwdty nbwdh, mygwynd: y khsh mn hm b anh bwdm, w bh khmyby bzrgy ny'l myshdm.
ps khsnykhh zndgy dny r bh akhrt frwkhthnd, byd dr rh llh pykhr khnnd, w an khsykhh dr rh llh pykhr khnd, chh khshth shwd y pyrwz grdd, bh zwdy pdsh bzrgy khwhym dd.

w shm r chh shdhst khh dr rh llh w (bry yry) mrdn w znn w khwdkhn, mstD`f pykhr nmykhnyd, ann khh mygwynd: <<prwrdgr! m r z yn shhr (mkhh) khh hlsh stmgrnd, byrwn bbr, w z jnb khwd, bry m sr prsty qrr bdh, w z jnb khwd yr w mddkhry bry m mqrr khn>>.
khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd dr rh llh pykhr mykhnnd, w ann khh khfrnd dr rh TGwt (= bt w shyTn) pykhr mykhnnd, ps shm b yrn shyTn pykhr khnyd, qT`an nyrng (w nqshh) shyTn D`yf st.

ay ndydy khsny r khh (dr mkhh) bh anh gfth shd: <<(khnwn) dst z jng brdryd, w nmz r br p khnyd w zkht bdhyd>> ps chwn (dr mdynh) jhd br ann mqrr shd, ngh jm`y z ann, z mrdm mytrsydnd hmngwnh khh z llh mytrsnd y byshtr mytrsydnd, w gftnd: <<prwrdgr, chr jhd r br m mqrr khrdy?! chr m r t zmny nzdykh mhlt nddy?>> bgw: <<mt` dny nchyz st, w sry akhrt, bry khsykhh prhyzgr bshd, bhtr st, bhndzhy rshthy (khh dr myn hsth khrmst) bh shm stm nkhwhd shd.

hr khj bshyd, mrg shm r dr myybd, hr chnd dr brjhy mHkhm bshyd, w gr bh anh (= mnfqn) khyry brsd, mygwynd: <<yn z jnb llh st >> w gr bdy bh anh brsd mygwynd: <<yn z jnb twst>>. bgw: <<hmh z jnb llh st>> ps chr yn qwm HDr nystnd skhny r drkh khnnd?!
anchh z nykhyh bh tw rsd; ps z jnb llh st, w anchh z bdy bh tw rsd; z jnb khwd twst, w m tw r rswl bry mrdm frstdym, w gwhy llh (dr yn brh) khfy st.
khsykhh z pymbr T`t khnd dr Hqyqt llh r T`t khrdhst, w khsykhh srbz znd, tw r bryshn nghbn (w mrqb) nfrstdym.

w ann (dr HDwr tw) mygwynd: <<frmnbrdrym>> w chwn z nzd tw byrwn rwnd; grwhy z ann br khlf gfthhy tw, jlst srWy shbnh tshkhyl mydhnd. w anchh (dr anj) shbnh nqshh mykhshnd; llh mynwysd. ps z ann rwy bgrdn, w br llh twkhl khn, w w yr w mdf` tw bshd khfy st.
ay dr qran nmyndyshnd? khh gr z swy Gyr llh bwd, qT`an khtlf bsyr dr an myyftnd.

w hngmykhh khbry z ymny (w pyrwzy) y trs (w shkhst) bh anh brsd an r shy` mysznd, dr Hlykhh gr an r bh pymbr w SHbn mrshn bz mygrdndnd, z Hqyqt mr agh myshdnd, w gr fDl w rHmt llh br shm nbwd, jz ndkhy, (hmgy) z shyTn pyrwy mykhrdyd.
ps dr rh llh pykhr khn, jz br nfs khwdt mkhlf nysty, w mw'mnn r (bh jhd) tshwyq khn, myd st llh z asyb (w qdrt) khfrn jlwgyry khnd, w llh qdrtsh byshtr, w khyfrsh skhttr st.
khsykhh shf`ty (= mynjy) nykh khnd, nSyby z an bry w khwhd bwd. w khsykhh shf`t bdy khnd; shmy z an khwhd dsht, w llh br hr chyz twn (w nghbnn) st.
w chwn shm r tHyt (w slm) gwynd, ps pskhy bhtr w y hmnnd an bdhyd, llh br hmh chyz Hsbrs st.
llh (m`bwd br Hq st) m`bwdy jz w nyst, w yqynan hmhy shm r dr rwz qymt - khh shkhy dr an nyst;- jm` mykhnd, w khyst khh z llh rstgwtr bshd.

chyst shm r khh drbrhy mnfqn dw grwh shdhyd? dr Hlykhh llh bkhTr `mlshn, ann r srngwn (w mrdwd) khrdhst, ay shm mykhwhyd khsy r khh llh gmrh khrdhst, hdyt khnyd? dr Hlykhh hr khs r llh gmrh khnd, bry w rhy nkhwhy yft.

ann arzw mykhnnd khh shm hm mnnd anh khfr shwyd t b hm ykhsn shwyd, bnbryn z anh dwstny ntkhb nkhnyd, t ynkhh (mslmn shwnd w) dr rh llh hjrt khnnd, ps hr gh z yn khr srbz zdnd, hr j khh anh r yftyd, bgyryd. w bkhshyd, w z myn anh yr w ywry khtyr nkhnyd.

mgr anhyy khh b hm pymnn shm pymn bsthnd, y anhyy khh bswy shm myaynd w z pykhr b shm y pykhr b qwmshn dltng bshnd, w gr llh bkhwhd, ann r br shm mslT mykhnd t b shm pykhr khnnd, ps gr z shm khnrh gyry khrdnd w b shm pykhr nkhrdnd w bh shm pyshnhd SlH ddnd, ps (bdnyd khh) llh bry shm br `lyh ann rhy qrr nddhst.

w bzwdy (grwh) dygry r khwhyd yft khh (Zhran) mykhwhnd z shm dr mn bshnd, w (nyz) z qwmshn dr mn bshnd, w hr gh bh ftnh (w bt prsty) bz grdndh shwnd, dr an frw myrwnd, ps gr z shm khnrh ngyrnd w pyshnhd SlH nfrstnd, w dstshn r (z shm) bz ndrnd, hr khj khh ann r yftyd, ann r (bh srt) bgyryd w (y) bkhshyd, anh khsnynd khh m bry shm tslT ashkhry br ann qrr ddhym.

hych mw'mny mjz nyst khh mw'mny r bh qtl brsnd, mgr z rwy shtbh w khT, w khsykhh mw'mny r z rwy khT bh qtl rsnd, byd ykh brdh mw'mn r azd khnd, w khwnbhyy bh khnwdh w bprdzd, mgr ynkhh anh bbkhshnd, ps gr (mqtwl) z qwmy bshd khh dshmnn shm hstnd; wly w mw'mn bwdh, byd (qtl) ykh brdh mw'mn r azd khnd, w gr (mqtwl) z qwmy bshd khh myn shm w anh pymny br qrr st, byd khwnbhyy bh khnwdh w bprdzd, w (nyz) ykh brdh mw'mn r azd khnd, w hr khs khh (brdhy) nyft, ps dw mh py dr py rwzh bgyryd, yn twbhy z jnb llh st, w llh dny Hkhym st.
w hr khs mw'mny r z rwy `md bh qtl brsnd, khyfrsh dwzkh st, khh dr an jwdnh mymnd, w llh br w GDb mykhnd, w w r z rHmtsh dwr myszd w `dhb bzrgy bry w amdh skhth st.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! hngmykhh dr rh llh (bry jhd) rhspr shdyd, ps brrsy khnyd, w bh khsykhh br shm slm khrd (w Zhr SlH w slm nmwd) ngwyyd: <<mw'mn nysty>> t ynkhh (Gnym w) srmyhy npydr dny bh dst awryd, zyr Gnymthy bsyry (bry shm) nzd llh st, shm nyz pysh z yn chnyn bwdyd, angh llh br shm mnt gdhrd (w hdyt shdyd) bnbryn brrsy khnyd, khh hr ayynh llh bh anchh njm mydhyd; agh st.

(hrgz) mw'mnny khh bdwn bymry w asyb, z jhd bz nshstnd, b mjhdny khh dr rh llh b ml w jn khwd jhd khrdnd, ykhsn nystnd, llh khsny r khh b ml w jnshn jhd khrdnd; br bznshstgn (= trkh khnndgn jhd b `dhr) mrtbh brtry bkhshydhst, w llh bh hr ykh (z anh) w`dhy nykhw (= bhsht) ddhst. w llh mjhdn r br q`dn (= bznshstgn) b pdshy bzrg brtry bkhshydhst.
drjty (dr bhsht) z jnb llh, w amrzsh w rHmt (nSyb ann mygrdd) w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

hmn khsnykhh frshtgn jnshn r grftnd dr Hlykhh bh khwyshtn stm khrdh bwdnd (frshtgn) bh ann gftnd: shm dr chh Hly bwdyd? gftnd: <<m dr zmyn mstD`f bwdym>> (frshtgn) gftnd: <<mgr sr zmyn khd, phnwr nbwd khh dr an mhjrt khnyd?>> bnbryn jyghshn dwzkh st w bdjyy st.
mgr an mstD`fn z mrdn w znn w khwdkhny khh nh chrhy drnd w nh rhy (bry njt) myybnd.
ps ynn r myd st khh llh z yshn dr gdhrd (w bbkhshyd) w llh bkhshyndhy amrzndh st.

w khsykhh dr rh llh hjrt khnd dr zmyn jhy mn frwn w gshysh (dr rzq w rwzy) myybd. w khsykhh bh qSd hjrt bh swy llh w pymbrsh, z khnh khwd byrwn rwd, angh mrgsh fr rsd, qT`an pdshsh br llh st. w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
w chwn dr zmyn sfr khnyd, gnhy br shm nyst khh nmz r khwth (= qSr) khnyd, gr trsyd khh khfrn bh shm zyny brsnnd, zyr khfrn, bry shm dshmn ashkhry hstnd.

w chwn (wqt khwf) dr myn anh bshy, w bry anh nmz br p khrdy, byd dsthy z anh b tw (bh nmz) bystnd, w byd slHhyshn r b khwd brgyrnd. w chwn sjdh khrdnd (w nmz r tmm nmwdnd) byd (dsth dwm) psht srtn bshnd, w byd an dsthy khh nmz nkhwndhnd; byynd w b tw nmz bkhwnnd, w byd anh HtyT khnnd w slHhyshn r (dr nmz) b khwd bgyrnd, (zyr) khfrn arzw drnd khh shm z slHhy w mt`hy khwd Gfl shwyd; ps ykhbrh br shm ywrsh brnd [ dr yn ayh bh Sl@ lkhwf (nmz khwf) Hkhm ddh shdh st, yn nmz dr wqty khwndh myshwd khh mslmnh w khfrn jht styzh w nbrd mqbl ykhdygr ystdhnd w b khwchkhtryn Gflty khsrt sngyny bry mslmnn bh br khwhd awrd.], w gr bry shm z brn rnjy bwd w bymr (w mjrwH) bwdyd; br shm gnhy nyst (w mn`y ndrd) khh slHhy khwd r (br zmyn) bgdhryd, wly (wsyl df`y w) HtyT khwd r br gyryd. hmn llh bry khfrn `dhby khwrkhnndh amdh khrdhst.

ps chwn nmz r bh pyn rsndyd, llh r ystdh, w nshsth w br phlwy khwysh (khwbydh) yd khnyd, w hrgh armsh yftyd (w khwf zyl shd) nmz r (tmm w khml) br p dryd, khh hmn nmz (fryDhy st khh) dr wqt m`yny br mw'mnn wjb (w nwshth) shdhst.
w dr t`qyb dshmn sst nshwyd. gr shm rnj mybryd; anh nyz mnnd shm rnj mykhshnd, wly shm mydy z llh dryd khh anh ndrnd, w llh dny Hkhym st.
yqynan (yn) khtb r bHq br tw nzl khrdym. t bh anchh llh bh tw amwkhth dr myn mrdm dwry khny, w mdf` (w Hmytkhnndh) khy'nn mbsh.
w z llh amrzsh bkhwh, Hq khh llh, amrzndhy mhrbn st.
w z khsnykhh bh khwd khynt khrdnd, df` mkhn, yqynan llh, frd khynt pyshhy gnhkhr r dwst ndrd.
anh (zshtkhryhy khwd r) z mrdm pnhn mydrnd, m z llh pnhn nmydrnd, w w b yshn st; hngmykhh dr jlst shbnh skhnny r khh llh nmypsndd, tdbyr mykhnnd, w llh bh anchh njm mydhnd; HTh drd.
hn! shm khsny hstyd khh dr zndgy dny, z ann df` khrdyd, ps khyst khh dr rwz qymt dr brbr llh z anh df` khnd? y chh khsy st khh wkhyl w Hmy anh khwhd bwd?
w khsykhh khr bdy njm dhd y br khwyshtn stm khnd, ps z llh amrzsh bTlbd, llh r amrzndhy mhrbn khwhd yft.
w hr khs gnhy mrtkhb shwd, ps tnh bh zyn khwd mrtkhb shdhst, w llh dny Hkhym st.
w hr khs khT y gnhy mrtkhb shwd, sps by gnhy r bh an mthm khnd, qT`an bri bhtn w gnh ashkhry r br dwsh grfth st.

w gr fDl llh w rHmtsh shml Hl tw nbwd, hr aynh grwhy z ann qSd dshtnd khh tw r gmrh khnnd, w jz khwdshn r gmrh nmykhnnd, w hych zyny bh tw nmyrsnnd, w llh khtb w Hkhmt (= snt) brtw nzl khrd, w anchh r nmydnsty, bh tw amwkht, w fDl llh br tw (hmyshh) bzrg bwdhst.
dr bsyry z (dr gwshy w) njwhyshn khyry nyst, mgr khh (b yn khr) mr bh Sdqh ddn y khr nykh, y SlH dr myn mrdm khnd. w hr khs bry khshnwdy llh chnyn khnd, bh zwdy pdsh bzrgy bh w khwhym dd.

w khsykhh ps z ankhh hdyt (w rh Hq) brysh rwshn shd; b pymbr mkhlft khnd, w z rhy jz rh mw'mnn pyrwy khnd, m w r bh anchh pyrwy khrdh; w gdhrym, w w r bh jhnm dr fkhnym [ mrd z mw'mnyn SHbhy grmy hstnd khh wlyn pyrwn slm bwdnd, chr khh hngm nzwl yn ayt Gyr z SHbh grwhy bh `nwn grwh mw'mnyn wjwd ndsht.], w bd jyghy st.
qT`an llh, shrkh awrdn bh w r nmyamrzd, w jz an (hr gnhy) r bry hr khh bkhwhd myamrzd. w hr khs bh llh shrkh awrd, ps bdwn shkh dr gmrhy dwry ftdhst.
(mshrkhn) jz llh chyzhyy (= bthy) mdh r mykhwnnd w (dr Hqyqt) jz shyTn srkhsh r nmykhwnnd.
llh w r z rHmt khwysh dwr skhth, w w gft: <<z bndgn tw, shmy m`yn khwhm grft.

w mslman anh r gmrh mykhnm, w ann r bh arzwhy bTl fkhnm, w bh ann dstwr mydhm khh gwsh chhr pyn bshkhfnd, w wdr shn mykhnm; t khlqt w afrynsh llh r tGyyr dhnd>>. w hr khs shyTn r bh jy llh wly w dwst khwd bgyrd, qT`an zyny ashkhr khrdhst.
(shyTn) bh anh w`dh mydhd w ann r bh arzw fkhnd, w shyTn jz fryb w bTl bh ann w`dh nmydhd.
anh (= pyrwn shyTn) jygh shn jhnm st, w hych rh frry z an nkhwhnd yft.

w khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd w khrhy shysth njm ddhnd, bzwdy ann r dr bGhyy (z bhsht) wrd mykhnym khh nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd, w`dh llh Hq st, w khyst khh dr gftr (w w`dhhysh) z llh rstgwtr bshd?
(yn fDlyt w brtry) bh arzwhy shm w arzwhy hl khtb nyst, hr khs khr bdy njm dhd, bh khyfr an khwhd rsyd w jz khd, yr w mddkhry bry khwd nkhwhd yft.
w khsykhh chyzy z khrh shysth r njm dhd, chh mrd bshd y zn, dr Hlykhh w mw'mn bshd, ynn bh bhsht dkhl myshwnd w khmtryn stmy (bh ndzhy gwdy psht hsthy khrm) bh anh nkhwhd shd.
w chh khsy nykh ayyn tr st z khsykhh rwy khwd r bh llh sprd (w mkhlSnh tslym shd) w nykhw khr (w frmnbrdr) bwd w ayyn pkh brhym r pyrwy khrd? w llh brhym r bh dwsty khwd br gzydhst.
w anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn st, z an llh st, w llh bh hr chyzy HTh drd.

z tw (y pymbr) drbrhy znn ftw mykhwhnd, bgw: llh drbrh ann bh shm ftw mydhd w (hmchnyn) anchh dr khtb (= qran khrym) br shm khwndh myshwd; drbrhy znn ytymy khh anchh r khh bry ann mqrr shdhst (z mhr w myrth w Hqwq) bh anh nmydhyd, w mykhwhyd khh b anh zdwj khnyd. w (nyz bh shm twSyh mykhnd w ftw mydhd dr mwrd) khwdkhn SGyr ntwn, w ynkhh b ytymn bh `dlt rftr khnyd, w anchh z nykhyh njm mydhyd, llh bh an agh st.

w gr zny, z nszgry y `rD shwhrsh bym dsht, ps br an dw gnhy nyst khh b hm SlH khnnd, w SlH, bhtr st, gr chh nfsh r bkhl fr grfth st w gr nykhy khnyd w prhyzgry pyshh szyd (w gdhsht khnyd) qT`an llh bh an chh njm mydhyd; agh st.

w hr chnd bkhwshyd hrgz nmytwnyd (z nZr mHbt qlby) dr myn znn `dlt br qrr khnyd. ps ykhsrh bh swy ykhy myl nkhnyd, khh dygry r bl tkhlyf (w sr gshth) rh khnyd, w gr rh SlH pysh gyryd, w prhyzgry khnyd, llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
w gr an dw z ykhdygr jd shwnd, llh hr khdm z anh r b fDl w khrm khwd bynyz mykhnd, w llh gshyshgr Hkhym st.

w anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn st z an llh st, w m bh khsnykhh pysh z shm khtb (asmny) bh anh ddh shdnd w (nyz) bh shm sfrsh khrdym khh <<z llh btrsyd>> (w ykht prst bshyd) w gr khfr shwyd (bdnyd) anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn st z an llh st, w llh bynyz (w) stwdhst.
w anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn st z an llh st, w llh bry khrszy khfy st.
y mrdm! gr w bkhwhd, shm r z myn mybrd w dygrn r (bh jy shm) myawrd, w llh br yn (khr) twnst.
hr khs khh pdsh dnywy bkhwhd; ps (bdnd khh) pdsh dny w akhrt nzd llh st. w llh shnwy byn st.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! brp drndhy `dlt bshyd, bry llh shhdt dhyd; gr chh bh zyn khwd shm y pdr w mdr w nzdykhn (shm) bshd, gr (md`y `lyh) twngr y fqyr bshd. (bh hr Hl) llh bh ann szwrtr (w mhrbntr) st. ps z hwy nfs pyrwy nkhnyd, khh z Hq mnHrf myshwyd w gr zbn r bgrdnyd (w Hq r tHryf khnyd) y (z Zhr Hq) `rD khnyd, mslman llh bh anchh njm mydhyd; agh st.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! bh llh w pymbrsh w khtby khh br w nzl khrdh w khtby khh pysh z yn frstdhst; ymn bywryd (w br an pydr bshyd) w hr khs bh llh w frshtgn w khtbhysh w pymbrnsh w rwz qymt khfr shwd; btHqyq dr gmrhy dwr w drzy ftdhst.
hmn khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd, sps khfr shdnd, bz ymn awrdnd, sps khfr shdnd, angh br khfr (khwd) fzwdnd; llh hrgz ann r nkhwhd bkhshyd, w anh r bh rh (rst) hdyt nkhwhd khrd.
bh mnfqn bshrt dh khh bryshn `dhby drdnkh st.
ann khh khfrn r bh jy mw'mnn bh dwsty br mygzynnd, ay bh nzd ann `zt myjwynd? ps (bdnnd khh) `zt hmh zan llh st.

w mslman (llh) dr qran (yn Hkhm) r br shm nzl khrdh khh chwn shnydyd (frdy) ayt llh r nkhr mykhnnd w an r bh ryshkhnd mygyrnd b ann nnshynyd t bh skhn dygry bprdznd (w gr b ann bnshynd) dr yn Swrt qT`an shm (nyz) hm mnnd anh khwhyd bwd. hmn llh hmhy mnfqn w khfrn r dr jhnm grd myawrd.

khsnykhh hmwrh ntZr mykhshnd (w mrqb shm hstnd) gr ftH w pyrwzy z jnb llh nSyb shm grdd, mygwynd: <<mgr m shm nbwdym?>> w gr bhrhy nSyb khfrn grdd, gwynd: <<mgr m br shm chyrh nshdhym (w pshtybn shm nbwdym) w shm r z (asyb) mw'mnn bzndshtym?>>. ps llh dr rwz qymt myn shm dwry mykhnd, w llh hrgz bry khfrn rhy bh (zyn) mw'mnn qrr nddhst.

byshkh mnfqn (bgmn khwdshn) llh r fryb mydhnd, dr Hlykhh w anh r fryb mydhd, w chwn bh nmz brkhyznd; b ssty w khhly br mykhyznd, dr chshm mrdm khwd nmyy mykhnnd w (dr nmzshn) llh r jz ndkhy yd nmykhnnd.
(mnfqn) byn yn dw (grwh mw'mnn w khfrn) dw dl w srgshthnd. nh b ynnnd w nh b annnd, w hr khs r khh llh gmrhy khnd, rhy bry w nkhwhy yft.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdyd! khfrn r bh jy mw'mnn dwstn (khwd) ngyryd, ay mykhwhyd (b yn khr) bry llh dlyl ashkhry br Dd khwd pdyd awryd?
hmn mnfqn dr pyyntryn Tbqh (= drkht) atsh (jhnm) hstnd, w hrgz ywry bry anh nkhwhy yft.
mgr ann khh twbh khrdnd w jbrn w SlH nmwdnd, w bh llh tmskh jstnd w dyn khwd r bry llh khlS grdndnd, ps ynn b mw'mnn khwhnd bwd, w llh bh zwdy mw'mnn r pdsh bzrgy khwhd dd.
llh chh nyzy bh `dhb shm drd gr spsgzry khnyd w ymn awryd?! w llh shkhrgzr dnst.
llh bng brdshtn bh skhnn nrw r dwst ndrd, mgr (z jnb) an khs khh mwrd stm wq` shdh bshd, w llh shnwy dnst.
gr khr nykh ashkhr khnyd y an r pnhn dryd, y z bdy w (stmy khh bh shm rsydh) gdhsht nmyyd, ps (bdnyd khh) llh amrzndhy twnst.
hmn khsnykhh bh llh w pymbrnsh khfr mywrznd w mykhwhnd myn llh w pymbrnsh jdyy byndznd; w mygwynd: <<bh b`Dy ymn myawrym; w b`Dy r nkhr mykhnym>> w mykhwhnd byn yn (w an) rhy (bry khwd) brgzynnd.
anh dr Hqyqt khfrnd, w bry khfrn `dhb khwrkhnndhy; amdh khrdhym.
w khsnykhh bh llh w pymbrnsh ymn awrdh w myn hych ykh zann jdy'y nyfkhndnd; ynn bzwdy pdshshn r (llh) khwhd dd, w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

hl khtb (= yhwdyn) z tw mykhwhnd khh khtby z asmn (ykhj) br anh nzl khny, hmn anh z mwsy, bzrgtr z yn r khwstnd w gftnd: <<llh r ashkhr bh m nshn bdh>>. ps bkhTr yn Zlm w stmkhryshn S`qh anh r frw grft, sps b`d z ankhh m`jzh w dlyl rwshn bryshn amd, gwslh r (bh khdy'y) grftnd, w m z an gnh dr gdhshtym (w bkhshydym). w bh mwsy Hjt (w brhn) ashkhry ddym.

w bkhTr grftn pymn z yshn (khwh) Twr r br frz anh br frshtym w bh anh gftym: <<sjdhkhnn bh drwzh (byt lmqds) dkhl shwyd>>. w (nyz) bh ann gftym: dr rwz shnbh tjwz nkhnyd (w z Syd mhy dst bkhshyd) w z ann pymn mHkhmy grftym.

ps bkhTr pymn shkhny shn w nkhr ayt khd, w bh nHq khshtn pymbrn w (yn) gfth shn khh dl hy m dr prdhst (w skhnn pymbr r drkh nmykhnym). blkhh llh bh sbb khfrshn br (dlhy) anh mhr zdh st; ps jz `dh khmy ymn nmyawrnd.
w (nyz) bkhTr khfrshn w thmt bzrgy khh br mrym zdnd.

w (nyz) bkhTr yn gfth shn khh <<m msyH, `ysy psr mrym pymbr llh r khshtym>>. dr Hlykhh nh w r khshtnd w nh bh dr awykhtnd, lkhn mr br anh mshtbh shd, w hr aynh ann khh dr(brhy qtl) w khtlf khrdnd, qT`an z an dr shkh hstnd, w `lm bh an ndrnd w tnh z gmn pyrwy mykhnnd w bh yqyn w r nkhshthnd.
blkhh llh w r bh swy khwd bl brd, w llh pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.

w (khsy) z hl khtb nyst mgr ynkhh qbl z mrgsh bh w (= HDrt `ysy) ymn myawrd, w (`ysy) rwz qymt br anh gwh khwhd bwd [ yn ayh br nzwl HDrt `ysy `lyh lslm z asmn dllt drd, rjw` bh swrhy al `mrn ayh: 55.].
ps bh (khyfr) stmy khh qwm yhwd mrtkhb shdnd, w (nyz) bkhTr jlw gyry bsyr anh z rh khd, chyzyhy pkhyzhy r khh bryshn Hll bwd; br anh Hrm khrdym.
w (nyz) bh sbb rb grftnshn, dr Hlykhh z an nhy shdh bwdnd, w (nyz) bh sbb ankhh mwl mrdm r bh nHq mykhwrnd, w m bry khfrnshn `dhb drdnkhy amdh khrdym.

wly (dnshmndn w) rskhn dr `lm z ann w mw'mnn, bh anchh br tw nzl shdh w anchh pysh z tw nzl grdydh; ymn myawrnd, w (hmchnyn) br p drndgn nmz w zkht dhndgn, w mw'mnn bh llh w rwz qymt; bzwdy bh hmhy anh pdsh bzrgy khwhym dd.

hmn m bh tw wHy frstdym hmn gwnh khh bh nwH w pymbrn b`d z w wHy frstdym w (nyz) bh brhym w sm`yl w sHq w y`qwb w sbT (= nwdgn dwzdh gnh) w `ysy w ywb w ywns w hrwn w slymn wHy frstdym w bh dwd zbwr ddym.
w pymbrny (mb`wth khrdym) khh sr gdhsht anh r pysh z yn bry tw byn khrdhym, w pymbrny khh sr gdhsht anh r byn nkhrdym, w llh (bdwn wsTh) b mwsy skhn gft.
pymbrny khh bshrtdhndh w bymdhndh bwdnd, t b`d z (amdn) yn pymbrn bry mrdm br llh Hjty nbshd w llh pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.
lykhn llh bh anchh br tw nzl khrdhst; gwhy mydhd, khh an r bh `lm khwd nzl khrdhst, w frshtgn (nyz) gwhy mydhnd, w (gr chh) gwhy llh khfy st.
hr aynh ann khh khfr shdnd w (mrdm r) z rh llh bz dshtnd, mHqqan dr gmrhy dwry grftr shdhnd.

mgr rh jhnm, khh jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd w yn (khr) br llh asn st.

y mrdm, bygmn pymbr (mw`wd mHmd Sly llh `lyh wslm) b (ayyn) Hq z jnb prwrdgrtn bry shm amd, ps bh w ymn bywryd khh bry shm bhtr st, w gr khfr shwyd; ps yqynan (bdnyd khh) anchh dr asmnh w zmyn st z an llh st, (w khfr shm bh w zyny nmyrsnd) w llh dny Hkhym st.

y hl khtb! dr dyn khwd Glw nkhnyd w drbrhy llh jz Hq ngwyyd, hmn msyH `ysy psr mrym frstdhy llh w khlmhy wst; khh w r bh mrym lq nmwd, w rwHy z jnb wst, ps bh llh w pymbrnsh ymn bywryd, w ngwyyd: (llh) sh gnh st, (z yn skhn) bz ayyd khh bry shm bhtr st, llh tnh m`bwd ygnh st w z ynkhh frzndy dshth bshd pkh (w mnzh) st, anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn st z an wst w llh bry khrszy khfy st.
msyH hrgz b ndrd khh bndhy llh bshd, w nh frshtgn mqrb (b drnd) w hr khs z bndh gy w sr bz znd w tkhbr khnd, bzwdy hmhy anh r (dr qymt) nzd khwd mHshwr khwhd khrd.

m ann khh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd, pdshhyshn r bTwr khml khwhd dd, w z fDl khwysh br anh khwhd fzwd, w m ann khh b khrdnd w tkhbr wrzydnd, ann r bh `dhby drdnkh `dhb mykhnd, w bry khwd Gyr z khd, dwst w ywry nkhwhnd yft.
y mrdm! hmn dlyl w Hjty z jnb prwrdgrtn bry shm amd, w nwry ashkhr bh swy shm nzl khrdym.
m ann khh bh llh ymn awrdnd w bh w tmskh jstnd, bzwdy hmh r dr rHmt w fDl khwd, wrd khwhd khrd, w ann r dr rh rsty bh swy khwd hdytshn mykhnd.

z tw (drbrhy khllh= mrdh nh frznd drd nh pdr) ftw mykhwhnd, bgw: <<llh dr(brhy) khllh bry shm ftwy mydhd, gr mrdy bmyrd khh frznd ndshth bshd w bry w khwhry bshd, nSf mwly r khh bh j gdhshth, bry w st. w w tmm ml khwhr r bh rth mybrd, (gr khwhr bmyrd) dr Swrty khh frznd ndshth bshd, w chnnchh dw (khwhrsh) bqy bshnd; dw swm trkhh r mybrnd, w gr chndyn mrdn w znny brdr w khwhr bshnd bry hr mrd dw brbr shm zn khwhd bwd, llh (Hkhm khwysh r) bry shm byn mykhnd t gmrh nshwyd, w llh bh hmh chyz dnst>>.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! bh pymnh (w qrr ddhy khwd) wf khnyd, (gwsht) chhr pyn bry shm Hll shdh st, mgr anchh br shm khwndh myshwd, w dr Hl Hrm shkhr r Hll nshmryd, hmn llh hr chh bkhwhd Hkhm mykhnd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! (Hrmt) sh`y'r lhy (r ngh dryd w by Hrmty bh anh) r Hll ndnyd, w nh mh Hrm r, w nh qrbnyhy by nshn w nshndr r, w nh qSdn khnh llh r khh fDl w khshnwdy prwrdgrshn r myTlbnd. w chwn z Hrm byrwn amdyd, ps shkhr khnyd, w dshmny grwhy khh shm z msjd lHrm bz dshtnd, nbyd shm r bh t`dy w tjwz w dr khnd. w dr rh nykhw khry w prhyzgry b hmdygr hmkhry khnyd w (hrgz) dr rh gnh w tjwz hmkhry nkhnyd, w z llh btrsyd, bygmn llh skht khyfr st.

(gwsht) mrdr, w khwn w gwsht khwkh w anchh (hngm dhbH) nm Gyr llh br an brdh shwd, w (Hywnt) khfh shdh, w b Drbh mrdh, w z blndy ftdh, w bh Drb shkh (Hywn dygry) mrdh, w anchh drndgn khwrdh bshnd, - mgr ankhh dhbH (shr`y) khrdh bshyd-, w anchh bry bth dhbH shdh, w ankhh b tyrhy fl; bkht w qsmt Tlb khnyd (hmh) br shm Hrm shdh, w (rwy awrdn bh tmm) ynh fsq w nfrmny st. mrwz khfrn z ayyn shm m'yws shdnd, bnbr yn z anh ntrsyd w z mn btrsyd, mrwz dyn shm r khml khrdm w n`mt khwd r br shm tmm nmwdm, w slm r (b`nwn) dyn bry shm br gzydm. m hr khs khh z grsngy drmndh shwd w myl bh gnh nbshd (mn`y ndrd khh z gwshthy mmnw` bkhwrd) ps (bdnd khh) llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

z tw myprsnd chh chyz bry anh Hll shdh st? bgw: pkhyzhh bry shm Hll grdydh w (nyz) anchh z (Syd) Hywnt shkhry w sghy amwkhth (w trbyt shdh) khh z anchh llh bh shm amwkhth st bh anh amwkhthyd (br shm Hll st) ps anchh bry shm (Syd mykhnnd w) ngh mydrnd, bkhwryd, w nm llh r (bh hngm frstdn Hywn bry shkhr) br an bbryd, w z llh btrsyd, bygmn llh zwd shmr st.

mrwz pkhyzhh bry shm Hll shdh, w (hmchnyn) T`m hl khtb bry shm Hll st, w T`m shm bry anh Hll st w (nyz) znn pkhdmn z mslmnn w znn pkhdmn z khsnykhh pysh z shm bh anh khtb (asmny) ddh shdh, hr gh khh mhr anh r bprdzyd, dr Hlykhh pkhdmn bshyd, nh zn khr w nh dwst pnhny gyrndh (bry shm Hll st) w khsykhh bh (rkhn) ymn khfr wrzd, hmn `mlsh tbh shdh st w w dr akhrt z zynkhrn khwhd bwd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! chwn bh nmz brkhstyd; ps Swrt khwd w dsthytn r t arnj bshwyyd w srtn r msH khnyd, w phytn r t dw qwzkh (bshwyyd) w gr jnb bwdyd; ps khwd r pkh szyd (w Gsl khnyd), w gr bymr y msfr hstyd, y ykhy z shm z mHl qDy Hjt amdh (= qDy Hjt khrdh) y b znn (tms grfth w) amyzsh khrdh bshyd, angh ab nybyd; ps b khkh pkhy tymWm khnyd. w z an br Swrttn w dsthytn bkhshyd. llh nmykhwhd br shm dshwry qrr dhd, blkhh mykhwhd shm r pkh szd w n`mtsh r br shm tmm khnd, bshd khh shkhr gzryd.
w bh yd awryd n`mt llh r br khwysh, w (bh yd awryd) pymny r khh b t'khyd z shm grft, an hngm khh gftyd: <<shnydym w T`t khrdym>> w z llh btrsyd, bygmn llh z anchh drwn synhhst agh st.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! hmwrh bry llh qym khnyd w bh `dlt gwhy dhyd, dshmny b grwhy shm r br an ndrd khh `dlt nkhnyd; `dlt khnyd khh bh prhyzgry nzdykhtr st w z llh btrsyd, hmn llh bh anchh mykhnyd; agh st.
llh bh ann khh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd w`dhy amrzsh w pdsh bzrgy ddh st.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd w ayt m r tkhdhyb khrdnd; ann hl dwzkhnd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! n`mt llh r br khwd bh yd awryd, angh khh grwhy (z dshmnn) qSd khrdnd khh bh swy shm dst drz khnnd, ps (llh) dst anh r z shm bz dsht w z llh btrsyd, w mwmnn byd tnh br llh twkhl khnnd.

hmn llh z bny sry'yl pymn grft w z anh dwzdh nqyb (= srprst) br ngykhtym. w llh (bh ann) frmwd: <<mn b shm hstm gr nmz r br pdshtyd w zkht r prdkhtyd w bh pymbrn mn ymn awrdyd w anh r yry nmwdyd w bh llh qrDlHsnh ddyd (dr rh w nfq nmwdyd) yqynan gnhntn r z shm myzdym w shm r bh bGhyy (z bhsht) wrd mykhnm khh nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, ps hr khs z shm b`d z yn khfr shwd; mslman z rh rst mnHrf grdydh st>>.

ps bh khTr pymn shkhny shn anh r z rHmt khwysh dwr skhtym w dlhy shn r skht grdnydym skhnn (khd) r z mwrdsh tHryf mykhnnd w bkhshy z anchh r khh bh an pnd ddh shdh bwdnd; frmwsh khrdnd, w pywsth tw bh khynt (tzhy) z anh agh myshwy; mgr `dh khmy z ann, ps z anh drgdhr w rwy bgrdn, bygmn llh nykhw khrn r dwst mydrd.

w z khsnykhh gftnd: m nSrny hstym; pymn grftym, ps bkhshy z anchh r khh bh ann pnd ddh shdh bwdnd; frmwsh khrdnd, ldh m (nyz) byn ann t rwz qymt `dwt w dshmny fkhndym, w llh bzwdy anh r z anchh njm myddnd; agh khwhd skht.
y hl khtb! btHqyq pymbr m bh swy shm amd t bsyry z Hqyq z khtb (asmn) r khh khtmn khrdhyd bry shm rwshn szd w z bsyry drgdhrd, bh rsty z jnb llh nwr w khtb ashkhry bh swy shm amd.
llh bwsylhy an khsny r khh z khshnwdy w pyrwy khnnd bh rhhy slmt hdyt mykhnd w bh frmn khwd anh r z trykhyh bh swy rwshnyy mybrd w anh r bh rh rst hdyt mykhnd.

khsnykhh gftnd: <<khd, hmn msyH psr mrym st>> yqynan khfr shdnd. bgw: <<gr llh bkhwhd msyH psr mrym w mdrsh w hmhy khsny r khh rwy zmyn hstnd; hlkh khnd, chh khsy qdrt br jlwgyry drd? frmnrwyy asmnh w zmyn w anchh myn an dw st z an llh st, hr chh bkhwhd myafrynd w llh br hr chyz twnst>>.

yhwd w nSry gftnd: <<m frzndn llh w dwstn w hstym>>. bgw: <<ps chr shm r bh khyfr gnhntn `dhb mykhnd? blkhh shm (hm) bshry hstyd z anchh afrydh st, hr khs r bkhwhd myamrzd w hr khs r bkhwhd `dhb mykhnd w frmnrwyy asmnh w zmyn w anchh myn an dw st z an llh st w bzgsht (hmh) bh swy wst>>

y hl khtb! pymbr m ps z (nqT` wHy w) ftrty z pymbrn bh swy shm amd, khh Hqyq r brytn byn khnd, t mbd (rwz qymt) bgwyyd: <<nh bshrtdhndhy bh swy m amd w nh bym dhndy>> ps btHqyq (ynkh) pymbr bshrtdhndh w bymdhndh bh swy shm amdh st. w llh br hmh chyz twnst.

(bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh mwsy bh qwm khwd gft: <<y qwm mn, n`mt llh r br khwd byd awryd, angh khh dr myn shm, pymbrny qrr dd w shm r frmnrw (w shhn) qrr dd w chyzhyy bh shm bkhshyd khh bh hych ykh z jhnyn nddh bwd.
y qwm! bh srzmyn mqds khh llh brytn mqrr nmwdh st, wrd shwyd, w bh psht sr khwd bz ngrdyd (w `qb grd nkhnyd) khh zynkhr khwhyd shd>>.
gftnd: <<y mwsy! bygmn dr anj qwmy (zwrmnd w) stmgrnd, w m hrgz wrd an nmyshwym t anh z an byrwn shwnd, ps gr anh z an byrwn shwnd, qT`an m wrd khwhym shd>>.
dw tn z mrdny khh (z llh) mytrsydnd w llh bh anh n`mt rzny dshth bwd gftnd: <<shm z drwzh br ann wrd shwyd ps hngmykhh wrd shdyd, qT`an shm pyrwz khwhyd shd, w br llh twkhl khnyd; gr ymn dryd>>.
(bny sry'yl) gftnd: <<y mwsy! t zmny khh anh dr anj hstnd; m hrgz wrd nkhwhym shd, tw w prwrdgrt brwyd w bjngyd; m hmyn j nshsthym>>.
(mwsy) gft: <<prwrdgr! mn tnh khtyr khwdm w brdrm (hrwn) r drm; ps myn m w yn grwh nfrmn jdyy byfkhn>>.
(llh) frmwd: <<an (srzmyn mqds) t chhl sl br anh Hrm shdh st pywsth dr zmyn sr grdn khwhnd bwd, ps br yn grwh nfrmn Gmgyn mbsh>>.

w (y pymbr m) dstn dw frzndn adm (hbyl w qbyl) bh Hq br anh bkhwn: hngmykhh (hr khdm) bry tqrb (lhy) qrbny tqdym khrdnd; ps z ykhy pdhyrfth shd w z dygry pdhyrfth nshd (w) gft: <<qT`an tw r khwhm khsht>> (brdrsh) gft: <<llh fqT z prhyzgrn mypdhyrd (mn tqSyry ndrm)
gr tw dstt bry khshtn mn drz khny mn hrgz dst khwd r bh swy tw drz nkhwhm khrd t tw r bkhshm, zyr mn z llh prwrdgr jhnyn mytrsm.
mn mykhwhm khh tw b gnh mn w gnh khwdt bz grdy (w br hr dw r br dwsh khshy) w z hl dwzkh bshy w yn st szy stmkhrn>>.
ps nfs (srkhsh) w; khshtn brdrsh r brysh arsth (w mwjh w asn) jlwh dd, w w r khsht w z zynkhrn shd.

angh llh khlGy r frstd khh dr zmyn jstjw (w khwsh) mykhrd t bh w nshn dhd chgwnh jsd brdrsh r bpwshnd w gft: <<wy br mn! ay mn anqdr drmndhm khh hmchwn yn khlG bshm w jsd brdrm r bpwshnm?>> w srnjm (z khr zsht khwd) pshymn shd.

bh hmyn sbb br bny sry'yl mqrr dshtym khh hr khs nsny r bdwn ynkhh mrtkhb qtl nfs y fsdy dr zmyn shdh bshd; bkhshd, chnn st khh gwyy hmhy mrdm r khshth bshd w hr khs nsny r z mrg njt dhd; chnn st khh gwyy hmhy mrdm r zndh khrdh st, w bygmn pymbrn m, b dlyl rwshn bry anh amdnd, bzhm bsyry z anh ps z an dr rwy zmyn tjwz w srf khrdnd.

szy khsnykhh b llh w pymbrsh myjngnd, w dr zmyn bh fsd mykhwshnd, fqT yn st khh khshth shwnd, y bh dr awykhth shwnd, y dst (rst) w py (chp) anh b`khs ykhdygr brydh shwd, w y z sr zmyn khwd tb`yd grdnd, yn rswyy anh dr dnyst, w dr akhrt `dhb bzrgy khwhnd dsht.

ps hr khs khh b`d z (gnh w) stmsh twbh khnd w (`ml khwd r) SlH w jbrn nmyd, hmn llh twbh w r mypdhyrd, bygmn llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
ay nmydny khh frmnrwyy asmnh w zmyn z an llh st?! hr khs r bkhwhd `dhb mykhnd w hr khs r bkhwhd mybkhshd, w llh br hr chyzy qdr st.

y pymbr! khsnykhh dr (rh) khfr shtb mykhnnd; tw r ndwhgyn nsznd, (chh) z khsnykhh bh zbnshn mygwynd: <<ymn awrdym>> w qlb anh ymn nywrdh st, w (chh) z khsnykhh yhwdy hstnd; gwsh sprdgn bh drwGnd, w bry grwhy khh nzd tw nymdhnd (bry jswsy) gwsh fr mydhnd, anh skhnn (khd) r z jyghshn tHryf mykhnnd. w (bh ykhdygr) mygwynd: <<gr yn (Hkhm tHryf shdh) bh shm ddh shd, ps bpdhyryd, w gr an r bh shm ddh nshd (z w) dwry khnyd>>. w hr khs khh llh gmrhysh r khwsth bshd, hrgz dr brbr llh bry w khtyr ndry (w nmytwny z w df` nmny) anh khsny hstnd khh llh nkhwsth dlhy shn r pkh khnd, bry ann dr dny rswyy, w dr akhrt bryshn `dhb bzrgy st.

ann gwsh sprdgn drwGnd (w) ml Hrm frwn mykhwrnd, ps gr nzd tw amdnd dr myn ann dwry khn, y z ann rwy bgrdn, w gr z ann rwy grdny bh tw hych zyny nmyrsnnd, w gr dwry khrdy, b `dlt dr myn anh dwry khn, yqynan llh `dln r dwst drd.
w chgwnh tw r bh dwry myTlbnd? dr Hlykhh twrt nzd yshn st, (w) Hkhm llh dr an st, sps b`d z an (z Hkhm tw) rwy mygrdnnd, w ynn mw'mn nystnd.

m twrt r nzl khrdym khh dr an hdyt w nwr st, pymbrny khh (dr brbr frmn khd) tslym bwdnd, br ss an bry yhwd Hkhm mykhrdnd w (hmchnyn) llh prstn w dnshmndn, khh HfZt w psdry khtb llh bh anh sprdh shdh w br an gwh bwdnd, (bh an Hkhm mykhrdnd) ps z mrdm ntrsyd, w z mn btrsyd, w ayt mr bh bhy nchyz nfrwshyd, w hr khs bh Hkhmy khh llh nzl khrdh st Hkhm nkhnd; khfr st.

w dr an (= twrt) br anh (= bny sry'yl) mqrr dshtym khh jn dr brbr jn, w chshm dr brbr chshm w byny dr brbr byny, w gwsh dr brbr gwsh, w dndn dr brbr dndn mybshd, w (nyz) zkhmh r qSS st. ps hr khs khh z an dr gdhrd (w bbkhshd) an khfrh (gnhn) w st, w hr khs bh Hkhmy khh llh nzl khrdh st Hkhm nkhnd; stmgr st.

w dr py anh (= pymbrn pyshyn) `ysy psr mrym r frstdym khh tSdyqkhnndhy twrty bwd khh pysh z w frstdh shdh bwd, w njyl r khh dr an hdyt w nwr bwd bh w ddym khh tSdyqkhnndhy twrt pysh z w bwd, w hdyt w mw`Zhy bry prhyzgrn bwd.
w hl njyl byd bh anchh llh dr an nzl khrdh Hkhm khnnd, w hr khs bh anchh llh nzl khrdh Hkhm nkhnd; nfrmnnd.

w (yn) khtb (= qran) r bh Hq br tw nzl khrdym dr Hlykhh tSdyqkhnndhy khtbhy khh pysh z an st w br anh shhd w nghbn st, ps bh anchh llh nzl khrdh st dr myn anh Hkhm khn w z hwy w hwshy ann bh jy anchh z Hq khh bh tw rsydh st, pyrwy nkhn (w z Hkhm lhy rwy mgrdn) m bry hr khdm z shm, ayyn w Tryqh rwshny qrr ddym w gr llh mykhwst hmhy shm r ykh mt qrr mydd, wly (khd mykhwhd) shm dr anchh bh shm ddh st byzmyd, ps dr nykhyh br ykhdygr pyshy gyryd, bzgsht hmhy shm bh swy llh st, angh z anchh dr an khtlf mykhrdyd bh shm khbr myhd.

w dr myn anh (= yhwd) br ss anchh llh (dr qran) nzl khrdh Hkhm khn, w z hwshy ann pyrwy mkhn, w z ann br Hdhr bsh, mbd tw r z b`Dy z chyzhyy khh llh br tw nzl khrdh mnHrf khnnd, w gr anh (z Hkhm tw) rwy grdnnd, ps bdn khh llh mykhwhd ann r bh (khTr) prhy z gnhnshn mjzt khnd, w bygmn bsyry z mrdm nfrmnnd.
ay anh Hkhm jhlyt r mykhwhnd?!chh khsy bhtr z llh, bry grwhy khh yqyn drnd, Hkhm mykhnd?!
y khsnykhh ymn awrdyd! yhwd w nSry r bh dwsty br ngzynyd, ann dwstn ykhdygrnd, w khsnykhh z shm b anh dwsty khnnd, z anh hstnd, hmn llh grwh stmkhr r hdyt nmykhnd.

ps khsny r khh dr dlhyshn bymry (= nfq) st mybyny khh dr (dwsty b) ann myshtbnd (w) mygwynd: <<mytrsym khh asyby bh m brsd>> ps nzdykh st khh llh pyrwzy y chyzy (dygr) z swy khwd (bry mslmnn) pysh awrd, angh (yn frd) z anchh dr dl khwd pnhn dshtnd, pshymn grdnd.
w anhy khh ymn awrdhnd mygwynd: <<ay ynh (= mnfqn) hmn khsny hstnd khh b nhyt t'khyd bh llh swgnd yd mykhrdnd, khh ann b shm hstnd?!>> `mlshn tbh shd, w zynkhr shdnd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! hr khs z shm khh z dyn khwd brgrdd (bh llh zyny nmyrsnd) llh bzwdy grwhy r myawrd khh anh r dwst drd w anh (nyz) w r dwst drnd, (ann) dr brbr mw'mnn frwtn w dr brbr khfrn sr skht w grdn frz hstnd, dr rh llh jhd mykhnnd w z srznsh hych srznsh khnndhy nmyhrsnd, yn fDl llh st khh bh hr khs bkhwhd mydhd, w llh gshyshgr dnst.
yr w wly shm tnh llh st, w pymbrnsh w anh khh ymn awrdhnd, (hmn)khsnykhh nmz r br p mydrnd w ann b khshw` w frwtny zkht r mydhnd.
w hr khs llh w pymbr w w khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd, dwst bdrd, (w z Hzb llh st w) yqynan Hzb llh pyrwz st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! ann khh dyn shm r bh tmskhr w bzy grfthnd; z (hl khtb) khsnykhh pysh z shm khtb ddh shdhnd w (hmchnyn) khfr r; dwst ngyryd. w gr ymn dryd z llh btrsyd.
w chwn bh nmz nd dhyd an r bh mskhrh w bzy mygyrnd, yn bkhTr an st khh anh mrdmy nbkhrdnd.

bgw: <<y hl khtb! ay z m khrdh w `yb mygyryd?! (mgr m chh khrdhym?) jz ynkhh bh llh w anchh br m nzl shdh w anchh pysh z yn nzl shdh st; ymn awrdhym, w Hl ankhh byshtr shm nfrmn (w z rh Hq mnHrf) hstyd?!>>

bgw: <<ay shm r khbr bdhm z khsnykhh nzd llh khyfrshn bdtr z yn st. khsnykhh llh anh r z rHmt khwd dwr skhth w br anh khshm grfth w b`Dy z anh r bwzynhh w khwkhh grdnydh w bt (= TGwt) r prstydhnd, ynn bd jyghtr w z rh rst gm gshthtrnd>>.
w chwn nzd shm myaynd, mygwynd: <<ymn awrdhym>>. Hl ankhh b khfr wrd shdnd w b khfr khrj gshtnd, w llh bh anchh khtmn mykhnnd, aghtr st.
w bsyry z anh r mybyny khh dr gnh w tjwz, w khwrdn ml Hrm, shtb mykhnnd, chh bd st `mly khh njm myddnd.
chr llh prstn w dnshmndn anh r z skhnn gnhalwd, w khwrdn ml Hrm, nhy nmykhnnd?! chh bd st khry khh njm myddnd.

w yhwd gftnd: <<dst llh bsth st>> dsthyshn bsth bd! w bkhTr anchh gftnd, l`nt shdnd. blkhh dw dst w gshdh st, hr gwnh bkhwhd mybkhshd, w yn ayt khh z Trf prwrdgrt br tw nzl shdh br sr khshy w khfr bsyry z anh myfzyd, w m dr myn ann t rwz qymt dshmny w khynh fkhndym, w hr zmn atsh jngy frwkhtnd, llh an r khmwsh khrd, w ann bry fsd dr zmyn mykhwshnd, w llh mfsdn r dwst ndrd.
w gr hl khtb ymn bywrnd w tqw pyshh khnnd, yqynan gnhnshn r khwhym zdwd w anh r bh bGhyy pr n`mt (bhsht) wrd khwhym khrd.

w gr ann twrt w njyl, w anchh r khh z swy prwrdgrshn br anh nzl shdh (z khtbhy asmny w qran) br p drnd (w bh an `ml nmynd) z frz w frwd physhn (= z asmn w zmyn) rwzy khwhnd khwrd, grwhy z anh m`tdl w mynh rw hstnd, w bsyry z ann `ml bdy njm mydhnd.
y pymbr! anchh z Trf prwrdgrt brtw nzl shdh st, (bh mrdm) brsn, w gr (yn khr) nkhny, rslt w r nrsndhy, w llh tw r z (shr) mrdm HfZ mykhnd, hmn llh grwh khfrn r hdyt nmykhnd.

bgw: <<y hl khtb! shm br hych (ayyn drsty) nystyd, mgr ynkhh twrt w njyl w anchh r khh z Trf prwrdgrtn br shm nzl shdh st, br p dryd>>. w btHqyq anchh br tw z swy prwrdgrt nzl shdh, br srkhshy w khfr bsyry z anh myfzyd, ps br (yn) grwh khfrn, Gmgyn mbsh.
hmn khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd, w khsnykhh yhwdy hstnd, w Sby'n w nSry, hr khs khh bh llh w rwz qymt ymn bywrd w khrhy shysth njm dhd, nh trsy br anh khwhd bwd w nh ann ndwhgyn shwnd.
yqynan m z bny sry'yl pymn grftym, w rswlny bh swy anh frstdym, hr gh khh pymbry chyzy br khlf dlkhwh anh myawrd, grwhy r tkhdhyb mykhrdnd w grwhy r mykhshtnd.
w pndshtnd khh azmysh (w mjzty) dr khr nyst, ldh khwr w khr shdnd. sps (twbh khrdnd w) llh twbhy anh r pdhyrft, bz bsyry z anh khwr w khr shdnd, w llh bh anchh njm mydhnd; bynst.

anh khh gftnd: <<llh, hmn msyH psr mrym st>> yqynan khfr shdnd, dr Hlykhh (khwd) msyH gft: <<y bny sry'yl! llh r khh prwrdgr mn w prwrdgr shm st; prstsh khnyd, hmn hr khs bh llh shrkh awrd, llh bhsht r br w Hrm khrdh st, w jygh w dwzkh st, w stmkhrn r ywry nyst>>.
anh khh gftnd: <<llh swmyn (qnwm) thlthh st>> bh yqyn khfr shdnd, m`bwdy (bh Hq) jz m`bwd ygnh nyst, w gr z anchh mygwynd bz nystnd, qT`an bh khfrn shn `dhb drdnkhy khwhd rsyd.
ay bh swy llh bz nmygrdnd, w z w Tlb amrzsh nmykhnnd?! w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

msyH psr mrym frstdhy bysh nyst khh pysh z w (nyz) frstdgn dygry bwdnd, w mdrsh zny rstgwy bwd, hr dw Gdh mykhwrdnd, bngr chgwnh nshnhh r bry anh rwshn myszym, ps bngr chgwnh (z Hq) bz grdndh myshwnd!

bgw: <<y hl khtb! dr dyn khwd bh nHq Glw (w zydhrwy) nkhnyd, w z hwshy grwhy khh z pysh gmrh shdnd w bsyry r gmrh khrdnd w z rh rst mnHrf gshtnd; pyrwy nkhnyd>>.
khfrn bny sry'yl, br zbn dwwd w `ysy psr mrym l`nt shdnd, yn bkhTr an bwd khh nfrmny (w gnh) khrdnd w (z Hd) tjwz mynmwdnd.
anh z khr zshty khh njm myddnd, ykhdygr r nhy nmykhrdnd, qT`an bd khry njm myddnd!
bsyry z anh r mybyny khh b khfrn (w btprstn) dwsty mykhnnd, chh bd st anchh nfshyshn bry ann pysh frstdh st, khh llh br anh khshm bywrd, w ann dr `dhb jwdnh khwhnd mnd.
w gr bh llh w pymbr w anchh brw nzl shdh, ymn myawrdnd (hrgz) ann (khfrn) r bh dwsty brnmy gzydnd, wly bsyry z anh fsqnd.

bh yqyn dshmntryn mrdm nsbt bh mw'mnn r; yhwd w mshrkhn [ mrd z mshrkhyn annynd khh m`tqd bh m`bwdn mt`dd hstnd w nyz btprsth w khsnykhh mnkhr wHdnyt llh mt`l w rslt mHmd Sly llh `lyh wslm mybshnd.] khwhy yft, w nzdykhtryn dwstn bh mw'mnn r; khsny myyby khh mygwynd: <<m nSry hstym>>. yn bkhTr an st khh z (myn) anh khshyshn w trkhn dny hstnd, w anh tkhbWr nmywrznd.
w chwn ayty r khh br pymbr nzl shdh bshnwnd, chshmhy anh r mybyny khh shkh ryzn myshwd, bkhTr Hqyqty khh dr yfthnd, w mygwynd: <<prwrdgr! ymn awrdym, ps m r dr zmrh gwhn bnwys.
chr bh llh w anchh z Hq bh m rsydh st, ymn nywrym, dr Hlykhh arzw drym prwrdgrmn m r dr zmrh SlHn dr awrd>>.
ps llh bh khTr yn skhn khh gftnd, bh anh bGhyy (z bhsht) pdsh dd khh z zyr (drkhtn) an nhrh jry st, w jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd, w yn st jzy nykhw khrn.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd w ayt m r tkhdhyb khrdnd, anh hl dwzkhnd.

w z chyzhy Hll (w) pkhyzhy khh llh bh shm rwzy ddh st; bkhwryd, w z llh khh bh w ymn dryd; btrsyd.

llh shm r bkhTr swgndhy lGw (w byhwdh) tn mw'khdhh nmykhnd, wly shm r bkhTr swgndhyy khh (z rwy qSd) mHkhm khrdhyd; mw'khdhh mykhnd, ps khfrhy an T`m dh mskhyn st z Gdhhy mtwsTy khh bh khnwdhy khwd mykhwrnyd, y lbs pwshnydn anh, w y azd khrdn ykh brdh, ps gr khsy (hych ykh z ynh) nybd, sh rwz rwzh bgyrd, yn khfrhy swgndhy shmst, hr gh khh swgnd yd khrdyd (w bh an wf nkhrdyd) w swgndhy khwd r HfZ khnyd (w nshkhnyd) yn chnyn llh ayt khwd r bry shm byn mykhnd, bshd khh shkhr gzryd.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! hmn shrb w qmr w bth, w tyrhy qr`h, plyd w z `ml shyTn st. ps z anh dwry khnyd, t rstgr shwyd.
hmn shyTn mykhwhd b shrb w qmr dr myn shm `dwt w khynh yjd khnd w shm r z yd llh w z nmz bz drd; ps ay shm khwddry khwhyd khrd?!
w llh r T`t khnyd w (nyz) pymbr r T`t khnyd w (z nfrmny) brHdhrbshyd, ps gr rwy grdndyd; bdnyd khh br pymbr m jz blG ashkhr chyz dygry nyst.

br khsnykhh ymn awrdh w khrhy shysth njm ddhnd gnhy dr anchh khwrdhnd nyst; gr prhyzkhry khnnd w ymn awrnd w khrhy shysth njm dhnd, sps prhyzkhry khnnd w ymn awrnd, sps prhyzkhry khnnd w nykhy nmynd, w llh nykhwkhrn r dwst mydrd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! llh shm r bh chyzy z shkhr khh dsth w nyzhhytn bh an myrsd; azmysh mykhnd t llh m`lwm bdrd chh khsy dr nhn z w mytrsd, ps hr khs b`d z an tjwz khnd; brysh `dhb drdnkhy khwhd bwd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! dr Hl Hrm shkhr r nkhshyd, w hr khs z shm bh `md an r bkhshd; byd khfrhy hmnnd an z chhrpyn bdhd (bshrTy) khh dw nfr `dl z shm (brbr bwdn) an r tSdyq khnnd w (bSwrt) qrbny bh kh`bh brsnd y (bh jy qrbny) T`m mskhyn khnd y m`dl an rwzh bgyrd t khyfr `ml khwd r bchshd, llh z anchh gdhshth dr gdhsht, w hr khs khh (bh yn gnh) bz grdd; llh z w ntqm mygyrd, w llh nyrwmnd (w) ntqmgyr st.
shkhr dry w T`m an bry shm Hll shdh st t bry shm w khrwnyn bhrhy bshd, w shkhr bybn t mwq`y khh dr Hrm hstyd, br shm Hrm st, w z llh khh bswy w mHshwr myshwyd; btrsyd.

llh kh`bh - bytlHrm-, w mh Hrm w qrbny (bynshn) w qrbny nshndr r wsylhy bry stwry w smn bkhshydn (bh khr) mrdm qrr dd, yn (gwnh Hkhm bry ynst khh) bdnyd btHqyq llh anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn st mydnd, w mslman llh bh hr chyz dnst.
bdnyd khh llh skht khyfr st w (dr `yn Hl) llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! z chyzhy nprsyd khh gr bry shm ashkhr grdd, shm r ndwhgyn khnd, w gr bh hngm nzwl qran, z anh sw'l khnyd bry shm ashkhr myshwd llh z anh `fw khrdh st, w llh amrzndhy brdbr st.
bh rsty grwhy qbl z shm z an sw'l khrdnd, sps (wqty khh jwbshn amd) bdn khfr shdnd.
llh hychgwnh <<bHyrh>> w nh<<sy'bh>> w nh <<wSylh>> w nh <<Hm>> r qrr nddh st, wly khsnykhh khfr shdnd, br llh drwG mybndnd, w byshtrshn dr nmyybnd.

w hngmykhh bh anh gfth shwd: <<bh swy anchh llh nzl khrdh w bh swy pymbr byyyd>> gwynd: <<anchh nykhnmn r br an yfthym, m r bs st>>. ay gr nykhn anh chyzy nmydnstnd w hdyt nyfth bwdnd (bz hm z anh pyrwy mykhnnd)?.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! mrqb khwd bshyd gr shm hdyt yfth bshyd, gmrhy khsnykhh gmrh shdhnd bh shm zyny nmyrsnd, bzgsht hmhy shm bh swy llh st, angh shm r z anchh `ml mykhrdyd; agh myszd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! chwn mrg ykhy z shm fr rsd dr mwq` wSyt byd z myn shm dw nfr `dl r gwh bgyryd y gr msfrt khrdyd w mSybt mrg bh shm rsyd (w mslmny r nyftyd) dw nfr z Gyr khwdtn r bh gwhy bTlbyd w gr (hngm dy shhdt dr Sdq anh) shkh khrdyd an dw r b`d z nmz ngh dryd t bh llh swgnd bkhwrnd khh: <<m HDr nystym Hq r bh chyzy bfrwshym gr chh khwyshnmn bshnd w shhdt llh r khtmn nmykhnym khh dr yn Swrt z gnhkhrn khwhym bwd>>.

ps gr m`lwm shd khh an dw mrtkhb gnh (khynt) shdhnd (w Hq r khtmn nmwdhnd) dw nfr z khsnykhh stm dydhnd w nsbt bh myt wly hstnd jy anh r khwhnd grft, angh bh llh swgnd yd khnnd khh: <<gwhy m z gwhy an dw drsttr st; w m tjwzy nkhrdhym, w gr chnyn khrdh bshym z stmkhrn khwhym bwd>>.
yn (rwsh) bh ankhh gwhy r bh gwnhy drstsh d khnnd; nzdykhtr st, w y btrsnd khh b`d z swgndh(y wrthh) swgndhyshn rd shwd; w z llh btrsyd, w gwsh fr dhyd w (bdnyd khh) llh grwh fsqn r hdyt nmykhnd.
rwzykhh llh pymbrn r grd awrd; angh bgwyd: <<(dr brbr d`wt Hq) chh pskhy bh shm ddh shd?>> gwynd: <<m r `lmy nyst; bygmn tw khwd dny rzhy nhny>>.

(bh yd bywr) hngmy r khh llh (bh `ysy psr mrym) myfrmyd: <<y `ysy psr mrym! n`mty r khh bh tw w mdrt bkhshydm bh yd awr; zmny khh tw r b <<rwH lqds>> (jbry'yl) tqwyt khrdm, dr ghwrh w bzrgy b mrdm skhn gfty, w hngmykhh khtb w Hkhmt, w twrt w njyl r bh tw amwkhtm, w hngmykhh bh frmn mn z gil chyzy mnnd shkhl prndhy skhty; ps dr an mydmydy w bh frmn mn prndhy myshd, w khwr mdr zd w mbtl bh bymry pysy r bh frmn mn shf myddy, w angh khh mrdgn r bh frmn mn (zndh) byrwn myawrdy, w hngmykhh bnysry'yl r z asyb rsndn bh tw bzdshtm, angh khh dlyl rwshn bry anh awrdy, ps khsny khh z anh khfr shdnd; gftnd: <<ynh jz jdwy ashkhr (chyzy dygr) nyst>>.

(w bh yd awr) chwn Hwrywn gftnd: <<y `ysy psr mrym! ay prwrdgrt mytwnd sfrhy z asmn br m nzl khnd?>>. (`ysy dr pskh) gft: <<gr mw'mn hstyd z llh btrsyd>>.

`ysy psr mrym (d` khrd w) gft: brlh, y prwrdgr m, z asmn sfrhy br m bfrst t bry wl w akhr m `ydy bshd w nshnhhy z tw, w bh m rwzy dh khh tw bhtryn rwzy dhndgny>>.

w gr w (= frstdh) r frshthy qrr myddym, Htm wy r bh Swrt ykh mrd dr myawrdym, bz hm (bh gmn ann khr r br anh) mshtbh myskhtym hmngwnh khh anh (br khwd w dygrn) mshtbh mysznd (w jy shbh bqy mymnd).

w z an wst, anchh dr shb w rwz arm gyrd, w w shnwyy dnst>>.

khsnykhh bh anh khtb ddhym, bh khwby w r myshnsnd, hmn gwnh khh frzndn khwd r myshnsnd, khsnykhh bh khwysh zyn rsndhnd ps ymn nmyawrnd.
w chh khsy stmkhrtr st z an khs khh br llh drwG bbndd, y aytsh r tkhdhyb khnd? bh rsty stmkhrn rstgr nkhwhnd shd.
w rwzykhh hmh anh r grd awrym, sps bh khsnykhh shrkh wrzydhnd; mygwyym: <<m`bwdhyy khh anh r shrykh llh mypndshtyd; khj hstnd?>>

w z ann khsny hstnd khh bh tw gwsh fr mydhnd, w m br dlhy shn prdhh fkhndhym t an r nfhmnd, w dr gwshhyshn sngyny (qrr ddhym) w gr tmm m`jzhh r bbynnd, bh an ymn nmyawrnd, t ynkhh nzd tw aynd w b tw mjdlh khnnd, khsnykhh khfr shdnd, gwynd: <<yn jz fsnhhy pyshynyn nyst>>.
w anh (mrdm r) z (pyrwy) w (= pymbr) bz mydrnd, w khwd (nyz) z w dwr myshwnd, anh jz khwyshtn (khsy) r hlkh nmykhnnd w nmydnnd.
w gr (anh r) hngmykhh dr brbr atsh ngh dshthnd; bbyny (shgft zdh myshwy) ps mygwynd: <<y khsh bz grdndh myshdym, w ayt prwrdgrmn r tkhdhyb nmykhrdym, w z mw'mnn mybwdym>>.
(nh chnyn nyst) blkhh anchh r khh pysh z yn pnhn mykhrdnd bryshn ashkhr shdh, w gr bz grdndh shwnd, bytrdyd bh anchh z an nhy shdh bwdnd; bz mygrdnd, w ynn drwGgwynnd.

w gr anh r bh hngmykhh dr pyshgh prwrdgrshn bzdshth shdhnd bbyny (shgft zdh myshwy, w llh bh anh) myfrmyd: <<ay yn Hq nyst?>> gwynd: <<chr qsm bh prwrdgrmn (Hq st) (llh) myfrmyd: <<ps bh szy ankhh khfr mywrzydyd `dhb r bchshyd>>.

anh khh lqy prwrdgr r tkhdhyb khrdnd; qT`an zyn dydnd, hngmykhh nghn qymt bh srGshn byyd, gwynd: <<y fsws br m khh drbrhy an khwthy khrdym>>. w anh (br) gnhnshn r br pshthy khwd Hml mykhnnd, chh bd bry st anchh r Hml mykhnnd.

w brsty pymbrny pysh z tw tkhdhyb shdnd, w dr brbr tkhdhybh Sbr khrdnd w (dr yn rh) azr dydnd; t yry m bh anh rsyd, w hych khs nmytwnd khlm llh r tGyyr dhd, w bygmn khbr pymbrn bh tw rsydh st.

hych jnnbdhy dr zmyn nyst, w nh hych prndhy khh b dw bl khwd prwz mykhnd, mgr ynkhh mthyy mnnd shm hstnd, m dr khtb (lwH mHfwZ) hych chyz r frw gdhr nkhrdym, sps bh swy prwrdgrshn mHshwr mygrdnd.

w ynkhh nmz r br p dryd, w z w btrsyd, w tnh wst khh bh swysh mHshwr myshwyd>>.

anh khsny hstnd khh khtb w Hkhmt w nbwt bh ann ddym, ps gr yn (mshrkhn) bh an (ayt qran) khfr wrznd, btHqyq m grwhy r br an mygmrym khh nsbt bh an khfr nystnd.

w anh (mqm w `Zmt) llh r an gwnh khh shysth st; nshnkhthnd, khh gftnd: <<llh br hych bshry chyzy r nzl nkhrdh st>> bgw: <<khtby r khh mwsy bry rwshnyy w hdyt mrdm awrd, chh khsy nzl khrdh st?! chshmh w r dr nmyybnd, w w chshmh r dr myybd, w w brykh byn agh st.

w anh bh skhttryn swgndhysh bh llh swgnd yd khrdnd khh gr m`jzhy bry ann byyd, qT`an bh an ymn myawrnd, bgw: <<m`jzt fqT nzd llh st (w dr khtyr mn nyst) w (shm y mw'mnn) chh mydnyd khh hr gh m`jzhy (hm) byyd, ymn nmyawrnd?!>>
