w khsnykhh ayt m r tkhdhyb khrdnd, bh tdryj z jyy khh nmydnnd, grftrshn khwhym khrd.
w bh anh mhlt mydhm, bygmn tdbyr mn mtyn (w stwr) st.
ay fkhr nkhrdhnd khh hmnshyn anh (= rswl llh) hych gwnh (nshny z) dywngy ndrd? w tnh bymdhndhy ashkhr st.
ay dr mlkhwt asmnh w zmyn, w anchh llh afrydh st, nmyngrnd?! w (ay fkhr nmykhnnd) shyd jlshn nzdykh shdh bshd?! ps b`d z yn (qran), bh khdm skhn, ymn khwhnd awrd?!
hrkhs r khh llh gmrh khnd, ps hdyt khnndhy brysh nyst, w anh r dr srkhshy w TGynshn srgrdn rh mykhnd.

(y pymbr) drbrhy qymt z tw swl mykhnnd, khy wq` myshwd? bgw: <<mslman `lm an fqT nzd prwrdgr mn st, w hychkhs jz w (nmytwnd) an r dr wqt m`ynsh ashkhr szd; (dnstn an) dr asmnh w zmyn sngyn (w pwshydh) st, w jz bTwr nghny, bh swy shm nmyayd>>. (chnn) z tw swl mykhnnd khh gwyy tw z w qw` an khbr dry, bgw: <<`lm an, fqT nzd llh st, wly byshtr mrdm nmydnnd>>.

bgw: <<mn mlkh swd w zyn khwyshtn nystm, mgr anchh r llh bkhwhd, w gr Gyb mydnstm, khyr (w swd) bsyry (bry khwd) frhm myskhtm, w hych bdy (w zyny) bh mn nmyrsyd, mn (khsy) nystm, jz bymdhndh, w bshrtdhndhy bry grwhy khh ymn drnd.

wst khh shm r z ykh tn afryd, w hmsrsh r (nyz) z khwdsh pdyd awrd; t dr khnr w arm bgyrd, ps chwn (mrd b hmsrsh) amyzsh khrd, Hmly sbkh brdsht, ps mdty b an (Hml) gdhrnyd, w chwn sngyn shd, hr dw (zn w shwhr) bh drgh llh, prwrdgr shn d` khrdnd, khh: <<gr (frzndy) tndrst (w shysth) bh m bdhy, mslman z spsgzrn khwhym bwd>>.
ps chwn (llh, frzndy) tndrst (w shysth) bh anh dd, bry w dr anchh bh ann ddh bwd, shrykhny qrr ddnd, ps llh brtrst z anchh shrykh (w hmty) w qrr mydhnd.
ay chyzy r shrykh mygyrnd khh chyzy r nmyafrynd w khwdshn mkhlwqnd.
w nmytwnnd anh r yry khnnd, w nh khwdshn r yry mydhnd.
w gr anh r bh swy hdyt d`wt khnyd, z shm pyrwy nmykhnnd, bry shm ykhsn st, khwh anh r d`wt khnyd w y khmwsh bshyd.
bygmn anhyy r khh Gyr z llh mykhwnyd, bndgny hmchwn shm hstnd, ps anh r bkhwnyd, gr rst mygwyyd (w anh llh hstnd), ps byd (d`y) shm r jbt khnnd!

ay phyy drnd khh b an rh brwnd?! y dsthyy drnd, khh b an chyzy r bgyrnd?! y chshmny drnd, khh b an bbynnd?! ay gwshhyy drnd, khh b an bshnwnd?! (y pymbr! bh mshrkhyn) bgw: <<shrykhntn r bkhwnyd, sps (br Dd mn) tdbyr (w nyrng) khnyd, w mr mhlt ndhyd.
hmn ywr (w srprst) mn, llh st khh (yn) khtb r nzl khrdh, w w ywr (w khr sz) SlHn st.
w khsny r khh bh jy w mykhwnyd, nmytwnnd shm r yry khnnd, w nh khwdshn r yry dhnd.
w gr anh r bh swy hdyt d`wt khnyd, (skhnntn r) nmyshnwnd, w ann r mybyny khh bh tw ngh mykhnnd, dr Hlykhh nmybynnd>>.
(y pymbr!) gdhsht r pyshh khn, w bh nykhy frmn dh, w z ndnn rwy bgrdn.
w gr z swy shyTn wswshy bh tw rsd, bh llh pnh bbr, bygmn w shnwy dnst.
hmn khsnykhh prhyzgry mykhnnd, chwn (khTrh w) wswshy z shyTn bh anh brsd, bh yd (llh) myftnd (w llh r yd mykhnnd) ps nghn byn mygrdnd.
w brdrnshn (z shyTn) ann r bh gmrhy mykhshnnd, sps (dr yn zmynh) khwthy nmykhnnd.

w chwn ayh (w m`jzhy khh anh mykhwhnd) bry ann nywry, gwynd: <<chr khwdt an r br ngzydy?!>>. bgw: <<mn fqT z chyzy pyrwy mykhnm khh z prwrdgrm bh mn wHy myshwd, yn (qran) Hjth (w byn)yy z Trf prwrdgrtn, w myhy hdyt w rHmt st bry grwhy khh ymn myawrnd>>.
w chwn qran khwndh shwd, ps bh an gwsh fr dhyd, w khmwsh bshyd, t mshmwl rHmt shwyd.
w prwrdgrt r dr dl khwd, b tDr` w bym, nh b Sdy blnd, dr SbHghn w shmghn, yd khn, w z Gfln mbsh.
hmn khsnykhh dr nzd prwrdgr tw hstnd, z `bdtsh tkhbr nmy wrznd, w w r bh pkhy yd mykhnnd, w brysh sjdh mykhnnd.
z tw drbrhy nfl (= Gnym) swl mykhnnd, bgw: <<nfl z ani llh w pymbr st, ps z llh btrsyd; w myn khwdtn r SlH khnyd, w khd w pymbrsh r T`t khnyd; gr ymn dryd.
mw'mnn tnh khsny hstnd khh chwn nm llh brdh shwd, dlhy shn trsn grdd, w chwn ayt w br anh khwndh shwd, ymnshn fzwn grdd, w br prwrdgrshn twkhl mykhnnd.
khsnykhh nmz r br p mydrnd, w z anchh bh ann rwzy ddhym, nfq mykhnnd.
ynn, mw'mnn Hqyqy hstnd, bry ann drjty pypy (`ly) nzd prwrdgrshn st, w (hmchnyn) amrzsh, w rwzy frwn w nykhw (dr bhsht) st.
hmngwnh khh prwrdgrt tw r bh Hq z khnht (= mdynh, bh swy mydn bdr) byrwn awrd, dr Hlykhh grwhy z mw'mnn nkhshnwd bwdnd.
anh ps z an khh Hqyqt ashkhr shd; drbrhy Hq (= jhd) b tw mjdlh mykhnnd, gwyy bh swy mrg rndh myshwnd, w khwd myngrnd.

w (bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh llh bh shm w`dh dd khh ykhy z dw grwh (= khrwn tjry y lshkhr) nSyb shm khwhd bwd, w shm dwst mydshtyd khh khrwn Gyr jngy (tjry) bry shm bshd, w llh mykhwst b skhnn khwysh Hq r pydr (w stwr) khnd w ryshhy khfrn r qT` khnd.
t Hq r thbt, w bTl r z myn br drd, gr chh gnhkhrn n khshnwd bshnd.
(byd awryd) hngmykhh z prwrdgrtn (fryd w) yry mykhwstyd, ps w (khwsthy) shm r pdhyrft. (w frmwd:) <<mn shm r b ykh hzr z frshtgn, khh pypy frwd myaynd, yry mykhnm>>.
w llh yn (yry w mdd) r tnh bry shdy w Tmynn qlb shm qrr dd, w grnh, pyrwzy jz z Trf llh nyst, bh rsty llh pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.

(w bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh khwb sbkhy khh armshy z swy w bwd, shm r fr grft, w z asmn aby br shm frw frstd, t shm r b an pkh khnd, w plydy shyTn r z shm dwr szd, w dlhy shm r mHkhm bdrd, w gmhytn r b an stwr khnd.

(w bh yd awr) hngmykhh prwrdgrt bh frshtgn wHy khrd: <<mn b shm hstm, ps khsny r khh ymn awrdhnd; thbt qdm dryd, bh zwdy drdl khsnykhh khfr shdnd; trs w hrs myfkhnm, ps br frz grdnh bznyd, w hmhy ngshtnshn r bznyd (w qT` khnyd).
yn bkhTr an st khh anh b llh w rswlsh mkhlft khrdnd, w hr khs b llh w rswlsh mkhlft khnd, ps (bdnd khh) llh skht khyfr st.
(y khfrn) shm yn (`dhb w mjzt dr dny) r bchshyd! w (bdnyd) khh bry khfrn (dr qymt) `dhb atsh st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! chwn b nbwh khfrn (dr mydn jng) rwbrw shwyd, ps bh anh psht nkhnyd.
w hr khs dr an rwz bh anh psht khnd mgr ankhh (hdfsh z khnrhgyry) bry Hmlhy dwbrh y (bh qSd) pywstn bh grwhy (dygr bshd) bh khshm llh bzgshth (w szwr) st, w jygh w jhnm st, w chh bd jyghy st.
ps shm anh r nkhshtyd, blkhh llh anh r khsht. w hngmykhh (bh swy anh khkh w sng) ndkhty, tw nyndkhty, blkhh llh ndkht, t mw'mnn r bh azmyshy nykhw z jnb khwd byzmyd, bygmn llh shnwy dnst.
yn (wq`h) chnyn bwd (khh dydyd) w (bdnyd khh) hmn llh sstkhnndhy mkhr (w nqshhhy) khfrn st.

(y khfrn!) khwhn ftH w pyrwzy (Hq) hstyd, ps bygmn ftH w pyrwzy (mslmnn) brytn amd, w gr (z khfr w mkhlft w jng) dst brdryd, bry shm bhtr st. w gr bz grdyd, (m hm) bz khwhym gsht, w grwh shm hr chnd zyd bshd, shm r bynyz nkhwhd khrd, (zyr) khh llh b mw'mnn st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! llh w rswlsh r T`t khnyd, w z w rwy ngrdnyd dr Hlykhh (skhn w r) myshnwyd.
w mnnd khsny nbshyd khh gftnd: <<shnydym>> Hl ankhh ann nmyshnydnd.
hmn bdtryn jnbndgn nzd llh, (frd) khr w lly hstnd, khh nmyndyshnd.
w gr llh khyry dr anh mydnst, qT`an bh ann myshnwnd, w gr (hm b yn Hl) bh ann myshnwnd, bz rwy mygrdndnd w `rD (w srpychy) mykhrdnd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! (d`wt) llh w pymbr (w) r jbt khnyd, hngmykhh shm r bh swy chyzy fr mykhwnd khh shm r Hyt (w zndgy) mybkhshd, w bdnyd khh llh myn shkhS w qlb w Hyl myshwd, w (bdnyd) khh bh swy w mHshwr khwhyd shd.
w z ftnhy bprhyzyd khh tnh bh stmkhrni shm nmyrsd, (blkhh hmh r fr mygyrd) w bdnyd khh llh skht khyfrst!

wbh yd awryd zmny r khh shm dr rwy zmyn ndkh w ntwn bwdyd, mytrsydyd khh mrdm shm r brbynd, ps llh shm r pnh dd, w b yry khwd shm r t'yyd (w tqwyt) khrd, w z chyzhy pkhyzh bh shm rwzy bkhshyd, shyd shm spsgzr bshyd.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! bh llh w pymbr (w) khynt nkhnyd, w (nyz) dr mnthy khwd, dr Hlykhh mydnyd khynt nwrzyd.
w bdnyd khh mwl shm, w wld shm, (wsylhy) azmysh st, w hmn llh st khh pdsh bzrg nzd w st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! gr z llh btrsyd bry shm rh njt (w wsylhy bry jdyy Hq z bTl) qrr mydhd, w gnhntn r mypwshnd, w shm r myamrzd, w llh SHb fDl w bkhshsh bzrg st.

w (bh yd awr) angh khh khfrn dr(brhy) tw nqshh mykhshydnd, khh tw r bh zndn byfkhnnd, y tw r bkhshnd, w y (z mkhh) byrwnt khnnd, anh chrh w mkhr myndyshydnd, w llh (hm) tdbyr mykhrd, w llh bhtryn (chrhjwyn w) tdbyrkhnndgn st.
w chwn ayt m br anh khwndh shwd, gwynd: <<hmn shnydym, gr m (hm) bkhwhym, mnnd an r mygwyym, ynh jz fsnhhy pyshynyn nyst>>.
w (bh yd awr) angh khh gftnd: <<prwrdgr! gr yn (qran) Hq st, w z jnb twst, ps z asmn sngy br m bbrn, y `dhb drdnkhy br m bfrst>>.
w t tw (y pymbr) dr myn anh hsty, llh anh r `dhb nkhwhd khrd, w (nyz) t zmny khh stGfr mykhnnd; llh `dhbshn nmykhnd.
wchr llh anh r `dhb nkhnd, Hl ankhh ann (mrdm r) z msjd lHrm bz mydrnd, dr Hlykhh ann mtwlyn w srprst an nystnd (w lyqt an r ndrnd) mtwly w srprst an tnh prhyzgrnnd, wly byshtrshn nmydnnd.
w nmzshn nzd khnhy (kh`bh) chyzy jz swt khshydn w khf zdn nbwd, ps bh (khyfr) khfrtn, `dhb r bchshyd.

bh rsty khsnykhh khfr shdnd, mwlshn r bry bzdshtn (mrdm) z rh llh khrj mykhnnd, ps bh zwdy hmh r khrj mykhnnd, angh (myhy) Hsrt w pyshmny br ann khwhd bwd, sps shkhst mykhwrnd, w (srnjm) khsnykhh khfr shdnd, bswy (atsh) jhnm rndh myshwnd.
t llh plyd r z pkh jd szd, w plydn r rwy hm bgdhrd, angh hmgy r mtrkhm szd, w sps ykh j dr dwzkh qrr dhd, ynh hmn zynkhrn (wq`y) hstnd.

(y pymbr!) bh khsnykhh khfr shdnd bgw: <<gr (z khfr w dshmny) dst br drnd, gdhshthhyshn amrzydh myshwd, w gr (bh hmn `ml khwd) bzgrdnd, ps bygmn snt (w rwsh llh drbrhy) pyshynyn gdhshth st (w drbrhy anh nyz jr myshwd).
w b anh pykhr khnyd, t ftnhy (shrkh) ryshh khn shwd, w (prstsh w) dyn, hmh z an llh bshd, ps gr anh (z shrkh w azr w dhyt) dst br drnd, llh bh anchh mykhnnd; bynst.
w gr (srpychy w) rwy grdny khnnd, ps bdnyd khh llh srprst (w mwly) shmst, chh nykhw srprst w chh nykhw ywry st.

w bdnyd khh hrgwnh Gnymty bh dst awrdyd, ykh pnjmsh bry khd, w bry pymbr, w bry khwyshn, w ytymn w mskhynn w dr rh mndgn st, gr bh llh w anchh br bndhy khwd dr rwz frqn (= jdyy Hq z bTl), rwz br khwrd dw grwh (mw'mnyn w mshrkhyn dr bdr) nzl khrdym, ymn awrdhyd, w llh br hr chyz twnst.

angh khh shm bh khnrh nzdykhtr bwdyd, w anh bh khnrhy dwrtr bwdnd, w khrwn (qrysh) pyyntr z shm bwd, w gr b ykhdygr w`dh mygdhshtyd, qT` dr (njm) w`dhy (khwd) khtlf mykhrdyd, wly llh (bdwn my`d, shm r jm` khrd w rwbrwy ykhdygr qrr dd) t khry r khh mybyst njm shwd, bh njm brsnd, t an khh hlkh (w nbwd) myshwd, z rwy dlyl (w Hjt) hlkh shwd, w khsykhh zndh mymnd, z rwy dlyl (w Hjt) zndh mnd, w hmn llh shnwy dnst.

(byd awr) angh khh llh (`dhy) anh r dr khwbt bh tw ndkh nshn dd, w gr zyd nshn mydd; mslman sst myshdyd, w dr yn khr khtlf mykhrdyd, wly llh (shm r z ssty w khtlf) slmt ngh dsht, bygmn w bh anchh dr synhhst; agh st.

w (byd awr) angh khh chwn bhm rwbrw shdyd, anh r bh chshm shm khm nshn dd, w shm r (nyz) bh chshm anh khm jlwh dd, t llh, khry r khh mybyst njm shwd, bh njm brsnd, w hmhy khrh bh llh bz grdndh myshwd.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! hngmykhh b grwhy (z dshmn) rwbrw shdyd, pydr (w thbt qdm) bshyd, w llh r bsyr yd khnyd, t rstgr shwyd.
w llh w pymbrsh r T`t khnyd, w b hmdygr nz` nkhnyd, khh sst shwyd, w qwt (w mhbt) shm z myn brwd, w Sbr khnyd, bygmn llh b Sbrn st.
w mnnd khsny nbshyd khh b srkhshy w khwd nmyy bh mrdm, z srzmyn khwd (mkhh) byrwn amdnd, w (mrdm r) z rh llh bz mydshtnd, w llh bh anchh mykhnnd; HTh drd.

w (bh yd bywryd) hngmy r khh shyTn `ml anh r dr nZrshn byrst, w gft: <<mrwz hych khs z mrdm br shm pyrwz nkhwhd shd, w mn Hmy (w pnh dhndhy) shm hstm>>. ps hngmykhh dw grwh rwbrw shdnd, bh `qb bzgsht, w gft: <<bygmn mn z shm byzrm, bh rsty mn chyzy r mybynm khh shm nmybynyd, hmn mn z llh mytrsm, w llh skht khyfr st!>>.
w (bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh mnfqn w ann khh dr dlhy shn bymry st, mygftnd: <<ynn r dynshn bfryfth st>>. w hrkhs br llh twkhl khnd, ps bygmn llh pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.
w gr bbyny hngmykhh frshtgn (mrg) jn khfrn r mygyrnd, bh Swrt w psht anh myznnd w (mygwynd:) <<`dhb swzndh r bchshyd>> (hr aynh t`jb mykhrdy).
yn bh (khTr) khrhyy st khh pysh z yn frstdhyd, w ankhh llh hrgz nsbt bh bndgnsh stm r rw nmydrd.
hmnnd shywhy fr`wnyn, w khsnykhh pysh z ann bwdnd, bh ayt llh khfr wrzydnd, ps llh anh r bh khyfr gnhnshn frw grft, mslman llh nyrwmnd skht khyfr st.
yn, bdn khTr st khh llh, hych n`mty r khh br qwmy rzny dshth, tGyyr nmydhd, t ankhh anh (rwsh) khwdshn r tGyyr dhnd, w bygmn llh shnwy dnst.
mnnd shywhy fr`wnyn w khsnykhh pysh z ann bwdnd, ayt prwrdgrshn r tkhdhyb khrdnd, ps ann r bh khyfr gnhnshn hlkh khrdym, w fr`wnyn r Grq nmwdym, w hmhy (anh) stmkhr bwdnd.
yqynan, bdtryn jnbndgn nzd llh, khsny hstnd khh khfr shdnd, ps ann ymn nmyawrnd.
khsnykhh b anh pymn bsty, sps hr br pymn khwd r myshkhnnd, w anh (dr khynt w pymnshkhny z llh) nmytrsnd.
ps gr anh r dr (mydn) jng byby, chnn bh ann Hmlh bbr t khsnykhh psht sr anh hstnd (btrsnd w) bshd khh pnd gyrnd.
w gr z khynt qwmy bym dshty; mnSfnh (pymnshn r) bh swy ann byndz (w fskh pymnshn r bry hmgn `ln khn), bh rsty khh llh khy'nn r dwst nmydrd.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd, npndrnd khh pyshy grfthnd; anh hrgz m r ntwn nkhwhnd khrd.

w anchh z nyrw dr twn dryd; bry (mqblh b) anh amdh szyd, w (hmchnyn) z sbn bsth (y wrzydh, mhy khnyd) t bh wsylhy an dshmn llh w dshmn khwd r btrsnyd, w (hmchnyn) dshmnn dygry Gyr z anh r, khh shm nmyshnsyd w khd anh r myshnsd (btrsnyd) w hr chyzy r khh dr rh llh khrj mykhnyd, (pdshsh) bh tmm w khml bh shm ddh myshwd, w bh shm stm nkhwhd shd.
w gr bh SlH myl shdnd, ps tw (nyz) z dr SlH dray, w br llh twkhl khn, bygmn w shnwy dnst.
w gr bkhwhnd tw r fryb dhnd, ps llh bry tw khfy st, wst khh b yry khwd w mw'mnn tw r t'yyd (w tqwyt) khrd.
w byn dlhy anh lft dd, gr tmm anchh r khh dr rwy zmyn st khrj mykhrdy, nmytwnsty byn dlhy shn lft dhy, wly llh dr myn anh lft dd, hmn w pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.
y pymbr! llh tw r w khsny z mw'mnn r khh z tw pyrwy khrdhnd; (z shr dshmnn) khfyt mykhnd.

y pymbr! mw'mnn r bh jng tshwyq khn, gr byst nfr brdbr z shm bshnd, br dwyst nfr (z khfrn) Glbh mykhnnd, w gr Sd nfr z shm bshnd br hzr nfr z khsnykhh khfr shdnd, Glbh mykhnnd, zyr ann grwhy hstnd khh nmyfhmnd.

khnwn llh bh shm tkhfyf dd, w dnst khh dr shm ntwny st, ps gr Sd nfr brdbr z shm bshnd; br dwyst nfr pyrwz myshwnd, w gr z shm hzr nfr bshnd, bh frmn llh br dw hzr nfr pyrwz khwhnd shd, w llh b Sbrn st.
hych pymbry r szwr nyst khh syrny dshth bshd; t ankhh dr zmyn khshtr bsyr khnd, shm (b grftn fdyh z syrn) mt` dny r mykhwhyd, w llh (sry) akhrt r (bry shm) mykhwhd, w llh pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.

gr Hkhm pyshyn lhy nbwd (khh Gnymt w fdyhy syr Hll st) [ b`Dy mygwynd khh mrd z Hkhm pyshyn Hllbwdn ml Gnymt st y`ny yn khh yn Hkhm pyshyn (nwshth shdh) tqdyr lhy bwd khh ml Gnymt bry mslmnn Hll khwhd grdyd, ldh shm b grftn fdyh khr jyzy r njm ddhyd w gr chnyn nmybwd bh sbb grftn fdyh bh `dhb bzrgy dchr myshdyd. b`Dy an r mGfrt hl bdr dnsthnd. w b`Dy an r bh nymdn `dhb dr hngm wjwd rswl llh Sly llh `lyh wslm tfsyr khrdhnd.], qT`an dr anchh grftyd, `dhb bzrgy bh shm myrsyd.
ps z anchh Gnymt grfthyd, Hll pkhyzh bkhwryd, w z llh btrsyd, hmn llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
y pymbr! bh syrny khh dr dst shm hstnd bgw: <<gr llh khyry dr dlhy shm bdnd, bhtr z anchh z shm grfth shd, bh shm khwhd dd, w shm r myamrzd, w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st>>.
w gr bkhwhnd bh tw khynt khnnd, ps anh pysh z yn (nyz) bh llh khynt khrdnd, w llh (tw r) br anh pyrwz grdnyd, w llh dny Hkhym st.

hmn khsnykhh ymn awrdnd, w hjrt khrdnd, w b mwl w jnhyshn dr rh llh jhd nmwdnd, w khsnykhh (yshn r) pnh ddnd w yry nmwdnd, ynn yrn (w dwstdr) ykhdygrnd, w khsnykhh ymn awrdnd w hjrt nkhrdhnd, shm hych gwnh dwsty (w msw'lyty) dr brbr anh ndryd; t ankhh hjrt khnnd, w gr dr (khr) dyn z shm yry khwstnd, ps brshmst khh (anh r) yry khnyd, mgr br `lyh grwhy khh myn shm w anh pymny st, w llh bh anchh mykhnyd; bynst.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd, dwstdr (w ywr) ykhdygrnd, gr (shm y mw'mnn yn khr r) nkhnyd, ftnh w fsdy bzrg dr zmyn br p khwhd shd.
w khsnykhh ymn awrdnd, w hjrt nmwdnd, w dr rh llh jhd khrdnd, w khsnykhh (yshn r) pnh ddnd w yry nmwdnd, ynn mw'mnn Hqyqy hstnd, bry anh amrzsh w rwzy shysthy khwhd bwd.
w khsnykhh b`d z anh ymn awrdnd w hjrt nmwdnd, w bh hmrh shm jhd khrdnd, ps ann z shm hstnd. w khwyshwndn dr khtb llh nsbt bh ykhdygr szwrtrnd, w hmn llh bh hmh chyz dnst.
(`lm) byzry z swy llh w pymbrsh, bh khsny z mshrkhn st khh (b anh) pymn bsthyd.
ps chhr mh (mhlt dryd khh) dr zmyn syr khnyd, w bdnyd khh shm nmytwnyd llh r ntwn szyd, w hmn llh khwr w rswkhnndhy khfrn st.

w (yn) `lmy st z jnb llh w pymbrsh bh mrdm, dr rwz Hj khbr (= rwz `yd qrbn) khh: llh w pymbrsh z mshrkhn byzrnd, ps gr twbh khnyd, bry shm bhtrst, w gr rwy bgrdnyd (w sr pychy khnyd) ps bdnyd khh shm nmytwnyd llh r n twn szyd, w khsnykhh khfr shdnd bh `dhb drdnkhy bshrt dh!.

mgr khsny z mshrkhn khh b anh pymn bsthyd, angh anh chyzy (z an dr Hq shm) frw gdhr nkhrdnd, w khsy r br (`lyh) shm yry nddnd, ps pymn anh r t mdt (pymn) shn bh akhr (w tmm) brsnyd, hmn llh prhyzgrn r dwst drd.

ps hngmykhh mhhy Hrm pyn pdhyrft; mshrkhn r hr khj yftyd, bkhshyd, w anh r (syr) bgyryd, w anh r mHSrh khnyd, w dr hr khmyngh, br sr rhshn bnshynyd, ps gr twbh khrdnd, w nmz r brp dshtnd, w zkht r prdkhtnd; anh r rh khnyd, bygmn llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
w gr ykhy z mshrkhn z tw pnh khwst, ps w r pnh bdh, t skhn llh r bshnwd, sps wr bh mHl mnsh brsn, yn bdn sbb st khh anh grwhynd khh nmydnnd.

chgwnh bry mshrkhn nzd llh w nzd rswlsh (`hd w) pymny khwhd bwd, mgr khsnykhh nzd msjd lHrm b anh pymn bstyd, t zmny khh (br pymnshn) wfdr mndnd, shm nyz (br srpymntn) wfdr bshyd, bygmn llh prhyzgrn r dwst drd.
chgwnh (pymny bshd) drHlykhh gr br shm pyrwz shwnd, nh khwyshwndy r r`yt mykhnnd w nh pymn r?! shm r b zbnhy shn khshnwd mykhnnd, w (ly) dlhy shn b drd, w byshtr shn nfrmnnd.
ayt llh r bh bhy ndkhy frwkhtnd, ps (mrdm r) z rh w (= llh) bzdshtnd, anh khr bdy njm myddnd!
drbrhy hych frd mw'mny khwyshwndy w pymn r r`yt nmykhnnd, w ann mrdmy tjwz khrnd.
ps gr twbh khnnd, w nmz r br p drnd, w zkht r bdhnd, brdrn dyny shm hstnd, w m ayt khwd r bry grwhy khh mydnnd byn mykhnym.
w gr swgnd (w pymnhy) khwd r ps z `hd (w pymn) khwysh shkhstnd, w dr dyn shm T`n zdnd, ps b pyshwyn khfr jng khnyd, zyr anh `hd (w pymny) ndrnd, bshd khh (z khrdr khwd) dst br drnd.
ay b grwhy khh pymnhy khwd r shkhstnd, w qSd khrj pymbr khrdnd, nmyjngyd?! drHlykhh anh nkhstyn br (jng b shm r) aGz khrdnd, ay z anh mytrsyd?! ps llh szwrtr st khh z w btrsyd, gr ymn dryd.
b anh bjngyd, t llh b dstn shm `dhbshn khnd, w ann r rsw szd, w shm r br anh pyrwzy dhd, w synhy grwh mw'mnn r shf mybkhshd.
w khshm dlhy shn r z myn mybrd, w llh twbhy hrkhs r bkhwhd mypdhyrd, w llh dny Hkhym st.

ay gmn khrdyd khh (bh Hl khwd) rh myshwyd; dr Hlykhh llh hnwz khsny r khh z shm jhd khrdnd, w Gyr z llh w rswlsh w mw'mnn r hmrz (khwysh) ngrfthnd (z dygrn) mshkhS nkhrdh st?! w llh bh anchh njm mydhyd; agh st.
mshrkhn r (szwr) nyst, khh msjd llh r abd khnnd, dr Hlykhh bh khfr khwysh gwhy mydhnd, anh `mlshn nbwd (w HbT) shdh, w dr atsh (jhnm) jwdnh khwhnd mnd.
msjd llh r fqT khsy abd mykhnd khh bh llh w rwz akhrt ymn awrdh, w nmz r br p drd, w zkht r bdhd, w jz z llh ntrsd, myd st khh ynn z hdytyftgn bshnd.

ay ab ddn bh Hjj, w abd skhtn msjd lHrm r, hmchwn (`ml) khsykhh bh llh w rwz qymt ymn awrdh, w dr rh llh jhd khrdh st, brbr mygyryd?! (khyr, anh) nzd llh brbr nystnd, w llh grwh stmkhrn r hdyt nmykhnd.
(mqm) khsnykhh ymn awrdnd, w hjrt khrdnd, w b mwlshn w jnhyshn dr rh llh jhd khrdnd, nzd llh brtr (w blndmrtbhtr) st, w anh hmn rstgrnnd.
prwrdgrshn anh r bh rHmty z nzd khwd w khshnwdy (khwysh) w bh bGhyy (z bhsht) khh dran n`mthy jwydnh drnd, bshrt mydhd.
hmwrh dr an jwdnnd, bygmn jr (w pdsh) bzrg nzd llh st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! pdrn khwd w brdrn khwd r dwstn (w wly) khwd qrr ndhyd, gr khfr r br ymn trjyH ddnd, w khsny z shm khh ann r dwst (w wly) khwd qrr dhnd, ps ann stmkhrnnd.

bgw: <<gr pdrntn, w frzndntn, w brdrntn w hmsrntn, w khwyshwndntn, w mwly khh bh dst awrdhyd, w tjrty khh z khsd an mytrsyd, w khnhhyy khh bdn dlkhwsh hstyd, dr nzd shm z llh w pymbrsh w jhd dr rh w mHbwbtr st, ps mntZr bshyd, t llh frmn (`dhb) khwysh r bywrd, w llh grwh nfrmn r hdyt nmykhnd>>.

bh rsty llh shm r dr jhy zydy yry khrd, (w pyrwzy bkhshyd) w dr rwz Hnyn (nyz yry khrd) angh khh fzwny jm`yttn shm r shgft awrdh bwd (w mGrwr skht) ps swdy bh Hltn ndsht, w zmyn b hmhy frkhy w ws`tsh br shm tng amd, w sps psht (bh mydn jng) nmwdh, frr khrdyd.
angh llh armsh khwd r br pymbrsh w br mw'mnn nzl khrd, w lshkhryny frstd khh shm anh r nmydydyd, w khsny r khh khfr shdnd `dhb (w mjzt) khrd, w yn st khyfr khfrn.
sps llh b`d z an twbhy hr khs r bkhwhd mypdhyrd, w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! bygmn mshrkhn plydnd, ps nbyd b`d z imsl, bh msjd lHrm nzdykh shwnd, w gr z fqr (w tngdsty) mytrsyd, ps hrgh llh bkhwhd shm r z fDl khwd bynyztn myszd, bygmn llh dny Hkhym st.
b khsny z hl khtb khh nh bh llh w nh bh rwz qymt ymn drnd, w nh anchh r llh w rswlsh Hrm khrdh, Hrm mydnnd, w nh dyn Hq r mypdhyrnd, bjngyd, t zmny khh b dhlt w khwry bh dst khwysh jzyh bdhnd.

w yhwd gftnd: <<`zyr psr llh st>> w nSr gftnd: <<msyH psr llh st>>. yn skhny st khh b zbnhyshn mygwynd, mshbht (w tqlyd) mykhnnd skhn khsnykhh pysh z yn khfr bwdnd, llh anh r bkhshd, chgwnh (z Hq) mnHrf myshwnd?!

(anh) dnshmndn w rhbn khwysh, w (hmchnyn) msyH psr mrym r m`bwdny bjy llh grftnd; dr Hlykhh dstwr ndshtnd jz llh ykhtyy r khh hych m`bwdy (bh Hq) jz w nyst; bprstnd, w pkh w mnzh st z anchh shrykh w qrr mydhnd.
(anh) mykhwhnd nwr llh r b dhn khwd khmwsh khnnd, w llh b mykhnd, mgr ynkhh nwrsh r khml (w tmm) khnd, gr chh khfrn khrht dshth bshnd.
w khsy st khh rswl khwd r b hdyt w dyn Hq frstd, t an r br hmhy dynh Glb grdnd, gr chh mshrkhn khrht dshth bshnd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! bygmn bsyry z Hbr w rhbn mwl mrdm r bh bTl mykhwrnd, w (dygrn r) z rh llh bz mydrnd, w khsnykhh Tl w nqrh r myndwznd (w gnjynh mykhnnd) w dr rh llh nfq nmykhnnd, ps anh r bh `dhby drdnkh bshrt dh.

rwzykhh an r dr atsh jhnm grm (w tfthsh) khnnd, ps b an pyshnyhyshn w phlwhyshn, w pshthyshn r dG khnnd, (w bh anh gfth shwd) yn hmn chyzy st khh bry khwd ndwkhtyd, ps bchshyd (T`m) anchh r myndwkhtyd.

bygmn t`dd mhh nzd llh dr khtb khd, z an rwz khh asmnh w zmyn r afrydh, dwzdh mh st, khh chhr mh z an, (mh) Hrm st [ mhhy Hrm `brtnd z: dhy lq`dh, dhy lHjh, mHrm, w rjb; khh jng dr anh Hrm st.]. yn, dyn thbt w drst (lhy) st. ps dr yn mhh bh khwd stm nkhnyd, w dsthjm`y b mshrkhn bjngyd, hmn gwnh khh anh dsthjm`y b shm myjngnd, w bdnyd khh llh b prhyzgrn st.

hmn bh t'khyr fkhndn (w jbjyy mhhy Hrm) fzwny dr khfr st, khsnykhh khfr shdnd, b an gmrh myshwnd, ykh sl; an r Hll, w ykh sl (dygr) an r Hrm mykhnnd, t mTbq b t`dd mhhyy shwd khh llh tHrym khrdh st, ps anchh r khh llh Hrm khrdh, Hll myshmrnd, `ml zshtshn dr nZrshn arsth shdh st, w llh grwh khfrn r hdyt nmykhnd.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! shm r chh shdh, hngmykhh bh shm gfth myshwd: <<(bh swy jhd) dr rh llh Hrkht khnyd>> bh zmyn mychsbyd (w ssty mykhnyd)) ay bh jy akhrt bh zndgy dny rDy shdhyd?! Hl ankhh mt` zndgy dny, dr (brbr) akhrt, jz ndkhy (hych) nyst.
gr (bry jhd) khwch nkhnyd, (llh) shm r bh `dhb drdnkhy, `dhb mykhnd, w qwm dygry r bjy shm qrr mydhd, w hych zyny bh w nmyrsnyd, w llh br hr chyzy twnst.

gr w (= pymbr) r yry nkhnyd, bh rsty khh llh w r yry khrd, angh khh khfrn w r (z mkhh) byrwn khrdnd, nfr dwm z dw nfry khh an dw dr Gr bwdnd, bh yr khwd (bwbkhr) mygft: <<ndwhgyn mbsh, yqynan llh b mst>>. ps llh armsh khwd r br w frw frstd, w b lshkhrhyy khh shm an r nmydydyd, w r t'yyd (w tqwyt) nmwd, w khlm (w gftr shrkh) khsny r khh khfr shdnd; pyyn qrr dd, w khlm (w ayyn) llh bl (w pyrwz) st, w llh pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.
sbkhbr w grnbr (hmgy bry jhd) khwch khnyd, w b mwltn, w jnhytn dr rh llh jhd khnyd, yn bry shm bhtrst, gr bdnyd.

gr mt`y nzdykh (w dst yftny) bwd, w sfry asn (w nzdykh dr pysh) bwd, lbth z tw pyrwy mykhrdnd, w lykhn msft rh (tbwkh) br anh dwr (w pr mshqt) st, w bh zwdy bh llh swgnd yd mykhnnd khh: <<gr twnyy dshtym, lbth hmrh shm byrwn myshdym>> (anh b yn khrh) khwd r hlkh mykhnnd, w llh mydnd khh anh drwGgw hstnd.
(y pymbr!) llh tw r bbkhshyd! chr bh anh jzh ddy?! pysh z ankhh rstgwyn br tw ashkhr shwnd, w drwGgwyn r bshnsy!.
khsnykhh bh llh w rwz akhrt ymn drnd, hychgh bry (trkh) jhd b mwl shn w jnhyshn, z tw jzh nmykhwhnd, w llh nsbt bh prhyzgrn dnst.
tnh khsny z tw jzh mykhwhnd; khh bh llh w rwz akhrt ymn ndrnd, w dlhy shn grftr shkh st, w anh dr shkh (w trdyd) khwd sr grdnnd.
w gr anh mykhwstnd khh (hmrh shm) byrwn shwnd, sz w brgy bry an amdh mykhrdnd, w lykhn llh z Hrkht anh khrht dsht, ldh anh r (z Hrkht) bzdsht, w bh ann gfth shd: <<b nshstgn bnshynyd>>.

gr (anh) hmrh shm byrwn myamdnd, jz fsd (w tbhy) chyzy br shm nmyfzwdnd, w bh sr`t dr myn shm ftnhngyzy mykhrdnd, w dr myn shm frdy (D`yf lymn) hstnd khh bh (skhnn) anh gwsh fr mydhnd, w llh, (nsbt) bh stmkhrn dnst.
bh rsty khh anh pysh z yn (nyz) ftnhgry mykhrdnd, w khrh r bry tw dgrgwn khrdnd, t ankhh Hq fr rsyd, w frmn llh ashkhr shd, (w shm pyrwz shdyd) dr Hlykhh anh khrht dshtnd.
b`Dy z anh mygwynd: <<(dr trkh jhd) bh mn jzh bdh, w mr bh ftnh (w gnh) nyfkhn>>. agh bshyd khh anh dr ftnh ftdhnd, w bygmn jhnm khfrn r HTh khrdh st.
gr bh tw nykhy brsd, anh r nrHt mykhnd, w gr mSybty bh tw rsd, mygwynd: <<m pysh z yn chrhy khr khwd r ndyshydhym>> w shdmnh bz mygrdnd.
bgw: <<hrgz (mSybty) bh m nrsd, jz anchh llh bry m nwshth st, w mwly mst, w mw'mnn byd br llh twkhl khnnd>>.

bgw: <<ay bry m jz ykhy z dw nykhy r ntZr dryd?! (y pyrwzy y shhdt) w m bry shm ntZr drym khh llh, `dhby z nzd khwdsh bh shm brsnd, y bdst m (shm r mjzt khnd) ps shm ntZr bkhshyd, bygmn m (nyz) b shm ntZr mykhshym>>.
bgw: <<nfq khnyd, chh z rwy myl bshd y bh khrh, hrgz z shm pdhyrfth nkhwhd shd, zyr shm mrdmy fsq (w nfrmn) hstyd>>.
w hych chyz mn` qbwl nfqhy anh nshd, mgr ankhh bh llh w pymbrsh khfr shdnd, w jz b khslt (w by myly) bry nmz HDr nmyshwnd, w jz b khrht nfq nmykhnnd.
ps (fzwny) mwlshn w wldshn, tw r shgftzdh nkhnd, zyr llh mykhwhd bh (wsylhy) an anh r dr zndgy dny `dhb khnd, w drHlykhh khfrnd jnshn br ayd.
w anh (= mnfqn) bh llh swgnd yd mykhnnd khh z shm hstnd, drHlykhh z shm nystnd, w lykhn anh grwhynd khh mytrsnd, (bdyn sbb swgnd mykhwrnd).
gr pnhgh y Grh y twnly (dr zyr zmyn) bybnd, shtbn bh swy an mygryznd.
w z anh khsny hstnd khh dr (tqsym) Sdqt (w Gnym) bh tw khrdh mygyrnd, ps gr z an (mwl, bhrhy) bh anh ddh shwd, rDy myshwnd, w gr z an (chyzy) ddh nshwd, fwran khshm mygyrnd.
gr bh anchh llh w rswlsh bh anh ddh st, rDy bshnd, w bgwynd: <<llh bry m khfy st, bh zwdy llh w rswlsh z fDl khwd bh m `T myfrmyd, m tnh bh swy llh rGbt mywzrym>>. (bry anh bhtr bwd).

Sdqt (w zkhth) mkhSwS fqr w mskhyn w khr gzrn (jm` awry) an, w dljwyy shdgn (nw mslmnn) w bry (azd khrdn) brdgn, w (dy wm) bdhkhrn, w dr rh llh, w bh rh mndgn, (st, yn) fryDhy (mqrr shdh) z jnb llh st, w llh dny Hkhym st.

w z anh (= mnfqn) khsny hstnd khh pymbr r azr mydhnd, w mygwynd: <<gwsh (w khwsh bwr) st>>. bgw: <<bry shm gwsh nykhy st, bh llh ymn drd, w mw'mnn r tSdyq mykhnd, w rHmt st bry khsny z shm khh ymn awrdhnd>>. w khsnykhh rswl llh r azr mydhnd, bryshn `dhb drdnkhy st.
(mnfqn) bry shm bh llh swgnd yd mykhnnd, t shm r khshnwd sznd, dr Hlykhh gr ymn dshtnd, shysthtr (yn) st khh llh w rswlsh r khshnwd sznd.
ay nmydnnd, bygmn hr khs b llh w rswlsh mkhlft (w dshmny) khnd, ps mslman bry w atsh jhnm st, jwdnh dr an khwhd bwd?! yn (hmn) rswyy bzrg st.
mnfqn mytrsnd khh mbd swrhy br (`lyh) ann nzl shwd, w bh anh z anchh drwn dlhy shn (nhfth) st, agh szd, bgw: <<sthz khnyd, bygmn llh, anchh r khh z an mytrsyd, ashkhr myszd>>.
w (y pymbr!) gr z anh bprsy: (<<chr chnyn khrdhyd?>>). gwynd: <<m Hrf myzdym, (shwkhy w) bzy mykhrdym>> bgw: <<ay llh w ayt w w pymbrsh r mskhrh mykhrdyd?>>.
`dhr nywryd, bh rsty khh shm ps z ymn (awrdn) tn khfr shdhyd, gr grwhy z shm r (bkhTr twbh) bbkhshym, grwh dygry r `dhb khwhym khrd, zyr khh mjrm bwdnd.

mrdn mnfq w znn mnfq, hmh (hmnnd hm w) z ykh grwhnd, bh khrhy zsht frmn mydhnd, w z nykhyh bz mydrnd, w dsthyshn r (z bkhshsh) mybndnd, llh r frmwsh khrdnd, ps llh (nyz) anh r frmwsh khrd, bygmn mnfqn hmn fsqn hstnd.
llh bh mrdn mnfq w znn mnfq w khfr, w`dhy atsh jhnm ddh st, jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd, hmn bry anh khfy st, w llh anh r l`nt khrdh st, w bry anh `dhb hmyshgy st.

(shm mnfqn) hmnnd khsnykhh pysh z shm bwdnd, (hstyd, blkhh) anh z shm nyrwmndtr, w mwl w frzndnshn byshtr bwd, anh z nSyb khwd bhrhmnd shdnd, ps shm nyz z nSyb khwd bhrhmnd shdhyd, hmchnnkhh khsnykhh pysh z shm bwdhnd, z nSyb khwysh bhrhmnd shdh bwdnd, w shm (dr skhnn npsnd) frw rftyd, hmn gwnh khh anh frw rftnd; ann `mlshn dr dny w akhrt nbwd shd, w ann hmn zynkhrnnd.

ay khbr khsnykhh pysh z anh bwdnd, (chwn) qwm nwH, w `d w thmwd, w qwm brhym, w SHb mdyn (= qwm sh`yb) w shhrhy zyr w rw shdh [ mr z hl mw'tfkht qwm lwT st khh shhrshn bh nm <<sdwm>> bwd. y'tkhf y`ny zyr w rwshdn, bh Trzy khh dr btd z asmn sngbrn gshtnd sps shhrshn bh bl brdh shd w z hmnj bh pyyn fkhndh shd.] (qwm lwT) bh anh nrsydh st, khh pymbrnshn b dlyl rwshn bh (swy) anh amdnd, (wly npdhyrftnd) ps llh (b hlkhshn) bh anh stm nkhrd, w lykhn khwdshn br khwyshtn stm mykhrdnd.

w mrdn mw'mn w znn mw'mn dwstn (w ywr) ykhdygrnd, mr bh m`rwf w nhy z mnkhr mykhnnd, w nmz r br p mydrnd, w zkht r myprdznd, w llh w pymbrsh r T`t mykhnnd, ynnnd khh llh bh zwdy anh r mwrd rHmt qrr mydhd, bygmn llh pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.

llh bh mrdn mw'mn w znn mw'mn, bGhyy (z bhsht) w`dh ddh khh nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd, w (nyz) khnhhy pkhyzhy dr bhshthy jwyd (nSyb shn frmwdh) w khshnwdy llh (z hmhy ynh) brtr st, yn, hmn khmyby bzrg st.
y pymbr! b khfrn w mnfqn jhd khn, w brann skht gyr bsh, w jyghshn jhnm st, w chh bd srnjmy st.

(mnfqn) bh llh swgnd yd mykhnnd khh (skhnn ndrst) ngfthnd, w bh rsty khh skhn khfr gfthnd, w ps z slm awrdnshn, khfr shdhnd, w qSd chyzy (khTrnkh) khrdnd, khh bh an nrsydnd, tnh bh yn sbb `ybjwy'y mykhnnd khh llh w rswlsh, anh r z fDl khwd bynyz khrd, ps gr twbh khnnd, bry anh bhtr st, w gr rwy bgrdnnd; llh anh r dr dny w akhrt, b `dhby drdnkh `dhbshn mykhnd, w dr (rwy) zmyn hych khrsz w ywry nkhwhnd dsht.
b`Dy z anh b llh (`hd w) pymn bstnd khh: gr (llh) z fDl khwd (nSyby) bh m dhd, qT`an Sdqh (w zkht) khwhym dd, w z nykhwkhrn khwhym bwd.
ps chwn (llh) z fDl khwd bh anh (nSyby) bkhshyd, bh an bkhl wrzydnd, w `rDkhnn rwy grdndnd (w sr pychy khrdnd).
ps (yn `ml) nfq r t rwzykhh w (= llh) r mlqt khnnd, dr dlhy shn br qrr skht, bh (sbb) anchh khh b llh w`dh khrdh bwdnd, khlf nmwdnd, (w `hd shkhny khrdnd) w bh (sbb) ankhh drwG mygftnd.
ay nmydnstnd khh llh srrshn, w (skhnn) dr gwshy shn r mydnd, w bygmn llh dny Gybh st.

khsnykhh z mw'mnn rGbtkhnndh (w frmnbrdr) dr Sdqt (shn) `ybjwyy mykhnnd, w khsny r khh jz bhndzhy (nchyz) twnyy khwd (chyzy) nmyybnd, ps (`ybjwyy w) mskhrh shn mykhnnd, llh anh r mskhrh mykhnd, w bry anh `dhb drdnkhy st.
(y pymbr) bry anh amrzsh bkhwh y bryshn amrzsh nkhwh, gr hftd br bry anh amrzsh bkhwhy, hrgz llh anh r nmyamrzd, yn bdn sbb st khh anh bh llh w pymbrsh khfr shdnd, w llh grwh fsqn r hdyt nmykhnd.

wpsmndgn (z Gzwhy tbwkh) z nshstn khwd b`d z (mkhlft b) rswl llh, khwshHl shdnd, w khrht dshtnd khh b mwl khwd, w jnhy khwd, dr rh llh jhd khnnd, w (bh ykhdygr) gftnd: <<dr yn grm, (bry jhd) byrwn nrwyd>>, (y pymbr! bh ann) bgw: <<atsh jhnm (z yn) grmtrst>> gr dr myyftnd.
ps anh byd khmtr bkhndnd, w bsyr gryh khnnd, (yn) jzy anchh khh njm myddnd.

ps gr llh tw r bh swy grwhy z anh bz grdnd, w z tw jzhy khrwj (bry jhd) khwstnd, ps bgw: <<hrgz b mn khrj nkhwhyd shd, w hrgz hmrh mn, b hych dshmny nkhwhyd jngyd, zyr shm nkhstyn br bh nshstn (w khnrh gyry) rDy shdyd, ps b psmndgn bmnyd>>.
w hrgz br hych ykh z anh khh mrdh st, nmz nkhwn, w br (khnr) qbrsh nyst, bygmn anh bh llh w rswlsh khfr shdnd, w dr Hlykhh fsq (w nfrmn) bwdnd; mrdnd.
w (fzwny) mwlshn w wldshn, tw r shgftzdh nkhnd, zyr llh mykhwhd bh (wsylhy) an, anh r dr zndgy dny `dhb khnd, w dr Hlykhh khfrnd; jnshn brayd.
w hngmykhh swrhy nzl shwd khh bh llh ymn awryd, w hmrh pymbrsh jhd khnyd, twngrnshn z tw jzh mykhwhnd, w gwynd: <<bgdhr m b khnhnshynn (khh m`dhwrnd) bshym>>.
anh rDy shdnd khh b (znn w) bzmndgn bshnd, w br dlhyshn muhr zdh shdh, ps ann (chyzy) nmyfhmnd.
lykhn pymbr w khsnykhh b w ymn awrdnd, b mwl khwd w jnhy khwd (dr rh llh) jhd khrdnd, nykhyh (hmh) z ani anhst, w annnd khh rstgrnnd.
llh bry anh bGhyy (z bhsht) amdh khrdh st, khh nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd, yn khmyby bzrg st.
w `dhrawrndgn z `rb (bdyhnshyn, nzd tw) amdnd, t bh anh jzh ddh shwd, w khsnykhh bh llh w rswlsh drwG gfth bwdnd (dr khnh) nshstnd, bh zwdy bh khsny z anh khh khfr shdnd, `dhb drdnkhy khwhd rsyd.
br ntwnn gnhy nyst w nh br bymrn, w nh br khsnykhh chyzy nmyybnd, khrj khnnd, (gnhy st). hrgh bry llh w pymbrsh khyr khwhy khnnd, br nykhw khrn hych rh (srznsh) nyst, w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

w nh br khsnykhh wqty nzd tw amdnd khh anh r (br mrkhby) swr khny, gfty: <<chyzy khh shm r bran swr khnm, nmyybm>> anh bzgshtnd, dr Hlykhh z ndwh chshmnshn shkh ryzn bwd, chr khh hych chyzy bry nfq (dr rh llh) nyftnd.
tnh rh (srznsh) br khsny (bz) st khh z tw jzh mykhwhnd, dr Hlykhh twngrnd, (anh) rDy shdnd khh b (znn w) bzmndgn bshnd, w llh br dlhy shn mhr nhdh st, ps ann (chyzy) nmydnnd.

hngmykhh bh swy anh bz grdyd, z shm `dhrkhwhy mykhnnd, bgw: <<`dhrkhwhy nkhnyd; m hrgz (gftr) shm r bwr nkhwhym khrd, bh rstykhh llh m r z khbr shm agh khrdh st, w bh zwdy llh w rswlsh, `ml shm r khwhnd dyd, angh bh swy (llh) dny pnhn w ashkhr bz grdndh myshwyd; ps shm r bh anchh njm myddyd; agh mykhnd>>

hngmykhh bh swy ann bz grdyd, bry shm bh llh swgnd yd mykhnnd, t z anh chshm pwshy (w `rD) khnyd, ps z anh rwy bgrnyd (w `rD khnyd) bygmn anh (mrdmy) plydnd, w jyghshn jhnm st, bh khyfr anchh khh njm myddnd.
bry shm swgnd yd mykhnnd, t z anh rDy shwyd, gr shm z anh rDy shwyd, ps bytrdyd llh z grwh fsqn rDy nkhwhd shd.
khfr w nfq `rb (bdyhnshyn), shdydtr st, w bh n aghy z Hdwd (w Hkhmy) khh llh br pymbrsh nzl khrdh, szwrtrnd, w llh dny Hkhym st.
z `rb (bdyhnshyn) khsnynd khh anchh r (dr rh llh) nfq mykhnnd, Grmt bh Hsb myawrnd, w mntZrnd Hwdth (w pyshmd ngwry) bh shm brsd, Hwdth bd (w ngwr) br khwdshn bd, w llh shnwy dnst.

w z `rb (bdyhnshyn) khsny nd khh bh llh w rwz akhrt ymn drnd, w anchh r (dr rh llh) nfq mykhnnd, sbb tqrb bh llh, w d`y pymbr mydnnd, agh bshyd, bygmn ynh sbb tqrbshn khwhd bwd, w llh bh zwdy anh r dr rHmt khwd wrd khwhd khrd, bygmn llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

w pyshgmn nkhstyn z mhjryn w nSr, w khsnykhh bh nykhy z anh pyrwy khrdnd, llh z anh khshnwd gsht, w anh (nyz) z w khshnwd shdnd, w bry anh bGhyy (z bhsht) amdh khrdh st, khh nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd, yn khmyby bzrg st.

w z (myn) `rb (bdyhnshyn) khh pyrmwn shm hstnd, grwhy mnfqnd, w z hl mdynh (nyz) grwhy khwy nfq grfthnd, tw anh r nmyshnsy, (wly) m anh r myshnsym, bh zwdy anh r dw br `dhb khwhym khrd, sps bh swy `dhby bzrg (dr qymt) frstdh myshwnd.
w grwh dygry (nyz) hstnd khh bh gnhn khwd `trf khrdnd, khrhy shysth w nshysth r bh hm amykhtnd, myd st khh llh twbhy an r bpdhyrd, bygmn llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
z mwl anh Sdqh (w zkht) bgyr, t bwsylhy an anh r pkh szy w tzkhyh shn khny, w bryshn d` khn, yqynan d`y tw myhy armsh bry anhst, w llh shnwy dnst.
ay nmydnnd, khh tnh llh twbh r z bndgnsh mypdhyrd, w Sdqt r mygyrd, w bygmn llh st khh twbhpdhyr mhrbn st.
w bgw: <<`ml khnyd, ps bzwdy llh, w pymbrsh w mw'mnn `ml shm r khwhnd dyd, w bh zwdy bh swy (llh) dny pnhn w ashkhr, bz grdndh myshwyd, ps shm r bh anchh njm myddyd; agh mykhnd>>
w grwh dygry (nyz) mwqwf bh frmn (w mshyt) llh st, y anh r `dhb mykhnd, w y twbhy anh r mypdhyrd, w llh dny Hkhym st.

w khsnykhh bry zyn rsnydn (bh mslmnn) w (tqwyt) khfr w tfrqhfkhny myn mw'mnn, msjdy skhtnd, w (t) khmynghy bry khsnykhh z pysh b llh w rswlsh mbrzh khrdhnd bshd, w lbth anh swgnd yd mykhnnd khh qSdy jz nykhy (w khdmt) ndshthym w llh gwhy mydhd khh yqynan anh drwGgw hstnd.

(y pymbr!) hrgz dr an msjd (bry nmz) nyst, an msjd khh z rwz nkhst br pyh tqw bn shdh, shysthtr st khh dr an (bh nmz) bysty, dr an mrdny hstnd khh dwst drnd khh pkhyzh shwnd, w llh pkhyzgn r dwst drd.

ay khsykhh ss (w bnyn) an r br trs z llh w khshnwdy (w) an r bn khrdh bhtr st, y khsykhh ss (w bnyn) an brkhnr prtgh ssty bn nhdh st, ps (nghn) b w dr atsh jhnm frw ryzd? w llh grwh stmkhrn r hdyt nmykhnd.
an bny khh anh nhdhnd, pywsth dr dlhy shn myhy shkh (w nfq) khwhd bwd, mgr ynkhh dlhy shn prh prh shwd (w bmyrnd) w llh dny Hkhym st.

bygmn llh z mw'mnn jnhyshn w mwlshn r khrydh st, bh (bh~) ynkhh bhsht bry anh bshd. (bdyn Swrt khh): dr rh llh jng mykhnnd, ps mykhshnd, w khshth myshwnd, (yn) w`dhy Hqy st br w, (khh) dr twrt w njyl w qran (amdh st) w chh khsy z llh bh `hdsh wfdrtr st?! ps shd bshyd, bh dd w stdy khh shm b w khrdhyd, w yn hmn khmyby bzrg st.
(anh) twbhkhnndgn, `bdn, spsgzrn, rwzhdrn, rkhw`khnndgn, sjdhkhnndgn, frmndhndgn bh m`rwf w bzdrndgn z mnkhr, w HfZn (w nghdrndgn) Hdwd (w Hkhm) lhy hstnd, w mw'mnn r bshrt dh.
bry pymbr w khsnykhh ymn awrdnd (shysth) nbwd khh bry mshrkhn Tlb amrzsh khnnd, - hr chnd z nzdykhnshn bshnd- b`d z ankhh bry anh rwshn shd khh anh hl dwzkhnd.
w amrzsh khwstn brhym bry pdrsh nbwd; mgr bh khTr w`dhy khh bh w ddh bwd, ps chwn bry w ashkhr shd khh w dshmn llh st; z w byzry jst, bygmn brhym lbh khnndhy brdbr bwd.
w hrgz llh qwmy r, b`d zankhh anh r hdyt khrd gmrh nmykhnd, t ankhh chyzhy r khh byd z an bprhyznd, bry anh byn khnd, bygmn llh bh hr chyzy dnst.
yqynan frmnrwyy asmnh w zmyn z an llh st, zndh mykhnd w mymyrnd, w shm r jz llh khrsz w ywry nyst.

qT`an llh rHmt khwd r shml Hl pymbr w mhjrn w nSr, ann khh dr zmn skhty (w tngdsty) z w pyrwy khrdnd; nmwd, b`d zankhh nzdykh bwd, dl hy grwhy z anh (z Hq) mnHrf shwd, sps twbhy anh r pdhyrft, bygmn w (nsbt) bh anh rw'wf mhrbn st.

w bh an sh nfry khh (z jng tbwkh) tkhlf nmwdnd, (lTf w Hsn nmwd); [ an sh nfr kh`b bn mlkh, mrrh bn rby` w hll bn myh rDy llh `nhm bwdnd, dstn ann r bh zbn kh`b (ykhy z an sh nfr) dr khtb SHyH bkhry: 4418 mlHZh frmyyd.] t angh khh zmyn b hmhy frkhysh br anh tng shd, w z khwd bh tng amdnd, w dnstnd khh pnhghy z llh jz bh swy w nyst, sps rHmt khwd r shml Hl anh nmwd, t twbh khnnd (w twbhy ann r pdhyrft) bygmn llh st khh twbhpdhyr mhrbn st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd, z llh btrsyd, w b rstgwyn bshyd [ zyr khh rstgwyy sbb njt nsn w drwGgwyy sbb hlkht mygrdd. ].

szwr nyst khh hl mdynh, w `rb (bdyhnshyn) khh Trf anh hstnd, z (hmrhy) rswl llh bz ps mnnd, w nh bry (HfZ) jn khwd, z jn w chshm bpwshnd, yn bdn sbb st khh hych tshngy w khstgy w grsngy dr rh llh bh anh nmyrsd, w hych (j mnzl nmykhnnd w) gmy khh mwjb khshm khfrn shwd; br nmydrnd, w hych (dstbrd w) gzndy bh dshmn nmyrsnnd, mgr ynkhh bh (sbb) an, `ml SlHy bryshn nwshth shwd, bygmn llh pdsh nykhwkhrn r Dy` nmykhnd.
w hych ml khwchkh y bzrgy r (dr rh llh) nfq nmykhnnd, w hych wdy (w srzmyny) nmypymynd, mgr ynkhh bry anh nwshth myshwd, t llh pdsh nykhwtryn khrdrshn r bh anh bdhd.
w nbyd khh mw'mnn hmgy (bry jhd) khwchkh khnnd, ps chr z hr grwhy z ann, dsthy khwch nmykhnnd, t dr dyn dnsh bymwznd, w qwm khwd r hshdr dhnd, hngmykhh bh swy anh bz gshtnd, bshd khh anh btrsnd.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! b khsnykhh z khfrn khh nzdykh shmynd, jng khnyd, w byd anh dr shm shdt w drshty bybnd, w bdnyd khh llh b prhyzgrn st.
w hngmykhh swrhy nzl shwd, ps b`Dy z anh (bh dygry) mygwyd: <<yn swrh, ymn khdm ykh z shm r fzwd?!>> (bh anh bgw:) m khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd, ps bh ymnshn fzwdh, w anh shdmny mykhnnd.
w m khsnykhh dr dlhy shn bymry st, ps plydy bh plydyshn fzwdh, w dr Hlykhh khfr bwdnd; mrdnd.
ay anh nmybynnd khh dr hr sl, ykh y dwbr azmysh myshwnd?! bz twbh nmykhnnd, w nh anh pnd mygyrnd.
w hngmykhh swrhy nzl shwd, b`Dy z anh bh b`Dy dygr ngh mykhnnd (gwynd:) <<ay khsy shm r mybynd?!>> sps bz mygrdnd, llh dlhy anh r z (z Hq) bz grdnyd, zyr khh anh grwhynd khh nmyfhmnd.
yqynan pymbry z (myn) khwdtn bh swytn amd khh rnjhy shm br w dshwr (w grn) st, w br (hdyt) shm skht Srr drd, w (nsbt) bh mw'mnn rw'wf (w) mhrbn st.
ps gr rwy br grdnnd, bgw: <<llh bry mn khfy st, hych m`bwdy (bh Hq) jz w nyst, br w twkhl khrdm, w w prwrdgr `rsh `Zym st>>.
lr. (lf. lm. r) yn ayt khtb mHkhm (w b Hkhmt) st.

ay bry mrdm mwjb shgfty st khh bh mrdy z khwdshn wHy khrdhym khh: <<mrdm r btrsn w khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd bshrt dh khh bry anh sbqhy nykhw (w pdshy Htmy) nzd prwrdgrshn st>>. khfrn gftnd: <<yn (mrd) jdwgrashkhry st>>.

bygmn prwrdgr shm, llh st, khh asmnh w zmyn r dr shsh rwz afryd, sps br `rsh mstwy shd, khr (jhn) r tdbyr mykhnd. hych shf`tkhnndhy nyst, mgr b`d z frmn w, yn st llh prwrdgr shm, ps w r prstsh khnyd, ay pnd nmygyryd?!

bzgsht hmh shm bh swy wst, w`dhy llh Hq st, bygmn w afrynsh r aGz mykhnd, sps anh r bz mygrdnd, t khsny r khh ymn awrdh w khrhy shysth khrdhnd bh `dlt pdsh dhd, w khsnykhh khfr shdnd, bryshn nwshydny z ab jwshn st, w `dhby drdnkh, bh sbb ankhh khfr mywrzydnd.
w khsy st khh khwrshyd r rwshnyy, w mh r nwr qrr dd, w bry an mnzly mqdr khrd, t `dd slh w Hsb r bdnyd, llh yn r jz bh Hq nyfrydh st, ayt r bry grwhy khh mydnnd, bh tfSyl byn mykhnd.
bygmn dr amd w shd shb w rwz, w anchh llh dr asmnh w zmyn afrydh st, nshnhhy st bry grwhy khh prhyz gry mykhnnd.
hmn khsnykhh mlqt m r (dr rwz qymt) myd ndrnd, w bh zndgy dny khshnwd shdh w bdn dl bsthnd, w khsnykhh z ayt m Gflnd,
anh (hmh) jyghshn atsh (jhnm) st, bh sbb khrhyy khh njm myddnd.
bygmn khsnykhh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth khrdnd, prwrdgrshn bh sbb ymnshn anh r bh bGhy (bhsht) pr n`mt hdyt mykhnnd khh nhrh zyr (drkhtn) an jry st.
d`yshn dr an: <<llh! tw mnzhy>> bshd, w tHyt shn dr an: <<slm>> w pyn d`yshn yn st khh: <<Hmd w sps, mkhSwS llh, prwrdgr jhnyn st>>.
w gr llh zwd mrdm r mjzt mykhrd, hmngwnh khh anh bry khyr `jlh drnd, `mrshn bh pyn myrsyd, (w nbwd myshdnd) ps khsnykhh bh mlqt m myd ndrnd (bh Hl khwd) rh mykhnym t dr TGyn khwd srgrdn bmnnd.

w chwn bh nsn zyn (w rnjy) brsd, (dr hr Hl khh bshd) bh phlw khwbydh, y nshsth, y ystdh, m r mykhwnd. ps hngmykhh an zyn (w rnj) r z w br Trf khrdym, chnn myrwd khh gwyy hrgz m r bry df` zyn (w rnj) khh bh w rsydh bwd, nkhwndh st, yn gwnh bry srfkhrn, anchh mykhrdnd (dr nZrshn) zynt ddh shdh st.
bh rsty khh m mthy pysh z shm r hngmykhh stm khrdnd, hlkh khrdym, dr Hlykhh pymbrn anh b dlyl rwshn bh swy ann amdnd w anh ymn nywrdnd, yn gwnh grwh mjrmn r khyfr mydhym.
sps shm r ps z anh (rwy) zmyn jnshynn qrr ddym, t bngrym khh chgwnh `ml mykhnyd.

w hngmykhh ayt rwshn m br anh khwndh shwd, khsnykhh bh mlqt m (dr rwz qymt) myd ndrnd, gwynd: <<qrany Gyr z yn bywr y an r tGyyr bdh>>. (y pymbr!) bgw: <<mn Hq ndrm khh an r z pysh khwd tGyyr dhm, w mn pyrwy nmykhnm mgr anchh r khh br mn wHy myshwd, w mn gr prwrdgrm r nfrmny khnm z `dhb rwz bzrg mytrsm>>
bgw: <<gr llh mykhwst mn an r br shm nmykhwndm, w nh (llh) shm r z an agh mykhrd, bh rsty khh pysh z yn `mry r dr myn shm gdhrndh m, ay nmyndyshyd?!>>
ps chh khsy stmkhrtr st z an khsykhh br llh drwG mybndd, w y ayt w r tkhdhyb mykhnd?! bygmn mjrmn rstgr nkhwhnd shd.

w Gyr z llh chyzhy r myprstnd khh nh bh anh zyny myrsnd w nh swdshn mybkhshd, w mygwynd: <<ynh (= bth) shfy`n m nzd llh hstnd>> bgw: <<ay llh r bh chyzy khh dr asmnh w dr zmyn nmydnd, khbr mydhyd?!>> mnzh st w, w z anchh b w shrykh mysznd brtr st.
(dr aGz) mrdm jz mt wHdy nbwdnd, ps khtlf khrdnd, w gr frmny nbwd pysh z yn, z prwrdgr Sdr shdh bwd, dr myn anh dr anchh khh dr an khtlf dshtnd, dwry myshd.
w mygwynd <<chr m`jzhy z (jnb) prwrdgrsh br w nzl nshdh st?>>. ps bgw: <<(`lm) Gyb tnh z an llh st, ps shm ntZr bkhshyd khh mn (nyz) b shm z mntZrnm>>.

w hngmykhh bh mrdm, ps z rnj (w zyny) khh bh anh rsydh st rHmty bchshnym, angh anh dr ayt m nyrng mykhnnd, bgw: llh dr nyrng zdn sry`tr st, bytrdyd rswln (= frshtgn) m anchh nyrng mykhnyd, mynwysnd>>.

w khsy st khh shm r dr khshkhy w dry bh Hrkht dr myawrd, t angh khh dr khshty qrr mygyryd, w (khshtyh) b bdy mlym anh r (bh swy mqSd) Hrkht mydhnd w (anh) bh an shdmn myshwnd. (n ghn) Twfn shdydy mywzd, w mwj z hr sw (bh swy anh) byyd, w gmn khnnd, khh rh gryzy ndrnd (w hlkh khwhnd shd), llh r z rwy khlS mykhwnnd: <<khh gr m r z yn (grftry) njt dhy, qT`an z spsgzrn khwhym bwd>>.

ps chwn (llh) anh r njt dd, anh bh n Hq dr zmyn srkhshy (w stm) mykhnnd y mrdm! sr khshy (w stm) shm tnh bh zyn khwdtn st, mt` (chnd rwz) zndgy dnyst, sps bzgshttn bh swy mst, ps shm r bh anchh njm myddyd, khbr mydhym.

mthl zndgy dny, hmnnd aby st khh z asmn nzl khrdym, sps br thr an gyhn gwngwn zmyn z anchh mrdm w chhrpyn mykhwrnd; rwyyd, t zmny khh zmyn pyryh khwd bgrft, w arsth shd, w hl an gmn khrdnd khh khwd br an chyrhnd, (nghn) frmn m dr shb y rwzy fr rsd, w anchnn an (khshtzr) r drw khnym khh gwy dyrwz hrgz (khshtzry) nbwdh st. yn gwnh ayt (khwd) r bry grwhy khh myndyshnd bh tfSyl byn mykhnym.
w llh bh sry slmty (= bhsht) d`wt mykhnd, w hr khs r bkhwhd bh rh rst hdyt mykhnd.
bry khsnykhh nykhy khrdnd, pdsh nykh (= bhsht) st w fzwn br an (=rw'yt bry t`ly st). w tyrgy w khwry chhrhhyshn r npwshnd, ynn hl bhshtnd, w jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd.

w khsnykhh mrtkhb bdyh shdnd, pdsh hr bdy hmnnd an st, w khwry (chhrhhy) anh r mypwshnd w hych khsy nmytwnd anh r z (`dhb) llh ngh drd (chnn shwnd khh) gwyy b prhy z shb trykh chhrhhyshn pwshydh shdh st, ynn hl atsh (dwzkh)nd w jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd.

(w bh yd awryd) rwzykhh hmhy anh r grd awrym, sps bh khsnykhh shrkh awrdnd gwym: <<shm w m`bwdhytn dr mkhn khwd tn bmnyd>> ps anh r z ykhdygr jd mykhnym, w m`bwdhyshn (bh anh) mygwynd: <<shm m r `bdt nmykhrdyd,

w (ywsf) bh an khsy z dw nfr khh dnst rhyy myybd, gft: <<mr nzd srwrt (= Hkhm) yd khn>>. wly shyTn yd khrdn (w r nzd) srwrsh z khTr w brd, ps (ywsf) chnd sl dr zndn bqy mnd.

<<(ynh) khwbhy (ashfth w) pryshn st, w m z t`byr khwbhy pryshn agh nystym>>.

w pdr w mdr khwd r br tkht nshnd, w (hmgy) bry w bh sjdh ftdnd, w (ywsf) gft: <<y pdrjn! yn t`byr khwbm st, khh z pysh dydh bwdm, prwrdgrm an r rst grdnd (w tHqq bkhshyd), yqynan bh mn nykhy khrd hngmykhh mr z zndn byrwn awrd, w shm r z an bybn (bh ynj) awrd, b`d z ankhh shyTn myn mn w brdrnm (ftnh w) fsd khrd, bygmn prwrdgrm bh anchh khh mykhwhd (tdbyr khnd) brykh byn st, hmn w dny Hkhym st.
prwrdgr! (bhrhy `Zymy) z frmnrwyy bh mn `T khrdy, w z `lm (t'wyl Hdyth =)t`byr khwbh bh mn amwkhty, y pdyd awrndhy asmnh w zmyn! twyy khr sz mn dr dny w akhrt, mr mslmn bmyrn w bh shystgn mlHq frm>>.
(y pymbr!) yn z khbrhy Gyb st khh bh tw wHy mykhnym, w hngmykhh (brdrn ywsf) bd ndyshy mykhrdnd w tSmym (qT`y)grftnd, tw nzd anh nbwdy.
w byshtr mrdm - w gr chh (br ymnshn) HrS wrzy - mw'mn nkhwhnd bwd.
w tw br yn (d`wt) z anh pdshy nmyTlby, an jz pndy bry jhnyn nyst.
w chh bs nshnhy dr asmnh w zmyn wjwd drd khh anh z khnrsh mygdhrnd w z an rwy mygrdnnd.
w byshtr anh bh llh ymn nmyawrnd; mgr ynkhh ann (bh nw`y) mshrkhnd.
ay ymn hstnd z ynkhh `dhb frgyry z swy llh bh srG anh byyd, y nghn qymt bh srGshn ayd, dr Hlykhh ann bykhbrnd.
(y pymbr!) bgw: <<yn rh mn st, mn b bSyrt (khml) bh swy llh d`wt mykhnm, w khsnykhh z mn pyrwy khrdnd (nyz chnyn mykhnd) w llh pkh w mnzh st, w mn z mshrkhn nystm>>.

w m pysh z tw nfrstdym, jz mrdny z hl qryhh khh bh anh wHy mykhrdym, ay (mshrkhn) dr zmyn syr nkhrdnd; t bbynd `qbt khsnykhh pysh z anh bwdnd, chgwnh bwd?! w yqynan sry akhrt bry khsnykhh prhyzgry khrdnd, bhtr st, ay nmyndyshyd?!

(khfrn pywsth bh nkhr khwd dmh ddnd) t angh khh pymbrn (z qwmshn) n myd shdnd, w (mrdm) pndshtnd khh bh anh drwG gfth shdh st, (dr yn hngm) yry m bh srGshn amd, ps hr khs r khh khwstym njt yft, w `dhb m z qwm gnhkhr bz nkhwhd gsht.

yqynan dr dstnhyshn `brty bry khrdmndn st, yn (qran) skhny nbwd khh (bh drwG) bfth shwd, blkhh tSdyqkhnndhy khtbhy st khh pysh z an st, w bynkhnndh (w shrH) hr chyz st, w hdyt w rHmt bry grwhy st khh ymn myawrnd.
lmr (lf. lm. mym. r) ynh ayt khtb (qran) st, w anchh z (swy) prwrdgrt br tw nzl shdh, Hq st, w lykhn byshtr mrdm ymn nmyawrnd.

llh khsy st khh asmnh r bdwn stwn br frsht khh mybynyd, angh br `rsh mstqr shd, w khwrshyd w mh r mskhr skht, khh hr khdm t mdt m`yny rwn st, khr (w mwr hsty) r tdbyr mykhnd, nshnhhy r (rwshn) byn mykhnd, shyd shm bh lqy prwrdgrtn yqyn HSl khnyd.

w w khsy st khh zmyn r gstrd, w dr an khwhh w nhrh qrr dd, w dr an z hr nw` mywhh dw qsm (trsh w shyryn w...) pdyd awrd, shb r br rwz mypwshnd, bygmn dr yn (mwr) nshnhh (w `brth) st bry grwhy khh myndyshnd.

w dr zmyn qT`hhy (gwngwn) khnrhm (qrr drd) w bGhyy z ngwr w khshtzr w nkhlhy khh gh z ykh bn myrwynd w ghy z chnd bn, (dr Swrty) khh z ykh ab syrb myshwnd, w (b yn Hl) mywhy b`Dy z anh r b`Dy (dygr) brtry ddym, bdwn shkh dr yn (mwr) nshnhh (w `brth) st bry grwhy khh khrd mywrznd.

w (y pymbr!) gr (z ymn nywrdn khfr) t`jb mykhny, ps skhn ann `jyb (tr) st, khh (mygwynd:) <<ay hngmykhh (mrdym w) khkh shdym (br dygr zndh myshwym w) bh afrynsh nwyny bz mygrdym?!>> ynn khsny hstnd khh bh prwrdgrshn khfr shdhnd, w ynn Glh (w znjyrh) dr grdnhyshn st, w ynn hl atsh (jhnm)nd, w jwdnh dran khwhnd mnd.

w anh pysh z nykhy (w rHmt) bdy (w `dhb) r bh shtb z tw mykhwhnd, b ynkhh (br mth) pysh z anh blh (w `qwbthy `brt ngyz) gdhshth st, w bygmn prwrdgr tw nsbt bh mrdm - b wjwd stmkhr bwdnshn - dry mGfrt st (w myamrzd) w hmn prwrdgr tw skht khyfrst.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd mygwynd: <<chr nshnhh (w m`jzhy) z (swy) prwrdgrsh br w nzl nshdh st?!>> (y pymbr!) tw fqT hshdrdhndhy, w bry hr qwmy hdyt khnndhy st.
llh mydnd anchh r khh hr mdhy bdn brdr myshwd, w anchh r khh rHmh mykhhnd w anchh fzwn mykhnnd, w hr chyz nzd w mqdr m`yny drd.
(w) dny Gyb w ashkhr, bzrg blnd mrtbh st.
(bry llh) ykhsn st khh khsy z shm pnhny skhn bgwyd, w khsykhh an r ashkhr szd, w khsykhh dr (trykhy) shb pnhn myshwd, y dr (rwshnyy) rwz (ashkhr) rh myrwd.

bry w (= nsn) frshtgny st khh py drpy (SbH w shm) z pysh rwysh w z psht srsh w r bh mr llh HfZ mykhnnd, bygmn llh Hlt (w srnwsht) hych qwmy r tGyr nmydhd, t wqty khh ann anchh r khh dr Dmyrshn st, tGyr dhnd. w hngmykhh llh bry qwmy (bkhTr `mlshn) bdy r rdh khnd, ps hych chyz mn` an nkhwhd shd, w ann r jz w hych khrszy nyst.
w khsy st khh brq r bry trsndn, w mydwr shdn bh shm mynmynd, w brhy sngyn (br) r pdyd myawrd.

w r`d bh stysh w w frshtgn z trs w tsbyH mygwynd. w S`qhh r myfrstd, ps hr khs r khh bkhwhd bdn asyb myrsnd, w anh (b wjwd mshhdh yn hmh ayt lhy hmchnn) drbrhy llh mjdlh mykhnnd, w w bsyr nyrwmnd (w skhtgyr) st.

d`wt Hq z an wst, w khsny r khh (mshrkhn) bh jy w mykhwnnd, (hrgz) d`wtshn r jbt nmykhnnd, mgr mnnd khsykhh khf dstsh r bh swy ab mygshyd t (ab) bh dhnsh brsd, w (hrgz) bh an nkhwhd rsyd, w d`y khfrn jz dr gmrhy nyst.
(tmm) khsnykhh dr asmnh w zmyn hstnd - z rwy T`t (w dl khwh) y khrh (w n khwh) - w (hmchnyn) syhhyshn; SbHghnh w shmghn bry llh sjdh mykhnnd.

(y pymbr! bh mshrkhn) bgw: <<prwrdgr asmnh w zmyn khyst?>> bgw: <<llh>> (sps bh anh) bgw: <<ay bh jy w wly (w m`bwdny) br gzydhyd khh mlkh swd w zyn khwd nystnd>>. bgw: <<ay nbyn w byn brbrnd, y trykhyh w nwr ykhsn st? ay anh shrykhny bry llh qrr ddhnd khh hmchwn afrynsh w afrydhnd, ps (yn) afrynsh (h) br anh mshbh shdh st?!>>. bgw: <<llh afrynndhy hmh chyz st, w w ygnhy chyrh st.

(llh) z asmnh ab r frw frstd, ps rwdkhnhh bhndzhy (Zrfyt) khwysh rwn shd, angh syl br rwy khwd khfy bl amdh brdsht, w zanchh (dr khwrhh) bry bdst awrdn zynt alt y wsyl zndgy atsh rwy an rwshn mykhnnd, khfy mnnd an bh wjwd myayd, llh (mthl) Hq w bTl r yn gwnh byn mykhnd, ps m khfh khnr ftdh, z byn myrwd, w anchh bh mrdm swd mybkhshd dr zmyn (bqy) mymnd, yn gwnh llh (bry rwshn shdn Hq z bTl) mthl myznd.

bry khsnykhh (d`wt) prwrdgrshn r jbt khrdnd, pdsh nykh (= bhsht) st w khsnykhh (d`wt) w r jbt nkhrdnd, gr tmm anchh dr zmyn st w (nyz) hmnndsh, z an anh bshd bry rhyy khwd (z `dhb) fdyh bdhnd, (z anh pdhyrfth nkhwhd shd) anh Hsb skhty khwhnd dsht, w jyghshn jhnm st, w chh bd jyghy st!.
ay khsykhh mydnd anchh z (Trf) prwrdgrt br tw nzl shdh Hq st, mnnd khsy st khh w nbynst?! tnh khrdmndn pnd mygyrnd.
(hmn) khsnykhh bh pymn llh wf mykhnnd, w `hd (w pymn) r nmyshkhnnd.
w khsnykhh anchh r llh bh pywstn an frmn ddh; pywnd mydhnd, w z prwrdgrshn mytrsnd, w z skhty Hsb bym drnd.
w khsnykhh bh Tlb rwy prwrdgrshn Sbr khrdnd, w nmz r br p dshtnd w z anchh bh anh rwzy ddhym, pnhn w ashkhr nfq khrdnd, w bdy r b nykhy df` mykhnnd, frjm (nykh) sry akhrt z an anhst.
(hmn) bGhy jwydn (bhshty) khh wrd an myshwnd, w (hmchnyn) hr khs z pdrnshn w hmsrnshn w frzndnshn khh nykhw khr bwdhnd, w frshtgn z hr dry br ann wrd myshwnd.
(w bh anh mygwynd:) <<slm br shm bh (khTr) anchh Sbr nmwdhyd, ps chh khwb st `qbt an sry (jwydn)>>.
w khsnykhh pymn llh r ps z stwr khrdnsh myshkhnnd, w anchh r khh llh bh pywstn an frmn ddh; qT` mykhnnd, w dr zmyn fsd mynmynd, l`nt bry anhst, w bry anh skhty (w bdy) an sry (akhrt) st.
llh rwzy r bry hrkhsykhh bkhwhd wsy` mygrdnd, w (bry hr khs khh bkhwhd) tng mydrd, w (khfrn) bh zndgy dny shd shdnd, dr Hlykhh zndgy dny dr (brbr) akhrt jz mt`y (nchyz) nyst.

w khsnykhh khfr shdnd mygwynd: <<chr nshnh (w m`jzhy) z (swy) prwrdgrsh br w nzl nshdh st?!>>. (y pymbr!) bgw: <<bygmn llh hrkhs r bkhwhd gmrh mykhnd, w hr khs khh bz grdd (w twbh khnd) bh swy khwysh hdyt mykhnd>>.
(hmn) khsnykhh ymn awrdnd, w dlhy shn bh yd llh arm mygyrd, agh bshyd! (tnh) b yd llh dlh arm mygyrnd.
w khsnykhh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd, bryshn khwshy st, w bzgshtgh nykhw (drnd).

(y pymbr!) yn gwnh tw r dr (myn) mty frstdym khh pysh z anh mthy (dygr, bwdnd w) rftnd, t anchh r bh tw wHy khrdym br anh bkhwny, dr Hlykhh anh bh (llh) rHmn khfr mywrznd. bgw: <<w prwrdgr mn st, m`bwdy (bh Hq) jz w nyst, br w twkhl khrdm, w bzgshtm bh swy wst>>.

gr (chnyn) qrany bwd khh khwhh bh an bh Hrkht aynd y zmyn bh an prh prh shwd y mrdgn r bh skhn ard, (bz hm ymn nmyawrnd) blkhh hmh mwr z an llh st, ay khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd (hnwz) ndnsthnd khh gr llh mykhwst; qT`an hmhy mrdm r hdyt mykhrd?!w pywsth bh khsnykhh khfr wrzydnd bh szy khrhykhh khrdhnd mSybt khwbndhy myrsd y an mSybt bh nzdykh khnhy ann frw myayd t angh w`dhy lhy fr rsd, yqyn llh mt`l w`dhy khh ddh khlf nmykhnd
w bh rsty bh pymbrny pysh z tw (nyz) tmskhr (w sthz) khrdh shd, ps (mn) bh khsnykhh khfr wrzydnd mhlt ddm; angh ann r (frw) grftm, ps (bngr) mjzt mn chgwnh bwd?!

ay khsy khh br hmh nfws (jhnyn) b anchh bh dst awrdhnd mrqb (w nghbn) st (szwr prstsh st y mkhlwqt `jz w ntwn w z hmh j b~khbr)?! w bry llh shrykhny qrr ddnd, (y pymbr!) bgw: <<anh r nm bbryd! ay w r bh chyzykhh dr zmyn nmydnd, agh mykhnyd?! y skhn byhwdh (w bymHtw) mygwyyd?!>> blkhh (Hq yn st khh) bry khsnykhh khfr shdnd; mkhrshn arsth shdh st, w z rh (rst) bz dshth shdhnd, w khsy r khh llh gmrh khnd, ps hych rhnmyy bry w wjwd nkhwhd dsht.
dr zndgy dny bry anh `dhb (drdnkhy) st w qT`an `dhb akhrt skhttr st, w anh r hych ngh drndhy z (`dhb) llh nyst.

wSf bhshty khh bh prhyzgrn w`dh ddh shdh st, (chnyn st khh:) nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, mywhhysh hmyshgy, w (nyz) syhsh (dy'my st), yn st srnjm khsnykhh prhyzgry khrdnd, w srnjm khfrn atsh (jhnm) st.

w khsnykhh bh anh khtb (asmny) ddym, z anchh br tw nzl shdh, khwshHl myshwnd, w z Hzb (w grwhh) khsny hstnd khh qsmty z an r nkhr mykhnnd, (y pymbr!) bgw: <<mn m'mwrm khh <<llh>> r bprstm, w bh w shrkh nywrm, w tnh bh swy w d`wt mykhnm, w bzgsht mn bh swy wst>>.
w yn gwnh yn (qran) r (bh `nwn) Hkhm (w frmny bh zbn) `rby nzl khrdym, w gr b`d z an khh aghy bry twamdh, z hwshy anh pyrwy khny, dr brbr (`dhb) llh hych khrsz w nghdrndhy nkhwhy dsht.
w bh rsty pysh z tw pymbrny frstdym w bry anh hmsrn w frzndny qrr ddym, w hych pymbry Hq ndsht, khh jz bh frmn llh m`jzhy bywrd, bry hr (mr w) zmny, nwshthy mqrr st.
llh hrchh r khh bkhwhd mHw w (hrchh r bkhwhd) thbt mykhnd w m lkhtb (= lwH mHfwZ) nzd wst.
w gr brkhy z anchh r khh bh anh w`dh mydhym bh tw nshn dhym, y (bysh z fr rsydn anh) tw r bmyrnym, dr hr Hl br (`hdhy) tw tnh tblyG (rslt) st, w Hsb (anh) br mst.

ay ndydhnd khh m pywsth bh srG (yn sr) zmyn (khfr) myayym, khh an r z Trf (w dmnhhysh) mykhhym?! (w bh srzmyn slm myfzyym?) w llh Hkhm mykhnd, w hych khs nmytwnd Hkhm w r rd khnd, w w sry` lHsb (= zwd shmr) st.

w bh rsty khsnykhh pysh z anh bwdnd mkhr wrzydnd (w nqshh khshydnd) ps (byd dnst khh) tmm mkhrh (w nqshhh) z ani llh st, mydnd anchh r khh hr khs njm mydhd, w bh zwdy khfrn khwhnd dnst khh sr njm (nykh) sry (akhrt) z ani khyst.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd mygwynd: <<tw pymbr (llh) nysty>> bgw: <<khfy st khh llh w khsykhh `lm (pyshyn) nzd wst, myn mn w shm gwh bshnd>>.
lr (lf. lm. r) yn (qran) khtby st khh brtw (y pymbr) nzl khrdym, t mrdm r bh frmn prwrdgrshn z trykhyh(y shrkh w jhlt) bh swy rwshnyy (ymn w dnsh) dr awry, bh swy rh (llh) pyrwzmnd stwdh.
(hmn) llh khh anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn st, z an wst, w wy br khfrn z `dhb skht.
(hmn) khsnykhh zndgy dny r br akhrt trjyH mydhnd, w (mrdm r) z rh llh bz mydrnd, w khjy (w nHrf) an rh r mykhwhnd, ynn dr gmrhy dwry hstnd.
m hych pymbry r, mgr bh zbn qwmsh, nfrstdym; t (Hqyq r) bry anh byn khnd, ps llh hr khs r bkhwhd gmrh myszd w hr khs r bkhwhd hdyt mykhnd, w w pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.

w bh rsty m mwsy r b nshnhhy khwd frstdym, (w bh w dstwr ddym) khh: qwmt r z trykhyh bh rwshnyy byrwn ar, w ym llh (= rwzhy pyrwzy Hq br bTl) r bh ydshn awr, bygmn dr yn (mr) bry hr Sbrkhnndhy shkhrgzry nshnhhyy st.

w (y pymbr! bh yd awr) hngmykhh mwsy bh qwmsh gft: <<n`mt llh r br khwd byd awryd, chwn shm r z (chngl) fr`wnyn njt dd, khh bh bdtryn `dhbh shm r `dhb mykhrdnd, psrntn r sr mybrydnd, w znntn r (bry khdmtkhry) zndh mygdhshtnd, w dr yn (mr) z jnb prwrdgrtn bry shm azmysh bzrg bwd>>.
w (w bh yd awryd) hngmy r khh prwrdgrtn `lm khrd khh: <<gr shkhr gzry khnyd, yqynan (n`mt khwd r) bh shm fzwn mydhm, w gr khfrn khnyd, bygmn `dhb mn skht st>>.
w mwsy bh (anh) gft: <<gr shm w hmhy mrdm rwy zmyn khfr shwyd, ps (bh llh hych zyny nmyrsd) bygmn llh bynyz stwdh st>>.

ay khbr khsnykhh pysh z shm bwdnd, (mnnd) qwm nwH w `d w thmwd, bh shm nrsydh st?! w (khbr) khsnykhh ps z yshn bwdnd, khh jz llh ann r nmyshnsd?! pymbrn shn b dlyl (w m`jzt) rwshn bh swy anh amdnd, ps anh dstnshn dr dhnhyshn grftnd, w gftnd: <<m bh anchh shm frstdh shdhyd, khfrym, w m nsbt bh anchh m r bh swy an fr mykhwnyd, skht dr shkh w trdyd hstym>>.

pymbrn shn gftnd: <<ay dr (w jwd) llh afryndh asmnh w zmyn shkh st? (w) shm r fr mykhwnd t gnhntn r brytn bymrzd, w shm r t mdt m`yny mhlt dhd>>. (anh) gftnd: <<shm jz bshry hmnnd m nystyd, mykhwhyd m r z anchh khh nykhnmn myprstydnd bz dryd, ps m`jzh (w dlyl) ashkhry bry m bywryd>>.

pymbrn shn gftnd: <<m jz bshry hmnnd shm nystym, w lykhn llh br hr khs z bndgnsh khh bkhwhd mnWt mygdhrd (w bh pymbry brmygzynd) w m (hrgz) nmytwnym (w Hq ndrym) khh m`jzhy jz bh frmn llh brytn bywrym. w mw'mnn byd br llh twkhl khnnd.

w m r chh shdh st khh br llh twkhl nkhnym, dr Hlykhh m r bh rhhy (s`dt bkhsh) mn hdyt frmwdh st?! w mslman m br azrhy khh bh m myrsnyd Sbr khwhym khrd, (w rslt khwd r khwhym rsnd) w twkhlkhnndgn byd tnh br llh twkhl khnnd>>.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd bh pymbrn shn gftnd: <<m qT`an shm r z srzmyn khwd byrwn khwhym khrd, y ynkhh bh ayyn m bz grdyd>>. ps prwrdgrshn bh anh wHy frstd khh: <<yqynan stmgrn r nbwd khwhym khrd,
w shm r b`d z anh dr zmyn skhwnt khwhym dd, yn (w`dh) bry khsy st khh z wqwf dr pyshgh mn btrsd, w z w`yd (`dhb) mn bymnkh bshd>>.
w (pymbrn z khd) Tlb ftH w pyrwzy (br khfr) khrdnd, w (srnjm) hr grdnkhsh w styzh jwy nkhm (w nbwd) shd.
psht srsh jhnm st, w z ab chrkh w khwn (bd bw) nwshndh shwd.
khh jr`h jr`h an r mynwshd, w nmytwnd an r (bh asny) frw brd (w gwrysh nyst) w mrg z hr sw bh srG w myayd, dr Hlykhh w nkhwhd mrd, w `dhb skhty dr pysh rw drd.
wSf khsnykhh bh prwrdgrshn khfr shdnd, `mlshn hmchwn khkhstr st khh tnd bdy dr ykh rwz Twfny skht bran wzydh bshd, twn ngh dshtn anchh r khh bh dst awrdhnd; ndrnd, w yn hmn gmrhy dwr (w drz) st.
(y nsn) ay ndydy khh llh asmnh w zmyn r bh Hq afrydh st?! gr bkhwhd shm r mybrd w khlq jdydy (bh jy shm pdyd) myawrd.
w yn (khr) br llh dshwr nyst.

w (dr rwz qymt) hmgy dr pyshgh llh HDr (w ashkhr) shwnd, ps (dr yn hngm) D`yfn bh mstkhbrn mygwynd: <<hmn m pyrw shm bwdym, ps ay mytwnyd chyzy z `dhb llh r z m df` khnyd?>>. (anh) gwynd: <<gr llh m r hdyt khrdh bwd, m (nyz) shm r hdyt mykhrdym, chh bytby khnym w chh Sbr nmyym, bry m ykhsn st, (hych) gryzghy bry m nyst>>.

w chwn (dwry w) khr tmm shwd, shyTn gwyd: <<bygmn llh bh shm w`dhy Hq (w rstyn) dd, w mn bh shm w`dh ddm, angh khlf w`dh khrdm, mn br shm hych tslTy ndshtm, jz ynkhh d`wttn khrdm, w shm (d`wt) mr pdhyrftyd, ps mr srznsh nkhnyd, w (blkhh) khwysh r srznsh khnyd, nh mn fryd rs shm hstm, w nh shm fryd rs mn, hmn mn z ynkhh mr pysh z yn shrykh (llh) skhtyd, byzrm>> bygmn bry stmkhrn `dhb drdnkhy st.

w khsnykhh shrkh wrzydnd gftnd: <<gr llh mykhwst, nh m w nh pdrnmn, Gyr z w hych chyzy r prstsh nmykhrdym, w nh chyzy r bdwn frmn w Hrm myskhtym>> khsnykhh pysh z anh bwdnd (nyz) chnyn khrdnd, ps ay br pymbrn jz blG ashkhr (msy'wlyt dygry) hst?

yqynan m dr (myn) hr mt pymbry r frstdym khh: <<llh ykht r bprstyd, w z TGwt jtnb khnyd>>. ps llh b`Dy z ann r hdyt khrd w br b`Dy z ann gmrhy mHqq gsht, ps dr zmyn bgrdyd, angh bngryd `qbt tkhdhybkhnndgn chgwnh bwd.
(y pymbr!) hr ndzh br hdyt anh HryS bshy (swdy ndrd, zyr khh) llh khsy r khh gmrh khrdh st, hdyt nmykhnd, w anh ywrny ndrnd.
w anh b shdydtryn swgndhyshn bh llh swgnd yd khrdnd khh: <<llh khsy r khh mymyrd, br nmyngyzd!>> ary (yn) w`dhy qT`y br wst (khh hmhy mrdgn r br myngyzd) wly byshtr mrdm nmydnnd.
t anchh r khh dran khtlf mykhrdnd bryshn rwshn szd, w t khsnykhh khfr shdnd, bdnnd khh anh drwGgw bwdhnd.
frmn m bh hr chyzkhh chwn rdhsh khnym, fqT yn st khh bh w gwyym: <<mwjwd bsh>> ps (bl fSlh) mwjwd myshwd.
w khsnykhh ps z an khh stm dydnd, dr rh llh hjrt khrdnd, yqynan dr yn dny jygh khwby khwhym dd, w mslman pdsh akhrt bzrgtr st, y khsh mydnstnd.
(hmn) khsnykhh Sbr khrdnd, w (tnh) br prwrdgrshn twkhl mykhnnd.
w pysh z tw (y pymbr) jz mrdny khh bh anh wHy mykhrdym nfrstdym, ps (y mrdm) gr nmydnyd z (aghni) hl khtb bprsyd.
(khh anh r) b dlyl rwshn w khtbh (frstdym) w (m yn) qran r br tw nzl khrdym t bry mrdm rwshn szy, anchh r khh bh swy anh nzl shdh st, w bshd khh anh byndyshnd.
ay khsnykhh bd ndyshy (w twTy'h) khrdnd, (z yn) ymn hstnd khh llh (hmhy) anh r dr zmyn frw brd, w y `dhb (lhy) z jyy khh nmydnnd, bh srGshn byyd?!
y (an khh) bh hngm rft w amdshn (grybn) anh r bgyrd, ps ntwnnd khh (m r ntwn khnnd w) bgryznd.
y (an khh) ann r dr Hl trs (w wHsht) bgyrd, ps bytrdyd prwrdgr shm rw'wf mhrbn st.
ay anh bh chyzhy khh llh afrydh st nmyngrnd khh (chgwnh) syhhysh z rst w chp sjdhkhnn bry llh dr Hrkhtnd, w anh (`jz w) frwtn hstnd?!
w anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn z jnbndhgn wjwd drd, w (nyz) frshtgn; bry llh sjdh mykhnnd, w ann tkhbr nmywrznd.
anh z prwrdgrshn khh br frzshn st, mytrsnd, w anchh frmn myybnd, njm dhnd.
w llh frmwd: <<dw m`bwd r ngyryd, fqT w m`bwd ygnh st, ps (tnh) z mn btrsyd>>.
w anchh dr asmnh w zmyn st z ani wst, w (nyz) dyn (w prstsh) bdy z ani wst, ay z Gyr llh mytrsyd?!
anchh z n`mt dryd, ps (hmh) z (jnb) llh st, sps hngmykhh nrHty bh shm rsd, bz bh swy w zry mykhnyd.
sps hngmykhh an nrHty r z shm br Trf skht, angh grwhy z shm bh prwrdgrshn shrkh myawrnd.
t anchh r khh bh anh ddhym khfrn khnnd, ps (chnd rwzy) bhrh gyryd, khh bzwdy khwhyd dnst.
w anh bry chyzy (=btny) khh nmydnnd, shmy z anchh rwzyshn ddhym qrr mydhnd, bh llh swgnd, lbth z anchh ftr mybndyd, bzkhwst khwhyd shd.
w (anh) bry llh dkhtrn qrr mydhnd, - w mnzh st- w bry khwdshn anchh r myl drnd (qrr mydhnd).
w hrgh bh ykhy z anh bh (twld) dkhtr bshrt dhnd, chhrhsh syh myshwd dr Hlykhh w khshm khwd r frw mykhwrd.
w bh sbb bshrti bdy khh bh w ddh shdh, z qwm (khwd) pnhn myshwd (myndyshd khh) ay b khwry w r ngh drd y dr khkh pnhnsh khnd?! agh bshyd anchh r khh Hkhm mykhnnd, bd (Hkhmy) st.
bry khsnykhh bh (sry) akhrt ymn ndrnd, mthl (w Sft) bd st. w bry llh Sft brtr (w `ly) st, w w pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.

w gr llh mrdm r bh (khTr) stmshn mw'khdhh mykhrd, hych jnbndhy br rwy an (=zmyn) bqy nmygdhrd, w lykhn anh r t zmn m`yn mhlt mydhd, ps hngmykhh jlshn fr rsd, nh s`ty t'khyr mykhnnd w nh s`ty pyshy mygyrnd.
w (anh) bry llh chyzhyy qrr mydhnd khh khwdshn (z an) khrht drnd, w zbnhyshn (skhn) drwG byn mykhnd khh nykhyh z ani yshn st, bytrdyd bry ann atsh (jhnm) st, w qT`an anh z pyshgmn (jhnm) hstnd.
(y pymbr!) bh llh swgnd khh bh swy mthy pysh z tw (pymbrny) frstdym, ps shyTn `mlshn r bry anh byrst, ldh mrwz w dwst (w ywr) shn st, w `dhb drdnkhy bry anhst.
w (y pymbr! m) khtb (qran) r br tw nzl nkhrdym; mgr bry ynkhh anchh r khh dr an khtlf khrdnd, bry anh rwshn szy, w (nyz) myhy hdyt w rHmt bry grwhy khh ymn myawrnd; bshd.
w llh z asmn aby frw frstd, ps b an zmyn r b`d z mrdnsh zndh grdnd. bygmn dr yn, nshnhy st bry grwhy khh myshnwnd.
w hmn dr (wjwd) chhr pyn bry shm `brty st, z anchh dr shkhm anh, z myn srgyn w khwn, shyr khlS khh bry nwshndgn gwr st, bh shm mynwshnym.
w (nyz) z mywhhy drkhtn khrm w ngwr, mskhrt (n pkh) w rwzy khwb (w pkhyzh) mygyryd. bygmn dr yn nshnhy st bry grwhy khh khrd mywrznd.
w prwrdgr tw bh znbwr `sl lhm khrd khh: <<z khwhh w drkhtn w drbsthyy khh (mrdm) mysznd, khnhhyy brgzyn,
angh z (shyrhy) tmm mywhh (w glh) bkhwr, sps rhhy hmwr prwrdgrt r bpym>> z shkhm anh, nwshydny b rnghy gwngwn byrwn myayd khh dr an shf bry mrdm st. byshkh dr yn nshnhy st bry grwhy khh myndyshnd.
w llh shm r afryd, sps mymyrnd, w b`Dy z shm r bh pyry w (frtwty) myrsnd, t b`d z `lm (w aghy) chyzy ndnd (w hmh r frmwsh khnd) bygmn llh dny twnst.
w llh brkhy z shm r br brkhy (dygr) dr rwzy brtry ddh st, ps khsnykhh brtry ddh shdhnd, HDr nystnd z rwzy khwd bh brdgnshn bdhnd, t hmgy dr an brbr shwnd, ay anh n`mt llh r nkhr mykhnd?!
w llh bry shm z (jns) khwdtn hmsrny qrr dd, w z hmsrntn bry shm frzndn w nwdgn pdyd awrd, w z pkhyzhh bh shm rwzy dd, ay bh bTl ymn myawrnd, w bh n`mt llh anh khfr mywrznd?!
w anh Gyr z llh, chyzy r myprstnd khh hych rwzy r bry anh z asmnh w zmyn dr khtyr ndrnd, w (hrgz) nmytwnnd.
ps bry llh mthlh mznyd, yqynan llh mydnd, w shm nmydnyd.

llh mthly zdh: brdhy mmlwkhy r khh br hych chyz twn nyst, w khsy r khh z jnb khwd, rwzy nykhw bkhshydhym, ps w pnhn w ashkhr z an (rwzy) nfq mykhnd, ay (yn dw nfr) brbrnd?! [ mTlb yn st khh b yn khh brdh w shkhS azd hrdw nsnnd w mkhlwq mybshnd w nyz dr bsyry z chyzh b hm mshtrkhnd, wly bz hm z lHZ drjh w mnzlt ykhsn shmrdh nshdhnd. ps chgwnh myshwd bth r b llh mt`l ykhsn qrr dd?] stysh mkhSwS llh st, blkhh byshtrshn nmydnnd.

w llh mthl (dygry) zdh st: dw mrd r, khh ykhy z an dw, gng st, w br hych chyzy twn nyst, sr br SHb (w mwly) khwd st, hr khj w r bfrstd, hych khyry r nmyawrd. (w m'mwrytsh r khwb njm nmydhd). ay w w khsykhh bh `dl frmn mydhd, w khwd br rh mstqym qrr drd, brbr st?!
(`lm) Gyb asmnh w zmyn z an llh st (w tnh w hmh r mydnd) w mr qymt mnnd chshm brhmzdn w y z an hm nzdykhtr st, bygmn llh br hmh chyz twnst.
w llh shm r z shkhm mdrntn byrwn awrd, dr Hlykhh hych chyz nmydnstyd, w bry shm gwsh w dydgn w dlh pdyd awrd, shyd sps gzryd.
ay anh bh prndgny khh drjwW asmn mskhr (frmn llh) hstnd, nmyngrnd, mslman dr yn (mr) nshnhhyy st bry grwhy khh ymn myawrnd.

w llh bry shm z khnhhytn jy armsh (w skhwnt) qrr dd, w z pwst chhr pyn (nyz) bry shm khnhhyy (= khymhhyy) qrr dd khh anr dr rwz khwch khrdntn w rwz qmttn sbkh myybyd (w bh asny anr j bj mykhnyd) w z pshmhysh w khrkhhysh w mwhysh ththyh (khnh) w mt` (w sbb w wsyl zndgy) t mdt m`yny (brytn) qrr dd.

w (nyz) llh z anchh afrydh st syhhyy bry shm qrr ddh, w z khwhh pnhghhyy bry shm qrr ddh st, w bry shm jmhhyy bry shm qrr dd khh shm r z z grm (w srm) HfZ mykhnd, w jmhhyy khh shm r dr (hngm) jng (w drgyry) mSwn mydrd. yn gwnh (llh) n`mthysh r br shm tmm mykhnd, bshd khh tslym (frmn w) shwyd.
ps (y pymbr!) gr (anh) rwy grdndnd; jz yn nyst khh br (`hdhy) tw blG ashkhr st.
(anh) n`mt llh r myshnsnd, sps nkhrsh mykhnnd, w byshtrshn khfrnd.
w rwzykhh z hr mty gwhy (br ann) br myngyzym, angh bh khsnykhh khfr shdnd, jzhy (skhn gftn) ddh nmyshwd, w nh z anh tqDy twbh (w `dhrkhwhy) myshwd.
w khsnykhh stm khrdnd, hngmykhh `dhb r bbynnd, ps nh z (`dhb) anh khsth myshwd, w nh anh mhlt myybnd.

w khsnykhh shrkh wrzydnd hngmykhh shrykhn (= m`bwdhyy khwd skhthy) khwd r bbynnd, mygwynd: <<prwrdgr! ynn shrykhn (w m`bwdn) m hstnd, khsnykhh m bh jy tw mykhwndym>>. angh (m`bwdnshn) bh anh pskh mydhnd: <<bh rsty khh shm drwGgw hstyd>>
w dr an rwz (hmgy) dr pyshgh llh tslym shwnd, w (tmm) anchh r ftr mybstnd, z (nZr) ann gm (w nbwd) shwnd.
khsnykhh khfr shdnd w (mrdm r) z rh llh bz dshtnd, bh (khyfr) ankhh fsd mykhrdnd, `dhby br `dhbshn khwhym fzwd.
w rwzykhh dr (myn) hr mty, gwhy z khwdshn br anh br myngyzym, w tw r br anh gwh awrym. w (m yn) khtb r br tw nzl khrdym, khh byngr hmh chyz, w hdyt w rHmt w bshrt bry mslmnn st.

bh rsty llh bh `dl w Hsn w bkhshsh bh nzdykhn frmn mydhd [ nzdykhn drjty drnd khh bh trtyb: nkhst pdr w mdr, sps frzndn, sps brdr w khwhr, sps `mw w `mh sps dyy w khlh sps nzdykhn dygr.], w z fHsh w mnkhr w stm nhy mykhnd, w shm r pnd mydhd; shyd mtdhkhr shwyd.
w bh `hd (w pymn) llh wf khnyd, hrgh `hd (w pymn) bstyd, w swgndh r ps z mHkhm skhtnsh nshkhnyd, drHlykhh shm llh r khfyl (w Dmn) br khwd qrr ddhyd, yqynan llh anchh r mykhnyd; mydnd.

w mnnd an zn nbshyd khh pshmhy tbydhy khwd r ps z mHkhm shdn w mytbd. (w qT`h qT`h mykhnd), khh swgndhy khwd r wsylhy (khynt w) fryb szyd, bh khTr ynkhh grwhy z grwh (dygr) byshtr st. jz yn nyst khh llh shm r b yn wsylh azmysh mykhnd, yqynan rwz qymt, anchh r dran khtlf mykhrdyd, bry shm rwshn khwhd khrd.
w gr llh mykhwst hmhy shm r ykh mt qrr mydd, w lykhn hr khs r bkhwhd; gmrh mykhnd, w hr khs r bkhwhd; hdyt mynmyd, w qT`an z anchh mykhrdyd, bzkhwst khwhyd shd.

w swgndhytn r wsylhy (khynt w) fryb dr myn khwd qrr ndhyd, khh (mbd) gmy b`d z stwrysh (br ymn) mtzlzl shwd, w bh khTr bz dshtn (mrdm) z rh llh, bdy an r (dr dny) bchshyd, w (dr akhrt) bry shm `dhb bzrgy khwhd bwd.
w pymn (w `hd) llh r bh bhy ndkh nfrwshyd, gr bdnyd! anchh nzd llh st, yqynan bry shm bhtr st.
anchh nzd shmst, fn myshwd, w anchh nzd llh st bqy st, w qT`an bh khsnykhh Sbr khrdnd, pdshshn r bh (Hsb) bhtryn `mly khh njm myddnd; mydhym.
hr khsykhh khr shysthy njm dhd, (khwh) mrd bshd y zn, dr Hlykhh mw'mn st, w r bh Hyty pkh zndh mydrym, w mslman pdshshn r bh (Hsb) bhtryn `mly khh njm myddnd; bh anh mydhym.
ps hngmykhh qran mykhwny, z (shr) shyTn rndh shdh, bh llh pnh bbr.
bygmn w br khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd w br prwrdgrshn twkhl mykhnnd, (hych) tslTy ndrd.
tslT w tnh br khsny st khh w r bh dwsty (w srprsty) khwd brgzydhnd, w khsnykhh (bh pyrwy z wy) bh w (= llh) shrkh mywrznd.
w hngmykhh ayhy r bh jy ayhy dygr jygzyn (= nskh) khnym - w llh bh anchh khh nzl mykhnd, dntr st - (anh) gwynd: <<bygmn tw ftr zny>> (hrgz chnyn nyst) blkhh byshtr anh nmydnnd.
bgw: <<rwH lqds (= jbry'yl) an r z jnb prwrdgrt bh Hq nzl khrdh st, t khsny r khh ymn awrdhnd, thbt qdm grdnd, w bry (`mwm) mslmnn hdyt w bshrt bshd>>.
w bh rsty (m) mydnym khh anh mygwynd: <<hmn bshry (yn ayt r) bh w amwzsh mydhd>> dr Hlykhh zbn khsykhh ynh bh w nsbt mydhnd `jmy (= Gyr `rby) st, w yn (qran bh) zbn `rby ashkhr st.
yqynan khsnykhh bh ayt llh ymn nmyawrnd, llh anh r hdyt nmykhnd, w bry anh `dhb drdnkhy st.
tnh khsny drwG mybndnd khh bh ayt llh ymn ndrnd, w yshnnd khh drwGgwyn (wq`y) hstnd.

khsykhh b`d z ymnsh bh llh khfr shwd (bz khwst myshwd) mgr khsykhh bh zwr (bh khfr) w dshth shwd dr Hlykhh qlbsh bh ymn arm bshd [ hl `lm br yn jm` khrdhnd khh gr shkhSy bh khfr awrdn mjbwr shwd, w w bry njt jn khwysh mrtkhb bh khfr qwly w f`ly grdd wly qlban ymn dshth bshd, khfr nkhwhd bwd.], lykhn khsykhh synhy khwd r bry (pdhyrsh) khfr bgshyd, ps khshm llh branhst, w bry anh `dhb bzrgy st.
yn bh (khTr) an st khh zndgy dny r br akhrt trjyH ddnd, w hmn llh grwh khfrn (ljwj) r hdyt nmykhnd.
ynn khsny hstnd khh (br thr gnhn shn) llh br dlhy shn w gwshshn w chshmnshn mhr nhdh st, w ynn Gfln (wq`y) hstnd.
bdwn shkh anh dr akhrt zynkhrnnd.
angh prwrdgr tw bry khsnykhh hjrt khrdnd, b`d z an khh shkhnjh (w `dhb) khshydnd (t skhn khfr bgwynd) sps (dr rh llh) jhd khrdnd, w Sbr nmwdnd, bygmn prwrdgrt b`d z yn (rnjh) amrzndhy mhrbn st.
(bh yd awryd rwz qymt, an) rwzykhh hrkhs (bh df`) z khwd bh mjdlh br mykhyzd, w bh hr khsy (pdsh) anchh khrdh st; bh Twr khml (w tmm) ddh myshwd, w bh anh stm nkhwhd shd.

w llh mthly zdh st: qryhy khh ymn w aswdh bwd, hmwrh rwzysh bh frwny z hrj myrsyd, ps (hlsh) bh n`mthy llh nspsy khrdnd, angh llh bh (khyfr) anchh khh njm myddnd; lbs grsngy w trs (w n mny) r br anh pwshnyd (w T`msh r chshnyd).
w bh rsty pymbry z khwdshn bh swy anh amd, ps w r tkhdhyb khrdnd, angh dr Hlykhh Zlm bwdnd, `dhb (lhy) anh r frw grft.
ps z anchh khh llh bh shm rwzy ddh st; Hll (w) pkhyzh bkhwryd, w shkhr w n`mt llh r bjy myawryd, gr w r myprstyd.

(llh) tnh mrdr, w khwn w gwsht khwkh w anchh r khh (hngm dhbH) nm Gyr llh bran brdh shdh st; br shm Hrm khrdh st, ps khsykhh nchr shwd dr Hlykhh nh stmkhr bshd w nh z Hd tjwz khnd (w z anh bkhwrd) ps bygmn llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
w chyzy r khh zbntn bh drwG twSyf mykhnd; ngwyyd: <<yn Hll st, w an Hrm>> t br llh ftr bbndyd, yqynan khsnykhh br llh ftr mybndnd; rstgr nmyshwnd.
(dr yn dny) bhrhy ndkh (nSybshn myshwd) w bry anh (dr akhrt) `dhb drdnkh st.
w brkhsnykhh yhwdy shdnd; Hrm khrdh bwdym, chyzhy r khh pysh z yn br tw Hkhyt khrdym, w (m) bh anh stm nkhrdym, w lykhn anh bh khwdshn stm khrdnd.
sps prwrdgr tw bry khsnykhh z rwy jhlt bdy khrdnd, angh b`d z an twbh khrdnd, w (`ml khwd r) SlH khrdnd, yqynan prwrdgrt b`d z ankhh (twbh, bry anh) amrzndhy mhrbn st.
bh rsty brhym (bh tnhyy) mty bwd, frmnbrdr llh, Hnyf (= khly z nHrf) bwd w (hrgz) z mshrkhn nbwd [ bh swrhy al `mrn ayh 67 rjw` frmyyd.].
shkhrgzr n`mthy llh bwd, (llh) w r brgzyd, w bh rh rst hdytsh nmwd.
(m) dr dny bh w nykhy `T khrdym; w qT`an w dr akhrt z SlHn st.
sps bh tw (y pymbr!) wHy khrdym khh z ayyn brhym khh Hnyf bwd w z mshrkhn nbwd; pyrwy khn.
(r`yt t`Zym rwz) shnbh tnh br khsnykhh dr an khtlf khrdnd (b`nwn mjzt) mqrr shd, w bygmn prwrdgrt rwz qymt dr anchh khtlf mykhrdnd; myn anh dwry mykhnd.

b Hkhmt w pnd nykhw (mrdm r) bh rh prwrdgrt d`wt nm, w b rwshy khh nykhwtr st, b anh (bHth w) mnZrh khn, bytrdyd prwrdgrt bh (Hl) khsykhh z rh w gmrh shdh st; dntr st, w (nyz) w bh hdytyftgn; dntr st.
w gr khwstyd mjzt khnyd, ps chnn mjzt khnyd khh shm r mjzt khrdhnd, w gr Sbr nmyyd, mslman an bry Sbrn bhtr st.
w (y pymbr grmy) Sbr khn w Sbr tw jz bh (twfyq) llh nyst, w br anh ndwhgyn mshw, w z anchh mkhr mywrznd; dltng mbsh.
hmn llh b khsny st khh tqw pyshh khrdnd, w khsnykhh nykhwkhrnnd.
pkh w mnzh st khsykhh bndhsh r shby z msjd lHrm bh msjd l'qSy - khh grdgrdsh r brkht ddhym brd; t brkhy z ayt khwd r bh w bnmynym, bygmn wst khh shnwy bynst.
w (m) bh mwsy khtb (twrt) ddym, w an r (myhy) hdyt bry bny sry'yl grdndym, (w frmwdym:) khh jz mn khrszy br mgzynyd.
y frzndn khsnykhh b nwH (br khshty) swr khrdym, bh rsty w (= nwH) bndhy shkhr gzr bwd.
w (m) bh bny sry'yl dr khtb (twrt) wHy khrdym khh dw br dr zmyn fsd khwhyd khrd, w brtry jwyy (w TGyn) bzrgy khwhyd nmwd.

ps hngmykhh w`dhy nkhstyn an dw (br) fr rsd; grwhy z bndgn bsyr nyrwmnd (pykhr jwy) khwd r br shm brngyzym (t shm r drhm khwbnd w nbwd khnnd) ps (bry qtl w khshtr) drwn khnhh r jstjw khnnd, w yn w`dh shdny (w qT`y) st.
angh shm r br anh chyrh grdnym, w shm r b mwl w frzndn yrytn khnym, w (t`dd) nfrt shm r byshtr (z dshmn) grdnym.

gr nykhy khnyd, bh khwdtn nykhy khrdhyd, w gr bdy khnyd, bz bh khwd khrdhyd, ps hngmykhh w`dhy dygr fr rsd, (chnn dshmnn br shm mslT hstnd khh) athr Gm w ndwh dr chhrhhytn Zhr myshwd, w bh msjd (l'qSy) dr aynd; hmngwnh khh dr mrtbhy wl wrd shdnd, w anchh r zyr slThy khwd ybnd; ykhsrh nbwd grdnnd.
