nh yshn bh yn skhn `lm w aghy drnd w nh pdrnshn, skhn bzrgy z dhnshn byrwn myshwd! ann jz drwG nmygwynd.
ps gwyy mykhwhy dr py yshn khwd r z Gm w ndwh hlkh szy, gr bh yn skhn (qran) ymn nywrnd.
m anchh khh rwy zmyn st, zynt an qrr ddhym, t anh r byzmyym khh khdm ykhshn `ml bhtr mykhnnd.
w m (srnjm) anchh khh rwy zmyn st, (Sf mykhnym) bh khkhy hmwr w bygyh (bybny khshkh) tbdyl mykhnym.
ay gmn khrdy khh SHb khhf (= Gr) w rqym (= nwshth) z jmlhy nshnhhy shgft ngyz m bwdhnd?!
(byd awr) angh khh an jwnn bh Gr pnh brdnd, w gftnd: <<prwrdgr! m r z swy khwd rHmty `T khn, w rh njty brymn m frhm sz>>.
ps (m prdhhy khwb r) dr Gr br gwshhyshn zdym, w slh dr khwb frw rftnd.
sps ann r br ngykhtym t bdnym khdm ykh z an dw grwh mdt mndn khwd r bhtr Hsb khrdh st.
m dstn ann r bh Hq bry tw bzgw mykhnym. anh jwnny bwdnd khh bh prwrdgrshn ymn awrdh bwdnd, w m br hdytshn fzwdym.
w (m) dlhy anh r mHkhm skhtym, hngmykhh qym khrdnd, w gftnd: <<prwrdgr m, prwrdgr asmnh w zmyn st, w m hrgz Gyr z w m`bwdy nmyprstym (gr chnyn khnym) skhny gzf w byhwdh gfthym.
yn qwm m, m`bwdhy jz llh ntkhb khrdhnd, chr dlyl ashkhry (br yn m`bwdn) nmyawrnd?! chh khsy stmkhrtr st z an frdy khh br llh drwG bbndd?!>>.
w (bh anh gftym:) hngmykhh z anh w anchh r jz llh myprstnd; khnrhgyry khrdyd, ps bh Gr pnh bryd, khh prwrdgrtn n`mtsh r br shm mygstrnd, w rh asysh w njt z yn mr r bry shm frhm myszd.

w khwrshyd r mydydy khh bh hngm Tlw` bh smt rst Grshn mtmyl mygrdd, w bh hngm Grwb yshn r w gdhshth bh smt chp mtmyl mygrdd, w anh dr mHl wsy`y z an (Gr) qrr dshtnd, yn z ayt llh st, hr khs r hdyt khnd, ps w hdyt yfth (wq`y) st, w hrkhh r gmrh khnd, srprst w rhnmy'y hrgz bry w nkhwhy yft.

w (gr bh anh ngh mykhrdy) mypndshty bydrnd, dr Hlykhh anh khfth bwdnd, w m anh r bh smt rst w chp mygrdndym, w sg anh dsthy khwd r (bHlt psbny) br dhnhy Gr gshwdh bwd. gr bh anh ngh mykhrdy qT`an frr mykhrdy, w tw z anh skht mytrsydy (w wjwdt z wHsht pr myshd).

w yn gwnh m anh r (z khwb) br ngykhtym t z ykhdygr sw'l khnnd, ykhy z anh gft: <<chh mdt khwbydyd?>> gftnd: <<ykh rwz y bkhshy z ykh rwz>> (wqty khh ntwnstnd mdt khwbshn r bdnnd) gftnd: <<prwrdgrtn dntr st khh chqdr mndhyd, ps (khnwn) ykh nfr z khwdtn r b yn skhhy khh dryd bh shhr bfrstyd, w byd bngrd khdm ykh z Gdhh pkhyzhtr st, ps rwzy w T`my z an bry shm bywrd, w byd dqt khnd, w hych khs r z Hl shm agh nszd.
bdrsty khh gr anh (z wD` shm agh shwnd w), br shm dst ybnd, sngsrtn mykhnnd, y shm r bh ay'yn khwysh bz mygrdnnd, w dr an Swrt hrgz rstgr nkhwhyd shd>>.

w yn chnyn mrdm r mtwjh Hl anh khrdym, t bdnnd khh w`dhy llh Hq st, w ankhh dr (qym) qymt shkhy nyst, hngmykhh (mrdm) myn khwd dr yn brh nz` mykhrdnd, ps grwhy gftnd: <<bny'y br an bszyd>>, prwrdgrshn bh Hl anh aghtr st. brkhy dygr khh qdrt bdst (w khthryt) dshtnd gftnd: <<br (Gr) yshn prstshghy myszym>>.

(grwhy) khwhnd gft: <<anh sh nfr bwdnd, khh chhrmyn anh sgshn bwd,>> w (grwhy) mygwynd: <<pnj nfr bwdnd, khh shshmyn anh sgshn bwd>> - hmhy ynh skhnny bdwn dlyl st - w (grwhy) mygwynd: <<anh hft nfr bwdnd, w hshtmyn anh sgshn bwd>>, bgw: <<prwrdgr mn z t`dd anh aghtr st>>. jz grwh khmy t`dd anh r nmydnnd. ps drbrhy ann gftgwy mkhtSr w sdh (w mjdlh rwshn w arm) dshth bsh, w z hych khs drbrhy anh sw'l mkhn.
w hrgz drbrhy hych chyz ngw: <<mn frd an r njm mydhm>>.
mgr ynkhh llh bkhwhd, w hrgh frmwsh khrdy (w n sh llh ngfty) prwrdgrt r bh khTr bywr, w bgw: <<mydwrm khh prwrdgrm mr bh rhy rwshntr z yn hdyt khnd>>.
w anh (= SHb khhf) mdt sySd sl dr Grshn drng khrdnd, w nuh sl (nyz) br an fzwdnd.
(y pymbr!) bgw: <<llh z mdt mndnshn (dr Gr) aghtr st, Gyb asmnh w zmyn z ani wst, chqdr bynst w chqdr shnwst! anh hych wly (w srprsty) jz w ndrnd, w w t`ly hych khs r dr Hkhm khwd shrykh nmykhnd>>.
w anchh z khtb prwrdgrt bh swy tw wHy shdh; tlwt khn, hych khsy nmytwnd skhnn prwrdgrt r dgrgwn szd, w hrgz pnhghy jz w nmyyby.

w b khsny bsh khh prwrdgr khwd r SbHghn w shmghn mykhwnnd, (w tnh) wjh w r myTlbnd, w hrgz bkhTr zywrhy dny, chshmnt r z anh br mgyr, w pyrwy nkhn z khsnykhh dlhy shn r z yd khwd Gfl skhthym, w hwy nfs khwysh r pyrwy khrdnd, w khrhyshn z Hd gdhshth (w brbd) st.

(y pymbr!) bgw: <<(yn qran) Hq st z swy prwrdgrtn, ps hr khs mykhwhd ymn bywrd, w hrkhs mykhwhd khfr grdd>>. m bry stmkhrn atshy amdh khrdhym khh sr prdhsh ann r z hr Trf HTh khrdh st. w gr tqDy ab khnnd, aby, hmchwn flz gdkhth khh Swrth r bryn mykhnd, bry ann myawrnd, chh bd nwshydny, w chh bd armghy st.
bdrsty khsnykhh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd, hmn m pdsh nykhw khrn r Dy` nkhwhym khrd.

anh khsny hstnd khh bhshthy jwydn z ani yshn st, (bhshthy khh) nhrh z zyr (khkhh w drkhtn) an jry st, dr anj b dstbndhyy z Tl arsth myshwnd, w lbshyy (fkhr) sbz rng z Hryr nzkh w Dkhym dr br mykhnnd, dr Hlykhh br tkhth tkhyh zdhnd, chh pdsh khwby w chh mnzl nykhw w khwby st.
w (y pymbr!) bry anh mthly bzn, (mthl) an dw mrd khh bry ykhy z anh dw bG z nw` ngwrh qrr ddym, w grdgrd an dw (bG) r b drkhtn nkhl pwshndym, w dr myn an zr`t (pr brkhty) qrr ddym.
hr dw bG, mywh awrdh bwd (mywhhy bsyr) w chyzy frw gdhr nkhrdh bwd, w myn an dw (bG), nhr bzrgy jry skhth bwdym.
(SHb yn dw bG) mywhhy bsyr (w dramd frwny) dsht; ps bh hmyn khTr b dwstsh dr Hlykhh b w gftgw mykhrd gft: <<mn z lHZ thrwt z tw byshtrm w z lHZ nfrt nyrwmndtrm>>.
w dr Hlykhh bh khwd stmkhr bwd, dr bG khwysh dkhl shd, w gft: <<mn bwr nmykhnm hrgz yn (bG) nbwd shwd.
w bwr nmykhnm khh qymt br p grdd, w gr bh swy prwrdgrm bz grdndh shwm (bh frD ynkhh qymty bshd) qT`an jyghy bhtr z yn khwhm yft>>.
dwst wy - dr Hlykhh b w gftgw mykhrd - bh w gft: <<ay bh an khsykhh tw r z khkh, sps z nTfh afryd, angh tw r mrdy (khml) qrr dd, khfr shdy?!
lykhn mn (mygwym) llh prwrdgr mn st, w hych khs r shrykh prwrdgrm qrr nmydhm.
chr hngmykhh bh bG khwysh wrd shdy, ngfty: m sh llh, nyrw w qwty jz z nHyh llh nyst, gr mr z nZr ml w frznd khmtr z khwd bbyny.
ps myd st khh prwrdgrm bhtr z bG tw bh mn bdhd, w br bG tw afty z asmn frw frstd;t bh zmyny by gyh lGzndhy tbdyl grdd.
y ab an dr `mq zmyn frw rfth t hrgz ntwny an r bh dst awry>>.

(sr njm `dhb lhy fr rsyd) w tmm mywhhysh r dr br grft w nbwd shd. w w bkhTr hzynhhyy khh Srf an khrdh bwd; pywsth dsthysh r bh hm mymlyd - dr Hlykhh drbsthy an frw rykhth bwd- w mygft: <<y khsh khsy r shrykh prwrdgrm qrr nddh bwdm!>>
w w r grwhy nbwd khh dr brbr llh yrysh khnnd, w ntwnst khh khwd r yry khnd.
dr anj (thbt grdyd) khh yry w khmkh z an llh brHq st, wst khh bhtryn pdsh w bhtryn `qbt r (bry mTy`n) drd.
(y pymbr!) bry ann mthl zndgy dny r bzn khh mnnd aby st khh an r z asmn frw frstdym, sps gyhn zmyn b an drhm amykht sps khshkh grdyd, w bdh an r bh hr sw prkhndhsh khrdnd. w llh br hmh chyz twnst.
ml w frzndn zynt zndgy dnyst, w khrhy mndgri shysth, nzd prwrdgrt bhtryn thwb drd, w bhtryn myd st.
w (byd bywr) rwzy r khh khwhh r bh Hrkht dr awrym, w zmyn r ashkhr (w Sf) mybyny, hmgn r gird myawrym, w Hdy z ann r frw nmygdhrym.
w yshn bh Sf br prwrdgrt `rDh myshwnd (w bh anh myfrmyd:) <<hmgy nzd m amdyd, hmn gwnh khh nkhstyn br shmr r afrydym, blkhh shm gmn mykhrdyd, m hrgz mw`dy bry shm qrr nkhwhym dd>>.

w khtb (nmhy `ml) dr anj gdhrdh myshwd, ps gnhkhrn r mybyny khh z anchh dr an st trsnnd, w mygwynd: <<y wy br m, yn chh khtby st khh hych `ml khwchkh w bzrgy r frw ngdhshth; mgr ynkhh an r bh shmr awrdh st?!>> w anchh r njm ddhnd; HDr ybnd w prwrdgrt bh hych khs stm nmykhnd.

w (y pymbr! bryshn byn khn) zmny r khh bh frshtgn gftym: <<bry adm sjdh khnyd>> ps (hmh) sjdh khrdnd, bjz blys - khh z jn bwd - w z frmn prwrdgrsh srpychyd, ay w w frzndnsh bh jy mn dwstn khwd mygyryd, dr Hlykhh anh dshmn shm hstnd?! stmkhrn chh jygzyn bdy drnd.
mn ann (= blys w frzndnsh) r bh hngm afrynsh asmn w zmyn, w nh bh hngm afrynsh khwdshn HDr nkhrdm. w mn hych wqt gmrh khnndgn r dstyr w mddkhr khwd qrr nmydhm (w Slan nyzy ndrm).
w (byd bywryd) rwzy r khh llh myfrmyd: shrykhhyy r khh bry mn mypndshtyd, bkhwnyd (t shm r z `dhb rh sznd). ps anh r bkhwnnd, wly jbtshn nkhnnd, w m dr myn yn dw grwh hlkht ghy qrr ddhym.
w gnhkhrn atsh (dwzkh) r mybynnd, ps yqyn mykhnnd khh dr an khwhnd ftd, w z an hych rh gryzy nybnd.
w bh rsty dr yn qran, hr gwnh mthly bry mrdm byn khrdhym, wly nsn bysh z hr chyz bh mjdlh myprdzd.
w chyzy mrdm r bz ndsht z ynkhh - wqty hdyt bh swyshn amd - ymn bywrnd, w z prwrdgrshn Tlb amrzsh khnnd; jz ynkhh (mykhwstnd) sr nwsht pyshynyn bry ann byyd, y `dhb dr brbrshn qrr gyrd.

w m pymbrn r jz bshrtdhndh w hshdr dhndh nmyfrstym, w khsnykhh khfr shdnd, hmwrh bh bTl mjdlh mykhnnd t bwsylhy an, Hq r z myn brdrnd, w ayt w nshnhhy mn w anchh bh an bym ddh shdhnd bh bd mskhrh grftnd.

w chh khsy stm khrtr z an khsy st khh bh ayt prwrdgrsh pnd ddh shwd, sps z an rwy grdnd, w anchh r b dsthy khwd pysh frstdh frmwsh khrd?! m br dlhy ann prdhhyy fkhndhym t nfhmnd, w dr gwshhyshn sngyny (qrr ddhym). w gr anh r bhswy hdyt bkhwny, ps hrgz hdyt nmyshwnd.
w prwrdgrt amrzndh, w SHb rHmt st, gr bh khTr anchh mrtkhb shdhnd, anh r mw'khdhh mykhrd, qT`an hr chh zwdtr `dhb r bry anh myfrstd, wly bry anh mw`dy st khh hrgz z an rh frry nkhwhnd dsht.
w yn shhrh w abdyh hngmykhh stm khrdnd; hlkhshn nmwdym, w bry hlkhtshn mw`dy qrr ddym.
w (byd bywr) hngmy r khh mwsy bh jwn (khdmtkhr) khwd (ywsh` bn nwn) gft: <<mn dst z jstjw br nmydrm t bh mHl brkhwrd dw dry brsm hr chnd mdt Twlny bh rh khwd dmh dhm>>.
ps chwn bh mHl brkhwrd dw dry rsydnd, mhy khwd r (khh bry tGdhyh hmrh dshtnd) frmwsh khrdnd w mhy rh khwd r dr dry pysh grft (w rft).
ps hngmykhh (z anj) gdhshtnd, (mwsy) bh jwn (khdmtkhr) khwd (ywsh`) gft: <<Gdhymn r bywr, khh skht z yn sfrmn khsth shdhym>>.

gft: <<bh yd dry, hngmykhh (bry strHt) bh khnr an tkhth sng pnh brdym, mn (dr anj) mhy r frmwsh khrdm; w jz shyTn (khsy) an r z yd mn nbrd t bh ydsh bshm, w mhy bTrz shgft awry rh khwd r dr dry pysh grft>>.
(mwsy) gft: <<an hmn chyzy bwd khh m mykhwstym>> ps jstjw khnn z hmn rh bz gshtnd.
ps (dr anj) bndhy z bndgnm (= khDr) r yftnd khh z jnb khwd bh w rHmty `T khrdh w `lm frwny z nzd khwd bh w amwkhth bwdym.
mwsy bh w gft: <<ay z tw pyrwy khnm t z anchh bh tw amwkhth shdh w myhy rshd w SlH st, bh mn bymwzy?>>.
(khDr) gft: <<tw hrgz nmytwny b mn shkhybyy khny!
w chgwnh mytwny br chyzy khh bh (rz) an agh nysty, shkhyb bshy?!>>
(mwsy) gft: <<bh khwst llh mr shkhyb khwhy yft, w dr hych khry tw r nfrmny nkhnm>>.
(khDr) gft: <<ps gr hmrhy mr nmwdy, z hych chyz mprs t ankhh khwdm drbrhy an bry tw skhn bgwym>>.
ps an dw bh rh ftdnd, t ankhh swr khshty shdnd (khDr) khshty r swrkh khrd. (mwsy) gft: <<ay an r swrkh khrdy t srnshynn an r Grq khny? rsty chhkhr bdy njm ddy!>>
(khDr) gft: <<ay ngftm tw hrgz nmytwny b mn shkhybyy khny?!>>
(mwsy) gft: <<bkhTr anchh frmwsh khrdm, mr mw'khdhh mkhn w z yn khrm br mn skht mgyr>>.
ps bh rh khwd dmh ddnd; t hngmykhh bh nwjwny br khwrdnd, ps (khDr) w r khsht, (mwsy) gft: <<ay nsn pkhy r, bdwn ankhh khsy r khshth bshd; khshty? bhrsty khr zshty njm ddy!>>
gft: <<ay bh tw ngftm khh hrgz nmytwny b mn Sbr khny?!>>
(mwsy) gft: <<b`d z yn gr z tw drbrhy chyzy sw'l khrdm, dygr b mn hmrhy nkhn, bhrsty z jnb mn m`dhwr khwhy bwd>>.

ps bh rh khwd dmh ddnd, t bh hl qryhy rsydnd, z ann khwstnd khh bh yshn Gdh dhnd, wly ann z mhmn nmwdn ann khwd dry khrdnd. angh dr anj dywry yftnd khh mykhwst frw ryzd, ps (khDr)an r rst w stwr khrd, (mwsy) gft: <<gr mykhwsty (mytwnsty) dr mqbl yn khr; mzdy bgyry>>
(khDr) gft: <<ynkh zmn jdyy mn w tw fr rsydh, bhzwdy tw r z rz (w Hkhmt) anchh khh ntwnsty dr brbr an Sbr khny; agh khwhm skht.
m khshty, z an bynwyny bwd khh dr dry khr mykhrdnd, ps mn khwstm an r m`ywb khnm, (chr khh) psht sr anh pdshhy (stmgr) bwd khh hr khshty (slmy) r bhzwr mygrft.
w m nwjwn, pdr w mdrsh (hrdw) b ymn bwdnd, ps bym dshtym khh ann r bh srkhshy w khfr wdrd.
z yn rw, khwstym khh prwrdgrshn frznd pkhtr w pr mHbt try bjy w bh an dw `T frmyd.

w m dywr, z an dw nwjwn ytym dr an shhr bwd, w zyr an, gnjy mt`lq bh an dw wjwd dsht, w pdrshn mrdy SlH bwd, ps prwrdgrt khwst khh ann bh Hd blwG brsnd w gnj khwd r byrwn awrnd, yn rHmty z prwrdgrt bwd, yn (khrh) r mn khwd srnh njm nddm, yn bwd rz (w Hkhmt) khrhy khh ntwnsty dr brbr anh Sbr khny>>.
w (y pymbr!) z tw drbrhy <<dhwlqrnyn>> myprsnd; bgw: <<bh zwdy chyzy z sr gdhsht w bry shm khwhm khwnd>>.
yqynan m bh w dr zmyn qdrt w Hkhwmt ddym, w sbb hr chyz r dr khtyrsh gdhshtym.
ps w (z yn) sbb (pyrwy w) stfdh khrd.

t an khh bh Grwb gh aftb rsyd, (chnyn bh nZrsh rsyd) khh khwrshyd dr chshmhy gil alwd w syh Grwb mykhnd, w dr anj mrdmy r yft, gftym: <<y dhwlqrnyn! y (ann r) mjzt mykhny, w y rwsh khwby drbrhy anh ntkhb mynmyy>>.
(dhw lqrnyn) gft: <<m khsykhh stm khrdh st, mjzt khwhym khrd, sps bh swy prwrdgrsh bz grdndh myshwd, angh w r mjzt skhty khwhd khrd.
w m khsykhh ymn awrd w khr shysth njm dd, ps (dr akhrt) pdshy nykhw drd, w m dstwr, asny bh w khwhym dd>>.
sps z sbby (khh dr khtyrsh bwd) stfdh khrd.
t ankhh bh jygh bramdn aftb rsyd, (dr anj) dyd khh aftb br mrdmny Tlw` mykhnd khh dr brbr (tbsh) aftb bryshn pwshshy qrr nddh bwdym.
ynchnyn bwd (khr dhy lqrnyn) w bh rsty m z anchh dr khtyr dsht (w njm mydd) khmlan agh bwdym.
sps z wsyl w sbb stfdh khrd.
(w bh sfr dmh dd) t bh myn dw khwh rsyd, w dr khnr an dw (khwh) mrdmy r yft khh hych skhny r nmyfhmydnd.
(ann bh w) gftnd: <<y dhwlqrnyn! y'jwj w m'jwj dr yn srzmyn fsd mykhnnd, ps ay hzynhy bry tw qrr dhym, khh myn m w anh sdy bszy?!>>
(dhwlqrnyn) gft: <<anchh prwrdgrm dr khtyr mn qrr ddh (z qdrt w thrwt) bhtr st (z anchh shm pyshnhd mykhnyd) ps mr b nyrw yry khnyd, t myn shm w anh sdW mHkhmy bszm.

qT`t bzrg ahn brym bywryd, (w rwy hm bchynyd)>> t wqtykhh khmlan myn dw khwh r brbr khrd (w pwshnyd), gft: <<(dr Trf an atsh byfrwzyd) w dr an bdmyd>> (anh dmydnd) t wqty qT`t ahn r srkh w gdkhth khrd. gft: <<(khnwn) ms dhwb shdh brym bywryd; t br rwy an bryzm>>.
(sr njm sd mHkhmy skht) ps anh (= y'jwj w m'jwj) Slan ntwnstnd z an bl rwnd, w ntwnstnd swrkh w nqby dran yjd khnnd.
(angh) gft: <<yn z rHmt prwrdgr mn st (w t llh bkhwhd p brj mymnd) m hngmykhh w`dhy prwrdgrm fr rsd, an r drhm mykhwbd, w w`dhy prwrdgrm Hq st>>.
w dr an rwz (khh jhn pyn mypdhyrd) m anh r (chnn) rh mykhnym khh dr hm mwj myznnd, w dr shypwr dmydh myshwd, sps m hmh r (dr ykhj) jm` mykhnym.
w dran rwz, jhnm r br khfrn `rDh mydrym.
(an) khsnykhh chshmnshn z yd mn dr prdhy (Gflt) bwd, w twn shnydn (Hq r) ndshtnd.
ay khsnykhh khfr shdnd; gmn mybrnd khh bndgn mr bjy mn wlyy khwd bgyrnd?! bygmn m jhnm r bry pdhyry'y khfrn amdh khrdhym.
(y pymbr!) bgw: <<ay shm r bh zyn khrtryn (mrdm) dr khrh, khbr dhym.
khsnykhh tlsh w khwshsh shn dr zndgy dny tbh w Dy` shdh, w b yn Hl gmn mykhnnd khh khr nykh njm mydhnd>>.
anh khsny hstnd khh bh ayt prwrdgrshn w lqy w (dr jhn akhrt) khfr shdnd, dr ntyjh `mlshn tbh w nbwd shd, sps dr rwz qymt bry anh (rzshy qy'l nystym) w zny br p nkhwhym khrd.
(ary) yn (gwnh) st szyshn dwzkh st, bkhTr ankhh khfr shdnd, w ayt mn w pymbrnm r mskhrh grftnd.
bygmn khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd, bGhy (bhsht) bryn mHl pdhyry'y ann khwhd bwd.
jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd w hrgz tqDy nql mkhn z anj nmykhnnd.
(y pymbr!) bgw: <<gr dry bry (ngrsh) khlmt prwrdgrm jwhr shwd; qT`an dry bh pyn myrsd, pysh z ankhh khlmt prwrdgrm pyn ybd, hr chnd hmnnd an (dry) bh khmkh an bywrym>>.

ps mwsy dr dl khwd trsy Hss khrd khh (mbd dr ymn mrdm khlly yjd shwd).

w anchh r khh dr dst rst khwd dry byfkhn, t (tmm) anchh r khh skhthnd, bbl`d, byshkh anchh skhthnd, tnh mkhr sHr st, w sHr hr j rwd rstgr (w mwfq) nkhwhd shd>>.
(ps mwsy `Sy khwd r fkhnd, nghn bh mr bzrgy tbdyl shd w hmhy anh r khh skhth bwdnd bl`yd) angh sHrn (hmgy) bh sjdh ftdnd, gftnd: <<(m) bh prwrdgr hrwn w mwsy ymn awrdym>>.

(fr`wn) gft: <<ay pysh z an khh bh shm jzh dhm bh w ymn awrdyd?! bytrdyd w bzrg shmst khh bh shm sHr amwkhth st, ps yqynan dstntn w phytn r br khlf ykhdygr qT` mykhnm, w shm r br tnhhy nkhl bh dr myawyzm, w byshkh khwhyd dnst khh `dhb (w shkhnjh) khdmykh z m skhttr st w pydrtr st!>>.
gftnd: <<swgnd bh an khh m r afrydh st, hrgz tw r br yn dlyl rwshny khh bry m amdh, trjyH nmydhym, ps bh hr Hkhmy khh mykhwhy Hkhm khn, tw tnh mytwny dr yn zndgy dny Hkhm khny.
hmn m bh prwrdgrmn ymn awrdhym t gnhnmn w anchh r z sHr khh m r bh an wdr khrdy, brymn bbkhshyd, w llh bhtr w pydrtr st>>.
bygmn khsykhh gnhkhr bh nzd prwrdgrsh HDr shwd, ps atsh jhnm bry wst, dr an j nh mymyrd, w nh zndh mymnd.
w khsykhh mw'mn nzd w ayd, dr Hlykhh khrhy shysth njm ddh bshd, ps ynn bryshn drjt blnd st.
bGhy jwydn (bhshty) khh nhrh zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, hmyshh dr an khwhnd bwd, w yn st pdsh khsykhh khwd r (z shrkh w gnhn) pkh nmwdh st.
w bhrsty (m) bh mwsy wHy khrdym khh: <<shbnh bndgn mr (z mSr byrwn) bbr, sps bry anh dr dry rhy khshkh bgsh, khh nh z t`qyb (dshmnn) khwhy trsyd, w nh (z Grq shdn dr dry) hrsy dry.

gftnd: <<(m) bh khtyr khwd w`dhy tw r khlf nkhrdym, lykhn brhy sngyny z zynt (w zywrhy) qwm (fr`wn) khh b khwd dshtym, an r (dr atsh) fkhndym>> ps bdynsn smry nyz (anchh dsht) fkhnd.
angh bry anh mjsmhy gwslhy khh Sdyy (chwn Sdy gwslh) dsht, pdyd awrd, ps (smry w pyrwnsh bh mrdm) gftnd: <<yn m`bwd shm, w m`bwd mwsy st, khh an r frmwsh khrdh st>>.

w byshkh hrwn pysh z yn bh anh gfth bwd: <<y qwm mn! yqynan shm bh (wsylhy) yn (gwslh) azmwn shdhyd, w bygmn prwrdgr shm (llh) rHmn st, ps z mn pyrwy nmy'yd w frmnm r T`t khnyd>>.

ps anh r (zmyny) Sf w hmwr mygrdnd,
khh dr an hych psty w blndy r nbyny>>.
(dr) an rwz, (hmgy) d`wt khnndh r pyrwy khnnd, hych rh srpychy (w mkhlft) nyst, w hmhy Sdh dr brbr (llh) rHmn khsh` myshwd, ps jz Sdy ahsth (chyzy) nmyshnwy.
an rwz shf`t (hych khs) swd nmybkhshd, jz khsykhh (llh) rHmn bh w jzh ddh, w gftr w r psndydh st.
anchh r pysh rw drnd, w anchh r psht srshn st mydnd, w anh bh `lm w HTh ndrnd.
w (hmhy) chhrhh dr brbr (llh) zndhy pyndh frwtn myshwd, w an khh (br) stm br dwsh drd, nkhm (w m'yws) mygrdd.

(hrgz) dr skhn br w pyshy nmygyrnd, w bhfrmn w khr mykhnnd.

ps (dr Gyb btprstn) hmhy anh - jz (bt) bzrgshn - r qT`h qT`h khrd, bshd khh bh swy w bz grdnd.
(w hngmykhh bh bt khnh amdnd w dydnd) gftnd: <<hr khsykhh b m`bwdn m chnyn khrdh st, mslman w z stmkhrn st>>.
(`dhy) gftnd: <<shnydym jwny khh w r brhym mygwynd, anh (= bth) r (bh bdy) yd mykhrd>>.
gftnd: <<ps w r dr brbr dydgn mrdm bywryd, bshd khh anh gwhy dhnd>>.
(hngmykhh brhym r HDr khrdnd) gftnd: <<y brhym! ay tw yn (khr) r b m`bwdn m khrdhy?!>>
gft: <<blkhh yn bzrgshn yn (khr) r khrdh st, ps z anh bprsyd gr skhn mygwynd!>>.
angh (anh) bh khwd bz gshtnd, ps gftnd: <<bygmn shm khwd stmkhr hstyd>>.
sps (b shrmndgy) sr bh zyr ndkhtnd (w gftnd:) <<mslman tw mydny khh ynh skhn nmygwynd>>.
(brhym) gft: <<ay bh jy llh chyzy r myprstyd khh hych nf`y bry shm ndrd, w nh zyny bh shm myrsnd?!
f br shm, w br anchh bh jy llh myprstyd, ay nmyndyshyd?!>>
gftnd: <<w r bswznyd, w m`bwdn khwd r yry khnyd, gr khnndhy (khry) hstyd>>.
(srnjm anh w r bh atsh ndkhtnd, wly m) gftym: <<y atsh! br brhym srd w slmt bsh>>.
w anh khwstnd bry (nbwdy) w nyrng (khTrnkhy) wrznd, ps anh r zynkhrtryn (mrdm) qrr ddym.
w w w lwT r bh srzmyny khh dr an bry jhnyn brkht ddhym, njt ddym.
w sHq, w fzwn (br w nwhsh) y`qwb r bh w bkhshydym, w hmhy ann r shysth qrr ddym.
w (nyz) anh r pyshwyny qrr ddym khh bhfrmn m (mrdm r) hdyt mykhrdnd, w njm khrhy nykh w br pdshtn nmz w dy zkht r bh anh wHy khrdym, w anh (hmh) `bdtgzr m bwdnd.
w lwT r Hkhmt (= nbwt) w dnsh ddym, w w r z shhry khh (mrdmnsh) `ml zsht (w plyd) njm myddnd, njt ddym, byshkh anh mrdm bdi fsqy bwdnd.
w w r dr rHmt khwd dkhl khrdym, bygmn w z SlHn bwd.
w (y pymbr!) nwH r (bh yd awr) hngmykhh pysh z an (m r) nd dd, ps m (d`ysh) r bry w jbt khrdym, angh w w khndnsh r z ndwh bzrg njt ddym.
w w r br qwmykhh ayt m r tkhdhyb khrdh bwdnd; yry ddym, bygmn anh qwm bdy bwdnd, ps hmhy anh r Grq khrdym.
w dwd w slymn r (bh yd awr) hngmykhh dr(brhy) khshtzry khh gwsfndn qwm, shbnh dr an chrydh bwdnd, dwry mykhrdnd, w m br Hkhm (w qDwt) anh shhd bwdym.
ps an (shywhy qDwt `dlnh w drst) r bh slymn fhmndym, w bh hr ykh z ann Hkhmt (= dwry) w dnsh `T khrdym, w khwhh w prndgn r b dwd mskhr skhtym khh (hmrh w) tsbyH mygftnd, w m yn (hmh) r njm ddym.
w skhtn zrh r bkhTr shm bh w amwkhtym, t shm r z (asyb) jnghytn mHfwZ drd, ps ay shkhr gzr hstyd?!.
w tnd bd r mskhr (w mTy`) slymn khrdym, khh bhfrmn w bhswy srzmyny khh dr an brkht ddym, Hrkht mykhrd, w m br hr chyz aghym.
w (nyz) z shyTyn khsny r (mskhr khrdym) khh brysh GwSy mykhrdnd, w khrhyy Gyr z yn (nyz) njm myddnd, w (m) HfZ anh bwdym.
w (y pymbr!) ywb r (bh yd awr) hngmykhh prwrdgrsh r nd dd: <<rnj w bymry bh mn rsydh st, w tw mhrbntryn mhrbnny>>.
ps (m) d`y w r jbt khrdym, w rnj w nrHty khh dsht br Trf skhtym, w khnwdhsh w (nyz) hmnndshn r b anh bh w bzgrdndym, (t) rHmty z jnb m, w pndy bry `bdt khnndgn bshd.
w sm`yl w drys w dhwlkhfl r (bh yd awr) khh hmgy z Sbrn bwdnd.
w (m) anh r dr rHmt khwd wrd khrdym, bygmn anh z SlHn bwdnd.

w dhwlnwn (= ywns) r (bh yd awr) hngmykhh khshmgyn (z myn qwmsh) rft, ps chnyn pndsht khh m hrgz br w tng nmygyrym, ps (wqty khh dr shkhm mhy frw rft) dr trykhyh nd dd khh: <<(prwrdgr!) hych m`bwdy br Hq jz tw nyst, tw mnzhy! bygmn mn z stmkhrn bwdm>>.
ps d`y w r jbt khrdym, w z ndwh njtsh ddym, w yn gwnh mw'mnn r njt mydhym.
w zkhry r (bh yd awr) hngmykhh prwrdgrsh r nd dd: <<prwrdgr! mr tnh mgdhr, w tw bhtryn wrthny>>.

ps d`y w r jbt khrdym, w yHyy r bh w bkhshydym, w hmsrsh r (b`d z an khh nz bwd) brysh shysth (w amdh br dry) grdnydym. bygmn anh hmwrh dr khrhy khyr myshtftnd, w dr Hl bym w myd m r mykhwndnd, w pywsth bry m (khsh` w) frwtn bwdnd.

w (y pymbr! bh yd awr) zny r khh shrmghsh r pkh ngh dsht, ps (m) z rwH khwd dr an dmydym [ gfth myshwd khh jbry'yl `lyh lslm dr grybn HDrt mrym `lyh lslm dmyd, angh bh frmn llh mt`l Hmlh shd. (tfsyr qrTby)], w w w frzndsh r nshnhy bry jhnyn qrr ddym.
bytrdyd yn st ayyn shm khh ayyny ygnh st, w mn prwrdgr shm hstm, ps mr prstsh khnyd.
w (grwhy z pyrwn nby) dr myn khwd dr mr (dyn) shn frqh frqh shdnd, hmgy bhswy m bz mygrdnd.
ps khsykhh z khrhy shysth r njm dhd dr Hlykhh mw'mn bshd, khwshsh w nspsy nkhwhd shd, w bygmn m (`mlsh r) brysh mynwysym.
w (mrdm)hr shhry r khh (br thr khfr w gnh) an r hlkh khrdym, mHl st khh (bh dny) bzgrdnd.
t wqtykhh (sd) y'jwj w m'jwj gshwdh shwd, w anh z hr (tbh w) blndy shtbn srzyr grdnd.
w w`dhy Hq (= qymt) nzdykh shwd, ps dr an hngm chshmhy khsnykhh khfr shdnd (z wHsht) khyrh mnd (gwynd:) y wy br m khh z yn (wq`h) dr Gflt bwdym, blkhh m stmkhr bwdym!
yqynan shm w anchh bh jy llh myprstyd, hyzm jhnm hstyd, shm dr an wrd khwhyd shd.
gr ynh (= bth) m`bwdny (brHq) bwdnd, hrgz wrd an nmyshdnd, w (anh) hmgy dr an jwdn khwhnd mnd.
bry anh dr an (= jhnm) nlhhy (drdnkhy) st, w anh dr an (chyzy) nmyshnwnd.
bhrsty khsnykhh pyshtr z swy m (w`dhy) nykhwyy bry anh mqrr shdh st, anh z an (= jhnm) dwr ngh dshth myshwnd.
anh (Hty) Sdysh r nmyshnwnd, w dr anchh dlshn bkhwhd jwdnh (mtn`m) hstnd.
wHsht bzrg (qymt) anh r ndwhgyn nszd, w frshtgn bh stqblshn aynd (gwynd:) <<yn hmn rwztn st khh bh shm w`dh ddh myshd>>.
rwzykhh asmn r chwn Twmry nwshth shdh drhm mypychym, hmngwnh khh nkhstyn afrynsh r aGz khrdym, (dygr br) an r bz mygrdnym, (yn) w`dhy br m st, qT`an an r njm khwhym dd.
w bh rsty b`d z dhkhr (= twrt) dr zbwr nwshtym khh: <<zmyn r bndgn SlH mn bh rth khwhnd brd>>.
bygmn dr yn (mr) bry grwh `bdt khnndgn pym rwshny st.
w (y pymbr!) tw r jz rHmty bry jhnyn nfrstdym.
bgw: <<tnh bh swy mn wHy myshwd khh hmn m`bwd shm, m`bwd ygnh st, ps ay shm tslym myshwyd?!>>.
ps gr (bz) rwy grdn shwnd, bgw: <<mn shm r ykhsn agh khrdm (w `lm khTr mykhnm) w nmydnm anchh khh bh shm w`dh ddh myshwd; nzdykh st y dwr?!
byshkh w skhn ashkhr r mydnd, w (nyz) anchh r (dr dl khwd) khtmn mykhnyd; mydnd.
w mn nmydnm, shyd yn (t'khyr `dhb) bry shm azmyshy, w bhrhmndy t mdty (m`yn) bshd>>.
(w pymbr) gft: <<y prwrdgr! bh Hq dwry khn, w prwrdgr m (llh) rHmn st, khh z w stmdd myshwd dr brbr anchh shm byn mykhnyd>>.
y mrdm! z prwrdgrtn btrsyd, bdwn shkh zlzlhy qymt Hdthhy `Zymy st.
rwzykhh an r mybynyd, hr mdr shyr dhy, (khwdkh) shyr khwrsh z yd khwd mybrd, w hr (zn) brdry, br khwd r br zmyn mygdhrd, w mrdm r mst mybyny, dr Hlykhh mst nystnd, w lykhn `dhb llh shdyd st.
w b`Dy z mrdm, bdwn (hych) `lm w dnshy, dr(brhy) llh bh mjdlh br mykhyznd, w z hr shyTn srkhshy pyrwy mykhnnd,
(dr qDy lhy) br w (= shyTn) nwshth shdh khh hr khs b w dwsty khnd, mslman w gmrhsh mykhnd, w w r bh `dhb (atsh) swzn (jhnm) mykhshnd.

y mrdm! gr z br ngykhth shdn dr shkh hstyd, ps (bh yn nkhth dqt khnyd:) hmn m shm r z khkh afrydym, sps z nTfh, w b`d z khwn bsth shdh, sps z mDGh (= prh gwshty) shkhl yfth w shkhl nyfth, t (qdrt w Hkhmt khwd r) bry shm ashkhr szym, w hr chh r khh bkhwhym t zmny m`yn dr rHm (mdrn) ngh mydrym, angh shm r bh Swrt Tfl byrwn myawrym, sps t bh Hd rshd (w blwG) khwd brsyd, w z shm khsy hst khh mymyrd, w z shm khsy hst khh (anqdr `mr mykhnd khh) bh nhyt frtwty (w pyry) bz brdh myshwd, t ankhh ps z (an hmh) `lm w dnsh, chyzy ndnd, w (bh mthl dygr twjh khnyd:) zmyn r khshkhydh mybyny, ps hngmykhh ab (brn) br an frw frstym, bh Hrkht dr ayd, w rshd khnd, w z hr nw` gyh zyb (w khrm) brwynd.
yn bh khTr an st khh (bdnyd) llh Hq st, w ankhh w mrdgn r zndh mykhnd, w ankhh w br hr chyz twnst.
w ankhh qymt amdny st, shkhy dr an nyst, w ankhh llh (hmhy) khsnykhh dr gwrh hstnd, br myngyzd.
z mrdm khsy st khh bdwn hych dnsh w hych hdyt w khtb rwshny bkhshy drbrhy llh mjdlh mykhnd.
(tkhbr khnn) phlw (w grdn) khwd r mypychd, t (mrdm r) z rh llh gmrh szd, bry w dr dny rswyy st, w rwz qymt atsh swzn r bh w mychshnym.
(w bh w mygwyym:) yn (khyfr) dr brbr chyzy st khh dsthyt z pysh frstdh st, w bygmn llh (hrgz) bh bndgn stm nmykhnd.

w z (myn) mrdm khsy st khh llh r br khnrh (b trdyd) myprstd (w ymnsh bsyr D`yf w sst st) ps gr khyry bh w brsd (dlsh) bh an arm mygyrd, w gr blyy (bry azmysh) bh w brsd, rwy mygrdnd (w bh khfr bz mygrdd), dr dny w akhrt zyn khrdh st, yn hmn zyn ashkhr st,
(w) bh jy llh chyzy r mykhwnd khh nh zyny bh w myrsnd w nh swdy bh w mybkhshd, yn hmn gmrhy dwr st.
(w) khsy r mykhwnd khh zynsh nzdykhtr z nf`sh st, chh bd (sr prst w) ywry st, w chh bd (hmdm w) m`shry st.
bygmn llh khsny r khh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd, bh bGhyy (z bhsht) wrd mykhnd khh nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, mslman llh anchh r mykhwhd, njm mydhd.

w yn gwnh (m) an (= qran) r (bSwrt) ayt rwshn nzl khrdym, w bygmn llh hr khs r bkhwhd hdyt mykhnd.
yqynan khsnykhh ymn awrdnd, w khsnykhh yhwdy shdnd, w Sby'n (= by dynn) w nSry w mjws w khsnykhh (bh llh) shrkh awrdnd, hmn llh dr myn anh rwz qymt dwry mykhnd, bygmn llh br hr chyz gwh st.

ay ndydy khh hr khs dr asmnh w hr khs khh dr zmyn st, w khwrshyd w mh w strgn w khwhh w drkhtn w jnbndgn w bsyry z mrdm bry llh sjdh mykhnnd, w bsyrnd khh (frmn) `dhb br ann tHqq yfth st, w hr khh r llh khwr szd, ps khsy w r grmy nkhwhd dsht, bygmn llh hr chh r bkhwhd, mykhnd.
yn dw (grwh) dshmnn ykhdygrnd drbrhy prwrdgrshn (styz w) khSwmt khrdnd, ps khsnykhh khfr shdnd lbshyy z atsh bry anh brydh shdh st, z bly srshn ab swzn rykhth myshwd.
khh anchh dr drwnshn st w (nyz) pwsthy (shn) b an gdkhth myshwd.
w bry (zdn) anh grzhy z ahn (dG) st.
hr gh bkhwhnd z (shdt) ndwh z anj (= dwzkh) khrj shwnd, bh an bz grdndh myshwnd, w (bh anh gfth myshwd:) `dhb swzn (jhnm) r bchshyd.
bygmn llh khsny r khh ymn awrdh w khrhy shysth njm ddhnd bh bGhyy (z bhsht) wrd mykhnd khh z zyr (drkhtn) an nhrh jry st, dr anj bh dstbndhy z Tl w mrwryd arsth myshwnd, w lbsshn dr anj bryshm st.
w bh swy gftr pkhyzh hdyt myshwnd, w bh rh (llh) stwdh rhnmyy mygrdnd.

bygmn khsnykhh khfr shdnd, w (mrdm r) z rh llh bz mydrnd w (hmchnyn z) msjd lHrm, khh an r bry (hmhy) mrdm ykhsn qrr ddym, (chh) mqym dr anj w y wrd br an, w khsykhh z rwy stm dr anj khjrwy (w nHrf z Hq r) bkhwhd, z `dhb drdnkh bh w mychshnym.
w (bh yd awr) zmny r khh jy khnh (kh`bh) r bry brhym t`yyn khrdym; (w gftym:) chyzy r shrykh mn qrr mdh, w khnhy mr bry Twf khnndgn w qym khnndgn w rkhw` (w) sjwd khnndgn pkh grdn.
w dr (myn) mrdm bh Hj nd bdh, t pydh w (swr) br hr (mrkhb w) shtr lGry z hr rh dwry bh swy tw byynd.

(Hkhm) yn st, w hr khs (mqdst w) Hrmt nhdhhy llh r bzrg drd, ps yn (khr) nzd prwrdgrsh bry w bhtr st. w chhrpyn bry shm Hll shdh, mgr anchh br shm khwndh myshwd, ps z plydy bth jtnb khnyd, w z gftr bTl (w drwG) dwry khnyd.
dr Hlykhh Hqgr w mkhlS llh w shrykh nywrndgn bh w bshyd, w khsykhh bh llh shrkh awrd, ps gwyy z asmn sqwT khrdh st, angh prndgn (gwsht khwr) w r myrbynd, y bd w r bh jyy bsyr dwr prtb mykhnd.
(Hkhm) yn st, w khsykhh sh`y'r lhy r bzrg drd, ps bygmn yn (khr) z prhyzgry dlhst.
dr an (chhrpyn qrbny) t zmn m`yn bry shm mnf` (w bhrhh) st, ps qrbngh anh khnhy khhnsl (kh`bh) st.
w bry hr mty (rsm) qrbny ddym, t nm llh r (bh hngm dhbH) br chhrpyny khh rwzyshn khrdh st; bbrnd, ps m`bwd shm, m`bwd ygnh st, (hmh) bry w tslym shwyd, w bh frwtnn bshrt dh.
(hmn) khsnykhh chwn nm llh brdh shwd, dlhy shn trsn grdd, w shkhybyn dr brbr mSybthyy khh bh anh myrsd, w anh khh nmz r br p mydrnd, w z anchh rwzyshn khrdhym; nfq mykhnnd.

w (qrbny) shtrn (frbh) r (dr Hj) bry shm z sh`y'r lhy qrr ddym, dr an bry shm khyr (w brkht) st. ps (hngm qrbny) dr Hlykhh br p ystdhnd; nm llh r br anh bbryd, angh chwn phlwhyshn (br zmyn) ftd, z (gwsht) anh bkhwryd, w (fqyrn) qn` (Gyr sy'l) w (fqyrn) sy'l r T`m khnyd. yn gwnh (m) anh r bry shm rm khrdym; bshd khh shm spsgzry khnyd.

yqynan llh z khsnykhh ymn awrdhnd; df` mykhnd, bygmn llh hych khyntkhri nspsy r dwst ndrd.
bh khsnykhh b ann jng myshwd, jzhy (jhd) ddh shdh st, z an rwy khh mwrd stm qrr grfthnd, w yqynan llh br yry anh twnst.

(hmn) khsnykhh bh nHq z dyrshn rndh shdnd; jz ynkhh mygftnd: <<prwrdgr m llh st>>. w gr llh b`Dy z mrdm r bh (wsylhy) b`Dy dygr df` nmykhrd, bygmn dyrhy (rhbn) w khlyshy (msyHyn) w khnshthy (yhwdyn) w msjdy khh nm llh dr anh bsyr brdh myshwd; wyrn mygrdyd, w mslman llh yry mykhnd khsykhh (dyn) w r yry dhd, bygmn llh qwy pyrwzmnd st.

(y pymbr) gr (yn qwm bt prst) tw r tkhdhyb mykhnnd, (Gmgyn nbsh) bhrsty pysh z anh qwm nwH w `d w thmwd (pymbrnshn r) tkhdhyb khrdnd.
w (hmchnyn) qwm brhym w qwm lwT.

ps chh bsyr abdyh r dr Hlykhh (mrdmsh) stmgr bwdnd; nbwdshn khrdym, ps (ynkh) br sqfhysh frwrykhth (w wyrn shdh) st, w (chh bsyr) chh (pr ab) khh byHSl mndh, w (chh) qSr (hy) br frshth stwr (khh bySHb mndh st).

ay anh dr zmyn syr nkhrdnd, t dlhyy dshth bshnd khh b an (Hqyqt r) drybnd, y gwshhy khh b an (khbr gdhshtgn r) bshnwnd?! ps bygmn chshmhy (Zhr) nbyn nmyshwd, w lykhn dlhyy khh dr synhhst; nbyn myshwd.
w anh bh shtb z tw `dhb myTlbnd, w llh hrgz w `dhsh r khlf nmykhnd, w bygmn ykh rwz nzd prwrdgrt, mnnd hzr sl z anchh st khh (shm) myshmryd.
w chh bsyr abdyh khh bh anh mhlt ddm; dr Hlykhh (mrdmsh) stmgr bwdnd, angh anh r grftm, w bz gsht (hmh) bh swy mn st.
(y pymbr!) bgw: <<y mrdm! jz yn nyst khh mn bry shm bymdhndhy ashkhry hstm>>.
ps khsnykhh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd, bry anh amrzsh w rwzy nykh st.
w khsnykhh mbrzhkhnn dr (nkhr) ayt m tlsh khrdnd, (w pndshtnd khh m r bh stwh myawrnd) ann hl dwzkh hstnd.

w (m) hych rswl w pymbry r pysh z tw nfrstdym; mgr ynkhh chwn (ayt m r) tlwt mykhrd, shyTn dr tlwt w (chyzy) lq mykhrd, angh llh anchh shyTn lq mykhnd; z myn mybrd, sps llh aytsh r stwr (w mHkhm) mydrd, w llh dny Hkhym st.
t (llh) anchh r khh shyTn lq mykhnd, azmwny qrr dhd bry khsnykhh dr dlhyshn bymry st, w anhyy khh dlhyshn skht st, w bygmn stmkhrn dr mkhlft (w dshmny) dwr (w drz) hstnd.
w t khsnykhh bh ann dnsh ddh shdh bdnnd khh mslman an (qran) z swy prwrdgrt Hq st, ps bh an ymn bywrnd, angh dlhyshn bry an (Hq) khD` grdd, w yqynan llh khsny r khh ymn awrdnd bh rh rst hdyt mykhnd.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd hmwrh dr an (= qran) shkh drnd, t ankhh nghn qymt fr rsd y `dhb rwz nHs br anh (frwd) ayd.

chr hngmykhh yn (thmt) r shnydyd, mrdn w znn mw'mn nsbt bh khwd gmn khyr nbrdnd, w ngftnd: yn thmty (bzrg w) ashkhr st.
chr chhr shhd br an nywrdnd?! ps chwn gwhn r nywrdnd, ann dr nzd llh drwGgwynnd.
w gr fDl llh w rHmt w dr dny w akhrt nbwd, qT`an dr anchh bh an prdkhtyd, `dhb (skht w) bzrgy bh shm myrsyd.
zmny khh an (shy`h) r z zbn ykhdygr mygrftyd, w b dhn khwd skhny mygftyd khh bh an `lm (w yqyn) ndshtyd, w an r shl (w khwchkh) mypndshtyd dr Hlykhh an nzd llh bsyr bzrg st.

llh shm r ndrz mydhd khh gr mw'mn hstyd; hrgz bh chnyn khry bz ngrdyd.

khsny z myn shm khh twngr w (dry) ws`t (zndgy) hstnd, nbyd swgnd bkhwrnd br an khh bh khwyshwndn w mstmndn w mhjrn dr rh llh chyzy ndhnd, anh byd `fw khnnd w chshm bpwshnd [ msTH bn ththh psr khlhy bwbkhr Sdyq, frdy mskhyn bwd khh bwbkhr mkhrj wy r t'myn mykhrd, w nyz dr yn shy`h prkhny shrkht dsht ldh bwbkhr Sdyq rDy llh `nh swgnd yd khrd khh dygr bh w khmkh nkhnd, angh llh mt`l yn ayh r nzl frmwd (tfsyr bn khthyr).], ay dwst nmydryd khh llh shm r bbkhshd?! w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
bygmn khsnykhh znn pkhdmn bykhbr (z hrgwnh bdkhry w) mw'mn r mthm (bh zn) mysznd, dr dny w akhrt l`nt shdhnd, w `dhb bzrgy bry anhst.
rwzy khh zbnhyshn w dsthyshn w physhn bh anchh mykhrdnd br `lyh anh gwhy mydhnd.
an rwz, llh jzy wq`y anh r bh tmm (w by khm w khst) mydhd, w khwhnd dnst khh llh hmn Hq ashkhr st.

znn npkh z an mrdn npkhnd, w mrdn npkh (nyz) bry znn npkh hstnd, w znn pkh z an mrdn pkh, w mrdn pkh z an znn pkhnd. ynn z anchh (mrdm drbrhyshn) mygwynd, mbWr (w pkh) hstnd, bry anh amrzsh (lhy) w rwzy rzshmndy st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! wrd khnhhyy jz khnhhy khwd nshwyd, t jzh bgyryd, w br hl an (khnh) slm khnyd, yn bry shm bhtr st, bshd khh pnd gyryd.
ps gr khsy dr an (khnh) nyftyd, wrd nshwyd, t bh shm jzh ddh shwd, w gr bh shm gfth shd: <<bz grdyd>> ps bz grdyd, khh an bry shm pkhyzhtr st, w llh bh anchh njm mydhyd; dnst.
w br shm gnhy nyst khh wrd khnhhyy Gyr mskhwny bshwyd, khh dr an mt`y dryd, w llh mydnd anchh r ashkhr myszyd w anchh r pnhn mykhnyd.
(y pymbr!) bh mrdn mw'mn bgw chshmhy khwd r (z ngh bh nmHrm) frw gyrnd, w shrmghshn r HfZ khnnd, yn (khr) bry anh pkhyzhtr st, bygmn llh bh anchh njm mydhnd; agh st.

w bh znn mw'mn bgw chshmhy khwd r (z ngh bh nmHrm) frw gyrnd, w shrmghshn r HfZ khnnd, w zynt khwd r ashkhr nkhnnd; jz anchh z an khh (Tb`an khwdsh) nmyn st, w byd (Trf) mqn`hhy khwd r br grybnhyshn byfkhnnd (t chhrh w grdn w synh b an pwshydh grdd) w zynt khwd r ashkhr nsznd; mgr bry shwhrnshn, y pdrnshn, y pdr shwhrnshn, y psrnshn y psrn shwhrnshn, y brdrnshn y psrn brdrnshn, y psrn khwhrnshn y znn (hm khysh) shn y brdgnshn y mrdn (sfyh) khdmtkhry khh rGbty (bh znn) ndrnd, y khwdkhnykhh br shrmgh znn aghy nyfthnd, w (znn) nbyd (hngm rh rftn) phy khwd r (bh zmyn) bkhwbnd, t anchh z zyntshn r khh pnhn khrdhnd, dnsth shwd, w y mw'mnn! hmgy bh swy llh twbh khnyd, t rstgr shwyd.

t llh bhtr z anchh njm ddhnd bh anh pdsh dhd, w z fDl khwd br pdsh anh byfzyd, w llh hr khs r khh bkhwhd byHsb rwzy mydhd.

llh shb w rwz r dgrgwn myszd, bygmn dr yn (mr) bry dydhwrn `brty st.

br nbyn gnhy nyst, w br (frd) lng gnhy nyst, w br bymr (nyz) gnhy nyst, w (hmchnyn) br khwd shm gnhy nyst; dr an khh z khnhhy khwd, y khnhhy pdrntn y khnhhy mdrntn y khnhhy brdrntn y khnhhy khwhrntn y khnhhy `mwhytn y khnhhy `mWhhytn y khnhhy dy'yhytn y khnhhy khlhhytn, y khnhy khh khlydsh dr khtyr shmst, y (khnhhy) dwstntn (chyzy) bkhwryd, br shm gnhy nyst khh dsthjm`y y jdgnh (Gdh) bkhwryd, ps hngmykhh bh khnhh wrd shdyd br khwyshtn slm khnyd khh tHyty mbrkh (w) pkhyzh z swy llh (mqrr) st, yn gwnh llh ayt (khwd) r bry shm rwshn mykhnd, bshd khh shm khrd wrzyd.

w khsnykhh khfr shdnd; gftnd: <<yn (qran) jz drwGy nyst khh (khwd) bfth st, w grwhy dygr w r br yn (khr) yry ddhnd>> bh rsty anh (b yn skhnshn) stm w drwG bzrgy r mrtkhb shdhnd.

y gnjy (z asmn) br w fkhndh shwd, w y bGy dshth bshd khh z (mywhhy) an bkhwrd?!>> w stmgrn gftnd: <<shm fqT z mrdy sHr shdh pyrwy mykhnyd>>.

(llh bh anh myfrmyd:) bh rsty (yn m`bwdn) shm r dr anchh mygwyyd; tkhdhyb khrdnd, ps (khnwn) nmytwnyd (`dhb r) brTrf khnyd, w nh (z khsy) yry bjwyyd, w hrkhs z shm khh stm (= shrkh) khnd, `dhb bzrgy bh w mychshnym.
(y pymbr!) pysh z tw hych pymbry r nfrstdym, mgr ynkhh anh hm Gdh mykhwrnd, w dr bzrh rh myrftnd, w m b`Dy z shm r wsylhy azmysh b`Dy dygr qrr ddhym, ay Sbr mykhnyd?! w prwrdgr tw bynst.

gft: <<prwrdgr! bh shkhrnhy n`mty khh br mn `T khrdy, ps hrgz pshtybn mjrmn nkhwhm bwd>>.

ps (mwsy) dr shhr trsn, w chshm bh rhi Hdthh (shb r) SbH nmwd, khh nghn (dyd) hmn khsykhh dyrwz z w yry khwsth bwd, w r fryd myznd (w khmkh mykhwhd) mwsy bh w gft: <<bygmn tw ashkhr (nsn mjr jw w) gmrh hsty>>.

ps hngmykhh (mwsy) khwst bh khsykhh dshmn hr dwy anh bwd, Hmlh brd (w bznd, w fryd zd w) gft: <<y mwsy! ay mykhwhy mr bkhshy hmn gwnh khh dyrwz khsy r khshty?! tw fqT mykhwhy dr zmyn jbWry bshy, w nmykhwhy khh z mSlHn bshy!>>.
w (dr yn hngm) mrdy z dwrtryn nqThy shhr shtbn amd (w) gft: <<y mwsy! hmn bzrgn (w shrf qwm) drbrhy tw mshwrt mykhnnd; t tw r bkhshnd, ps bydrng (z shhr) byrwn shw, bytrdyd mn z khyr khwhn tw hstm>>

ps (mwsy) bry gwsfndn an dw ab dd, sps rw bh syh awrd, angh gft: <<prwrdgr! mn hr khyry khh br mn bfrsty nyzmnd hstm>>.

angh ykhy z an dw (zn) dr Hlykhh b nhyt Hy gm br mydsht, nzd w amd, gft: <<hmn pdrm tw r d`wt mykhnd; t mzd ab ddn (gwsfndn) r khh bry m njm ddy, bh tw bdhd>> ps chwn (mwsy) bh nzd w amd w dstn (srgdhsht khwd) r br w Hkhyt khrd, gft: <<ntrs, z grwh stmkhrn njt yfty>>.
ykhy z an dw (dkhtr) gft: <<pdr jn! w r jyr khn, bytrdyd bhtryn khsy r khh mytwny jyr khny, khsy st khh nyrwmnd myn bshd (w w chnyn st)>>.

(sh`yb) gft: <<mn mykhwhm ykhy z yn dw dkhtr r bh zdwj tw dr bywrm bh shrTykhh hsht sl bry mn khr khny, w gr (an r) t dh sl tmm khny, ps (lTf w) mHbty z swy twst, mn nmykhwhm br tw skhtgyry khnm, gr llh bkhwhd mr z SlHn khwhy yft.
(mwsy) gft: <<yn (qrr dd) myn mn w tw bshd khh hr khdm z yn dw mdt r njm ddm br mn stmy nkhwhd bwd, w llh br anchh mygwyym gwh st>>.

ps hngmykhh mwsy (an) mdt (m`yn) r bh pyn rsnyd, w hmrh khnwdhsh Hrkht khrd, z swy (khwh) Twr atshy dyd; bh khnwdhsh gft: <<drng khnyd, hmn mn atshy dydm, shyd khbry z an bry shm bywrm, y sh`lhy z atsh (bywrm) t shm (b an) grm shwyd>>.
ps hngmykhh bh (nzdykhy) an rsyd, z khrnhy rst wdy dr jygh pr brkht, z (myn) ykh drkht nd ddh shd khh <<y mwsy! yqynan mn llh, prwrdgr jhnynm.
w ynkhh `Syt r byfkhn>>- ps chwn an r dyd khh (b sr`t) myjnbd gwyy khh an mry st, (trsyd w) bh `qb brgsht w psht sr khwd r ngh nkhrd - (llh frmwd:) <<y mwsy! pysh ay, w ntrs, bygmn tw z ymnn hsty.

dstt r dr grybn khwd frw khn, khh sfyd (w drkhshndh) by`yb byrwn byyd, w bzwyt r (bry Hdhr) z trs bh swy khwd (byr w) jm` khn, ps yn dw (m`jzh `S w yd byD) dw brhn (rwshn) z prwrdgrt bh swy fr`wn w shrf (qwm) wst, bygmn anh grwhy fsq hstnd>>.
(mwsy) gft: <<prwrdgr! hmn mn ykh tn z anh r khshthm, ps mytrsm khh mr bkhshnd.
w brdrm hrwn zbnsh z mn fSyHtr st, ps w r hmrh mn bfrst t ywrm bshd w mr tSdyq khnd, zyr khh mytrsm mr tkhdhyb khnnd>>.
(llh) frmwd: <<bh zwdy bzwy tw r b brdrt qwy (w nyrwmnd) khwhym khrd, w bry shm slTh w brtry qrr mydhym, ps bh sbb ayt m, br shm dst nybnd, w shm dw nfr w khsykhh z shm pyrwy khnd; pyrwzyd>>
ps hngmykhh mwsy b ayt rwshn m bh swy anh amd, gftnd: <<yn (chyzy) jz sHr skhtgy nyst, w m chnyn chyzy r dr nykhn pyshynyn khwd nshnydhym>>.

w mwsy gft: <<prwrdgr mn z (Hl) khsykhh hdyt r z nzd w awrdh, w khsykhh srnjm sry (dygr) z ani wst, dntr st, bygmn stmkhrn rstgr nkhwhnd shd>> [ mrd z <<Zlm>> mshrkh w khfr st. chr khh Zlm y`ny gdhshtn chyzy dr jy Gyr mkhtS bh khwd, w mshrkh Zlm shmrdh myshwd chwn khh khsny r dr mqm lwhyt qrr mydhd khh lyq an nyst, w hmchnyn khfr chwn khh z Hqyqt mqm prwrdgr khmlan jhl w nashn mybshd Zlm shmrdh shdhst.].

w fr`wn gft: <<y bzrgn! mn m`bwdy jz khwdm bry shm nmyshnsm, ps y hmn! brym atshy br gil byfrwz (w ajr bpz) angh brym brj blndy bsz, shyd khh z llh mwsy b khbr shwm, w hrchnd mn gmn mykhnm khh w z drwGgwyn st>>.
w w (= fr`wn) w lshkhrynsh bh nHq dr zmyn srkhshy khrdnd, w pndshtnd khh anh bh swy m bz grdndh nmyshwnd.
ps (m) w w lshkhrynsh r frw grftym, angh dr dry ndkhtym, ps bngr `qbt stmkhrn chgwnh bwd?!
w anh r pyshwyny qrr ddym khh bh swy atsh (dwzkh) d`wt mykhnnd, w rwz qymt yry nkhwhnd shd.
dr yn dny l`nty bh dnbl ann rwnh khrdym; w rwz qymt z zsht rwynnd.
w bh rsty b`d z ankhh mthy pyshyn r hlkh nmwdym; bh mwsy khtb (twrt) ddym khh bry mrdm bSyrt w hdyt w rHmt bshd, shyd pnd gyrnd.
w tw (y pymbr!) dr nHyh Grby nbwdy, hngmykhh frmn (nbwt) r bh mwsy ddym w tw z HDrn nbwdy.
w lykhn (m) nslhyy afrydym khh `mr drz yftnd, w tw dr myn hl mdyn qmt ndshty khh ayt m r br anh bkhwny, w lykhn m bwdym khh (pymbrny) myfrstdym.
w tw dr khnr Twr nbwdy angh khh nd ddym, wly yn (w Hy) rHmty z jnb prwrdgrt st; t grwhy r bym dhy khh pysh z tw bymdhndhy bry anh nymdh bwd, shyd khh anh pnd gyrnd.
w gr an nbwd khh bh (sbb) `mlykhh mrtkhb shdhnd; mSybty bh anh brsd, angh bgwynd: <<prwrdgr! chr bh swy m pymbry nfrstdy t z ayt tw pyrwy khnym w z mw'mnn bshym?>>.

ps hngmykhh Hq z nzd m bry anh amd, gftnd: <<chr (bh yn pymbr) mnnd anchh bh mwsy ddh shd, ddh nshdh st?!>> ay bh anchh pysh z yn bh mwsy ddh shd, khfr nwrzydnd? gftnd: <<yn dw (qran w twrt) jdwy t'yyd khnndhy ykhdygrnd>> w gftnd: <<hmn m bh hr khdm (zanh) khfrym>>.

ps gr (yn skhn) tw r npdhyrftnd, bdn khh anh fqT z hwshy khwd pyrwy mykhnnd, w gmrhtr z an khs khh hwy nfs khwysh r bdwn (hych) hdyty z (swy) llh pyrwy mykhnd; khyst?! bygmn llh grwh stmkhrn r hdyt nmykhnd.

khsnykhh pysh z yn (qran) bh ann khtb (asmny) ddhym; bh an ymn myawrnd.
w chwn (qran) br anh khwndh shwd, gwynd: <<bh an ymn awrdym, bytrdyd, yn Hq z swy prwrdgr m st, hmn m pysh z (nzwl) an hm mslmn bwdym>>.

w (mshrkhn) gftnd: <<gr bh hmrh tw z hdyt pyrwy khnym, m r z srzmynmn myrbynd>> ay m (anh r) dr Hrm mny jyshn nddym, khh thmrt (w frawrdhhy) hr chyzy (z hr sw) bh swy an awrdh myshwd, (yn) rzqy st z jnb m, w lykhn byshtr anh nmydnnd.
w chh bsyr z qryhh (w abdyh) yy r khh br thr fzwny n`mt, mst w mGrwr shdh bwdnd; hlkh khrdym, ps yn khnhhy (wyrn shdhy) anhst, khh b`d z anh jz ndkhy (khsy) dr anh skhwnt nkhrd, w m wrth anh bwdym.

(y pymbr!) bgw: <<bh mn khbr dhyd gr llh shb r t rwz qymt br shm pydr szd, khyst m`bwdy jz llh khh bry shm rwshny awrd?! ay nmyshnwyd?!>>.
bgw: <<bh mn khbr dhyd gr llh rwz r t rwz qymt br shm pydr grdnd, khyst m`bwdy jz llh khh bry shm shby awrd khh dr an arm bgyryd?! ay nmybynyd?!
w z rHmt khwysh shb w rwz r bry shm qrr dd, t dr an (= shb) arm bgyryd, w t (dr rwz) z fDl w (rwzy) bjwyyd, w shyd sps gzryd.
w rwzykhh (llh) ann r nd dhd, angh frmyd: <<khj hstnd, shrykhny r khh bry mn mypndshtyd?!>>
w z hr mty gwhy br mygzynym, angh mygwyym: <<dlyl khwd r bywryd>> angh bdnnd khh Hq z an llh st, w (tmm) anchh r ftr mybstnd z (nZr) ann npdyd shwd (w tbh grdd).

w dr anchh llh bh tw ddh, sry akhrt r bjwy w bhrht r z dny frmwsh nkhn [ y`ny dr mbHt dny nyz srf w wlkhrjy nkhn. mbHt dny mnnd khwrdn, nwshydn, lbs, khnh, zdwj w Gyrh. mTlb ynst khh hmchnnkhh bysty Hq prwrdgr r d khrd nyz byd Hq bdn khwd w zn w bchh w mhmnh w Gyrh r d khrd. y`ny byd Hq hr Hqdry r bh jy awrd.], w hmngwnh khh llh bh tw nykhy khrdh st; nykhy khn, w hrgz dr zmyn dr py fsd mbsh, bygmn llh mfsdn r dwst ndrd>>

(qrwn) gft: <<tnh bh sbb dnshy khh nzd mn st an (ml w thrwt) bh mn ddh shdh st>> ay w nmydnst khh llh pysh z w qwmy r hlkh khrd khh z w nyrwmndtr w thrwtmndtr bwdnd?! w mjrmn z gnhnshn prsydh nmyshwnd.
ps (rwzy qrwn) b arysh w zynt khwysh br qwmsh byrwn amd, khsnykhh khwhn zndgy dny bwdnd, gftnd: <<y khsh hmnnd anchh bh qrwn ddh shdh st; m nyz dshtym, bh rsty khh w z bhrhy `Zymy brkhwrdr st>>.
w khsnykhh dnsh bh anh ddh shdh bwd, gftnd: <<wy br shm! thwb llh bry khsykhh ymn awrd w khr shysth njm dhd bhtr st, w an (skhn r khsny) jz Sbrn nmypdhyrnd>>
ps w w khnhsh r dr zmyn frw brdym, w hych grwhy ndsht khh w r dr brbr (`dhb) llh yry khnnd, w khwd (nyz) nmytwnst khwysh r yry khnd.

w khsnykhh dyrwz arzw mykhrdnd bh jy w bshnd, mygftnd: <<wy br m! gwyy llh rwzy r bry hr khs z bndgnsh khh bkhwhd frkh mygrdnd, w (y) tng mygyrd, gr llh br m mnWt nnhdh bwd, bytrdyd m r (nyz bh q`r zmyn) frw mybrd, y wy! gwyy khfrn hrgz rstgr nmyshwnd.
(ary) yn sry akhrt r (fqT) bry khsny qrr mydhym khh nh khwhn brtry jwyy hstnd w nh khwhn fsd, w srnjm nykh bry prhyzgrn st.
khsykhh nykhy awrd, ps bry w pdsh bhtr z an st, w khsykhh bdy awrd, ps khsnykhh bdyh njm ddnd, jz (bhndzhy) anchh mykhrdnd, mjzt nkhwhnd dsht.
bytrdyd khsykhh qran r br tw frD (w nzl) khrd, qT`an tw r bh jyght (= mkhh) bz mygrdnd. bgw: <<prwrdgr mn bhtr mydnd chh khsy hdyt awrdh, w chh khsy dr gmrhy ashkhr st>>.
w tw myd ndshty khh khtb (asmny) br tw lq shwd, jz ynkhh rHmt prwrdgrt bwd, ps hrgz pshtybn khfrn mbsh.
w hrgz (khfrn) tw r z ayt llh, b`d z an khh br tw nzl shd, bz ndrnd, w bhswy prwrdgrt d`wt khn, w hrgz z mshrkhn mbsh.
w m`bwd dygry b llh mkhwn, hych m`bwdy (bh Hq) jz w nyst, hmh chyz jz rwy (= dht) w nbwd myshwd, frmnrwyy (tnh) z ani wst, w (hmh) bhswy w bzgrdndh myshwyd.

w bh rsty khsny r khh pysh z anh bwdnd; azmwdym, ps lbth llh khsny r khh rst gftnd m`lwm mydrd, w drwGgwyn r (nyz) m`lwm khwhd dsht.

w bh rsty bh lqmn Hkhmt ddym, (w bh w gftym) khh: shkhr llh r bh jy awr; w hrkhs shkhr khnd tnh bh swd khwd shkhr khrdh st, w hr khs khh khfrn khnd, ps bytrdyd llh bynyz stwdh st.
w (bh yd awr) hngmy r khh lqmn bh frzndsh dr Hlykhh w r pnd mydd, gft: <<y psrkh mn! bh llh shrkh nywr, bygmn shrkh, stm bzrgy st.

w bh nsn drbrhy pdr w mdrsh sfrsh khrdym, mdrsh w r b ntwny rwy ntwny Hml khrd, w z shyr bz grftnsh dr dw sl st, (ary, sfrsh khrdym) khh bry mn w bry pdr w mdrt shkhr bh jy awr khh bzgsht (hmhy shm) bh swy mn st.

w gr an dw (mshrkh bshnd w) tlsh khnnd khh tw chyzy r khh bh an `lm ndry shrykh mn qrr dhy, ps z ann T`t nkhn, w dr dny b ann bh shystgy rftr khn, w z rh khsy pyrwy khn khh (twbhkhnn) bh swy mn bz amdh st, sps bzgsht (hmhy) shm bh swy mn st, angh shm r z anchh njm myddyd; agh mykhnm.

w b by `tnyy z mrdm rwy mgrdn, w mGrwrnh dr zmyn rh mrw, bygmn llh hych mtkhbr khwdsty r dwst ndrd.
w dr rh rftnt `tdl r r`yt khn, w z Sdy khwd bkhh (w hrgz fryd nzn) zyr zshttryn Sdh; Sdy khrn st.

ay ndydyd khh llh anchh r khh dr asmnh w anchh r khh dr zmyn st; mskhr shm khrdh st, w n`mthy khwd r ashkhr w pnhn (bTwr frwn) br shm rzny dshth st?! w z mrdm khsy hst khh bdwn hych dnsh w hdyt w khtb rwshngry drbrhy llh mjdlh mykhnd.

w hngmykhh bh ann gfth shwd: <<z anchh llh nzl khrdh st; pyrwy khnyd>> gwynd: <<(nh) blkhh m z chyzy pyrwy mykhnym khh nykhn khwd r br an yftym>>. ay Hty gr shyTn ann r bh swy `dhb (atsh) swzn d`wt khnd (bz hm zanh pyrwy mykhnnd?!)
w khsykhh rwy khwysh r tslym llh khnd dr Hlykhh nykhwkhr bshd, bh rsty bh dstgyrhy mHkhmy chng zdh st, w srnjm (hmhy) khrh bh swy llh st.
w khsykhh khfr shwd, ps khfr w tw r Gmgyn nszd, bzgsht (hmhy) ann bh swy mst, ps ann r z anchh njm ddhnd; agh khwhym khrd, bytrdyd llh bh anchh drwn synhhst; dn st.
anh r ndkhy (z mt` dny) bhrhmnd mykhnym, sps anh r bh (tHml) `dhb skhty ngzyr szym.
w gr z anh bprsy: <<chh khsy asmnh w zmyn r afryd?!>> mslman mygwynd: <<llh>>. bgw: <<Hmd w stysh mkhSwSi llh st>> blkhh byshtr anh nmydnnd.

w gr (hmhy) drkhtn rwy zmyn qlm shwd, w dry (mrkhb grdd) w hft dryy dygr bh mdd an byyd, skhnn llh pyn nmyybd, bytrdyd llh pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.
afrynsh w br ngykhtn (hmhy) shm (dr rwz qymt) jz mnnd (afrynsh w zndh khrdn) ykh tn bysh nyst, bygmn llh shnwy bynst.
ay ndydykhh llh shb r dr rwz dkhl mykhnd, w rwz r dr shb dkhl mygrdnd, w khwrshyd w mh r mskhr khrdhkhh hr ykh t zmny m`yn dr Hrkht st, w yqynan llh bh anchh njm mydhyd; agh st.
yn bdn (sbb) st khh llh Hq st, w hmn anchh bh jz w mykhwnnd; bTl st, w hmn llh st khh bl w blnd mrtbhy bzrg st.
ay ndydy khh khshty bh (frmn w) n`mt llh dr dry Hrkht mykhnd, t (llh) bkhshy z nshnhhy khwd r bh shm nshn dhd?! bygmn dr yn bry hr shkhyby spsgzr nshnhhyy st.

w hngmykhh (dr dry) mwjy hmchwn syhbn anh r bpwshnd, llh r b khlS mykhwnnd, ps chwn anh r (b awrdn) bh khshkhy njt dd, angh b`Dy z ann rh `tdl r pysh mygyrnd. (w br ymn w `hd khwd mymnnd, dr Hlykhh b`Dy dygr rh khfr r pysh mygyrnd) w ayt m r hych khs jz pymnshkhnn nsps; nkhr nmykhnd.

y mrdm! z prwrdgrtn btrsyd, w z rwzy btrsyd khh nh pdr khyfr frzndsh r bh `hdh mygyryd, w nh frznd chyzy z khyfr (`ml) pdrsh r `hdh dr myshwd, yqynan w`dhy llh Hq st, ps zndgy dny shm r nfrybd, w (shyTn) frybkhr shm r nsbt bh llh nfrybd.

bygmn `lm (wqw`) qymt nzd llh st, w (w) brn r nzl mykhnd, w anchh r khh dr rHmhst mydnd, w hych khs nmydnd frd chh chyz bh dst myawrd, w hych khs nmydnd khh dr khdm srzmyn mymyrd, yqynan llh dny agh st.
lm (lf. lm. mym)

ay mygwynd: <<(mHmd-Sly llh `lyh wslm-) an r bh drwG bfth st?>> (nh) blkhh an Hq st, z jnb prwdgr twst, t hshdr dhy qwmy r khh pysh z tw hshdr dhndhy bryshn nymdh st, shyd hdyt shwnd.
llh khsy st khh asmnh w zmyn w anchh r myn anhst dr shsh rwz afryd, sps br `rsh qrr grft, shm r jz w hych khr sz w shfy`y nyst, ay pnd nmygyryd?!

angh (ndm) w r smn dd, w z rwH khwd dr an dmyd, w bry shm gwsh w chshmh w dlh qrr dd, chh ndkh sps mygzryd.
w (khfrn) gftnd: <<ay hngmykhh (mrdym w) dr zmyn npdyd shdym, ay dr afrynsh tzhy khwhym bwd?!>> blkhh ann bh dydr prwrdgrshn khfrnd.

w gr bbyny mjrmn r hngmykhh dr pyshgh prwrdgrshn srhyshn bh zyr fkhndhnd, (gwynd:) <<prwrdgr! dydym, w shnydym, ps m r bzgrdn t khr shysthy njm dhym, bygmn m (bh qymt) yqyn drym>>
w gr mykhwstym bh hrkhs hdytsh r myddym, w lykhn skhn (w w `dhy) mn Hq st khh jhnm r z jnyn w admyn hmgy pur mykhnm.
ps bh khyfr ankhh dydr mrwztn r frmwsh khrdyd, (`dhb r) bchshyd, bygmn m (nyz) shm r frmwsh khrdym. w `dhb jwdn r bkhTr `mlykhh njm myddyd; bchshyd.
tnh khsny bh ayt m ymn myawrnd khh chwn bh an pnd ddh shwnd, sjdhkhnn (bh zmyn) ftnd, w prwrdgrshn r bh pkhy bstynd, w ann tkhbr nmykhnnd.
phlwhyshn z bstrh (dr dl shb) dwr myshwd, prwrdgrshn r b bym w myd mykhwnnd, w z anchh bh anh rwzy ddhym nfq mykhnnd.
ps hych khs nmydnd chh pdshhy (`Zymy) khh myhy rwshny chshmhst bry anh nhfth shdh st, bh (ps) anchh khh (dr dny) njm myddnd.

m khsnykhh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd, ps bry anh bGhy bhsht jwydn khwhd bwd, (yn bh `nwn) mHl pdhyryy (z anh) st; bh pdsh anchh khh njm myddnd.
w m khsnykhh fsq shdnd, ps jyghshn atsh (jhnm) st, hrgh khh bkhwhnd z an khrj shwnd, bh an bz grdndh shwnd, w bh anh gfth shwd: <<bchshyd `dhb atshy r khh an r tkhdhyb mykhrdyd>>.

bh rsty bh mwsy khtb (twrt) ddym, ps (y pymbr grmy!) z dydr w (= mwsy) dr shkh w trdyd mbsh w m an (twrt) r (wsylhy) hdyt bry bny sry'yl qrr ddym.

mslman prwrdgr twst khh dr rwz qymt myn anh dr anchh khtlf mykhrdnd; dwry mykhnd.

w gwynd: <<gr rstgwyyd, yn pyrwzy khy khwhd bwd?!>>
bgw: <<rwz pyrwzy (hngm nzwl `dhb y rwz qymt), khsnykhh khfr shdnd; ymn shn swdy nkhwhd dsht, w nh bh anh mhlt ddh myshwd>>.
sps (y pymbr!) z anh rwy bgrdn, w mntZr bsh khh anh (nyz) mntZr hstnd.

t (llh) rstgwyn r z Sdqshn bprsd, w bry khfrn `dhby drdnkh amdh khrdh st.

hngmykhh anh (= dshmnn dr Gzwhy Hzb) z (smt) bly (shhr) shm w z (smt) pyyn (shhr) tn bh swy shm amdnd (w shm r mHSrh khrdnd) w zmny r khh chshmh (z shdt w Hsht) khyrh shd, w dlh bh Hnjrhh rsyd, w gmn hy gwngwny bh llh mybrdyd.
anj bwd khh mw'mnn azmysh shdnd w bh skhty tkhn khwrdnd.

w gr (lshkhr dshmnn) z Trf mdynh br ann wrd myshdnd (w khnhhyshn r mHSrh mykhrdnd) sps pyshnhd bzgsht bh khfr w shrkh (bh anh) mykhrdnd, qT`an mypdhyrftnd, w jz ndkhy bry (ntkhb) an drng nmykhrdnd.

(y pymbr!) bgw: <<gr z mrg y khshth shdn frr khnyd, hrgz frr swdy bh Hl shm nkhwhd dsht, w angh jz ndkhy (z zndgy dny) bhrhmnd nkhwhyd shd>>.
(y pymbr!) bgw: <<chh khsy st khh shm r z (rdhy) llh HfZ mykhnd, gr (w) bry shm bdy rdh khrdh bshd, y rHmty bry shm rdh khrdh bshd?!>> w anh bry khwd jz llh hych dwst w ywry nkhwhnd yft.
qT`an llh bz drndgn r (z jhd) z shm, w ann r khh bh brdrnshn gftnd: <<bh swy m byyyd>> w jz ndkhy bh khrzr nmyaynd; myshnsd.

(dr Hlykhh) anh br shm bkhl mywrznd, ps hngmykhh (zmn) trs (pysh) ayd, mybyny khh bh tw ngh mykhnnd, dr Hlykhh chshmhyshn (dr Hdqh) mychrkhd, mnnd khsykhh z (skhrt) mrg by hwsh shdh bshd, ps chwn trs (w wHsht) br Trf shd, shm r b zbnhy tyz (w tnd khwd) myrnjnnd, dr Hlykhh br ml (Gnym) skht HryS w azmndnd, ynn (hrgz) ymn nywrdhnd, ldh llh `mlshn r tbh (w nbwd) khrd, w yn (khr) br llh asn st.

anh gmn mykhnnd khh (lshkhryn) Hzb (hnwz) nrfthnd, w gr (lshkhryn) Hzb (br dygr) br grdnd, arzw mykhnnd, y khsh! ann dr myn `rb bdyhnshyn bwdnd, khh z khbr shm jwy myshdnd, w gr dr myn shm bshnd; jz ndkhy pykhr nkhnnd.

w chwn mw'mnn (lshkhr) Hzb r dydnd, gftnd: <<yn hmn chyzy st khh llh w pymbrsh bh m w`dh ddh, w llh w pymbrsh rst gfthnd>> w (yn mr) jz br ymn w tslymshn nyfzwd.

z mw'mnn mrdny hstnd khh bh `hd w pymny khh b llh bsth bwdnd (Sdqnh) wf khrdnd, ps khsy z ann hst khh pymn khwd r bh akhr rsnd (w shhyd shd) w z ann khsy hst khh dr ntZr (w chshm brh) st, w hrgz tGyyr w tbdyly (dr pymn khwd) nywrdhnd.
t llh rstgwyn r bh (khTr) Sdqshn pdsh dhd, w mnfqn r gr bkhwhd `dhb khnd, y twbhy anh r bpdhyrd, bytrdyd llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

w (llh) khsny z hl khtb (= yhwd bny qryZh) r khh z anh (= mshrkhn) Hmyt khrdh bwdnd; z ql`hhyshn frwd awrd, w dr dlhy shn w Hsht ndkht, (w shm) grwhy r mykhshtyd w grwhy r syr mygrftyd.

w gr shm llh w pymbrsh w sry akhrt r mykhwhyd, ps (bdnyd khh) llh bry nykhwkhrntn pdsh `Zymy amdh khrdh st>>.

w hr khs z shm bry llh w pymbrsh khDw` (w frmnbrdry) khnd, w `ml SlH njm dhd, pdsh w r dwbr bh w khwhym dd, w rwzy rzshmndy bry w amdh khrdhym.

w anchh r dr khnhhytn z ayt llh w Hkhmt (= snt pymbr) khwndh myshwd yd khnyd; bygmn llh brykhbyn agh st.

hmn mrdn mslmn w znn mslmn, mrdn mw'mn w znn mw'mn, mrdn frmnbrdr w znn frmnbrdr, mrdn rstgw w znn rstgw, mrdn Sbr w znn Sbr, mrdn b khshw` w znn b khshw`, mrdn Sdqh dhndh w znn Sdqh dhndh, mrdn rwzh dr w znn rwzh dr, mrdnykhh shrmgh khwd r HfZ mykhnnd, w znnykhh shrmgh khwd r HfZ mykhnnd, w mrdnykhh llh r bsyr yd mykhnnd, w znnykhh llh r bsyr yd mykhnnd, llh bry (hmhy) ann amrzsh w pdsh `Zymy amdh khrdh st.
w hych mrd mw'mn w zn mw'mny r nszd; hngmykhh llh w pymbrsh khry r Hkhm khnd, ankhh anh dr khrshn khtyry bshd, w hrkhs llh w pymbrsh r nfrmny khnd, bh rstykhh dr gmrhy ashkhry grftr shdh st.

w (bh yd bywr) zmny r khh bh an khskhh llh bh w n`mt ddh bwd, w tw (nyz) bh w n`mt ddh bwdy, mygfty: <<hmsrt r ngh dr w z llh btrs>> w dr dl khwd chyzy r pnhn mydshtykhh llh an r ashkhr mykhnd, w z mrdm mytrsydy; dr Hlykhh llh szwrtr stkhh z w btrsy, ps chwn zyd (bn Hrthh -rDy llh `nh-) z w Hjt khwysh bgzrd, (w Tlqsh dd) w r bh zdwj tw dr awrdym; t br mw'mnn dr (brhy zdwj b) znn psr khwndgnshn hych Hrjy nbshd; hngmykhh Hjt khwysh z w bgzrdh (w Tlqshn ddh) bshnd, w frmn llh njm shdny st.
br pymbr dr anchh llh bry w Hll (w mqrr) khrdh st; hych Hrjy nyst, yn snt llh st dr (brhy) khsnykhh pysh z yn bwdhnd, w frmn llh Hsb shdh w dqyq st.
(hmn) khsnykhh pymhy llh r myrsnnd w z w mytrsnd w z hych khs jz w nmytrsnd, w llh bry Hsbgry (`mlshn) khfy st.
mHmd ( Sly llh `lyh wslm) pdr hychykh z mrdn shm nyst, w lykhn rswl llh w khtm pymbrn st, w llh bh hr chyz agh st.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! llh r bsyr yd khnyd.
w SbH w shm w r tsbyH gwyyd.
w khsy st khh br shm drwd myfrstd, w frshtgnsh (nyz br shm drwd myfrstnd) t shm r z trykhyh bh swy nwr byrwn brd, w (llh) nsbt bh mw'mnn mhrbn st.
tHyt ann dr rwzykhh b w dydr mykhnnd <<slm>> st, w bry anh pdsh rzshmndy amdh khrdh st.

w d`wt khnndh bh swy llh bh frmn w, w chrGy rwshny bkhsh qrr ddym.
w mw'mnn r bshrt dh khh bry anh z swy llh fDl bzrgy st.
w z khfrn w mnfqn T`t mkhn, w azrshn r w gdhr (w bh ann `tny nkhn) w br llh twkhl khn, w llh (bh `nwn) khrsz (w mdf`) bsndh st.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! hngmykhh b znn b ymn zdwj khrdyd, angh pysh z ankhh b anh hmbstry khnyd, Tlqshn ddyd, ps `dhy bry shm br anh nyst khh shm an r bshmryd, ldh anh r (b hdyhy mnsb) bhrhmnd szyd w bh nykhwtryn wjh rhyshn khnyd.

y pymbr! m hmsrnt r khh mhrshn r prdkhthy bry tw Hll khrdym, w (nyz) khnyzny r khh (z Tryq Gnym jngy) llh bh tw rzny dshth st, w dkhtrn `mwyt, w dkhtrn `mhhyt w dkhtrn dyyt, w dkhtrn khlhhyt khh b tw hjrt khrdhnd, (zdwj b anh bry tw Hll khrdhym) w (nyz) zn mw'mny r khh gr khwd r bh pymbr bbkhshd, gr pymbr bkhwhd w r bh zny gyrd, (yn Hkhm) wyjhy twst; nh dygr mw'mnn, bh rsty khh m mydnym anchh r khh br anh dr (brhy) hmsrnshn w khnyznshn wjb khrdhym, t br tw hych Hrjy nbshd, w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

(nwbt) hr ykh z hmsrnt r khh bkhwhy (mytwny) bh t'khyr ndzy, w hrkhdm r bkhwhy nzd khwd jy dhy, w gr (b`Dy) z anh khh br khnr skhthy bkhwhy nzd khwd jy dhy, hych gnhy br tw nyst, yn (gzynsh) nzdykhtr st bry ankhh chshm ann rwshn grdd w ynkhh Gmgyn nbshnd, w hmgyshn bh anchh bh ann mydhy khshnwd grdnd, w llh anchh r khh dr dlhy shmst mydnd, w llh dny brdbr st.

b`d z yn, (dygr) hych zny bry tw Hll nyst, w nh (Hll st) ankhh hmsrn dygry jygzyn anh khny, hr chnd zybyy anh tw r bh shgft awrd, mgr anchhkhh (bSwrt khnyz) dst tw mlkh shd, w llh br hmh chyz nghbn st.

y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! bh khnhhy pymbr dkhl nshwyd; mgr ankhh bry (Srf) Gdh bh shm jzh ddh shwd, byankhh mntZr pkhth shdnsh bshyd, wly chwn d`wt shdyd, dkhl shwyd, ps hngmykhh Gdh khwrdyd; prkhndh shwyd, w (b`d z Srf Gdh) bry bHth w gftgw nnshynyd, bygmn yn (`ml) pymbr r azr mydhd, ps (w) z shm shrm mykhnd (w chyzy nmygwyd) w llh z (byn) Hq shrm nmykhnd, w hngmykhh chyzy (z wsyl zndgy bh `ryt) khwstyd, ps z ann (= znn pymbr) z psht prdh bkhwhyd, yn (khr) bry dlhy shm w dlhy ann pkhyzhtr st, w shm r nszd khh pymbr llh r byzryd, w nh ankhh hmsrnsh r b`d z w hrgz bh hmsry gyryd, bytrdyd yn (khr) nzd llh (gnhy) bzrg st.
gr chyzy r ashkhr khnyd y an r pnhn dryd, ps bygmn llh bh hr chyz agh st.

br ann (= znn) gnhy nyst (khh) dr (HDwr) pdrnshn w psrnshn w brdrnshn w psrn brdrnshn w psrn khwhrnshn w znn (hm dyn) shn w brdgnshn (bdwn Hjb bshnd) w (y znn!) z llh btrsyd, qT`an llh br hmh chyz gwh st.
bygmn llh w frshtgnsh br pymbr drwd myfrstnd; y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! br w drwd frstyd, w slm bgwyyd, slmy nykhw.
hmn khsnykhh llh w pymbrsh r azr mydhnd, llh anh r dr dny w akhrt l`nt khrdh, w bry anh `dhb khwrkhnndhy amdh khrdh st.
w khsnykhh mrdn mw'mn w znn mw'mn r by hych gnhykhh mrtkhb shdh bshnd; azr mydhnd, bh rsty (br) bhtn w gnh ashkhry r bh dwsh khshydhnd.

y pymbr! bh hmsrnt w dkhtrnt w znn mw'mnn bgw: <<chdrhy khwd r br khwysh frw fkhnnd, (w b an sr w Swrt w synhhyshn r bpwshnnd) yn mnsbtr st t shnkhth shwnd; ps mwrd azr qrr ngyrnd, w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
gr mnfqn w khsnykhh dr dlhy shn bymry st, w shy`h prkhnn dr mdynh (z khr khwd) bz nystnd, yqynan tw r br (Dd) anh myshwrnym (w br anh mslT mygrdnym) sps jz ndkhy dr khnr tw dr an (shhr mdynh) nbshnd.
Trd shdgnnd, hr khj yft shwnd, grfth khwhnd shd, w bh skhty khshth khwhnd shd.
(yn)snt llh st dr (brhy) khsnykhh pysh z yn gdhshtnd, w hrgz bry snt llh dgrgwny nkhwhy yft.
(y pymbr!) mrdm tw r z (zmn qym) qymt myprsnd, bgw: <<`lm an tnh nzd llh st>> w tw chh mydny shydkhh qymt nzdykh bshd.
bytrdyd llh khfrn r l`nt khrdh, w bry anh atsh swzn amdh khrdh st.
khh jwdnh dr an khwhnd mnd, hych dwst w ywry nkhwhnd yft.
rwzykhh Swrthyshn dr atsh (jhnm) grdnydh shwd (pshymn myshwnd w) mygwynd: <<y khsh llh r T`t khrdh bwdym, w rswl (llh) r T`t khrdh bwdym>>
w gftnd: <<prwrdgr! m z srwrn w bzrgn khwd T`t khrdym, ps m r z rh bh dr brdnd (w gmrh khrdnd)
prwrdgr! anh r z `dhb dw chndn dh, w anh r bh l`nty bzrg (w skht) l`nt frm>>
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! mnnd khsny nbshyd khh mwsy r azr ddnd, angh llh w r z anchh (dr Hq w) gfth bwdnd; mbWr skht, w (w) nzd llh abrwmnd (w SHb mnzlt) bwd.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! z llh btrsyd, w skhn drst (w Hq) bgwyyd.
t (llh) khrhytn r brytn SlH khnd, w gnhntn r bymrzd, w hrkhskhh z llh w pymbrsh T`t khnd; yqynan bh khmyby `Zymy ny'l shdh st.
hmn m mnt (khwysh) r br asmnh w zmyn w khwhh `rDh dshtym, ps anh z tHml an sr bz zdnd w z an trsydnd, w nsn an r br dwsh grft khh w bsyr stmkhr ndn st.
t (srnjm) llh mrdn mnfq w znn mnfq w mrdn mshrkh w znn mshrkh r `dhb khnd, w llh twbhy mrdn mw'mn w znn mw'mn r bpdhyrd (w z gnhnshn dr gdhrd) w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.
Hmd (w stysh) mkhSwSllhi st khh anchh dr asmnh w anchh dr zmyn st z ani wst, w stysh dr (sry) akhrt (nyz) z ani wst, w w Hkhym agh st.
anchh r khh dr zmyn frw myrwd w anchh r khh z an byrwn myayd, w anchh r khh z asmn nzl myshwd w anchh r khh dr an bl myrwd; mydnd, w w mhrbn amrzndh st.

w khsnykhh khfr shdnd, gftnd: <<qymt bh srG m nkhwhd amd>> (y pymbr!) bgw: <<ary, bh prwrdgrm (an) dny Gyb swgnd khh Htman bh srG shm khwhd amd, bhndzhy dhrhy dr asmnh w dr zmyn z w pnhn nyst, w nh khwchkhtr z an w nh bzrgtr, mgr (ynkhh) dr khtby ashkhr (thbt) st.
t khsny r khh ymn awrdhnd w khrhy shysth njm ddhnd; pdsh dhd, ann bryshn mGfrt w rwzy rzshmndy st.
w khsnykhh mbrzhkhnn dr (nkhr) ayt m tlsh khrdnd (w gmn khrdnd khh m r bh stwh myawrnd) bry ann `dhby z khyfr drdnkh khwhd bwd.
w khsnykhh bh yshn `lm ddh shdh st; mydnnd anchh r khh z swy prwrdgrt br tw nzl shdh, Hq st, w bh rh (llh) pyrwzmnd stwdh hdyt mykhnd.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd, gftnd: <<ay mrdy bh shm nshn dhym khh bh shm khbr mydhd hngmykhh (mrdyd w) khmlan mtlshy (w prkhndh) shdyd, hmn shm (br dygr) dr afrynsh tzhy khwhyd bwd?!
ay br llh drwG bsth y bh w dywngy st?!>> (chnyn nyst) blkhh khsnykhh bh akhrt ymn nmyawrnd dr `dhb w gmrhy dwr w drzy hstnd.

ay bh anchh pysh rwy w anchh psht sr ann z asmn w zmyn st, ngh nkhrdhnd?! gr bkhwhym anh r dr zmyn frw mybrym, y tkhhy z asmn r br (sr) ann myfkhnym, bygmn dr yn nshnhy bry hr bndhy bzgsht khnndhy st.
w bh rsty (m) bh dwwd z swy khwd fDylty (bzrg) ddym, (gftym:) y khwhh w y prndgn! b w (dr tsbyH gftn) hm awz shwyd, w ahn r bry w nrm khrdym.
(w bh w dstwr ddym) khh zrhhy blnd (w frkh) bsz w dr bftn (Hlqhh) ndzh ngh dr, w khr shysth njm dhyd, hmn mn bh anchh njm mydhyd; byn hstm.

w bry slymn bd r (mskhr skhtym) khh SbHghn msyr ykh mh r Ty mykhrd, w shmghn msyr ykh mh r, w chshmhy ms (mdhb) r brysh rwn skhtym, w z jn khsny r (mskhr khrdym) khh bh frmn prwrdgrsh dr pysh w khr mykhrdnd, w hr khh z ann khh z frmn m srpychy mykhrd, w r z `dhb atsh swzn mychshndym.

ps chwn mrg r br w (= slymn) mqrr dshtym, (khsy) anh r z mrgsh agh nskht; mgr jnbndhy zmyn (= mwrynh) khh `Sysh r mykhwrd, ps chwn (br zmyn) ftd, jnyn dryftnd khh gr Gyb mydnstnd dr (an) `dhb khwr khnndh nmymndnd.
hmn bry (qwm) sb dr mskhnshn nshnhy bwd, dw bG (bzrg) z rst w chp, (w bh anh gftym:) z rwzy prwrdgrtn bkhwryd w bry w shkhr gzryd, shhry st pkhyzh, w prwrdgry amrzndh.
ps anh rwy grdndnd, angh syly wyrngr r branh frstdym, w dw bG (pr mywh) shn r bh dw bG (by rzsh) b mywhhy tlkh w (drkhtn) shwrhgz w ndkhy z (drkht) khnr mbWdl skhtym.
yn khyfr r bh (khTr) ankhh n spsy khrdnd; bh anh ddym, w ay jz n spsn r mjzt mykhnym?!
w myn anh w qryhhyy khh brkht ddh bwdym, qryhhyy (abd w) bh hm pywsth (br sr rh) qrr ddym, w dr (myn) anh amd w rft mqrr dshtym (w bh ann gftym:) dr yn (abdyh) b mn (w mn) shbh w rwzh sfr khnyd.

ps gftnd: <<prwrdgr! myn sfrhy m dwry byfkhn>> w br khwyshtn stm khrdnd, ps m anh r dstnhyy (bry `brt dygrn) qrr ddym, w ann r skht prkhndh (w mtlshy) skhtym, bygmn dr yn (mjr) bry hr Sbr khnndhy spsgzry nshnhhyy st.
w yqynan blys gmn khwd r drbrhy anh drst yft, ps (hmgy) z w pyrwy khrdnd; jz grwhy (ndkh) z mw'mnn.
w w (= shyTn) r br ann hych slThy nbwd; mgr ynkhh (khwstym) m`lwm bdrym khsy r khh bh akhrt ymn myawrd, z khsykhh w z an dr shkh (w trdyd) st. w prwrdgr tw br hmh chyz nghbn st.

(y pymbr!) bgw: <<khsny r khh Gyr z llh (m`bwd khwd) mypndryd, (bh fryd) bkhwnyd, (anh) hmwzn dhrhy dr asmnh w dr zmyn mlkh nystnd, w dr (afrynsh w tdbyr) an dw hych shrkhty ndrnd, w w (= llh) z myn anh ywr w pshtybny ndrd.

w shf`t nzd w swd nbkhshd; mgr bry khsykhh (w khwd) brysh jzt ddh bshd, t zmnykhh DTrb (w ngrny) z dlhy shn br Trf shwd, gwynd: <<prwrdgrtn chh gft?>> gwynd: <<Hq r (frmwd), w w bl w blnd mrtbhy bzrg st>>
(y pymbr! bh mshrkhn) bgw: <<chh khsy shm r z asmnh w zmyn rwzy mydhd?>> (dr pskh) bgw: <<llh, w m y shm br (Tryq) hdyt y dr gmrhy ashkhr hstym>>.
bgw: <<shm z gnhykhh m mrtkhb shdhym; bz khwst nmyshwyd, w m (nyz) z anchh shm njm mydhyd; bz khwst nmyshwym>>.
bgw: << prwrdgr m, (hmhy) m (w shm) r grd myawrd; sps dr myn m bh Hq dwry mykhnd, w w dwr dnst>>.
bgw: <<khsny r khh bh `nwn shrykh bh w mlHq skhthyd; bh mn nshn dhyd, (hrgz) chnyn nyst, blkhh w llh pyrwzmndi Hkhym st.
w (y pymbr!) m tw r bry hmhy mrdm; jz bshrtdhndh w bymdhndh nfrstdym, w lykhn byshtr mrdm nmydnnd.

(y pymbr!) gr bbyny (dr rwz qymt) hngmykhh stmkhrn dr pyshgh prwrdgrshn (bry Hsbrsy) ngh dshth shdhnd, (z Hl anh bh shgft myayy) brkhy z anh skhn brkhy dygr r pskh mydhnd (w hr khdm gnh khwd r bh grdn dygry myndzd) khsnykhh bh stD`f khshydh shdhnd, bh khsnykhh stkhbr (w srkhshy) nmwdnd, gwynd: <<gr shm nbwdyd m qT`an mw'mn bwdym>>.

khsnykhh srkhshy (w tkhbr) khrdnd (= mstkhbrn) bh khsnykhh bh stD`f khshydh shdhnd, (= mstD`fn) gwynd: <<ay m shm r z hdyt bz dshtym b`d z ankhh bh srG shm amd?! (hrgz nh) blkhh shm khwd mjrm bwdyd>>.

w mstD`fn bh mstkhbrn gwynd: <<blkhh, mkhr w Hylhy shb w rwz shm (sbb shd khh z hdyt bzmnym) hngmykhh bh m dstwr myddyd khh bh llh khfr shwym w bry w hmtyny qrr dhym>>. w hngmykhh `dhb (lhy) r bbynnd, pshymny (khwd) r (dr dl) pnhn drnd, w m Glh dr grdnhy khsnykhh khfr shdnd; bgdhrym, ay jz anchh `ml mykhrdnd, bh anh jz ddh myshwd?!
m dr hych qryhy hshdrdhndhy nfrstdym; mgr ynkhh mtn`Wmn anh (khh mst nz w n`mt w qdrt bwdnd) gftnd: <<bytrdyd m bh anchh frstdh shdhyd; khfrym>>.

(y pymbr!) bgw: <<bygmn prwrdgrm rwzy r bry hr khskhh bkhwhd frkh w (y) tng mykhnd, (w yn nshnhy mHbt w rDyt llh nyst) w lykhn byshtr mrdm nmydnnd>>.

w mwltn w wldtn chyzy nystnd khh shm r nzd m nzdykh w mqWrb sznd, jz khsnykhh ymn awrdnd w `ml SlH njm ddnd, ps ynn pdsh mD`f dr brbr khrhykhh njm ddhnd; drnd, w anh dr Grfhhy (blnd bhshty) dr mn w (mn) hstnd>>.

(y pymbr!) bgw: <<bygmn prwrdgrm rwzy r bry hrkhskhh bkhwhd frkh mygrdnd, w (y) bry w tng (w mHdwd) myszd, w hr chyzy r (dr rh llh) nfq khnyd, ps w `wD an r mydhd, w w bhtryn rwzy dhndgn st>>.

(frshtgn) gwynd: <<tw mnzhy! (tnh) tw wly (w khr sz) m hsty, nh anh, (ann hrgz m r prstsh nmykhrdnd) blkhh jn (w shyTyn) r prstsh mykhrdnd, byshtrshn bh anh ymn dshtnd>>.
ps mrwz brkhy z shm bry brkhy dygr mlkh hych swd w zyny nyst, w bh khsnykhh stm (= shrkh) khrdnd, mygwyym: <<bchshyd `dhb atshy r khh an r tkhdhyb mykhrdyd>>.

w hngmykhh ayt rwshn (w wDH) m br ann khwndh shwd, gwynd: <<yn (mHmd Sly llh `lyh wslm) jz mrdy nyst khh mykhwhd shm r z anchh nykhntn myprstydnd; bz drd>> w gwynd: <<yn (qran) jz drwG bzrgykhh bh hm bfth shdh nyst>>. w khsnykhh khfr shdnd, hngmykhh Hq bh srG anh amd, drbrhy an gftnd: <<yn (qran) jz sHry ashkhr nyst>>.
w m (pysh z yn) chyzy z khtbhy (asmny) r bh anh nddhym khh an r bkhwnnd (w br ss an tw r tkhdhyb khnnd) w pysh z tw hych hshdrdhndhy bh swy anh nfrstdym.
w khsnykhh pysh z anh bwdnd (nyz pymbrn m r) tkhdhyb khrdnd, dr Hlykhh ynh bh ykh dhm anchh bh anh ddh bwdym; nrsydhnd, angh anh pymbrn mr tkhdhyb khrdnd, (bngr) mjzt mn chgwnh bwd?!

(y pymbr!) bgw: <<hmn mn shm r bh ykh (khSlt) ndrz mydhm, khh: dw nfr dw nfr y ykh nfr ykh nfr bry llh br khyzyd, sps byndyshyd khh yn hmnshyn shm (= mHmd Sly llh `lyh wslm) hychgwnh dywngy ndrd, w bry shm jz hshdrdhndhy pyshpysh `dhb shdyd nyst>>.
(y pymbr!) bgw: <<hr mzdykhh z shm khwsthm; ps an bry khwd shm bd, pdsh mn tnh br (`hdhy) llh st, w w br hmh chyz gwh st>>.
(y pymbr!) bgw: <<bygmn prwrdgrm Hq r (br qlb pymbrn khwd) myfkhnd, (an prwrdgrykhh) dny Gybhst>>.
(y pymbr!) bgw: <<Hq amd, w (m`bwdn) bTl nh (afrynsh r) aGz mykhnd, w nh (dwbrh) bz mygrdnd>>.
(y pymbr!) bgw: <<gr mn gmrh shwm, tnh br zyn khwdm gmrh myshwm, w gr hdyt ybm, ps bh (khTr) an chyzy st khh prwrdgrm bh mn wHy mykhnd, yqynan w shnwy nzdykh st>>.

ps shm hr chh r khh mykhwhyd bh jy w prstsh khnyd. bgw: <<bygmn zynkhrn (wq`y) khsny nd khh khwd w khndnshn r dr rwz qymt z dst ddhnd, agh bshyd yn hmn zyn ashkhr st.
bry anh z bly (sr) shn sybnhyy z atsh, w dr zyr (py) shn (nyz) sybnhyy st, yn (chyzy) st khh llh b an bndgnsh r mytrsnd, y bndgn mn! z mn btrsyd.
w khsnykhh z TGwt (= shyTn w bth) jtnb khrdnd z ankhh an r `bdt khnnd, w rw bh swy llh awrdnd, bry ann bshrt st, ps bndgn mr bshrt dh.

ay (tw mytwny) khsy r khh frmn `dhb br w tHqq yfth st (njt dhy?!) ay tw (my twny) khsy r khh dr atsh st njt dhy?!
lkhn bry khsnykhh z prwrdgrshn trsydnd, Grfhhyy (dr bhsht) st, khh br frz anh Grfhhy dygr bn shdh st, w z zyr anh nhrh jry st, (yn) w`dhy llh st (w) llh w`dhy khwd r khlf nmykhnd.

ay ndydy khh llh z asmn aby r nzl khrd, ps an r bSwrt chshmhhyy dr zmyn bh jryn dr awrd, sps b an khsht w zr`y khh rnghy gwngwn drd byrwn myawrd, angh khshkh myshwd, w an r zrd mybyny, sps an r (ryzh ryzh w) drhm myshkhnd?! bygmn dr yn (mr) pndy bry khrdmndn st.

w frshtgn r mybyny khh br grd `rsh Hlqh zdhnd bh stysh prwrdgrshn tsbyH mygwynd, w dr myn mrdm bh Hq dwry myshwd, w gfth shwd: <<Hmd w stysh mkhSwS llh prwrdgr jhnyn st>>.

(mygwynd:) <<prwrdgr! rHmt w `lm tw hmh chyz r fr grfth st, ps bry khsnykhh twbh khrdhnd, w rh tw r pyrwy khrdhnd, bymrz, w ann r z `dhb dwzkh ngh dr>>.

w khsnykhh khfr shdnd bh khsnykhh ymn awrdnd gftnd: <<gr (yn dyn) bhtr bwd, hrgz anh (dr pdhyrsh an) br m pyshy nmygrftnd>>. w chwn bdn hdyt nshdnd, khwhnd gft: <<yn (ykh) drwG qdym st>>.
w pysh z an, khtb mwsy pyshw w rHmt bwd, w yn (qran) khtby st tSdyq khnndhy (an) khh bh zbn `rby st, t khsnykhh stm khrdnd bym dhd w bry nykhwkhrn bshrty bshd.
bygmn khsnykhh gftnd: <<prwrdgr m llh st, sps stqmt khrdnd, ps br anh trsy nyst w nh anh ndwhgyn shwnd.
anh hl bhshtnd, jwdnh dr an bshnd, (yn) pdsh `mly st khh njm myddnd.

m bh nsn sfrsh khrdym khh bh pdr w mdrsh nykhy khnd, mdrsh w r bh dshwry Hml mykhnd, w bh dshwry br zmyn gdhrd, w dwrn Hml w w z shyr bz grftn w sy mh st [ dr swrhy bqrh mdt rD`t r dw sl byn khrdh st, w dr ynj mdt brdry w rD`t 30 mh byn shdh st, ldh fqh w dnshmndn slmy mygwynd: khmtryn mdt br dry shsh mh mybshd.], t hngmykhh bh khml (twnmndy w) rshdsh brsd, w bh (sn) chhl slgy brsd, gwyd: <<prwrdgr! mr twfyq dh t shkhr n`mtt r khh br mn w br pdr w mdrm rzny dshthy bh jy awrm w khr shysthy njm dhm khh tw z an khshnwd shwy, w frzndnm r SlH grdn, bygmn mn bh swy tw bzgshtm (w twbh nmwdm), w byshkh mn z mslmnnm>>.
anh khsny hstnd khh m nykhwtryn khrshn r mypdhyrym, w z gnhnshn mygdhrym w dr zmrhy hl bhsht hstnd, yn w `dhy rsty st khh w`dh ddh myshdnd.

w khsykhh bh pdr w mdrsh gft: <<f br shm! ay shm bh mn w`dhy mydhyd khh (z gwrm) byrwn awrdh myshwm? dr Hlykhh nslh pysh z mn gdhshthnd?! (w hrgz brngykhth nshdnd) w an dw (= pdr w mdr) llh r bh yry myTlbnd khh: <<wy brtw! ymn bywr, yqynan w `dhy llh Hq st>>, ps (w) mygwyd: <<ynh chyzy jz fsnhhy pyshynyn nyst>>.
anh khsny hstnd khh hmn skhn (= w`dhy `dhb) dr (zmrhy) mthyy khh pysh z anh z jn w ns gdhshthnd, br anh mHqq shdh st, bygmn anh zynkhr bwdnd.
w bry hr ykh (z anh) drjty st bh (Hsb) anchh njm ddhnd, w t llh (pdsh) khrhyshn r bh tmmy bh anh bdhd, w bh anh hych stmy nkhwhd shd.

w rwzykhh khsnykhh khfr shdnd br atsh `rDh khnnd, (w bh anh gfth shwd:) <<dr zndgy dny (n`mthy) pkhyzh (w ldhthy) khwd r z byn brdyd w z anh bhrhmnd shdyd, ps (y khfrn) mrwz bh `dhb khwr khnndh pdshtn mydhnd, (w yn) bh (khTr) grdnkhshy (w stkhbry) khh bh n Hq dr zmyn mykhrdyd, w bh (khTr) nfrmny (w gnhny) khh njm myddyd.

ps hngmykhh an (`dhb) r bh Swrt bry khh rw bh rh w dyhyshn st, dydnd, (khwshHl shdnd) gftnd: <<yn bry st khh br m (brn) mybrd>>. (hwd gft: nh,) blkhh yn hmn (`dhby) st khh dr amdnsh shtb mykhrdyd, bdy st khh `dhb drdnkhy dr an st.
hmh chyz r bh frmn prwrdgrsh (wyrn w) n bwd mykhnd, ps chnn shdnd khh jz khnhhyshn dydh nmyshd, m yn gwnh grwh mjrmn r khyfr mydhym.

bh rsty m bh anh (= qwm `d) chnn (tmkhWn w) qdrty ddym khh bh shm an qdrt (w tmkhn) nddhym w bry anh gwsh w chshmh w dlh qrr ddym. ps gwshhyshn w nh chshmhyshn w nh dlhyshn chyzy (z `dhb lhy) r z anh df` nkhrd (w bh Hlshn swdy nbkhshyd), chwn ayt llh r nkhr mykhrdnd, w (srnjm) anchh r khh bh (mskhrh w) ryshkhnd mygrftnd anh r frw grft.
w bh rsty m qryhh (w abdyh) yy r khh Trf shm bwdhnd hlkh khrdym, w ayt (khwd) r (bh Swrthy) gwngwn (bry anh) byn khrdym, t shyd bz grdnd.
ps chr khsny r khh anh bh jy llh bry (qSd) tqrb (bh khd) m`bwd (khwd) grftnd, yryshn nkhrdnd? blkhh z nZrshn gm shdnd, w yn bwd (ntyjhy) drwGshn, w anchh r ftr mybstnd.

w (byd awr, y pymbr) hngmykhh grwhy z jn r bh swy tw mtwjh skhtym khh qran r bshnwnd, ps chwn nzd w (= pymbr) HDwr yftnd, (bh ykhdygr) gftnd: <<khmwsh bshyd>> angh chwn (tlwt qran) bh pyn rsyd, (hmchwn) bym dhndgny bh swy qwm khwd bzgshtnd.
gftnd: <<y qwm m! yqynan m khtby r shnydym khh b`d z mwsy nzl shdh st khh tSdyq khnndhy (khtbhy) pysh z khwd st, bh swy Hq w bh swy rh rst hdyt mykhnd.
y qwm m! (d`wt, yn) d`wtkhnndhy llh r jbt khnyd, w bh w ymn awryd t (llh) brkhy z gnhntn r bry shm bymrzd, w shm r z `dhby drdnkh pnh dhd.
w hrkhs (d`wt) d`wt khnndhy llh r pskh ngwyd, ps hrgz nmytwnd dr zmyn (z `dhb khd) bgryzd w w r Gyr z llh hych ywry nyst, ann dr gmrhy ashkhry hstnd>>.
ay ndydnd llh~ khh asmnh w zmyn r afrydh st, w dr afrynsh anh (ntwn w) dr mndh nshdh, qdr st br ankhh mrdgn r zndh khnd?! ary, w br hr chyzy twnst.

w (rwz qymt) rwzy (st) khh khsnykhh khfr shdnd (bry `dhb) br atsh `rDh myshwnd, (w bh anh gfth myshwd:) <<ay yn (`dhb) Hq nyst?>> gwynd: <<chr, swgnd bh prwrdgrmn (khh Hq st)>>. gwyd: <<ps bh khTr khfry khh mywrzydyd `dhb r bchshyd>>.

ps (y pymbr) Sbr khn, hmchnnkhh pymbrn wlw l`zm Sbr khrdnd [ pymbrn wlw l`zm pnj tn hstnd: 1 nwH 2 brhym 3 mwsy 4 `ysy 5 mHmd khtm lnby `lyhm lslm. (tfsyr bn khthyr)], w bry (`dhb) anh shtb nkhn, rwzykhh anchh r khh w`dh ddh myshwnd bbynnd, gwyy jz s`ty z rwz (dr dny) drng nkhrdhnd, yn (qran) blGy st, ps ay (qwmy) jz qwm fsq (w nfrmn) hlkh myshwnd?!
khsnykhh khfr shdnd w (mrdm r) z rh llh bzdshtnd, (llh) `ml ann r nbwd khrd.

w khsnykhh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd w bh anchh br mHmd ( Sly llh `lyh wslm) nzl shdh w hmh z swy prwrdgrshn Hq st (nyz) ymn awrdnd, (llh) gnhnshn r z anh dwr skht (w bkhshyd) w khrshn r SlH nmwd.
yn bdn sbb st khh khsnykhh khfr shdnd z bTl pyrwy khrdnd, w hmn khsnykhh ymn awrdnd z Hqy khh z swy prwrdgrshn (nzl shdh) st pyrwy khrdnd, yn gwnh llh bry mrdm mthlhyshn r byn mykhnd.

ps hngmykhh (dr mydn nbrd) b khsnykhh khfr wrzydnd, rwbrw shdyd grdnh (yshn) r bznyd, (w nbrd r dmh dhyd) t hngmykhh (bsyry z) anh r z py dr awrdyd w) khshtyd, ps bnd (syrn) r mHkhm bbndyd, angh ps z an y br ann mnt gdhryd (w azdshn khnyd) y (z ann) fdyh bgyryd (w rhyshn khnyd) t jng br sngyn khwd r (br zmyn) nhd, (Hkhm) yn st, w gr llh mykhwst z anh ntqm mygrft w lykhn (my khwhd) b`Dy z shm r b b`Dy dygr byzmyd, w khsnykhh dr rh llh khshth shdnd, ps (llh) hrgz `ml anh r nbwd nmykhnd.
bh zwdy anh r hdyt mynmyd w (Hl w) khrshn r SlH mykhnd.
w anh r bh bhshty khh (wSfsh) bry anh byn dshth st, wrd mykhnd.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! gr (dyn) llh r yry khnyd, (llh) shm r yry mykhnd w gmhytn r (thbt w) stwr mydrd.
w khsnykhh khfr shdnd, mrg br ann bd! w (llh)`mlshn r nbwd khrd.
yn bdn sbb st khh ann anchh r khh llh nzl khrdh st npsnd dshtnd, ps llh `mlshn r tbh (w nbwd) khrd.
ay dr zmyn syr nkhrdnd t bngrnd `qbt khsnykhh pysh z anh bwdnd chgwnh bwd? llh (mwl w dyrshn r) br srshn wyrn khrd, (w anh r nbwd skht), w bry khfrn (khyfry) mnnd an khwhd bwd.
yn bdn sbb st khh llh ywr (w mwly) khsny st khh ymn awrdnd, w ankhh khfrn (mwl w) ywry ndrnd.

bygmn llh khsny r khh ymn awrdnd w khrhy shysth njm ddnd bh bGhyy (z bhsht) wrd mykhnd khh nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, w khsnykhh khfr shdnd (z mt` dnywy) bhrh mygyrnd w mykhwrnd hmchnnkhh chrpyn mykhwrnd, w atsh (jhnm) jygh ann st.
w chh bsyr shhrhyy khh (mrdm) anh z (mrdmi) shhr tw khh byrwnt khrdhnd, twnmndtr bwdnd, m hlkhshn khrdym, ps hych ywry ndshtnd.
ay khsykhh z swy prwrdgrsh br shywhy rwshny bshd, hmnnd khsy st khh khrdr bd w dr nZrsh arsth shdh w z hwhy (nfsny) khwd pyrwy mykhnnd?!

wSf bhshty khh bh prhyzgrn w`dh ddh shdh, chnyn st khh: dr an nhrhyy z ab (zll) bdbw nshdh, w nhrhyy z shyr khh T`m an dgrgwn ngshth, w nhrhyy z shrb (nb) khh myhy ldht nwshndgn st, w nhrhyy z `sl mSfy wjwd drd, w (nyz) dr an bry anh z hrgwnh mywhh (mhy) st, w (z hmh brtr) amrzshy z swy prwrdgrshn st. (ay ynh) hmnnd khsny hstnd khh hmyshh dr atsh (jhnm) nd, w z ab jwshn nwshndh shwnd khh rwdhhyshn r prh prh (w mtlshy) khnd?

(y pymbr) grwhy z anh(= mnfqn) bh tw gwsh fr mydhnd, t wqty khh z nzdt byrwn rftnd, bh khsnykhh bh ann `lm `T khrdh shdh, (z rwy sthz) mygwynd: <<lan (mHmd- Sly llh `lyh wslm-) chh gft?!>> anh khsny hstnd khh llh br dlhyshn mhr nhdh, w z hwhy (nfsny) khwd pyrwy khrdhnd.
w khsnykhh hdyt yfthnd (llh) br hdytshn fzwd, w bh ann prhyzgry `T frmwd.
ps ay anh (= khfrn) jz yn ntZr drnd khh qymt nghn fr rsd? bh rsty nshnhhysh amdh st, ps chwn fr rsd, pnd grftn (w ymn) shn chh swdy khwhd dsht?!
ps (y pymbr) bdn khh m`bwdy (bh Hq) jz <<llh>> nyst, w bry gnh khwd w bry mrdn w znn mw'mn amrzsh Tlb khn, w llh mHl Hrkht shm w qrr gh shm r mydnd.

wkhsnykhh ymn awrdhnd mygwynd: <<chr swrhy nzl nshdh?! (khh frmn jhd r bdhd?)>>. ps chwn swrhy mHkhm (w rwshn) nzl shwd w dr an (skhn z) jng dhkhr shdh bshd, khsnykhh dr dlhy shn bymry st mybyny khh hmchwn khsykhh dr skhrt mrg (qrr grfth w) byhwsh shdh bshd bh tw ngh mykhnnd, ps [hmyn Hlt] bry ann shysthtr st [ brkhy z mfsryn khlmhy <<'awla~>> r bm`ny: thdyd w w`yd (y`ny wy br ann) tfsyr khrdhnd, m brkhy dygr hmchwn mm bn khthyr an r bm`ny shysthtr, w szwrtr tfsyr nmwdh st.].
frmnbrdry (nmwdn) w skhn nykhw (gftn), ps chwn tSmym qT`y (jhd) grfth shd, gr b llh Sdq bshnd bry anh bhtr st.
ps ay gr bh Hkhwmt rsydyd, jz yn (myd) st khh dr zmyn fsd khnyd, w pywnd khwyshwndntn r bbryd?!
ynn khsny hstnd khh llh l`ntshn khrdh st, ps (gwshhy) ann r khr nmwdh w chshmhyshn r nbyn khrdh st.
ay dr qran tdbWr nmykhnnd y br dlhyshn qflhst?!
bygmn khsnykhh b`d z rwshn shdn (rh) hdyt bry anh, bh psht sr khwd bz gshtnd (w mrtd shdnd) shyTn (`ml zshtshn r) bry anh byrst, w (b arzwhy drz) frybshn dd.
yn bdn sbb st khh anh (=mnfqn) bh khsny (= yhwdyn) khh nsbt bh anchh llh nzl khrdh (z wHy) khrht dshtnd, gftnd: <<m dr prhy z mwr z shm pyrwy mykhnym>> w llh pnhnkhry anh r mydnd.
ps (Hl anh) chgwnh khwhd bwd hngmykhh frshtgn (mrg) jnhyshn r mygyrnd, br chhrhh w pshthyshn myznnd.
yn (khyfr) bdn sbb st khh anh z anchh llh r bh khshm myawrd pyrwy khrdnd, w khshnwdysh r khrht dshtnd, ps (llh) `mlshn r nbwd khrd.
ay khsnykhh dr dlhyshn bymry (nfq) st gmn khrdnd khh llh khynhhyshn r ashkhr nkhwhd khrd?!
w gr m bkhwhym anh r bh tw (y pymbr) nshn mydhym, angh ann r b sym (w qyfh) hyshn bshnsy, w mslman tw ann r dr Trz skhn gftnshn myshnsy, w llh `ml shm r mydnd.
w (hmhy) shm r qT`an azmysh mykhnym t z myn shm mjhdn w Sbrn r m`lwm khnym, w (khbr w) Hwl shm r byzmyym.
bygmn khsnykhh khfr shdnd w (dygrn r) z rh llh bz dshtnd w b`d z ashkhr shdn (rh) hdyt bry anh b pymbr mkhlft wrzydnd, hrgz zyny bh llh nmyrsnnd, w (llh) bh zwdy `mlshn r tbh khwhd khrd.
y khsnykhh ymn awrdhyd! llh r T`t khnyd, w rswl (llh) r T`t khnyd, w `mltn r bTl nkhnyd.
bygmn khsnykhh khfr shdnd w (dygrn r) z rh llh bz dshtnd sps dr Hl khfr mrdnd, ps llh hrgz anh r nkhwhd amrzyd.
ps (y mw'mnn) hrgz (hngm jhd) sst nshwyd, w (dshmnn r) bh SlH w ashty d`wt nkhnyd, dr Hlykhh shm brtr hstyd w llh b shmst, w (chyzy z pdsh) `mltn r nkhwhd khst.
jz yn nyst khh zndgy dny bzy w srgrmy st, w gr ymn bywryd w prhyzgry khnyd (llh) pdshhytn r bh shm khwhd dd, w (tmm) mwltn r z shm nmyTlbd.

agh bshyd, shm hmn khsny hstyd khh bry nfq dr rh llh fr khwndh myshwyd, ps b`Dy z shm bkhl mywrzd, w hrkhs bkhl wrzd, jz yn nyst khh br khwyshtn bkhl wrzydh st, w llh bynyz st w shm (hmh) fqyr (w nyzmnd)yd, w gr rwy bgrdnyd (llh) grwhy dygr r bjy shm myawrd, angh anh mnnd shm nkhwhnd bwd.
bh rsty m bry tw (ftH w) pyrwzy ashkhry mqrr khrdhym. [mrd z yn ftH w pyrwzy SlH Hdybyh st. (tfsyr bn khthyr).]
t llh gnh gdhshth w ayndhy tw r bymrzd, w n`mtsh r br tw tmm khnd, w bh rh rst hdytt nmyd.

w khsy st khh dr dlhy mw'mnn armsh nzl khrd, t ymny br ymnshn byfzynd, w sphyn asmnh w zmyn z an llh st, w llh dny Hkhym st.
t (srnjm) mrdn w znn mw'mn r bh bGhyy (z bhsht) wrd khnd, khh nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, jwdnh dr anj khwhnd bwd, w t gnhnshn r z anh bzdyd (w bbkhshd) w yn nzd llh khmyby bzrgy st.

w (nyz) mrdn w znn mnfq w mrdn w znn mshrkh r khh bh llh gmn bd mybrnd, `dhb khnd, Hwdth ngwr w bd br ann bd, w llh br anh khshm grfth, w anh r l`nt khrdh, w jhnm r bry anh amdh skhth st, w chh bd jyghy st.

t (shm y mrdm) bh llh w pymbrsh ymn bywryd w (dyn) wr yry khnyd, w w r bzrg dryd, w bmdd w shmgh w r tsbyH gwyyd.

bygmn khsnykhh b tw by`t mykhnnd, jz yn nyst khh b llh by`t mykhnnd, dst llh bly dst anhst, ps hrkhs khh pymn shkhny khnd, tnh bh zyn khwdsh pymn shkhsth st, w hrkhs bh anchh khh br an b llh `hd bsth wf khnd, bzwdy pdsh `Zymy bh w khwhd dd. [mrd z yn by`t, byt rDwn st khh dr rwz Hdybyh zyr drkhty njm grft. (tfsyr bn khthyr).]

bh zwdy bz mndgn z `rb (bdyhnshyn, `dhr awrdh w) bh tw (y pymbr) mygwynd: <<(nghdry) mwl w zn w frzndnmn m r bh khwd mshGwl dsht, (w ntwnstym dr sfr Hdybyh hmrh shm bshym) ps bry m Tlb amrzsh khn>> anh b zbnhy khwd chyzy mygwynd khh dr dlhy anh nyst, bgw: <<chh khsy mytwnd dr brbr llh z shm df` khnd, gr dr Hq shm zyny bkhwhd w y dr Hq shm nfy bkhwhd?! blkhh llh bh anchh njm mydhyd agh st>>.
blkhh shm gmn brdyd khh pymbr (llh) w mw'mnn hrgz bh swy khnwdhy khwysh bz nkhwhnd gsht, w yn (gmn) dr dlhy shm zynt yfth bwd, w gmn bd brdyd, w qwmy hlkh shdh (w nbwd) gshtyd.

frmnrwyy asmnh w zmyn z ani llh st, hr khh r bkhwhd myamrzd, w hr khh r bkhwhd `dhb mykhnd, w llh amrzndhy mhrbn st.

hngmykhh bh swy Gnym (khybr) Hrkht nmwdyd t anh r brgyryd, bzmndgn (Hdybyh) khwhnd gft: <<bgdhryd m (nyz) dr py shm byyym>>. anh mykhwhnd khlm llh r tGyyr dhnd, (y pymbr) bgw: <<hrgz z py m nyyyd, yn chnyn llh z pysh frmwdh st>>. ps anh khwhnd gft: <<(nh) blkhh, shm bh m Hsdt mywrzyd>>. blkhh (Hqyqyt yn st khh) jz ndkhy dr nmyybnd.

(y pymbr,) bh bz mndgn z `rb (bdyh nyshn) bgw: <<bh zwdy frkhwndh myshwyd bh swy qwmy skht jngjw (w nyrwmnd) khh b anh nbrd khnyd, y slm bywrnd, ps gr T`t khnyd, llh pdsh nykhy bh shm mydhd, w gr srpychy khnyd hmn gwnh khh pysh z yn srpychy khrdyd, shm r bh `dhby drdnkh `dhb mydhd>>.

br nbyn gnhy nyst, w br lng (nyz) gnhy nyst, w br bymr (hm) gnhy nyst, (gr ynh dr jhd shrkht nkhnnd). w hrkhs z llh w rswlsh T`t nmyd, w r dr bGhyy (z bhsht) wrd myszd khh nhrh z zyr (drkhtn) an jry st, w hr khs khh srpychy khnd bh `dhby drdnkh w r `dhb mykhnd.
bh rsty llh z mw'mnn - hngmykhh zyr drkht b tw by`t khrdnd- khshnwd shd, ps anchh khh dr drwn dlhy shn bwd dnst, ldh armsh r br anh nzl khrd w pyrwzy (w ftHy) nzdykh r bh anh pdsh dd.
w (hmchnyn) Gnymthy frwny khh an r bh dst myawrdnd, w llh pyrwzmnd Hkhym st.
